text: Sa report sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), nakasaad nga nakuha sa operasyon ang kapin 350 grams sang suspected shabu.
english: According to the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), more than 350 grams of suspected shabu were recovered from the suspect.

text: Una nga nakabakal ang police poseur buyer sang isa ka sachet, kag natigayon nga nakuha sa possession ang 25 ka plastic sachets kag apat ka knot-tied plastic sachets.
english: The police poseur buyer first bought one sachet, and managed to recover 25 plastic sachets and four knot-tied plastic sachets.

text: Suno kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, Chief sang CDEU, duha ka semana ang nangin monitoring sang pulis antes natigayon ang drug buy bust.
english: Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, chief of the CDEU, said the police monitored the suspects for two weeks before the drug buy bust was conducted.

text: Nakumpirma man nga naga-operate ang mga ini sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: It was also confirmed that they operate in Iloilo City and province.

text: Gin-ako naman sang mga arestado nga nagagamit sila sang iligal nga droga apang ginapanginwala nga nagabaligya ang mga ini.
english: The suspects admitted to using illegal drugs but denied selling them.

text: Igatugyan ang nakumpiskar nga illegal drug items sa PNP Iloilo City Forensic Unit, samtang gintugyan naman sa Police Station 4 ang mga arestado para sa nagakaigo nga disposisyon sang ila kaso.
english: The seized illegal drug items will be handed over to the PNP Iloilo City Forensic Unit, while the arrested were handed over to Police Station 4 for proper disposition of their cases.

text:
‘NEVER AGAIN’

Sa statement naman ni Mayor Jerry Treñas, gindayaw sini ang pamunuan sang ICPO sa idalom ni City Director PCOL Kim Legada kag ang CDEU sa idalom ni Inot sa isa na naman ka madinalag-on nga operasyon.
english:
‘NEVER AGAIN’

In a statement, Mayor Jerry Treñas commended the leadership of the ICPO under City Director PCOL Kim Legada and the CDEU under Inot for another successful operation.

text:
Yari ang statement:

“I extend my highest commendation to the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), under the direct supervision of City Director PCOL Kim Legada, for their relentless efforts in combating illegal drugs.
english:
Here is the statement:

“I extend my highest commendation to the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), under the direct supervision of City Director PCOL Kim Legada, for their relentless efforts in combating illegal drugs.

text: The successful buy-bust operation conducted today at 7th Street, Lawaan Village, Brgy.
english: The successful buy-bust operation conducted today at 7th Street, Lawaan Village, Brgy.

text: Balantang, Jaro, Iloilo City, which led to the arrest of two High-Value Individuals (HVIs) and the confiscation of approximately 350 grams of suspected shabu valued at P2.38 million, is a testament to their dedication to keeping Iloilo City safe from the dangers of illegal drugs.
english: Balantang, Jaro, Iloilo City, which led to the arrest of two High-Value Individuals (HVIs) and the confiscation of approximately 350 grams of suspected shabu valued at P2.38 million, is a testament to their dedication to keeping Iloilo City safe from the dangers of illegal drugs.

text: I especially recognize the outstanding work of the ICPO City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), led by PCPT Ryan Christ C. Inot and PLT Joelie John M. Bandojo, in collaboration with RPDEU 6 operatives and PDEG SOU6 intelligence operatives.
english: I especially recognize the outstanding work of the ICPO City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), led by PCPT Ryan Christ C. Inot and PLT Joelie John M. Bandojo, in collaboration with RPDEU 6 operatives and PDEG SOU6 intelligence operatives.

text: This operation sends a clear message—our city will NEVER AGAIN tolerate illegal drug activities.
english: This operation sends a clear message—our city will NEVER AGAIN tolerate illegal drug activities.

text: We remain steadfast in our mission to protect every Ilonggo family and uphold the law.
english: We remain steadfast in our mission to protect every Ilonggo family and uphold the law.

text: To the brave men and women of our law enforcement units, thank you for your service and dedication to the people of Iloilo City.”#
english: To the brave men and women of our law enforcement units, thank you for your service and dedication to the people of Iloilo City.”#

text: Ginkumpirma ni US President Joe Biden nga ang apat ka tuig nga bata nga babayi nga si Abigal Edan amo ang labing-una nga American hostage nga ginhilway sang Hamas militants halin sang nakasugtan sang grupo kag sang Israel nga magpatigayon sang apat ka adlaw nga ceasefire.
english: US President Joe Biden confirmed that four-year-old Abigal Edan is the first American hostage released by Hamas militants since the group and Israel agreed to a four-day ceasefire.

text: Kabahin si Edan sang 17 ka hostages nga ginbuy-an sang militante nga grupo sa ikatatlo nga adlaw sang truce.
english: Edan was among the 17 hostages released by the militant group on the third day of the truce.

text: Suno kay Biden, tuman ka daku nga trauma ang gina-agyan sang bata bangud nasaksihan sini kun paano ginpatay sang Hamas ang iya iloy sang Oktubre 7 sang aga sang nagsalakay ang militante nga grupo sa Southern Israel.
english: Biden said the child is going through a lot of trauma because he witnessed how Hamas killed his mother on the morning of October 7 when the militant group attacked Southern Israel.

text: Sunod nga nagdalagan ang bata sa iya amay, apang sang ulihi, napatay man ang amay sini bangud gingamit sini ang iya lawas agud matabunan ang iya bata.
english: The boy next ran to his father, but later, his father was also killed because he used his body to cover his son.

text: Sa subong, yara na ang bata sa Israel apang wala sang detalye nga ginhatag kun kamusta ang kondisyon sini.
english: The child is currently in Israel but no details were given on his condition.

text: Suno pa kay Biden, maga-istorya siya kay Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu kag nagalaum nga indi ini ang katapusan sang temporaryo nga ceasefire.
english: Biden said he will talk to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and hopes this is not the end of the temporary ceasefire.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni US national security adviser Jake Sullivan nga 4th birthday pa ni Edan sang nagligad lamang nga adlaw ukon sang tion nga ginabihag pa ini sang Hamas sa Gaza.
english: Earlier, US national security adviser Jake Sullivan said Edan's 4th birthday was just the other day or when he was still being held captive by Hamas in Gaza.

text: Nahibaluan nga pagkatapos sang kumpirmasyon nga na-release na si Edan, may 10 pa ka Americans nga nagapabilin nga missing sa amo nga gyera sa Middle East.
english: It is known that after the confirmation that Edan has been released, there are still 10 Americans who remain missing in the war in the Middle East.

text: Sa una nga adlaw sang ceasefire, 24 ka hostages ang ginbuy-an (13 ka Israeli kag 11 ka foreign nationals lakip ang isa ka Pinoy caregiver) samtang sa ikaduha nga adlaw naman, 17 ang ginhilway (13 ka Israelis kag apat ka foreign nationals).
english: On the first day of the ceasefire, 24 hostages were released (13 Israelis and 11 foreign nationals including a Filipino caregiver) while on the second day, 17 were released (13 Israelis and four foreign nationals).

text: Pagasayluhon na sa Negros Island Region (NIR) si Dr. Ramir Uytico nga nagapangalagad subong bilang director sang Department of Education (DepEd) Western Visayas.
english: Dr. will be transferred to the Negros Island Region (NIR). Ramir Uytico who is currently serving as director of the Department of Education (DepEd) Western Visayas.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Uytico sa iya Facebook page, kun sa diin nakasaad man nga ang mangin officer in charge assistant regional director sa amo nga rehiyon amo si Negros Occidental Schools Division Superintendent Anthony Liobet.
english: Uytico confirmed this on his Facebook page, which also stated that the officer in charge assistant regional director in the region will be Negros Occidental Schools Division Superintendent Anthony Liobet.

text: Sa iya post, nagpasalamat ang nasambit nga Education official kay DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara, Undersecretary Peter Irving Corvera, kag Undersecretary Wilfredo Cabral sa pagsalig nga ihatag sa iya ang pagdumala sa hanay sang edukasyon sa bag-o lang natukod nga rehiyon.
english: In his post, the said Education official thanked DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara, Undersecretary Peter Irving Corvera, and Undersecretary Wilfredo Cabral for entrusting him with the leadership of education in the newly formed region.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini sa mga lideres sang Negros Occidental sa paghatag sang rekomendasyon nga siya ang ibutang sa pwesto.
english: He also thanked the leaders of Negros Occidental for recommending that he be appointed.

text: Naghatag man si Uytico sang mensahe sa Western Visayas nga ginabansagan “Home of the Champions.” Pahayag sini, indi man siya perpekto, apang ang sigurado amo nga nagserbe siya sa rehiyon nga puno sang dedikasyon kag integridad.
english: Uytico also gave a message to Western Visayas called “Home of the Champions.” He said he is not perfect, but what is certain is that he served the region with dedication and integrity.

text: Kun balikan, nangin regional director si Uytico sang DepEd 6 sang Pebrero 2021.
english: Uytico became regional director of DepEd 6 in February 2021.

text: Sa idalom sang iya pagdumala sa Rehiyon Vi, lakip sa talalupangdon nga hinimuan amo ang Learning Continuity Plan sang tion nga may COVID-19 pandemic; Literacy and Numeracy Roadmap; uniform/simultaneous release sang sweldo sang mga manunudlo; reconciliation sang records sang DepEd-6 employees nga nangin problema sang naglinigad nga tinuig; Quality Management System; kag School Heads Academy.
english: Under his leadership in Region Vi, among the notable achievements are the Learning Continuity Plan during the COVID-19 pandemic; Literacy and Numeracy Roadmap; uniform/simultaneous release of teachers’ salaries; reconciliation of records of DepEd-6 employees that became a problem last year; Quality Management System; and School Heads Academy.

text: Sa bag-o sini nga obligasyon, covered sang rehiyon ang Negros Occidental, Negros Oriental, kag ang Siquijor lakip na ang highly-urbanized city sang Bacolod.
english: With its new obligation, the region covers Negros Occidental, Negros Oriental, and Siquijor including the highly-urbanized city of Bacolod.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, ang magabulos bilang director sa Western Visayas amo si OIC RD Cristito Eco sang National Capital Region kag magapabilin naman bilang OIC ARD si Dr. Miguel Mac D. Aposin.
english: According to initial information, OIC RD Cristito Eco of the National Capital Region will take over as director in Western Visayas while Dr. Miguel Mac D. Aposin.

text: Ginahulat pa ang order sang DepEd Central Office kun san-o mangin epektibo ini nga assignments.#
english: The order of the DepEd Central Office on when these assignments will be effective is still awaited.

text: Ginahanda na sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) ang ila nga technical divers agud ipadala sa Taal Lake agud magsugod sang ‘search kag retrieval operation’ matapos ang impormasyon nga gina-alegar nga didto ginlubong ang bangkay sang nadula nga manugbulang.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) is preparing its technical divers to be sent to Taal Lake to begin a search and retrieval operation following information that the body of the missing fisherman was allegedly buried there.

text: Suno kay PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan, ginmanduan na niya ang Coast Guard Special Operations Force nga makipag-angut sa Department of Justice (DOJ), National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), kag Philippine Navy agud makabulig nga ma-beripika ang report nga didto sa lake ang nagkaladula nga cockfighters.
english: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan said he has directed the Coast Guard Special Operations Force to liaise with the Department of Justice (DOJ), National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), and Philippine Navy to help verify reports that the missing cockfighters were in the lake.

text: Matandaan nga ginbuyagyag sang isa ka akusado nga ginpatay kag ginalubong ang mga manugbulang sa sulod sang Taal Lake.
english: It can be recalled that one of the accused revealed that the healers were killed and buried inside Taal Lake.

text: Wala naman ginpangalanan ang mga responsable sa krimen, apang ginasiling nga posible nga sobra pa sa 100 ka manugbulang ang ginpatay, kag indi lang 34 nga amo ang una nagguwa sa inisyal nga reports.
english: Those responsible for the crime were not named, but it is said that more than 100 healers may have been killed, and not just the 34 that initially appeared in initial reports.

text: Ginkumpirma naman ni Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla nga na-istorya na niya ang lalaki nga nagbulgar sini nga alegasyon.
english: Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla confirmed that he has spoken to the man who exposed the allegation.

text: Nangayo man ang tiglikom sang dugang nga tyempo agud maplastar nila ang development sa sini nga mga kaso.
english: The secretary also asked for more time to lay out the development in these cases.

text: Matandaan nga nadula ang mga manugbulang sa tunga-tunga sang Abril 2021 tubtob Enero 2022.
english: It can be recalled that the intermediaries went missing between April 2021 and January 2022.

text: Halin sila sa nagkalain-lain nga mga lugar sa Laguna, Batangas, Manila, kag Bulacan.#
english: They are from various places in Laguna, Batangas, Manila, and Bulacan.

text: Nabun-an sa sulod sang presuhan sa Arizona, USA si Derek Chauvin, isa ka former police officer sa Minneapolis, Minnesota nga kilala nga nagpatay sa Black American nga si George Floyd.
english: Derek Chauvin, a former police officer in Minneapolis, Minnesota who was known to have killed Black American George Floyd, was stabbed inside a prison in Arizona, USA.

text: Ginpahayag nga nakaluwas man si Chauvin sa amo nga insidente apang ginsaylo sa ospital agud nga mapadayon ang pagbulong.
english: Chauvin also reportedly survived the incident but was transferred to the hospital for further treatment.

text: Wala na sang iban pa nga preso nga napilasan kadungan sang hitabo.
english: No other inmates were injured during the incident.

text: Matandaan nga sang Abril 2021, na-convict si Chauvin sa kaso nga second-degree unintentional murder, third-degree murder kag second-degree manslaughter.
english: It can be recalled that in April 2021, Chauvin was convicted of second-degree unintentional murder, third-degree murder and second-degree manslaughter.

text:
via CNN

Ginsentensyahan ini sang tubtub 22 ka tuig kag tunga nga pagkapreso.
english:
via CNN

He was sentenced to up to 22 and a half years in prison.

text: Nangin bantog ang kaso sang amo nga pulis bangud kun matandaan, sang Mayo 25, 2020, siyam ka minutos sini nga ginluhudan ang liog ni Floyd matapos nga nag-responde ang mga pulis sa report nga naggamit ang biktima sang peke nga $20 sa corner store sa Minneapolis.
english: The policeman's case became famous because, on May 25, 2020, he knelt on Floyd's neck for nine minutes after police responded to a report that the victim used a fake $20 bill at a corner store in Minneapolis.

text:
Ginposasan pa ang 46-anyos nga biktima sang amo nga tion, ginduot ang nawong sa duta, kag nangin popular man ang sulit-sulit sini nga apelar nga “I can’t breathe.”

Ang amo nga hitabo ang nagpa-igrab sang tuman ka daku nga protesta batok sa racial injustice sa bilog nga Amerika kag mangin sa iban nga pungsod.
english:
The 46-year-old victim was even handcuffed at the time, pressed face down, and her repeated appeal “I can’t breathe” also became popular.

The incident sparked massive protests against racial injustice across America and abroad.

text: Gin-harass na naman sang China Coast Guard (CCG) ang mga barko sang Pilipinas nga yara sa Panatag Shoal sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The China Coast Guard (CCG) has again harassed Philippine ships in the Panatag Shoal in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Suno kay Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea (WPS) Jay Tarriela, naggamit ang barko sang China sang water cannon batok sa mga barko sang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR).
english: According to Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea (WPS) Jay Tarriela, the Chinese ship used a water cannon against the ships of the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR).

text: Natabo ini 10:00 kahapon sang aga sang ginpadala ang mga barko nga BRP Datu Tamblot, BRP Datu Taradapit, BRP Datu Bankaya, kag BRP Datu Daya agud magpanagtag sang fuel subsidies sa mga manugpangisda nga Pinoy.
english: This happened at 10:00 am yesterday when the ships BRP Datu Tamblot, BRP Datu Taradapit, BRP Datu Bankaya, and BRP Datu Daya were sent to distribute fuel subsidies to Filipino fishermen.

text: Suno kay Tarriela, nagpalapit kag naghimo sang agresibo nga maneuver ang CCG-4203 sa BRP Datu Taradapit sang ulihi, nagbomba pa ini sang tubig.
english: According to Tarriela, CCG-4203 approached and made an aggressive maneuver at BRP Datu Taradapit and later pumped water.

text: Apisar sang water cannon attack nga nag-igo sa port quarter sang BRP Datu Taradapit, nakapalayo ang vessel sang Pilipinas kag nalikawan ang mas daku nga halit.
english: Despite the water cannon attack that hit the port quarter of BRP Datu Taradapit, the Philippine vessel managed to get away and avoided further damage.

text: Gin-target man sang water cannon sang CCG-3105 ang BRP Datu Tamblot apang wala ini naigo.
english: The water cannon of CCG-3105 also targeted BRP Datu Tamblot but missed.

text: Sa amo nga operasyon, nakit-an man sa area ang anum ka CCH vessels, duha ka People’s Liberation Army (PLA) Navy warships, kag madamo nga Chinese maritime militia vessels.
english: During the operation, six CCH vessels, two People's Liberation Army (PLA) Navy warships, and several Chinese maritime militia vessels were also found in the area.

text: Nagapati si Tarriela nga didto ang Chinese vessels agud balabagan ang BFAR sa iya pagpanghatag sang subsidiya.
english: Tarriela believes that the Chinese vessels are there to obstruct the BFAR in its distribution of subsidies.

text: Nagpanindugan ang Philippine Coast Guard nga wala sang ginlapas ang BFAR vessels bangud naglayag sila sa teritoryo nga sulod sa Exclusive Economic Zone sang Pilipinas kag nagsunod man sa Philippine Maritime Zones Act, United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), kag sa 2016 Arbitral Award.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard insisted that the BFAR vessels did not violate anything because they sailed in the territory within the Exclusive Economic Zone of the Philippines and also complied with the Philippine Maritime Zones Act, the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), and the 2016 Arbitral Award.

text: Nagbisita ang rapid response team sang Philippine Embassy sa mga Pilipino nga nawad-an sang puluy-an matapos nag-igo ang missile nga ginpalupad sang Iran sa syudad sang Bnei Brak sa Israel.
english: The rapid response team of the Philippine Embassy visited Filipinos who lost their homes after an Iranian-launched missile hit the city of Bnei Brak in Israel.

text: 16 ka mga Pinoy ang nagatinir sa flat apang isa lamang sa ila ang yara didto sang natabo ang pagsigabong.
english: 16 Filipinos were staying in the flat but only one of them was there when the fire broke out.

text: Suno sa embahada, maswerte lang nga nakaluwas ini kag wala nasamaran bangud nakahingagaw ini sulod sa bomb shelter ukon sa mamad.
english: According to the embassy, ​​he was lucky to survive and was not injured because he managed to escape inside the bomb shelter or the mamad.

text: Sa subong, temporaryo lang anay nga nagapuyo sila kaupod sa ila nga mga amo kag mga abyan.
english: For now, they are temporarily living with their employers and friends.

text: Lakip naman sa gindala sang embassy amo ang bugas, groceries, kag hygiene products.
english: Among the items brought by the embassy were rice, groceries, and hygiene products.

text: Ginpasalig man sang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) nga makapangita sila sang bag-o nga apartment.
english: The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) also assured that they will be able to find a new apartment.

text: Subong nga gab-i sang ginbatak sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) sa Level 3 ang crisis alert level 3 sa Iran kag Israel nga nagakahulugan ang voluntary repatriation nga ipatuman gilayon.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) tonight raised the crisis alert level 3 in Iran and Israel to Level 3, which means voluntary repatriation will be implemented immediately.

text: Sandig sa data sang gobyerno, may yara sang 30,000 ka mga Pinoy sa Israel kun sa diin kadam-an ang nagatrabaho bilang caregivers; samtang masobra naman sa 1,100 sa Iran.#
english: According to government data, there are 30,000 Filipinos in Israel, most of whom work as caregivers; while more than 1,100 in Iran.#

text: Pormal na nga magapungko subong nga adlaw bilang bag-o nga arsobispo sang Archdiocese of Jaro si Most Rev.
english: Most Rev. Fr.

text: Midyphil Bermejo Billones, D.D. bulos kay Most Rev.
english: Midyphil Bermejo Billones, D.D. replacing Most Rev.

text: Jose Romeo O. Lazo, D.D., Archbishop-emeritus of Jaro.
english: Jose Romeo O. Lazo, D.D., Archbishop-emeritus of Jaro.

text: Patigayunon ang Solemn Pontifical Mass with Rite of Canonical Installation sang bag-o nga arsobispo sa las 9:00 subong nga aga sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.
english: The Solemn Pontifical Mass with Rite of Canonical Installation of the new archbishop will be held at 9:00 this morning at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.

text: Matandaan nga si Billones ang gin-appoint ni Pope Francis kag gin-anunsyo ini sa Vatican kadungan sang kapiestahan ni Nuestra Señora Dela Candelaria ukon our Lady of Candles.
english: Billones was appointed by Pope Francis and announced at the Vatican during the feast of Our Lady of Candles.

text: Si Billones nga naga-edad 55-anyos amo na ang mangin ika-14 nga archbishop sang Jaro nga nagasakop sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo amo man sa probinsya sang Guimaras.
english: Billones, 55, will be the 14th archbishop of Jaro, which covers the city and province of Iloilo as well as the province of Guimaras.

text: Nabun-ag siya sa Panay, Capiz.
english: He was born in Panay, Capiz.

text: Nagtuon siya sang Philosophy sa St.
english: He studied Philosophy at St.

text: Vincent Ferrer Seminary sa Iloilo City kag Theology sa Loyola School of Theology sa Quezon City kun sa diin nakuha sini ang master’s degree sa amo man nga program.
english: Vincent Ferrer Seminary in Iloilo City and Theology at Loyola School of Theology in Quezon City where he obtained his master’s degree in the same program.

text: Na-ordenahan siya bilang pari sa Archdiocese of Jaro sang Oktubre 2, 1995 ukon halos tatlo ka dekada na ang nagligad.
english: He was ordained a priest in the Archdiocese of Jaro on October 2, 1995 or almost three decades ago.

text: Lain-lain man nga posisyon ang gintungdan sini sa simbahan lakip na ang pagpungko bilang personal secretary kanday Archbishop Alberto Piamonte kag Archbishop Angel Lagdameo.
english: He also held various positions in the church including serving as personal secretary to Archbishop Alberto Piamonte and Archbishop Angel Lagdameo.

text: Sang 2011, naangkon sini ang Doctorate in Theology halin sa Pontifical Gregorian University sa Roma.
english: In 2011, he earned a Doctorate in Theology from the Pontifical Gregorian University in Rome.

text: Sang Hulyo 2019, nagaserbe pa sadto si Billones bilang rector sang St.
english: In July 2019, Billones was still serving as rector of St.

text: Joseph Regional Seminary of Jaro sang gin-appoint siya sang Santo Papa bilang auxiliary bishop sang Cebu.
english: Joseph Regional Seminary of Jaro when the Pope appointed him as auxiliary bishop of Cebu.

text: Na-ordenahan siya sa episcopate sang Agusto 27, 2019 diri man sa Jaro Cathedral.
english: He was ordained to the episcopate on August 27, 2019 here at the Jaro Cathedral.

text: Ginbatak na sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) sa Level 3 ang crisis alert level sa Israel kag Iran.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) has raised the crisis alert level in Israel and Iran to Level 3.

text: Nagakahulugan ini nga may yara na sang voluntary repatriation nga matabo samtang nagapadayon ang baslanay sang bombahanay sang duha ka nasambit nga mga nasyon sa Middle East.
english: This means that there will be a voluntary repatriation as the two countries continue to fight each other in the Middle East.

text: Kadungan sini, nagpanawagan ang ahensya sa mga Pilipino nga ikonsiderar nga mag-avail sang ginatanyag sang gobyerno nga mapabalik sila sa Pilipinas.
english: Meanwhile, the agency called on Filipinos to consider availing of the government's offer to return them to the Philippines.

text: Sandig sa data sang gobyerno, may yara sang 30,000 ka mga Pinoy sa Israel kun sa diin kadam-an ang nagatrabaho bilang caregivers; samtang masobra naman sa 1,100 sa Iran.
english: According to government data, there are 30,000 Filipinos in Israel, most of whom work as caregivers; while more than 1,100 in Iran.

text:
Kadungan sini, nag-abiso man ang gobyerno nga, “Travel by Filipinos to both these countries is highly discouraged due to the ongoing crisis and the actual closure of their airspace and seaports.”

Para sa mga interesado nga magpauli, mahimo makontak ang embahada sang Pilipinas kun sa diin man sila nga pungsod.
english:
Meanwhile, the government also warned that, “Travel by Filipinos to both these countries is highly discouraged due to the ongoing crisis and the actual closure of their airspace and seaports.”

For those interested in returning home, the Philippine embassy can be contacted wherever they are.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa ka semana na ini nga baslanay sang missile strikes kag wala sang patimaan nga maga-untat sa labing madali nga tion.
english: It is known that the missile strikes have been going on for a week and there is no sign of stopping anytime soon.

text: Walo naman ka mga Pilipino sa Israel ang nalakip sa nasamaran kun sa diin isa ang nagapabilin sa kritikal nga kondisyon.
english: Eight Filipinos in Israel were among the injured, one of whom remains in critical condition.

text: As of press time, may 187 na nga naghingyo sang repatriation, kag sa sini nga numero, 26 ang naka-schedule na para sa first batch sang pagbiya sa Israel nga mahimo matabo sa masunod nga duha tubtub tatlo ka adlaw.#
english: As of press time, there are 187 who have requested repatriation, and of this number, 26 are scheduled for the first batch of departures from Israel which could take place in the next two to three days.

text: Nakahatag na sang initial report ang Schools Division of Iloilo kaangot sa manunudlo nga akwtal nga nakit-an nga nagagamit sang iligal nga druga sa Ajuy, Iloilo.
english: The Schools Division of Iloilo has already given an initial report regarding the teacher who was actually found using illegal drugs in Ajuy, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Leonil Salvilla, spokesperson, Schools Division of Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ginahulat na ang report gikan sa Ajuy National High School kon sa diin nagatudlo ang manunudlo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Leonil Salvilla, spokesperson, Schools Division of Iloilo, said they are waiting for the report from Ajuy National High School where the teacher teaches.

text: Suno kay Salvilla, nagaguwa sa information nga ginhatag sang kapulisan nga naghalin sa amo nga buluthuan ang manunudlo.
english: According to Salvilla, the information provided by the police shows that the teacher left the school.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga yara pa sa level of identifying ang talatapan agud masiguro ang identity sang manunudlo.
english: He also explained that the office is still at the level of identifying to ensure the identity of the teacher.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga kon ma-identify kag ma-endorso sa kapulisan, didto na sila mahatag sang nagakaigo nga tikang batok sa manunudlo.
english: He also said that if identified and endorsed to the police, they will take appropriate action against the teacher.

text: Hatagan man nila sang kahigayonan ang manunudlo agud nga maka-eksplekar sang iya nga kaugalingon.
english: They will also give the teacher the opportunity to explain himself.

text: Nagpaandam man ang talatapan nga indi nila pag-itolerar ang iligal nga buluhaton ilabi na nga nagaserbe nga ehemplo sa mga estudyante ang mga manunudlo.
english: The office also warned that they will not tolerate illegal activities especially as teachers serve as examples to students.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang pinal nga desisyon kon ano nga intervention ang posible idagdag sa manunudlo.
english: At this time, no final decision has been made on what intervention might be added to the teacher.

text: Nahibaluan nga tuig 2023 pa sang natabo ang amo nga aktwasyon sang maestro kag subong lang natukiban paagi sa paglapta sang video.
english: It is known that the teacher's action occurred in 2023 and was only recently discovered through the circulation of the video.

text: Nagpahanumdom sa mga local candidate ang Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC) nga ginadumilian ang pagpangampanya sa Maundy Thursday kag Good Friday sa tion sang Semana Santa.
english: The Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC) reminded local candidates that campaigning on Maundy Thursday and Good Friday during Easter is prohibited.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jonathan Sayno, Election Assistant Officer II sang City COMELEC, iya ginpahayag nga ang Abril 17 tubtob 18, 2025 ang isa ka balaan nga adlaw sa pag-obserba man sang Semana Santa sang simbahang-katolika.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jonathan Sayno, Election Assistant Officer II of the City COMELEC, said that April 17 to 18, 2025 is a holy day for the observance of Holy Week of the Catholic Church.

text: Suno kay Sayno, wala man dapat sang social media posting halin sa bahin sang mga kandidato apang, kon ang supporters mismo ang mag-post, react, and share sang content sang local candidate, mahimo gid nila ini nga ubrahon.
english: According to Sayno, there should be no social media posting from the candidates but, if the supporters themselves post, react, and share the content of the local candidate, they can do it.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga antes ang adlaw sang eleksyon kag adlaw mismo sang eleksyon sa Mayo 11 kag 12, 2025, ginadumilian man ang magpangampanya sa social media man ukon sa personal.
english: He also said that before the election day and the election day itself on May 11 and 12, 2025, it is also prohibited to campaign either on social media or in person.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang sin-o man ang indi magsunod sa amo nga mga pagsulundan ang magapangatubang sang kaso sa paglapas sa Comelec Resolution No.
english: Anyone who fails to comply with these rules will face charges of violating Comelec Resolution No.

text: 11086 ukon ang Republic Act No.
english: 11086 or Republic Act No.

text: 9006 ukon Fair Elections Act.
english: 9006 or Fair Elections Act.

text: Nag-abot na sa Jeddah, Saudi Arabia ang Gilas Pilipinas pila ka adlaw antes ang FIBA Asia Cup.
english: Gilas Pilipinas has arrived in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia a few days before the FIBA ​​Asia Cup.

text: Ini ang ginpakigbahin sang Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas sa ila social media accounts.
english: This was shared by the Philippine Basketball Association on their social media accounts.

text: Kalakip sa mga players amo sanday Calvin Oftana, Carl Tamayo, CJ Perez, Scottie Thompson, Dwight Ramos, Jamie Malonzo, Chris Newsome, Kevin Quiambao, AJ Edu, Japeth Aguilar, June Mar Fajardo, kag Justin Brownlee.
english: Among the players are Calvin Oftana, Carl Tamayo, CJ Perez, Scottie Thompson, Dwight Ramos, Jamie Malonzo, Chris Newsome, Kevin Quiambao, AJ Edu, Japeth Aguilar, June Mar Fajardo, and Justin Brownlee.

text: Makita man sa picture si Gilas Pilipinas head coach Tim Cone upod sa iya deputies nga sanday Jong Uichico, Richard Del Rosario, kag Sean Chambers.
english: Also pictured are Gilas Pilipinas head coach Tim Cone with his deputies Jong Uichico, Richard Del Rosario, and Sean Chambers.

text: Pagasuguran sang Pilipinas ang ila kampanya sa Agosto 6 batok sa Chinese Taipei antes atubangon ang New Zealand sa Agosto 7.
english: The Philippines will begin their campaign on August 6 against Chinese Taipei before facing New Zealand on August 7.

text: Ang Iraq ang mangin katapusan nga assignment sang Pilipinas sa group stage sa Agosto 9.
english: Iraq will be the Philippines' final assignment in the group stage on August 9.

text: Nasapwan ang isa ka Ilongga overseas Filipino worker (OFW) nga wala na sang kabuhi sa ginatiniran sini nga hulot sa Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
english: An Ilongga overseas Filipino worker (OFW) was found dead in his room in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.

text: Ini amo si Mary Jill Dela Cerna Muya, tumandok sang Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: This is Mary Jill Dela Cerna Muya, a native of Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay alias June, anay bana sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga naglapta ang pictures ni Mary Jill kun sa diin makit-an nga may busal ini sa baba kag may higot sa liog.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, alias June, the victim's ex-husband, said that pictures of Mary Jill were circulating where she was seen with a muzzle on her mouth and a rope around her neck.

text: Nagadapat man ang tiil sang biktima sa salog.
english: The victim's foot was also touching the floor.

text: Nagaguwa sa impormasyon suno sa pamilya nga nagpanginmatay si Mary Jill, apang nagapati sila nga may foul play sa hitabo.
english: According to the family, Mary Jill committed suicide, but they believe there was foul play in the incident.

text: Suno kay alias June, nakit-an man nila nga may lagob sa kamot sang biktima.
english: According to alias June, they also found a bruise on the victim's hand.

text: Nagdangop sila sa Bombo Radyo agud mabuligan nga mapapauli ang bangkay sini sa Iloilo.
english: They turned to Bombo Radyo for help in bringing his body back to Iloilo.

text: Pahayag sang pamilya, ginabanta duha ka dekada nga naga-trabaho sa luwas sang pungsod si Mary Jill.
english: According to the family, Mary Jill has been working abroad for about two decades.

text: “TNT” ang status sini subong, ukon ang termino sang mga Pilipino nga “tago nang tago” samtang naga-trabaho sa abroad.
english: “TNT” is its current status, or the Filipino term for “tago nang tago” while working abroad.

text: Base sa iya nga bata, nagabulig kun kaisa si Mary Jill sa pag-cater kun may mga okasyon.
english: According to her daughter, Mary Jill sometimes helps cater when there are occasions.

text: Sandig sa pamilya, nag-umpisa sila nga matingala sa sitwasyon sini matapos nga wala man ini nakapangamusta ukon nakapanamyaw sa iya bata sang Christmas.
english: According to the family, they began to wonder about her situation after she did not greet her child at Christmas.

text: “Nagapangayo kami sang bulig sa OWWA kag sa DFA nga makita na sang bata ko ang iya iloy nga dal-on diri sa Pilipinas,” panawagan ni Alias June.
english: “We are asking for help from OWWA and DFA so that my child can find his mother and bring her to the Philippines,” Alias ​​June appealed.

text: “Wala kami sang kontak didto, ang picture lang gid ang nagalapta,” suno pa sa iya.
english: “We have no contact there, only the picture is circulating,” he said.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sang bulig sa Iloilo City Government nga mapapauli ang bangkay apisar nga TNT ang status sang iya anay asawa.#
english: He also appealed to the Iloilo City Government for help to bring the body home despite the status of his ex-wife as TNT.

text: ISA LANG ang paagi agud indi ka matapikan sang makamamatay nga balatian nga COVID-19.
english: There is ONLY ONE way to avoid contracting the deadly disease COVID-19.

text: Likawan nga ma-infect ka sang SARS-CoV-2 virus!
english: Avoid getting infected with the SARS-CoV-2 virus!

text: Paano?
english: How?

text: Una, sunu sa mga health authorities mismo, amo ang pag-angkon sang suficiente nga ihibalo parti sa balatian nga ini kag kon paano ini maglapta, nga ginabuylugan gid sa pagpahibalo sa mga pumuluyo sang mga media outlet sa radyo, TV kag pamantalaan.
english: First, according to the health authorities themselves, is to gain sufficient knowledge about the disease and how it spreads, which is being cooperated in informing the public by media outlets on radio, TV and newspapers.

text: Makuha man ang COVID-19 virus halin sa infected nga tawo nga nagagwa sa iya baba kag ilong kon mag-ubo, mangatsi, maghambal, magkanta, ukon mag-ginhawa.
english: The COVID-19 virus can also be transmitted from an infected person's mouth and nose when they cough, sneeze, talk, sing, or breathe.

text: Angot sa sining mga impormasyon, masunod na ang bagay nga mga hilimuon sang mga health authorities agud padayon ma-proteksyonan na ang mga pumuluyo.
english: Based on this information, the appropriate actions will be taken by the health authorities to continue to protect the people.

text: Lakip diri ang isolation sang infected, pag-quarantine sang nagapakita sang mga sintoma, border control sa pagsulod kag pagwa sa mga  ginadilian nga mga lugar, kag ang iban pa nga bagay nga pagpangamlig.
english: This includes isolation of the infected, quarantine of those showing symptoms, border control of entry and exit from restricted areas, and other protective measures.

text: Nahangpan naton ining mga pagpangamlig.
english: We understand these safeguards.

text: Pagpaniguro ini sang ikaayong lawas sang komunidad.
english: This is to ensure the health of the community.

text: In fact, wala sing may mamalabag sini – “mandatory” man ini nga kinahanglan sa seryoso nga sitwasyon, ukon halog lang nga restriction kon indi gid man daku ang risgo nga ginaatubang.
english: In fact, no one would object to it – whether it is a “mandatory” requirement in a serious situation, or a mild restriction if the risk is not great.

text:
***

However, tungod sa importansya nga ginahatag naton sa kinamatarong sang tawo (universal human rights) nga gina-garantiya man sang aton Constitution, may mga bagay nga indi naton mabalewala.
english:
***

However, because of the importance we give to universal human rights guaranteed by our Constitution, there are things that we cannot ignore.

text: Katulad sang “right against discrimination” sang mga indi-bakunado sa pagsulod man nila sa mga mall kag public transport – nga ginaplano sang sini lang sang MMDA sa Metro Manila nga pasaran sing resolution nga may penalidad.
english: Like the “right against discrimination” of the unvaccinated in their entry into malls and public transport – which the MMDA in Metro Manila recently planned to pass a resolution with penalties.

text: Sa matuod, indi man ini dapat problemahon batok sa mga indi-bakunado, sunu sa RA 1132, nga nagasiling nga pwede man sila makagwa kon “healthy” sila kag nagapangamlig man pareho sang mga bakunado sunu sa health protocol.
english: In fact, this should not be a problem against the unvaccinated, according to RA 1132, which states that they can also go out if they are “healthy” and protected like vaccinated people according to health protocols.

text: In fact, gina-penalize sang RA 1194 (Bayanihan 2 Act) “any act of discrimination” kontra sa kon sin-o man nga tawo angot sa ginapatuman nga Covid-19 measures.
english: In fact, RA 1194 (Bayanihan 2 Act) penalizes “any act of discrimination” against any person in connection with the implementation of Covid-19 measures.

text: Gani, indi naton mahangpan ang kasubong nga mga lihok sang aton gobyerno.
english: Therefore, we cannot understand such actions of our government.

text:
***

Pero ano gid bala ang gina-problema sang aton gobyerno batok sa mga indi-bakunado nga kinahanglan istriktuhan gid ang ila panghulag?
english:
***

But what exactly is the problem with our government against the unvaccinated who need to be very strict?

text: Sa makita naton, may kahilabtanan diri ang “degree of risk” nga ginaatubang sang mga pumuluyo angot sa kahimtangan sang mga bakunado kag indi-bakunado.
english: As we can see, the degree of risk faced by the population regarding the status of the vaccinated and unvaccinated is involved.

text: Sunu sa mga pagtuon sa 14 ka estado sa US, ang unvaccinated (indi-bakunado) 4.9 times more likely nga malatnan sang COVID-19 kag 29 times more likely nga ma-ospital.
english: According to studies in 14 US states, the unvaccinated are 4.9 times more likely to contract COVID-19 and 29 times more likely to be hospitalized.

text: Sa mga kaso sang malatnan liwat (breakthrough cases), six times more likely nga malatnan liwat ang unvaccinated.
english: In breakthrough cases, the unvaccinated are six times more likely to be reinfected.

text: Sa kon ano ang likelihood sang pagpanglaton sang COVID-19 sang bakunado kag indi-bakunado, daw pareho man lang ugaling ang ikasarang nila sa pagpanglaton, sunu man sa sining mga health experts.
english: In terms of the likelihood of infection with COVID-19 between vaccinated and unvaccinated people, it seems that they have the same ability to infect, according to these health experts.

text: Nadiskubrihan sang mga health experts sa Vermont, U.S.A. nga amo-amo man ang kadamo (virla load) sang mga virus ang nagasulod sa ilong sang bakunado kag indi-bakunado.
english: Health experts in Vermont, U.S.A., have discovered that that the same number (virla load) of viruses enter the nose of vaccinated and non-vaccinated.

text: Pakita ini nga pareho man ang abilidad sang bakunado kag indi-bakunado sa pagpanglaton.
english: This shows that the vaccinated and unvaccinated are equally capable of transmission.

text: In other words, wala kanahan kon sin-o gid ang kahadlukan nga makapanglaton sang COVID-19 kay pareho man lang ila sang ikasarang sa pagpanglaton.
english: In other words, it doesn't matter who is afraid of contracting COVID-19 because they have the same ability to contract.

text: Ang problema lang amo ang risgo sang indi-bakunado agud malatnan, nga natumod na naton sa ibabaw.
english: The only problem is the risk of the un-vaccinated to get infected, which we have already touched on above.

text: Mapasugtan bala sang aton gobyerno ang ining risgo nga malatnan sa bahin sang indi-bakunado sa iya pag-amlig sa mga pumuluyo, samtang ang mas maluag nga panghulag sang mga tawo makabulig man gani sa aton ekonomiya?
english: Can our government tolerate this risk of infection on the part of the unvaccinated in its protection of citizens, while more free movement of people can also help our economy?

text: Kon ako lang, pwede ko risguhan ang exposure ko, kon indi ako bakunado kag indi pa senior citizen.
english: If I'm alone, I can risk my exposure, if I'm not vaccinated and not a senior citizen.

text: Diutay man lang ang nagakaigu sang “severe”kag “critical” nga kaso.
english: Few are considered “severe” and “critical” cases.

text: Kalabanan sini mga senior citizen.
english: Most of them are senior citizens.

text: Ang mga indi senior, kon maigu, mild kag “moderate” lang nga pwede matuod makarisgo sa pag-gwa agud makapangita sing palangabuhian.
english: Non-seniors, if affected, are mild and “moderate” and can really risk going out to earn a living.

text: Basta nagapangamlig man sunu sa health protocol, kag willing mag-submit sa RT-PCR ukon antigen test agud makasulod sa diin man nga building.
english: As long as you are protecting yourself according to health protocols, and willing to submit to RT-PCR or antigen test to enter any building.

text: Indi man kinahanglan ang permanante nga desisyon tungod indi man permanente ang lakat sang panglaton sang COVID-19.
english: There is no need for a permanent decision because the course of the COVID-19 pandemic is not permanent.

text: Kon sobra na ang pagsaka, hugton anay ang restriction kag luagan liwat kon magnubo tubtub sa “tolerable range of infection”.
english: If the increase is too high, the restriction will be tightened and relaxed if it drops to the tolerable range of infection.

text: Of course, kon indi sugot ang gobyerno pa-risguhon ang indi-bakunado, sigehon ta na gid lang anay seguro ang pagsagud sa mga apektado nga mga pumuluyo tubtub mabakunahan na ini sila./PN
english: Of course, if the government is not willing to risk the unvaccinated, let's just keep taking care of the affected people until they are vaccinated./PN

text: Nagahingyo sa Iloilo City Government ang mga bolantero sa Iloilo Terminal Market nga hatagan sila sang tyansa nga makabaligya.
english: The volunteers at the Iloilo Terminal Market are asking the Iloilo City Government to give them a chance to sell.

text: Ini kasunod sa isa ka video nga nagalapta sa karun sa social media kun sa diin makit-an nga nagpatigayon sang clearing operation kag ginpangkuha sang personnel sang Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) ang mga baligya sang mga bolantero sang gab-i sang Marso 6.
english: This follows a video that is currently circulating on social media where it can be seen that the personnel of the Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) conducted a clearing operation and took the goods of the volunteers on the night of March 6.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Juls, isa sa mga naga-bolante kag na-eksperyensyahan mismo ang natabo nga clearing operation, iya ginpahayag nga gulpyada lang nag-abot ang personnel sang LEEO kaupod ang katapo sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) sa lugar kag gilayon nagpatigayon sang clearing operation.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Juls, one of the volunteers who experienced the clearing operation, said that LEEO personnel suddenly arrived at the scene with members of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) and immediately conducted the clearing operation.

text: Suno kay Juls, wala sang ‘notice’ nga ginhatag sang ila ang LEEO kun sa diin ginpangkuha lang gilayon ang ila mga baligya pati ang ila nga kilohan.
english: According to Juls, the LEEO did not give them any notice and immediately took their goods and their scales.

text: Pahayag niya, nakuha ang duha ka sako sang kalabasa sang iya kaupdanan nga mag-asawa nga naga-bolante man sa lugar kun sa diin ginkarga ini sang LEEO kag gindala.
english: He said the two sacks of pumpkins were recovered by his couple who were also volunteering in the area where the LEEO loaded them and took them away.

text: Suno sa mga naga-bolante, ginpahayag sang personnel sang LEEO nga posible nga makuha ang ila baligya kag gawadon sa ila nga opisina.
english: According to the volunteers, the LEEO personnel said that it is possible to pick up their goods and redeem them at their office.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Juls nga nagalab-ot P1,000 tubtob P2,000 ang balor sang isa ka sako sang ila baligya kun ila ini gawadon.
english: Juls said the value of a sack of their goods is P1,000 to P2,000 when they sell it.

text: Dugang pa niya, antes sila magpwesto kag magbaligya ginasiguro nila nga sarado na ang merkado kag iya man ginklaro nga wala sila nagasinabad sa lugar kag ginatuyo lamang nga makabaligya agud maka-kwarta kag may ibuhi sa ila nga mga pamilya.
english: He added that before they set up and sell they make sure that the market is closed and he also clarified that they do not disturb the place and only intend to sell to earn money and support their families.

text: Words by: Bombo Krylle Melliza
english: Words by: Bombo Krylle Melliza

text: Nagpagwa sang pahayag ang Miss Universe Organization (MUO) kasunod sang mga huring-huring nga may ginbag-o sa liderato sang organisasyon.
english: The Miss Universe Organization (MUO) has released a statement following rumors that there has been a change in the leadership of the organization.

text: Ginpanginwala sang organisasyon ang mga report nga nagaangkon nga may ginbag-o sa ila executive structure.
english: The organization denied reports claiming that something had been changed in its executive structure.

text: Ginpahayag sang organisasyon nga si Anne Jakrajutatip ang padayon nga Chief Executive Officer (CEO) sang Miss Universe Organization, kag si Raúl Rocha ang padayon nga Presidente.
english: The organization announced that Anne Jakrajutatip will continue as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Miss Universe Organization, and Raúl Rocha will continue as President.

text: Dugang pa sa pahayag, ang mga ginapalapnag nga tsismis puro alegasyon kag wala sang kamatuoran, kag indi ini nagarepresentar sang matuod-tuod nga kahimtangan ukon direksyon sang organisasyon.
english: The statement added that the rumors spread are purely allegations and have no truth, and do not represent the true state or direction of the organization.

text: Ginpangabay sang MUO ang publiko kag mga media partners nga magasalig lamang sa ila opisyal kag verified nga mga information para sa husto nga impormasyon.
english: The MUO urged the public and media partners to rely only on their official and verified information for accurate information.

text: Sa padayon nga liderato nanday Ms. Jakrajutatip kag Mr. Rocha, ang Miss Universe Organization nagpasalig gihapon sa ila misyon nga hatagan sang gahum ang kababainhan sa bug-os nga kalibutan kag maghatag sang global platform para sa mga tingog sang ambisyon, katuyuan, kag kabag-uhan.
english: Under the continued leadership of Ms. Jakrajutatip and Mr. Rocha, the Miss Universe Organization remained committed to its mission to empower women around the world and provide a global platform for voices of ambition, purpose, and innovation.

text: Kadam-an sa mga kababainhan ang masami nga nagaeksperyensya sang dysmenorrhea — isa ka sintomas sang menstruation kaangay sang pagsakit sang pus-on.
english: Most women often experience dysmenorrhea — a menstrual symptom similar to abdominal pain.

text: Apang suno sa mga eksperto, ang simple nga pag-inom sang duga sang dahon sang bayabas ang makabulong sa intense menstrual cramps.
english: But according to experts, a simple drink of guava leaf juice can cure intense menstrual cramps.

text: Suno kay Dr. Mary Jane Brown, registered dietician sa United Kingdom, sandig sa isa ka pagtuon, adlaw-adlaw nga ginpainom sang 6 milligram sang guava leaf extract ang 197 ka mga babaye nga nagasuprer sang dysmenorrhea kag natukiban nga nakabulong ang duga sang bayabas sa ila ginabatyag nga sakit sa pus-on.
english: According to Dr. Mary Jane Brown, registered dietician in the United Kingdom, according to a study, 197 women suffering from dysmenorrhea were given 6 milligrams of guava leaf extract daily and found that guava juice cured their stomach pain.

text: Magluwas diri pahayag ni Brown, nagapa-improve man sang heart health ang dahon sang bayabas bangud manggaranon ini sa antioxidants kag vitamins.
english: Brown said guava leaves also improve heart health because they are rich in antioxidants and vitamins.

text: Dugang pa sang dietician, tuman ka bentaha sa ikaayong lawas ang masami nga pag-inom sang tea ukon juice nga himo sa dahon sang bayabas bangud nagapabuhin ini sang bad cholesterol kag nagapanubo sa blood pressure.
english: The dietician added that drinking tea or juice made from guava leaves is very beneficial to health because it reduces bad cholesterol and lowers blood pressure.

text: Magakit-anay sanday US President Joe Biden kag Chinese President Xi Jinping sa masunod nga semana kadungan sang tuigan nga meeting sang mga lider sa Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) economies sa California.
english: US President Joe Biden and Chinese President Xi Jinping will meet next week in conjunction with the annual meeting of leaders of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) economies in California.

text:
File: Kevin Lamarque/Reuters

Ini pa lamang ang ikaduha nga face-to-face meeting sang duha ka lideres halin sang nagpungko si Biden bilang presidente sang USA.
english:
File: Kevin Lamarque/Reuters

This is only the second face-to-face meeting between the two leaders since Biden took office as president of the USA.

text: Suno sa American officials, lakip sa mahimo istoryahan amo ang giyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas, ang tensyon sa Taiwan, kag ang pagpang-atake sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: According to American officials, among the topics that could be discussed are the war between Israel and Hamas, tensions over Taiwan, and Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.

text: Sa sini nga tuig, lakip sa mga isyu nga nagpaluya pa sang relasyon sang China kag Amerika amo ang pag-akusar sang US sa Beijing nga nagpalupad sang spy balloon — butang nga gintawag naman sang China nga isa lamang ka weather balloon kag “overacting” lamang ang Washington.
english: This year, among the issues that have further strained relations between China and the United States is the US accusation of Beijing of flying a spy balloon — something that China has called a weather balloon and Washington is “overacting”.

text: Ang isa pa ka mainit nga isyu amo ang pag-bisita ni anay Speaker Nancy Pelosi sa Taiwan, teritoryo nga gina-claim sang China.
english: Another hot issue is former Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s visit to Taiwan, territory claimed by China.

text: Ang amo nga pagbisita ang rason kun ngaa gin-utod sang China ang komunikasyon sang militar sang duha ka pungsod.
english: The visit was the reason why China cut off military communication between the two countries.

text: Naghatag sang direktiba Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) sa mga hepe sang probinsya nga nga i-monitor ang ila mga katapo ilabi na ang mga nagapartisipar sa iligal nga buluhaton.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) has issued a directive to the provincial chiefs to monitor their members especially those who participate in illegal activities.

text: Ini kasunod man sang reklamo batok sa isa ka patrolman nga ginapahayag nagpanghilo sang inugbulang nga manok sa Coliseo de Leganes sa Brgy.
english: This follows a complaint against a patrolman who allegedly poisoned a chicken at the Coliseo de Leganes in Brgy.

text: San Vicente, Leganes, Iloilo.
english: San Vicente, Leganes, Iloilo.

text: Natabo ini sang Sabado, Marso 29, kun sa diin ang involved nga personnel ang ginapahayag nga naka-assign sa Police Station 7 sa syudad.
english: The incident occurred on Saturday, March 29, when the involved personnel were reportedly assigned to Police Station 7 in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, Director sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga nakaistoryahanay na ang tag-iya sang manok nga ginhiluan kaupod ang pulis.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, Director of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said the owner of the poisoned chicken has already spoken to the policeman.

text: Suno kay Razalan, nakatalana nga maghilisugot ang duha ka kampo nga mag-areglohanay kag nakadependi na sa biktima kon batunon niya ini ukon indi.
english: According to Razalan, the two camps are scheduled to agree to settle and it is up to the victim whether to accept it or not.

english: According to the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), this happened while Filipino vessels were deploying 20 floating aggregate devices (FADs) in Hasa Hasa and Kanduli Shoals from Monday to yesterday, June 18.

text: Ini nga devices nga mas kilala nga payao amo ang ginagamit agud nga mas madamo nga isda ang mahulik.

english: The Filipino crew and radio operators responded calmly and professionally, and were successful in their maritime presence.

english: In the operation, among those who went to the West Philippine Sea were Filipino fishing boats, three PCG vessels, and two BFAR ships.

text: Sang Nobyembre 3, 1957, ginpadala sa space ang layaw nga ido nga si Laika paagi sa Soviet ship nga Sputnik 2.
english: On November 3, 1957, stray dog ​​Laika was launched into space by the Soviet ship Sputnik 2.

text: Tuyo sang amo nga flight nga i-test ang safety sang space travel para sa mga tawo.
english: The purpose of the flight is to test the safety of space travel for humans.

text: Apang sa malain nga palad para kay Laika, isa lamang ini ka one-way trip.
english: But unfortunately for Laika, it was only a one-way trip.

text: Suno sa reports, nakaluwas pa si Laika sa lima tubtub pito ka oras matapos ang liftoff apang napatay sang ulihi bangud sa panic kag overheating.
english: According to reports, Laika survived five to seven hours after liftoff but died later due to panic and overheating.

text: Si Laika ang ginakilala nga una nga living creature nga naka-orbit sa Earth.
english: Laika is recognized as the first living creature to orbit Earth.

text:
Photo by: Sputnik/Alamy

Ginapahayag nga sang ginpatigayon ang mission, ginsulod si Laika sa pressurised cabin kun sa diin siya pwede makahigda kag makatindog.
english:
Photo by: Sputnik/Alamy

During the mission, Laika was reportedly put in a pressurized cabin where she could lie down and stand up.

text: May yara man sang air regeneration system nga nag-provide sang oxygen, food, kag tubig nga na-dispense sa “gelatinised form.” May yara man nga ginbutang nga harness kay Laika, bag nga maka-collect sang waste, kag electrodes agud nga maka-monitor sang vital signs.
english: There was also an air regeneration system that provided oxygen, food, and water dispensed in “gelatinised form.” Laika was also fitted with a harness, a waste collection bag, and electrodes to monitor vital signs.

text: Sa pag-umpisa sang mission, ginapahayag nga nakulbaan na si Laika apang nagakaon man ini gihapon.
english: At the beginning of the mission, Laika is said to be nervous but she is still eating.

text: “There was no capability of returning a payload safely to Earth at this time, so it was planned that Laika would run out of oxygen after about 10 days of orbiting the Earth.
english: “There was no capability of returning a payload safely to Earth at this time, so it was planned that Laika would run out of oxygen after about 10 days of orbiting the Earth.

text: Because of the thermal problems she probably only survived a day or two,” suno sa report sang National Aeronautics and Space Administration ukon NASA.
english: Because of the thermal problems she probably only survived a day or two,” according to a report by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration or NASA.

text: Suno pa sa report sang Smithsonian Magazine, hinadlukan si Laika sa gahod kag pressure sang flight rason nga nagdasig ang heart rate kag quadrupled na ang iya nga breath rate.
english: According to a report in Smithsonian Magazine, Laika was frightened by the noise and pressure of the flight, which caused her heart rate to increase and her breathing rate to quadruple.

text: Ginreport man nga nakalab-ot nga buhi si Laika sa orbit kag nakalibot sa Earth sang ginabanta 103 minutes antes ini ginbawian sang kabuhi.
english: It was also reported that Laika made it to orbit alive and orbited the Earth for approximately 103 minutes before she passed away.

text: SIN-O SI LAIKA KAG NGAA SIYA ANG NAPILIAN?
english: WHO IS LAIKA AND WHY WAS SHE CHOSEN?

text: Isa ka layaw nga ido si Laika kag ginapahayag nga ginkuha lang gikan sa dalanon sa Moscow isa ka semana antes ang launch sang Sputnik 2.
english: Laika is a stray dog ​​and was reportedly just picked up from the street in Moscow a week before the launch of Sputnik 2.

text: Suno sa NASA, isa ka female part-Samoyed terrier si Laika nga ang original name amo ang Kudryavka (Little Curly).
english: According to NASA, Laika is a female part-Samoyed terrier whose original name was Kudryavka (Little Curly).

text: Sang ulihi, ginpangalanan ini nga Laika, ang panawag sa Russian para sa “Husky” ukon “Barker.” Sa Estados Unidos naman, gintawag siya nga “Muttnik.” Ginapahayag nga 6 kgs.
english: Later, it was named Laika, Russian for “Husky” or “Barker.” In the United States, he was called “Muttnik.” Claimed to be 6 kgs.

text: ang iya nga kabug-aton.
english: its weight.

text: Sandig sa report sang Associated Press, gin-promote ang ido sa cosmonaut (ukon ang term nga nagatumod sa astronaut sa Soviet ukon Russian space program) bangud sa iya kagamayon kag ‘calm’ demeanor.
english: According to an Associated Press report, the dog was promoted to cosmonaut (or the term referring to an astronaut in the Soviet or Russian space program) because of its small size and 'calm' demeanor.

text: Ginpili sang mission ang female dogs bangud ginakonsiderar sila nga “anatomically better suited” para sa close confinement.
english: The mission chose female dogs because they are considered “anatomically better suited” for close confinement.

text: Apang ngaa bala nga ginpili sang Soviet Union nga sapat ang ipadala sa Space?
english: But why did the Soviet Union choose to send an animal into Space?

text: Indi lang Soviet Union ang nag-eksperimento sa mga sapat.
english: The Soviet Union was not alone in experimenting on animals.

text: Antes natigayon nga mapadala ang mga tawo sa space, isa sa mga teorya ang nagasaad nga indi makaluwas ang mga tawo sang malawig nga period sang weightlessness.
english: Before it was possible to send humans into space, one of the theories promised that humans would not survive a long period of weightlessness.

text: Suno sa US space agency nga NASA, gingamit sang American kag Russian scientists ang sapat — kaangay sang amo, chimps, kag ido — agud ma-test ang abilidad sang ila pungsod nga maka-launch sang living organism sa space kag ibalik ini nga buhi kag wala sang halit.
english: According to the US space agency NASA, American and Russian scientists used the animal — similar to monkeys, chimps, and dogs — to test their country’s ability to launch a living organism into space and return it alive and unharmed.

text: Luyag sang Soviet rocket scientists nga ipadala ang mga ido sa space agud mahangpan ang microgravity kag ang iban pa nga aspeto kun ano ang mahimo sang spaceflight sa lawas sang tawo.
english: Soviet rocket scientists wanted to send dogs into space to understand microgravity and other aspects of what spaceflight can do to the human body.

text: Suno pa sa report sang NASA, dapat nga female ang contenders kag brightly colored agud nga maathag ang video footage.
english: According to the NASA report, the contenders should be female and brightly colored so that the video footage is clear.

text: Kun basehan naman ang report sang Smithsonian Magazine, ginpili sang rocket engineers ang sapat nga “most obedient and most tolerant of loud noises and air pressure changes” para sa experiment.
english: According to a report by Smithsonian Magazine, rocket engineers chose the animal "most obedient and most tolerant of loud noises and air pressure changes" for the experiment.

text: SI LAIKA BALA ANG UNA NGA SAPAT NGA GIN-EKSPERIMENTUHAN SA SPACE?
english: WAS LAIKA THE FIRST ANIMALS TO BE EXPERIMENTED IN SPACE?

text: Bisan si Laika ang ginakabig pinakabantog, indi siya ang una nga sapat nga naeksperimentuhan sang scientists.
english: Although Laika is considered the most famous, she was not the first animal to be experimented on by scientists.

text: Sang Pebrero 1947, naggamit ang Estados Unidos sang fruit flies sang may gin-launch man nga mission.
english: In February 1947, the United States used fruit flies when a mission was also launched.

text: Indi man si Laika ang una nga ido sa space.
english: Laika isn’t the first dog in space, either.

text: Antes pa sa iya, naka-launch na ang Soviet Union sa space sang duha ka ido nga sanday Dezik kag Tsygan sang 1951; apang sang amo nga tion, ang duha ka nasambit nga ido ang gingamit lamang sa sub-orbital launches.
english: Before him, the Soviet Union had launched into space two dogs Dezik and Tsygan in 1951; but at the time, the two aforementioned dogs were only used in sub-orbital launches.

text: Naka-launch man ang US sang rhesus monkeys, mice, fruit flies, kag rats sang second world war, samtang ang Soviets naman ang nag-develop sang ila nga V-2 kag Aerobee missile projects nga nagpadala naman sang rhesus monkeys.
english: The US also launched rhesus monkeys, mice, fruit flies, and rats during World War II, while the Soviets developed their V-2 and Aerobee missile projects that sent rhesus monkeys.

text: Sa kabug-usan, antes kay Laika, may 36 na ka mga ido nga ginpadala ang Soviet sa Space.
english: In total, before Laika, the Soviets had sent 36 dogs into Space.

text: Ginpasalig ni Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla nga siguruhon sini kag sang ahensya nga indi makapalagyo sa hustiya si anay Negros Oriental Rep.
english: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla assured that he and the agency will ensure that former Negros Oriental Rep.

text: Arnolfo Teves Jr.
english: Arnolfo Teves Jr.

text: apisar sang mga excuse nga iya ginahimo.
english: despite the excuses he makes.

text: Sang Martes, Hunyo 17, sang gindala si Teves sa Philippine General Hospital kag ginpaidalom sa operasyon agud makuha ang iya appendix kasunod sang report nga nagbatyag ini sang tuman nga pagpalanakit sang tiyan.
english: On Tuesday, June 17, Teves was taken to the Philippine General Hospital and underwent surgery to remove his appendix following reports that he felt severe abdominal pain.

text: Suno naman kay Remulla, siguruhon nila nga mabalik ini gilayon sa kun diin ini naka-detain.
english: Remulla said they will ensure that he is returned immediately to where he is detained.

text: “I will ensure that he will not escape justice and that he will not escape regardless of whatever excuses he may say,” pahayag sang tiglikom sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG).
english: “I will ensure that he will not escape justice and that he will not escape regardless of whatever excuses he may say,” the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) secretary said.

text: Hunyo 9 sang gindala si Teves sa Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) facility sa Camp Bagong Diwa sa Taguig City.
english: Teves was brought to the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) facility at Camp Bagong Diwa in Taguig City on June 9.

text: Ang BJMP isa ka attached agency sang DILG.
english: The BJMP is an attached agency of the DILG.

text: Nagpahayag naman ang abogado ni Teves nga si Atty. Ferdinand Topacio nga magapabilin anay ang former congressman sa ospital samtang nga naga-recover ini kasunod sang laparoscopic appendectomy.
english: Teves' lawyer, Atty. Ferdinand Topacio said the former congressman will remain in the hospital while he recovers following a laparoscopic appendectomy.

text: Samtang yara sa ospital, magapa-check man ang anay kongresista sa iya pre-existing conditions kaangay sang asthma kag problema sa korason.
english: While in the hospital, the former congressman will also get checked for his pre-existing conditions such as asthma and heart problems.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Teves ang napabalik sa Pilipinas halin sa Timor Leste kag subong nagapangatubang sang sampaw-sampaw nga mga kaso sang murder, frustrated murder, kag attempted murder lakip na ang ginaalegar pagpapatay sini kay anay Negros Oriental Gov.
english: Teves was returned to the Philippines from Timor Leste and is now facing multiple charges of murder, frustrated murder, and attempted murder including the alleged killing of former Negros Oriental Gov.

english: Roel Degamo and nine others.

text: Nagmandu na ang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) sang matul-id nga imbestigasyon sa isa ka patrolman nga ginareklamo nga nagpanghilo sang inugbulang nga manok sa Coliseo de Leganes sa Brgy.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) has ordered a thorough investigation into a patrolman who allegedly poisoned a chicken at the Coliseo de Leganes in Brgy.

text: San Vicente, Leganes, Iloilo.
english: San Vicente, Leganes, Iloilo.

text: Natabo ini sang Sabado, Marso 29, kun sa diin ang involved nga personnel ang ginapahayag nga naka-assign sa Police Station 7 sa syudad.
english: The incident occurred on Saturday, March 29, when the involved personnel were reportedly assigned to Police Station 7 in the city.

text: Suno kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang ICPO, kumpirmado nga didto ang presensya sang pulis, apang sa verification sa hepe, wala sang sanctioned ukon lehitimo nga operasyon ang police unit sa bulangan sang amo nga tion.
english: According to Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the ICPO, it was confirmed that the police presence was there, but in verification with the chief, the police unit did not have a sanctioned or legitimate operation in the bulangan at that time.

text: Ginsulit ni Sangrines ang zero-tolerance policy sang ICPO batok sa anuman nga porma sang illegal gambling kag misconduct sang mga katapo sang pulisya.
english: Sangrines reiterated the ICPO's zero-tolerance policy against any form of illegal gambling and misconduct by police personnel.

text: Kun mapamatud-an sa mga ebidensya suno kay Sangrines, ipasaka ang kaso-administratibo batok sa patrolman.
english: If proven by the evidence, Sangrines said, an administrative case will be filed against the patrolman.

text: Sa pagpakig-angot sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain General Enrique Robles, hepe sang Leganes Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga gin-turn over sa ICPO ang pulis samtang pending ang pre-charge investigation.
english: Police Captain General Enrique Robles, chief of the Leganes Municipal Police Station, said the policeman was turned over to the ICPO pending pre-charge investigation.

text: Suno kay Robles, gin-report ini sa ila sang alas dies sang gab-i sang Sabado kag gindala man ang tag-reklamo kag ang tropa sa police station.
english: Robles said the incident was reported to them at 10 pm on Saturday and the complainant and the troop were also taken to the police station.

text: Base sa separado nga impormasyon, wala nag-ako ang pulis sa pagpanghilo, apang nakita sa closed circuit television footage nga nagabalik-balik ang pulis sa inugbulang nga manok, tubtub nga nagpalangluya ini suno sa tag-iya.
english: Based on separate information, the policeman did not admit to poisoning, but closed circuit television footage showed the policeman repeatedly hitting the chicken, until it became weak, according to the owner.

text:
MODELS OF INTEGRITY

Sa press statement nga ginpaguwa sang ICPO, ginsiling ni Director Police Colonel Kim Legada nga nagmandu na ini sa mga unit commander nga istrikto nga i-monitor ang ila nasakpan nga mga personnel.
english:
MODELS OF INTEGRITY

In a press statement issued by the ICPO, Director Police Colonel Kim Legada said it has already ordered unit commanders to strictly monitor their personnel.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga wala sang itolerar nga involvement sa illegal gambling ukon kaangay man nga aktibidad.
english: He said no involvement in illegal gambling or similar activities will be tolerated.

text: “We will enforce discipline and, if warranted, file appropriate charges,” suno kay Legada.
english: “We will enforce discipline and, if warranted, file appropriate charges,” Legada said.

text: Ginpahanumdom man sini sa police officers nga mangin ehemplo sa pagsunod sa layi: “Law enforcers must be role models of integrity.

text: Nanginwala si former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque nga ginbasura sang Netherlands ang iya nga aplikasyon para sa asylum.
english: Former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque denied that the Netherlands rejected his asylum application.

text: Pahayag ni Roque, confidential nga bagay ang iya nga asylum bid, kag kun may desisyon man ang gobyerno kaangot diri, siya kag ang Dutch government lamang ang makahibalo.
english: Roque said his asylum bid is a confidential matter, and if the government makes a decision on it, only he and the Dutch government will know.

text: Dugang niya, wala sang database nga kuhaan sang anuman nga update kaangot sa iya nangin petisyon.
english: He added that there is no database to get any updates regarding his petition.

text: Ginplastar man sini nga uniform ang procedure sa asylum application sa bilog nga kalibutan, kag nakahibalo siya sini bangud may nauyatan man siya anay nga kaangay sini nga mga kaso sang diri pa siya sa Pilipinas.
english: He also laid out the uniform procedure for asylum applications around the world, and he knows this because he had handled similar cases when he was here in the Philippines.

text: Ini nga pahayag ni Roque ang kasunod sang statement ni Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla nga gin-deny sang Netherlands ang iya application kag yara na ini subong sa Germany.
english: Roque's statement follows Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla's statement that the Netherlands denied his application and he is now in Germany.

text: Dugang sang Justice official, kun ma-kanselar na ang passport ni Roque, mahimo ini nga “undocumented alien” kag pagadakpon sang International Criminal Police Organization ukon Interpol.
english: The Justice official added that if Roque's passport is cancelled, he will become an “undocumented alien” and will be arrested by the International Criminal Police Organization or Interpol.

text: Sa statement naman nga gin-release ni Roque, nagpahayag ini nga nagbyahe siya sa Germany matapos na-imbitahan sang mga Pinoy kun sa diin nagpanguna siya sa oathtaking ceremony sang mga myembro sang “Hakbang ng Maisug Germany.” Pahayag sini, nakabalik na siya subong sa The Hague.
english: In a statement released by Roque, he said he traveled to Germany after being invited by Filipinos where he led the oathtaking ceremony of members of the “Hakbang ng Maisug Germany.” He said he is now back in The Hague.

text: Nahibaluan nga may standing arrest warrant si Roque diri sa Pilipinas kaangot sa kaso nga qualified human trafficking nga gin-file sang DOJ bangud sa ginaalegar nga kaangtanan sini sa iligal nga operasyon sang Philippine offshore gaming operator (Pogo) kag ginaalegar nga scam hub nga Lucky South 99 sa Porac, Pampanga.
english: Roque has a standing arrest warrant in the Philippines in connection with a case of qualified human trafficking filed by the DOJ for his alleged involvement in the illegal operation of the Philippine offshore gaming operator (Pogo) and the alleged scam hub Lucky South 99 in Porac, Pampanga.

text: Indi na maka-operate ang naga-isahanon nga cancer treatment hospital sa Gaza Strip bangud nawad-an na ini sang fuel sa ikaapat nga semana sang gyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas militants.
english: The only cancer treatment hospital in the Gaza Strip can no longer operate because it has run out of fuel in the fourth week of the war between Israel and Hamas militants.

text: Ginkumpirma ini sang director sang Turkish-Palestinian Friendship Hospital nga si Subhi Skaik kag ginsegundahan man ni Palestinian Health Minister Mai al-Kaila.
english: This was confirmed by the director of the Turkish-Palestinian Friendship Hospital Subhi Skaik and also seconded by Palestinian Health Minister Mai al-Kaila.

text:
Photo: Reuters

Suno pa sa statement sang health ministry, nabutang sa alang-alang ang kabuhi sang 70 ka pasyente nga may cancer.
english:
Photo: Reuters

According to a statement from the health ministry, the lives of 70 cancer patients are at risk.

text: Sa kabug-usan suno pa sa talatapan, 16 na sa 35 ka mga ospital sa Strip ang wala nagagana.
english: In total, the office said, 16 of the 35 hospitals on the Strip are not working.

text: “The number of cancer patients in the Gaza Strip is about 2,000 living in catastrophic health conditions as a result of the ongoing Israeli aggression on the Strip and the displacement of a large number,” pahayag ni al-Kaila.
english: “The number of cancer patients in the Gaza Strip is about 2,000 living in catastrophic health conditions as a result of the ongoing Israeli aggression on the Strip and the displacement of a large number,” al-Kaila stated.

text: Oktubre 7 sang gin-atake sang Hamas ang southern Israel nga nagpatay sang 1,400 ka mga tawo.
english: It was Oct. 7 when Hamas launched an attack on southern Israel that killed 1,400 people.

text: Sunod nga nagtimalos ang Israel paagi sa pagdeklarar sang gyera, pagpaidalom sa Strip sa total siege, pagpatigayon sang air strikes kag ground operation.
english: Israel subsequently retaliated by declaring war, subjecting the Strip to total siege, conducting air strikes and ground operations.

text: Suno sa health ministry sa Palestine, 8,796 ka Palestinians lakip na ang 3,648 ka mga kabataan ang napatay bangud sa amo nga pagpang-atake sang Israel.#
english: According to the Palestinian health ministry, 8,796 Palestinians, including 3,648 children, were killed in the Israeli attack.

text: Nadumduman mo bala ang Navy veteran sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga amo ang nangin ikaduha nga tawo sa bug-os nga kalibutan nga madinalag-on nga nasayluhan sang korason sang baboy?
english: Remember the Navy veteran in the United States of America who became the second person in the world to have a successful pig heart transplant?

text: Ginkumpirma mismo sang University of Maryland Medical Center nga nagtaliwan siya sang Oktubre 30 — anum ka semana pagkatapos sang maragtason nga operasyon.
english: The University of Maryland Medical Center itself confirmed that he passed away on October 30 — six weeks after the historic surgery.

text: Ang pasyente amo si Lawrence Faucette, 58-anyos nga residente sang Frederick, Maryland nga nakabaton sang amo nga organ sang baboy sang Septyembre 20.
english: The patient is Lawrence Faucette, a 58-year-old resident of Frederick, Maryland who received that pig organ on September 20th.

text: “We mourn the loss of Mr. Faucette, a remarkable patient, scientist, Navy veteran, and family man who just wanted a little more time to spend with his loving wife, sons, and family,” suno kay Dr. Bartley P. Griffith nga amo ang nag-perform sang transplant.
english: “We mourn the loss of Mr. Faucette, a remarkable patient, scientist, Navy veteran, and family man who just wanted a little more time to spend with his loving wife, sons, and family,” according to Dr. Bartley P. Griffith who performed the transplant.

text:
Photo: University of Maryland-School of Medicine

Nahibaluan nga antes pa man ang operasyon, indi na pwede si Faucette sa human heart transplant bangud sa iya malala nga medical conditions lakip na ang peripheral vascular disease.
english:
Photo: University of Maryland-School of Medicine

It was learned that even before the operation, Faucette was not eligible for human heart transplant due to his serious medical conditions including peripheral vascular disease.

text: Sang nasaylo naman sa iya ang korason sang baboy, naggana ini sa nauna nga mga inadlaw, apang sang ulihi nagpakita na sang senyales sang rejection.
english: When the pig's heart was transplanted, it worked for the first few days, but later showed signs of rejection.
