text: Madumduman nga una na nga ginpahayag sang Navy veteran nga ginkapyutan niya ang gamay kaayo nga tyansa sa xenotransplant kag wala gid siya nagsala sa desisyon bangud kasunod sang madinalag-on nga procedure, maka-ginhawa na siya sang maayo, matalunsay na ang pitik sang iya korason, kag naga-gana ini nga wala nagakinahanglan sang supportive device.
english: It can be recalled that the Navy veteran earlier said that he took the very small chance of xenotransplant and he did not make a mistake in the decision because after the successful procedure, he can breathe well, his heart beats smoothly, and it works without the need for a supportive device.

text: Ang operasyon kay Faucette ang ginpangunahan sang mga eksperto kag mga doktor halin sa University of Maryland School of Medicine– ang team nga nagpatigayon man sang labing-una nga transplant sang korason sang baboy sa tawo sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Faucette's surgery was led by experts and doctors from the University of Maryland School of Medicine– the team that also conducted the first-ever pig-to-human heart transplant last year.

text: Sang amo nga tion, duha ka bulan pa nga nagkabuhi ang 57-anyos nga pasyente nga si David Bennett matapos ang transplant apang napatay man bangud maluya na nga daan ini antes pa man ang operasyon.
english: At the time, 57-year-old patient David Bennett lived two months after the transplant but also died because he was already weak before the operation.

text: Ang xenotransplant sa USA amo ang ginalantaw nga makahatag sang solusyon sa chronic shortage sang human organ donations.
english: Xenotransplant in the USA is therefore expected to provide a solution to the chronic shortage of human organ donations.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa subong, masobra 100,000 ka Americans ang nagahulat para sa organ transplants.
english: Currently, more than 100,000 Americans are waiting for organ transplants.

text: Nagbisita si Speaker Martin Romualdez sa haya sang ginluthang-patay nga opisyal sang Kamara nga si Director Mauricio Pulhin.
english: Speaker Martin Romualdez visited the funeral of slain House of Representatives Director Mauricio Pulhin.

text: Personal nga nagpalab-ot sang pakig-unong si Romualdez sa pamilya ni Pulhin nga nagserbi nga Technical Staff Chief sang House Committee on Ways and Means.
english: Romualdez personally extended his condolences to the family of Pulhin, who served as Technical Staff Chief of the House Committee on Ways and Means.

text: Suno kay Speaker kaupod sang bilog nga institusyon sa pagpangita sang hustisya sa pagkamatay sang opisyal.
english: Speaker said the entire institution is united in seeking justice for the death of the officer.

text: Ginpakigbahin man ni Romualdez nga si Pulhin, isa ka mahipuson apang mapisan nga propesyunal nga nagaserbi sa Kamara nga may tampad nga intensyon.
english: Romualdez also shared that Pulhin, is a quiet but hard-working professional who serves the House with honest intentions.

text: Indi mag-untat ang Kamara asta nga indi mahibaluan kag mapasabat ang yara sa likod sang pagpangluthang sa nasambit nga opisyal.
english: The House will not rest until those behind the shooting of the said officer are identified and held accountable.

text: Ginkumpirma sang mga pulis nga naghimo na sang Special Investigation Team nga magapanguna sa kaso kag gin-review na ang CCTV footage kadungan sang forensic analysis kag pakig-estorya sa mga testigo.
english: Police confirmed that a Special Investigation Team has been formed to lead the case and the CCTV footage has been reviewed along with forensic analysis and interviews with witnesses.

text: Nagapanawagan naman si Romualdez sa mga otoridad nga magapatigayon sang madalom nga inbestigasyon
english: Romualdez called on the authorities to conduct a thorough investigation

text: Gintumod sang Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC) nga may mga nabaklas sila nga illegally posted nga tarpaulins sa syudad kadungan sang imbukada nga adlaw sang local campaign period sang 2025 midterm elections.
english: The Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC) has identified illegally posted tarpaulins in the city during the opening day of the local campaign period of the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Jonathan Sayno, Election Assistant II sang City COMELEC, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa mga napangbaklas amo ang campaign materials nga wala nagasunod sa mga propaganda nga nakasaad sa pagsulundan sang talatapan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Jonathan Sayno, Election Assistant II of the City COMELEC, said that among the rejected were campaign materials that did not comply with the propaganda stipulated in the office's rules.

text: Suno kay Sayno, kaupod ang regional office sang COMELEC, naglibot sila sa syudad kag nagsugod halin sa Bonifacio Drive padulong sa Gen.
english: According to Sayno, together with the regional office of the COMELEC, they went around the city and started from Bonifacio Drive to Gen.

text: Luna St.
english: Luna St.

text: La Paz, sa Buhang kag Tabuc Suba Jaro.
english: La Paz, in Buhang and Tabuc River Jaro.

text: Sa ila paglibot, ginpahayag sini nga may mga tarpaulins man sang national candidate ang ila nga nakuha.
english: During their tour, he said they also seized tarpaulins of the national candidate.

text: Gin-ako man sang natungdan nga may mga barangay pa sa syudad nga tubtob subong wala pa nakakadtuan agud sekyaron kon may mga illegally posted nga campaign materials.
english: He also acknowledged that there are still barangays in the city that have not yet been visited to check for illegally posted campaign materials.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa mga kandidato nga mahimo magbutang sang ila campaign posters sa designated area nga may sukol nga 2 feet by 3 feet nga kasangkaron.
english: He also advised candidates to put up their campaign posters in the designated area with a size of 2 feet by 3 feet.

text: Lakip na man sa rekisitos ang pagbutang sang ‘paid for by’ sa tagsa ka poster.
english: The requirement also includes putting a 'paid for by' on each poster.

text:
Kun naga-apply gani ikaw sa trabaho, masami nga hambalan ka sang imo prospective employer nga “hulat ka lang sa update ha, basi sa masunod semana ah.”

Indi gani silingan ka nga, “Don’t call us, we’ll call you.”

Sa masami, wala na nagaabot ina nga update, kag daw halangpon naman kun ano ang resulta sang imo application kun amo sina ang matabo.
english:
When you apply for a job, your prospective employer will often tell you, “Just wait for the update, maybe next week.”

Don’t even tell you, “Don’t call us, we’ll call you.”

Often, that update doesn't come, and it's a bit unclear what the results of your application will be if that happens.

text:
Apang may isa ka babaye nga madugay gid nga naghulat sa sabat sang employer, kag siling gani nila, “better late than never.”

Nag-abot ang reply sa iya, apang lima ka dekada man ang nagligad.
english:
But there was one woman who waited a long time for the employer's response, and as they say, “better late than never.”

The reply came to him, but also five decades later.

text: Ang babaye amo si Tizi Hodson, isa ka 70-anyos nga Lola nga naga-istar sa Lincolnshire county sa England.
english: The woman is Tizi Hodson, a 70-year-old Grandmother who lives in Lincolnshire county in England.

text: Sang 1976, nagpadala siya sang sulat sa isa ka kumpaniya agud mag-apply bilang motorcycle stunt rider.
english: In 1976, he sent a letter to a company to apply as a motorcycle stunt rider.

text: Adlaw-adlaw niya nga ginalantaw kun may sabat na sa iya sulat, apang nalipatan na lang niya ang iya dream job, wala gid nag-abot ang reply.
english: Every day he checked for a reply to his letter, but he forgot about his dream job, the reply never came.

text: Tubtub subong nga 2024, amo na lang ang iya kakibot nga ginbalik sa iya ang iya nga application letter nga may yara pa sang isa ka handwritten note.
english: Until 2024, he was surprised when his application letter was returned to him with a handwritten note.

text: Sa amo nga note nakasiling nga late delivery ang sulat bangud nakit-an ini nga nakabutang lang sa drawer.
english: The note said the letter was late delivery because it was found lying in a drawer.

text: Na-amaze gid si Tizi sa amo nga reply, apang wala siya nakahibalo kun sin-o ang nagbalik sang sulat.
english: Tizi was amazed by the reply, but she did not know who returned the letter.

text: Wala man siya nakahibalo kun paano siya natultulan bangud pahayag sini, halos 50 ka beses na siya nagsaylo sang ilistaran kag apat tubtub lima ka pungsod na ang iya natiniran.
english: He does not know how he was found because he said he has moved almost 50 times and has lived in four to five countries.

text: Sang mga tinuig nga wala gid siya nakabaton sang reply sa iya application bilang motorcycle stunt rider, nag-apply siya sa iban nga trabaho kag nakapangabuhi man bilang snake handler, horse whisperer, aerobatic pilot kag nangin flying instructor.
english: During the years when he never received a reply to his application as a motorcycle stunt rider, he applied for other jobs and also made a living as a snake handler, horse whisperer, aerobatic pilot and became a flying instructor.

text: Ginbalikan man sini ang tyempo nga arisgada gid siya nga mangin stunt rider kag wala man sini ginpahibalo sa aplikasyon nga babaye siya, bangud suno sa iya, gusto gid kuntani niya nga ma-interview kag nagpromisa pa siya nga wala siya sang labot bisan pila ka beses pa siya nga mabalian sang tul-an basta mabaton lang siya sa trabaho.
english: She also recalled the time when she was very risky to become a stunt rider and did not announce in the application that she was a woman, because according to her, she really wanted to be interviewed and she promised that she did not care how many times she broke her bones as long as she was accepted.

text: “If I could speak to my younger self, I would tell her to go and do everything I’ve done.
english: “If I could speak to my younger self, I would tell her to go and do everything I’ve done.

text: I’ve had such a wonderful time in life, even if I have broken a few bones,” pahayag ni Tizi.#
english: I’ve had such a wonderful time in life, even if I have broken a few bones,” said Tizi.#

text: INDI kumporme si Pedro, nga aton abyan, sa panawagan ni BongBong Marcos nga mag-“unite” ang mga pumuluyo agud mapadaug siya sa eleksyon sa Mayo 2022.
english: Pedro, our friend, does not agree with BongBong Marcos' call for the people to “unite” to win him the May 2022 elections.

text: “Ano kami mga esklabo nga sunud-sunuran lang sa ila amo!” siling gani ni Pedro.
english: “What are we slaves who obey their masters!” said Peter.

text: Kon matabo ini paagi sa ila manggad kag pamahog, daw katulad lang kuno ini sadtong pagpasunod ni Diktador Marcos sa mga pumuluyo sa iya luyag paagi lang sa pag-alsa sang kamot agud indi ka makabalibad sa kahadlok.
english: If this happens through their wealth and threats, it will be like Dictator Marcos making the people do what he wants just by raising your hand so that you cannot refuse in fear.

text: “I-disqualify na gid lang bala ini sang Comelec!” panugyan gani ni Pedro.
english: “Will the Comelec just disqualify it!” Peter even suggested.

text: Sa nahibal-an na sang kadam-an, may disqualification (DQ) case ini si BongBong Marcos nga gin-file sa Comelec sang madamo nga grupo tungod sa indi pagbayad sini sang income tax halin sadtong 1982 tubtub 1985.
english: As is well known, BongBong Marcos has a disqualification (DQ) case filed with the Comelec by many groups for not paying income tax from 1982 to 1985.

text: In fact,napamatud-an ini sang husgado tubtub sa Court of Appeals.
english: In fact, this has been proven by the court up to the Court of Appeals.

text: Ginbaton na gani sini ang iya kasal-anan kag wala na mag-apelar pa sa Korte Suprema agud indi na madugangan ang iya sentensya.
english: He even pleaded guilty and did not appeal to the Supreme Court to avoid increasing his sentence.

text: Butang ta pa nga malutsan niya ining iya DQ case, although nagapati ang madamo nga mga abogado, lakip na ang retirado kag nangin Acting Supreme Court Justice Antonio Carpio, nga ma-disqualify gid siya sang Comelec.
english: Let's say he passes his DQ case, although many lawyers, including retired and former Acting Supreme Court Justice Antonio Carpio, believe that he will be disqualified by the Comelec.

text: Ti, sa ano gid bala nga mga bagay nga dapat mag-“unite” ang mga pumuluyo agud padag-on siya sa eleksyon?
english: Well, on what exactly should the people “unite” to win him the election?

text: Okey ina ang pagpanawagan sang isa ka kandidato – ukon bisan sin-o man gani – nga mag-ugyon ang mga pumuluyo kon kaayuhan man lang ang katuyuan sini.
english: It is okay for a candidate – or anyone else – to call for the people to agree if the purpose is good.

text: Bag-o ugaling mag-ugyon ang kon ano man nga grupo sang mga pumuluyo sa iya panawagan, kinahanglan hibaluon ta anay kon paano niya ini matigayon sa aton Hilway kag Demokrasyahanon nga pangabuhi.
english: However, before any group of people agrees to his call, we must first know how he can achieve it in our Free and Democratic life.

text: Una sa tanan, indi lang sa lider, kundi, nga mas importante, sa matarong nga kawsa nga mapasugtan sang mga pumuluyo sa ila hilway nga pamensaron.
english: First of all, not just to the leader, but, more importantly, to the righteous cause that the people can agree to in their free minds.

text: Indi kay paagi sa tatlo ka G – guns, goons and gold – nga masami gamit sang mga dynastiya nga sobra ang kwarta kag may private army, katulad sang pagkilala sang madamo sa Marcos family.
english: Not through the three Gs – guns, goons and gold – often used by dynasties that have too much money and private armies, as many recognize in the Marcos family.

text: Ikaduha, dapat siya ang may pinaka-mabungahon gid nga hingyo para sa mga pumuluyo.
english: Second, he must have the most fruitful request for the people.

text: Imposible!
english: Impossible!

text: Butang ta pa nga wala sing pilian ang mga botante sa ginatanyag nga mga program del gobierno.
english: Suppose voters have no choice in the programs offered by the government.

text: So, sa Ikatatlo nga rason, kinahanglan tan-awon gid anay sang mga pumuluyo ang klase sang pagkatawo sang mga kandidato.
english: So, in the third reason, the people must first look at the kind of personality of the candidates.

text: Sin-o gid bala sa ila ang may mas matarong, ukon “less evil”, nga pagkatawo?
english: Which of them really has a more righteous, or “less evil”, nature?

text: Partikular sa kay BBM, matarong bala ang pagkatawo sini kag masaligan agud itib-ong ang kaayuhan sang mga pumuluyo?
english: Particularly in BBM, is he righteous and trustworthy to promote the welfare of the people?

text: “indi!” siling ni Pedro.
english: "No!" said Peter.

text: Kwestyonable kuno ang pagka-honesto ni BBM.
english: BBM's honesty is said to be questionable.

text: In fact, “found guilty” siya sa indi pagbayad sang iya mga buhis halin sadtong 1982 tubtub 1985, samtang wala sini nga problema ang iya mga kasumpong.
english: In fact, he was found guilty of not paying his taxes from 1982 to 1985, while his opponents did not have this problem.

text: Kabahin man siya, bilang eredero nga wala man lang sing reklamo sa ill-gotten wealth sang iya mga ginikanan, nga napamatud-an sang Korte Suprema, nga ang tanan wala pa mabawi sang gobyerno, nga wala man ang iya mga kasumpong sing kasubong nga isyu.
english: He is also part, as an heir without a single claim to his parents’ ill-gotten wealth, which the Supreme Court has proven, all of which has not been recovered by the government, which his opponents have no similar issue.

text: Nahadlok man si Pedro sa pamatasan nga natun-an ni BBM halin sa iya sobra ambisyoso nga amay, nga samtang matapos na ang iya pagpungko sa poder sadtong 1973 sunu sa kasuguan, gin-medyosan gid niya nga mapabilin sa poder paagi sa martial law.
english: Pedro is also afraid of the behavior that BBM learned from his overly ambitious father, who, while his term in power in 1973 was legally over, tried to stay in power through martial law.

text: In fact, sunu gani kay anay Defense Secretary Juan Ponce Enrile, gin-peke lang ang pag-ambush sa iya para tagaan rason ang martial law.
english: In fact, according to former Defense Secretary Juan Ponce Enrile, the ambush on him was faked to justify martial law.

text: Sobra na man kuno kadugay ang ila pamilya sa poder, nga halos tanan sila na ang hari sa Ilocos Norte tubtub karon.
english: Their family has been in power for so long, that almost all of them are the kings of Ilocos Norte until now.

text: Balik naman gani sila sa pila ka pwesto nasyonal kag luyag pa mag-presidente liwat.
english: They are even back in some national positions and want to be president again.

text: “Pabusla man ang iban ay!” siling ni Pedro.
english: “Let the others replace it!” said Peter.

text: Nahadlok man si Pedro sa matabo kon magdaug si BBM.
english: Pedro is also afraid of what will happen if BBM wins.

text: Na-intuan na gani kuno si Presidente Duterte agud kilalahon nga baganihan si Diktador Marcos.
english: President Duterte has even been taught to recognize Dictator Marcos as a hero.

text: Gani, gaduda si Pedro nga kon magdaug ini, madula na ang tanan nga legasiya sang gindaug naton nga Demokrasya.
english: Therefore, Pedro suspects that if it wins, all the legacy of our won Democracy will be lost.

text: Madula na ang Edsa Shrine.
english: The Edsa Shrine will be gone.

text: Madula ang ngalan ni Ninoy sa NAIA.
english: Ninoy's name will disappear from the NAIA.

text: Madula man nawong nanday Ninoy kag Cory sa P500 bill kag basi ibulos pa si Diktador Marcos.
english: Ninoy and Cory will also lose their faces in the P500 bill and maybe Dictator Marcos will be replaced.

text: Segurado nga ligwaton man sini ang kasaysayan sa tulun-an sang mga kabataan agud malimtan na ang kalainan sang martial law.
english: It will also surely change history in children's books so that the evils of martial law will be forgotten.

text: “Huwag po!”/PN
english: “Don’t!”/PN

text: Isa ka bag-o  nga negosyo ang ginatutukan subong sa Western Visayas, ang pagpadamo sang crayfish, freshwater nga klase sang ”ulang”, nga may mataas nga market value kag demand sa lokal kag internasyonal nga merkado.
english: A new business is now being focused on in Western Visayas, the breeding of crayfish, a freshwater species of ”ulang”, which has a high market value and demand in the local and international markets.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Seth Borbon sang Clawseth Aquafarm kag isa ka young farmer, ginpahayag niya nga nagsugod siya sang iya journey sa crayfish farming sang tuig 2023.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Seth Borbon of Clawseth Aquafarm and a young farmer, he said he started his journey in crayfish farming in the year 2023.

text: Suno sa iya, bag-o pa lang ini nga industriya diri sa Pilipinas kag gamay pa lang ang mga supplier subong, rason nga ginakabig ini nga oportunidad para sa mga bag-o nga negosyante.
english: He said that this industry is still new in the Philippines and there are few suppliers now, which is why it is considered an opportunity for new entrepreneurs.

text: Ginpabutyag ni Mr. Borbon nga freshwater ang crayfish kag pwede ini mapadamo sa mga artificial ponds ukon sa mga drum-based nga set-up nga ginadisenyo para sa controlled environment.
english: He expressed that Mr. Borbon freshwater crayfish and can be bred in artificial ponds or drum-based set-ups designed for a controlled environment.

text: Ginagamit nila ang biofloc technology kag aeration system para masiguro ang limpyo nga tubig kag maayo nga pagtubo sang crayfish.
english: They use biofloc technology and aeration system to ensure clean water and good crayfish growth.

text: May mga sensor man sila nga naga-monitor sang temperatura kag pH level sang tubig.
english: They also have sensors that monitor the temperature and pH level of the water.

text: Ginsugid man niya nga importante ang pagtuon sang basic aquaculture kag pagkuha sang training halin sa mga eksperto para masiguro ang kalampusan sang proyekto.
english: He also explained that it is important to learn basic aquaculture and get training from experts to ensure the success of the project.

text: Ginahingyo niya ang mga kabataan nga may interes sa agrikultura nga magtan-aw sang posibilidad sa aquafarming bilang isa ka sustainable nga negosyo.
english: He urges children with an interest in agriculture to look at the possibility in aquafarming as a sustainable business.

text: Suno kay Mr. Borbon, ang mensahe niya sa mga naga-pangita sang bag-o nga oportunidad amo nga indi na kinahanglan maghalin pa sa pungsod para magpangabuhi, pwede na magsugod sang negosyo sa uma gamit ang teknolohiya.
english: According to Mr. Borbon, his message to those looking for new opportunities is that they don't have to leave the country to make a living, they can start a farm business using technology.

text: Nakabaton sang warning ang tatlo ka nightclub sa syudad matapos wala sang mga ini ma-comply ang kumpleto nga pagproseso sang 2026 business permit antes ang ginhiwat nga inspeksyon sang mga otoridad.
english: Three nightclubs in the city received warnings after they failed to comply with the complete processing of the 2026 business permit before the inspection conducted by the authorities.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Nestor Canong, head sang Task Force on Moral and Values Formation (TFMVF), iya ginpahayag nga ginpahibalo na ang mga establisyemento sa una pa lang nga kinahanglan updated kag na-renew ang ila business permit, apang wala sang mga ini ma-comply ang final requirement sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Nestor Canong, head of the Task Force on Moral and Values ​​Formation (TFMVF), said the establishments were informed earlier that their business permits need to be updated and renewed, but none of them complied with the final requirement.

text: Suno kay Canong, ginarequire nga i-renew sang mga negosyo ang ila permit kada tuig agud masiguro nga nagasunod ang mga ini sa mga regulasyon sang local government.
english: According to Canong, businesses are required to renew their permits every year to ensure that they comply with local government regulations.

text: Dugang pa ni Canong nga obligasyon ini sang mga negosyante bilang ila fair share sa komunidad.
english: Canong added that this is the obligation of the businessmen as their fair share to the community.

text: Ginpabutyag man sini nga dapat asikasuhon sang mga establisyemento ini nga requirement bisan gamay ukon dalagko man ang ila negosyo.
english: He also stressed that establishments should take care of this requirement whether their business is small or large.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag man ni Canong nga nangin makanay-kanay ang pagbalik sang night life sa siyudad sang Iloilo halin sang Disyembre tubtob subong nga Marso.
english: Meanwhile, Canong said the return of night life in Iloilo City has been gradual since December until this March.

text: Gin-athag niya nga padayon ang ila pagmonitor kaupod ang mga kapulisan agud masiguro ang seguridad sang mga tawo nga nagakadto sa mga nagakalain-lain nga komunidad.
english: He explained that they continue to monitor with the police to ensure the safety of people going to different communities.

text: Wala sang major reshuffling ang mga election officers sa Western Visayas samtang nagahilapit ang 2025 May Midterm Elections.
english: There is no major reshuffling of election officers in Western Visayas as the 2025 May Midterm Elections approach.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Dennis Ausan, Regional Elections Director sang Commission on Elections 6, iya ginpahayag nga may yara lang sang mga personnel nga na-promote sa mas mataas nga posisyon ukon may bag-o nga appointments rason nga may paghulag sa pila ka mga probinsya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Dennis Ausan, Regional Elections Director of the Commission on Elections 6, said there are only personnel who have been promoted to higher positions or have new appointments, which is why there is movement in some provinces.

text: Si Atty. Ausan ang magapabilin bilang Director sang Comelec Region 6.
english: Atty. Ausan will remain as Director of Comelec Region 6.

text: Suno kay Ausan, sa lima ka mga probinsya sa Western Visayas, tatlo ka mga Provincial Election Supervisors (PES)ang ginsaylo.
english: According to Ausan, in five provinces in Western Visayas, three Provincial Election Supervisors (PES) have been transferred.

text: Si Atty. Wil Arceño ang yara na subong sa Antique matapos makapangalagad bilang PES sa Capiz.
english: Atty. Wil Arceño is now in Antique after serving as PES in Capiz.

text: Si Atty. Hazel Palencia ang yara na subong sa Guimaras matapos makapangalagad bilang PES sa Antique.
english: Atty. Hazel Palencia is now in Guimaras after serving as PES in Antique.

text: Si Atty. TicTac Villanueva ang yara na subong sa Capiz matapos makapangalagad bilang PES sa Guimaras.
english: Atty. TicTac Villanueva is now in Capiz after serving as PES in Guimaras.

text: Samtang, sanday Atty. Reinier Layson ang nagapabilin nga PES sang Iloilo kag si Atty. Roberto Salazar ang PES sa gihapon sang Aklan.
english: Meanwhile, Atty. Reinier Layson remains the PES of Iloilo and Atty. Roberto Salazar is still the PES of Aklan.

text: Paathag ni Atty. Ausan, ang pag-reshuffle sang mga election officers ang indi bangud nga may pamilya ang mga ini nga kandidato sa lugar kun sa diin sila na-assign sadto.
english: Explained by Atty. Ausan said the reshuffle of election officers is not because these candidates have families in the area where they were assigned.

text: Dugang sang natungdan, ang pagsaylo sang mga opisyal ang kabahin sa personnel movement policy sang Comelec sa diin ginasiguro nga yara ang mga ini sa position nga epektibo sila nga makaserbe samtang ginalikawan ang malawig nga assignment sa isa lang ka lugar.
english: He added that the transfer of officials is part of the personnel movement policy of the Comelec which ensures that they are in a position to serve effectively while avoiding long assignments in one place.

text: Nahimo na nga lulubngan sang linibo ka mga kabataan ang Gaza Strip bangud sa wala-untat nga giyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas militants nga naglawig na sang masobra tatlo ka semana.
english: The Gaza Strip has been turned into a graveyard for thousands of children due to the relentless war between Israel and Hamas militants that has lasted for more than three weeks.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag sang United Nations kadungan sang paandam nga posible magadamo pa gid ang mapatay bangud sa dehydration sa amo nga teritoryo sang Palestine.
english: The United Nations said this while warning that more people could die from dehydration in the Palestinian territory.

text:
Photo by MAHMUD HAMS / AFP

Ini nga statement ang kasunod sang tikang sang Israel nga pagpasangkad pa sang ila nga air kag ground attacks sa Gaza – lakip na sa mga balay kag ospital – bilang kabahin sang ila pagtimalos kag misyon nga pudpudon ang Palestinian group nga Hamas kasunod sang pagpang-atake nga ginhimo sang militante nga grupo sa southern Israel sang Oktubre 7 nga nagpatay sang 1,400 ka mga tawo.
english:
Photo by MAHMUD HAMS / AFP

The statement follows Israel's move to expand its air and ground attacks in Gaza - including on houses and hospitals - as part of its revenge and mission to crush the Palestinian group Hamas following the attacks carried out by the militant group in southern Israel on October 7 that killed 1,400 people.

text: Suno naman sa health ministry sa Gaza, lapaw na sa 8,500 ka Palestinians — kalabanan amo ang kabataan kag kababainhan — ang napatay bangud sa balos sang Israel.
english: According to the health ministry in Gaza, more than 8,500 Palestinians — mostly children and women — have been killed as a result of Israel's retaliation.

text: “Our gravest fears about the reported numbers of children killed becoming dozens, then hundreds, and ultimately thousands were realised in just a fortnight,” kabahin sang statement ni James Elder, ang spokesperson sang United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF).
english: “Our gravest fears about the reported numbers of children killed becoming dozens, then hundreds, and ultimately thousands were realized in just a fortnight,” part of the statement by James Elder, the spokesperson of the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF).

text:
“The numbers are appalling; reportedly more than 3,450 children killed; staggeringly this rises significantly every day.”

Pahayag pa sini: “Gaza has become a graveyard for thousands of children.
english:
“The numbers are appalling; reportedly more than 3,450 children killed; staggeringly this rises significantly every day.”

It added: “Gaza has become a graveyard for thousands of children.

text:
It’s a living hell for everyone else.”

Pahayag naman ni Catherine Russell, ang executive director sang UNICEF, ginabanta 6,300 ka mga kabataan sa Gaza ang nasamaran bangud sa apat na ka semana nga Israeli attacks.
english:
It’s a living hell for everyone else.”

Catherine Russell, executive director of UNICEF, said an estimated 6,300 children in Gaza have been injured in four weeks of Israeli attacks.

text: Buot silingon sini suno sa iya, sa average, 420 ka mga Palestinian nga kabataan ang nagakapatay kag nagakasamaran kada adlaw sa amo nga Strip.
english: This means, he said, that on average, 420 Palestinian children are killed and injured every day in the Strip.

text: “And if there is no ceasefire, no water, no medicine, and no release of abducted children?
english: “And if there is no ceasefire, no water, no medicine, and no release of abducted children?

text: Then we hurtle towards even greater horrors afflicting innocent children,” dugang ni Elder.
english: Then we hurtle towards even greater horrors afflicting innocent children,” Elder added.

text: Base naman sa numero halin sa health faculties sa Gaza, yara sa 940 ka mga kabataan ang missing bangud sa amo nga gyera.
english: According to figures from health faculties in Gaza, 940 children are missing due to the war.

text: Gin-ako ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. acknowledged that

text: nga napaslawan ang K-12 education program nga malab-ot ang mayor nga katuyuan sini nga ipreparar ang mga Pilipino nga estudyante para sa trabaho.
english: that the K-12 education program has failed to achieve its main goal of preparing Filipino students for employment.

text: Suno sa presidente, sa baylo, nagdugang lang ini sa pinansiyal nga kabudlay sang mga ginikanan nga napilitan nga pas-anon ang dugang nga duha ka tuig sa pag-eskwela sang ila kabataan.
english: According to the president, instead, it has only added to the financial burden of parents who are forced to bear an additional two years of their children's education.

text: Nagpahayag man sang suporta ang Presidente sa concerns sang mga mamalidha kalakip na si Senator Jinggoy Estrada nga nagapanawagan sang pagkakas sang mandatory senior high school system sa idalom sang K-12 framework.
english: The President also expressed support for the concerns of lawmakers including Senator Jinggoy Estrada who called for the abolition of the mandatory senior high school system under the K-12 framework.

text: Apang gin-athag niya nga ano man nga pagbag-o sa programa, magadepende ini sa Kongreso.
english: But he made it clear that any changes to the program would be up to Congress.

text: Sa pihak sang mga concerns, ginsiling ni President Marcos nga samtang magapabilin ang K-12, kinahanglan nga mapanami sang Department of Education ang implementasyon sini.
english: Despite the concerns, President Marcos said that while K-12 will remain, the Department of Education needs to improve its implementation.

text: Bangud desperado na nga makakaon, makainom, kag makakuha sang disente nga mga gamit, ginsulod sang linibo ka mga tawo ang mga warehouse sa Gaza kun sa diin nakatago ang mga ayuda lakip na ang mga harina kag basic hygiene products kaangay sang habon.
english: Desperate for food, drink, and decent supplies, thousands of people broke into warehouses in Gaza where aid including flour and basic hygiene products such as soap were stored.

text: Suno sa United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA), ang “break-ins” sa mga warehouse ang makabig nga makahalangawa nga senyales nga nagakadula na ang civil order sa Gaza bangud sa gyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas militants.
english: According to the United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA), the break-ins in the warehouses are considered a worrying sign that civil order in Gaza is disappearing due to the war between Israel and Hamas militants.

text:
Photo: Ahmad Hasaballah/Getty Images

“People are scared, frustrated and desperate,” kabahin sang statement.
english:
Photo: Ahmad Hasaballah/Getty Images

“People are scared, frustrated and desperate,” the statement read.

text: Ang UNRWA amo ang nagahatag sang basic services sa ginatos kag linibo ka mga residente sa Gaza.
english: UNRWA provides basic services to hundreds and thousands of residents in Gaza.

text: Ang mga eskwelahan nga sakop sini sa Gaza ang nahimo na nga ilistaran sang mga Palestinhon nga nawad-an sang puluy-an bangud sa giyera.
english: Its schools in Gaza have been turned into shelters for Palestinians displaced by the war.

text: Ang sulod sang ila nga warehouse amo ang ayuda nga halin sa Egypt kag ginpasugtan sang Israel nga makaabot sa Palestine.
english: Inside their warehouse was aid from Egypt that Israel allowed to reach Palestine.

text: Sang Sabado suno sa spokesperson sang ahensya nga si Juliette Touma, apat gid ka pasilidad ang ginpang-ransak sang mga tawo.
english: On Saturday, agency spokesperson Juliette Touma said four facilities were ransacked.

text: Gindugang sang ahensya nga wala sang fuel sa amo nga warehouses nga amo ang pinaka-kritikal subong sa Gaza kasunod sang pag-utod sang Israel sang shipment sini nga produkto halin sang ginpaidalom ang amo nga teritoryo sa total siege.
english: The agency added that there is no fuel in the warehouses, which are the most critical in Gaza following Israel's cut-off of shipments of this product since the territory was placed under total siege.

text: Sa rekord sang UN, nakasaad nga masobra sa tunga sa 2.4 million nga mga residente sa Strip ang na-displace kag linibo naman ka mga building ang naguba halin sang nagtimalos ang Israel sa Hamas kasunod sang Oktubre 7 nga pagpang-atake.
english: According to UN records, more than half a million residents in the Strip have been displaced and thousands of buildings have been destroyed since Israel took revenge on Hamas following the October 7 attacks.

text: Naglab-ot sa P7 billion ang nagasto sang Iloilo City government sa nagkalain-lain nga proyekto sang syudad sa tion sang administrasyon ni Mayor Jerry Treñas.
english: The Iloilo City government spent P7 billion on various projects in the city during the administration of Mayor Jerry Treñas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang isa lamang ka pagpakita sa publiko sang transparency agud mahibaluan kon sa diin nagpadulong ang kwarta sang pumuluyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said that this is just a public demonstration of transparency to know where the people's money went.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, sugod 2019, ang nasambit nga balor sang naggasto sang city government ang ginakabug-usan sang edukasyon, health centers, road, gyms, dialysis center, public market, kag iban pa nga proyekto.
english: According to Fantilaga, since 2019, the said value of the city government's spending includes education, health centers, roads, gyms, dialysis center, public market, and other projects.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga may mga wala pa natapos nga proyekto tubtob subong lakip na ang pila ka merkado sa syudad.
english: He also acknowledged that there are unfinished projects so far including some markets in the city.

text: Una na nga ginpabugal sang city government nga wala gid nagpangayo ang syudad sa national government agud nga makapatindog sang mga proyekto kaangay sang mga eskwelahan.
english: Earlier, the city government boasted that the city never asked the national government to build projects such as schools.

text: Ginbuy-an sang Hamas militants ang duha ka iban pa nila nga mga bihag sa Gaza Strip.
english: Hamas militants released two other hostages in the Gaza Strip.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga tion nga may ginhilway nga hostages ang Hamas militants halin sang ila ginsalakakay ang Southern Israel sang Oktubre 7 sang aga, gindala ang masobra 200 ka hostages sa Gaza (lakip na ang kabataan, foreigners, kag dual nationals), kag sunod nga natabo ang pagtimalos sang Israel kun sa diin masobra 4,000 na ang nagkalamatay nga Palestinians.
english: This is the second time that Hamas militants have released hostages since they attacked Southern Israel on October 7 morning, taking more than 200 hostages to Gaza (including children, foreigners, and dual nationals), and followed by Israeli retaliation that killed more than 4,000 Palestinians.

text: Nurit Cooper (left) and Yocheved Lifshitz.
english: Nurit Cooper (left) and Yocheved Lifshitz.

text:
(courtesy)-via The Times of Israel

Ang pinakaulihi nga ginbuy-an nga hostages ang natumod sang Israeli media nga sanday Yocheved Lifshitz, 85, kag Nurit Cooper, 79, nga halin sa Israeli kibbutz of Nir Oz.
english:
(courtesy)-via The Times of Israel

The latest hostages released were identified by Israeli media as Yocheved Lifshitz, 85, and Nurit Cooper, 79, who were from the Israeli kibbutz of Nir Oz.

text:
Sa statement sang Hamas, ginsiling nga ila ginhilway ang duha sa ngalan sang “humanitarian reasons.”

Antes sini, nauna na ang Israel, world leaders, kag mangin si Pope Francis sa pagpanawagan nga ipang-release na ang mga sibilyan nga ginatago sang Hamas militans.
english:
In a statement, Hamas said it released the two in the name of “humanitarian reasons.”

Earlier, Israel, world leaders, and even Pope Francis had already called for the release of civilians being held by Hamas militants.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, nagbulig sa pagpa-release sang duha ang Qatari kag Egyptian mediation, kag ang International Red Cross.
english: According to initial information, Qatari and Egyptian mediation, and the International Red Cross helped in the release of the two.

text: Antes sini, matandaan nga ang duha ka nauna ginbuy-an nga hostages amo ang American nga mag-iloy nga sanday Judith Tai Raanan kag Natalie Raanan.
english: Earlier, it can be recalled that the two previously released hostages were American mothers Judith Tai Raanan and Natalie Raanan.

text: Ginpakilala na sang House of Representatives ang spokesman sang prosecutor sa impeachment ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The House of Representatives has introduced the spokesman of the prosecutor in the impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ini amo si Atty. Antonio Bucoy nga isa ka prominente nga abogado kag Managing Partner sang Bucoy Poblador & Associates (BPA) nga isa ka full-service law firm nga naka-base sa Makati City.
english: This is Atty. Antonio Bucoy who is a prominent lawyer and Managing Partner of Bucoy Poblador & Associates (BPA) which is a full-service law firm based in Makati City.

text: Siya ang nakapasar sa Bar sang 1985 kag nagauyat sang Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) degree halin sa University of the Philippines .
english: He passed the Bar in 1985 and holds a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) degree from the University of the Philippines.

text: Siya ang eksperto sa Corporate and Tax Law, Dispute Resolution, kag Intellectual Property (IP).
english: He is an expert in Corporate and Tax Law, Dispute Resolution, and Intellectual Property (IP).

text: Myembro ini sang Philippine Bar Association, Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP), Intellectual Property Association of the Philippines (IPAP), American Intellectual Property Lawyers Association (AIPLA), kag madamo nga iban pa nga mga organisasyon.
english: It is a member of the Philippine Bar Association, Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP), Intellectual Property Association of the Philippines (IPAP), American Intellectual Property Lawyers Association (AIPLA), and many other organizations.

text: Tuman ka importante ang balay para sa isa ka tawo — amo ina ang iya ginatawag nga puluy-an, palasilungan, dalaganan, kag lugar kun sa diin natukod kag natipon ang tuman ka damo nga mga handurawan (isahanon man siya, ukon kaupod sa iya pamilya).
english: The house is very important to a person — it is what he calls home, shelter, escape, and the place where so many dreams are built and gathered (whether he is alone, or with his family).

text: Kun kaisa, may mga indi mapunggan nga hitabo — kaangay sang mga kalamidad — kun sa diin gulpi madula sa imo ini nga propiedad kag mapilitan ka nga magtukod liwat.
english: Sometimes, there are unpredictable events — like disasters — where you suddenly lose this property and are forced to rebuild.

text: Apang sa natabo sa southwest Atlanta, Georgia, USA, sobra-sobra man ang kaakig nga nabatyagan sang tag-iya nga si Susan Hodgson sang naghalin lang siya sa bakasyon, apang sa iya pagbalik, na-demolish na ang iya balay.
english: But in what happened in southwest Atlanta, Georgia, USA, owner Susan Hodgson was also very angry when she left on vacation, but when she returned, her house had been demolished.

text:
Photo: FOX

Ang malain pa dira, nagsala lang ang kumpaniya sa ila ginguba nga propiedad!
english:
Photo: FOX

To make matters worse, the company made a mistake in their destroyed property!

text: Suno kay Susan, samtang yara siya sa bakasyon, nagtawag ang iya kasilingan kag namangkot kun may gin-hire siya agud nga gub-on ang iya balay.
english: According to Susan, while she was on vacation, a neighbor called and asked if she had hired someone to demolish her house.

text: Natingala si Susan bangud ngaa man abi ipaguba niya ang propiedad nga dinekada na nga ginapanag-iyahan sang iya nga pamilya?
english: Susan wondered why she would destroy the property that her family had owned for decades.

text: Nagpalapit pa ang kasilingan agud nga kumprontahon ang mga naga-demolish sang balay, apang ang ila sabat: “Shut up and mind your own business”.
english: Nagpalapit pa ang kasilingan agud nga kumprontahon ang mga naga-demolish sang balay, apang ang ila sabat: “Shut up and mind your own business”.

text: Nagpalapit man ang himata ni Susan kag nagpangayo sang permit.
english: Susan's relative also approached and asked for a permit.

text: Sang gin-check na sang isa ka worker ang address, didto nakumpirma nga sala ang ila balay nga ginguba!
english: When a worker checked the address, it was confirmed that their house was wrong!

text: “It’s been boarded up about 15 years, and we keep it boarded, covered, grass cut, and the yard is clean,” pahayag ni Susan.
english: “It’s been boarded up about 15 years, and we keep it boarded, covered, grass cut, and the yard is clean,” Susan stated.

text:
“The taxes are paid and everything is up on it.”

Sa subong, wala pa sang sabat ang Atlanta-based nga kumpaniya nga You Call It We Haul It.
english:
“The taxes are paid and everything is up on it.”

So far, Atlanta-based company You Call It We Haul It has not responded.

text: Gin-ako naman sang tag-iya nga tuman ang iya kaakig, kag nagapanumdom siya kun joke time lamang ini.
english: The owner admitted that he was very angry, and he wondered if it was just a joke time.

text: Samtang wala pa na-resolbar ang isyu, nag-file si Susan sang report sa pulis kag nag-kontak na sa iya nga mga abogado.#
english: While the issue has not been resolved, Susan has filed a police report and has contacted her lawyers.

text: Nagapangayo si Vice President Sara Duterte sang P733 milyon nga budget para sa iya opisina sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte is seeking a P733 million budget for her office next year.

text: Ini ang halos kapareho man sang budget nga nabaton sang Office of the Vice President (OVP) sang 2025.
english: This is almost the same as the budget received by the Office of the Vice President (OVP) in 2025.

text: Suno kay VP Sara, ang amo nga budget proposal ang pinakagamay nga ipasa sang OVP sa idalom sang subong nga administrasyon.
english: According to VP Sara, the budget proposal is the smallest to be submitted by the OVP under the current administration.

text: Pahayag niya, wala na siya nagtuyo pa nga mangayo sang mas dako nga budget bangud napat-ud niya nga indi man ini pag-aprubahan.
english: He said he did not intend to ask for a larger budget because he was sure it would not be approved.

text: Ang budget nga gina-request sini sa masunod nga tuig ang mas manubo sa P2.3 bilyon sang 2023 kag P1.8 bilyon nga nabaton sang 2024.
english: The budget it is requesting for next year is lower than the P2.3 billion in 2023 and P1.8 billion received in 2024.

text: IMPORTANTE nga ang Comelec makahatag gid sang husto nga desisyon sa “disqualification case” ni Bongbong Marcos (BBM) kag iban pa nga mga kaso nga na-file diri.
english: IT IS IMPORTANT that the Comelec gives the right decision on the “disqualification case” of Bongbong Marcos (BBM) and other cases filed here.

text: Syempre, indi malikawan ang pagpangduha-duha nga basi may paboran ini sa gina-protestahan ukon sa naga-protesta sa kon ano man nga rason.
english: Of course, it is inevitable to doubt that it may favor the protester or the protester for whatever reason.

text: Otherwise, kon kwestyonable ang desisyon sini, basi bala may kinagamo nga matabo, labi na gid sa kaso ni BBM, kon diin ang ano man nga desisyon nga mahimo sini mangin basehan (precedent) na sa kasubong nga sitwasyon sa masunod nga kahigayunan kon indi malubag sang Korte Suprema.
english: Otherwise, if its decision is questionable, there might be chaos, especially in the case of BBM, where any decision it can make will become a precedent in a similar situation the next time if not overturned by the Supreme Court.

text: Gani, careful gid kamo nga yara sa Comelec.
english: So, be very careful in the Comelec.

text: Indi gid ipadaug ang inyo Diyosnon nga Konsyensya sa kahadlok ukon tentasyon ni Taning agud ang husto gid nga desisyon ang inyo mahimo.
english: Never let your Godly Conscience succumb to the fear or temptation of Taning so that you can make the right decision.

text:
***

Sa bahin sang mga botante, panugyan naton nga indi gid magpadala-dala sa kon ano lang nga poll survey.
english:
***

On the part of voters, we advise them not to be fooled by any poll survey.

text: Tandaan nga wala na sing maayo pa nga basehan sang aton boto sangsa aton KONSYENSYA agud pilion ang bagay gid saligan.
english: Remember that there is no better basis for our vote than our CONSCIENCE to choose the right one to trust.

text: Madaug man ukon mapierde, basta ang ginapili naton amo gid ang dapat sa aton Konsyensya, wala kita sing problema dira sa atubang sang aton pamilya kag sang Ginuo.
english: Whether we win or lose, as long as we choose what is right in our conscience, we have no problem in front of our family and the Lord.

text: Tandaan naton nga may mga survey dira nga “bogus” ukon “fake” nga ang tuyu amo lang ang magtuga sang “bandwagon mentality”.
english: Let's remember that there are surveys out there that are “bogus” or “fake” that are only intended to create a “bandwagon mentality”.

text: Sa ina nga mentalidad, ukon ano pa nga “mind conditioning” nga mahimo nila, ginatentar nila kita agud botohon lang ang mga kandidato nga na-manipular nila nga manguna sa survey, bisan pa indi gid ini sila masaligan sa poder.
english: With that mentality, or whatever other “mind conditioning” they can do, they tempt us to vote only for the candidates they have manipulated to lead the poll, even if they are not trustworthy in power.

text: Katulad ina seguro sang ginboto naton sadto nga pensar naton basi matarong man gali bandido.
english: It's probably like the one we voted for when we thought maybe the bandit was right.

text: Samtang ang dapat tani botohon naton amo ang mga kandidato nga may matarong nga pagkatawo, may ikasarang sa panghimanwa, indi “corrupt”, indi butigon, kag may “doable” nga programa del gobierno.
english: Meanwhile, we should vote for candidates who have good character, have the ability to citizenship, are not “corrupt”, are not liars, and have a “doable” government program.

text: Kon may basehan man ang prediksyon ang isa ka survey para sa posible nga kadalag-an sang nagapanguna nga mga kandidato, pwede gihapon ini magsala.
english: Even if a poll has a basis for predicting the likely victory of the leading candidates, it can still be wrong.

text: Katulad sang pila na ka beses nga natabo sa kampanyahanay sa Estados Unidos.
english: As has happened several times in the campaign in the United States.

text: Indi pa malipatan sang madamo ang natabo sa resulta sang poll survey sang magpadalagan sa pagka-Presidente si Harry Truman.
english: Many will never forget what happened in the poll when Harry Truman ran for President.

text: Mga duha ka semana bag-o ang aktwal nga eleksyon, nagapanguna na ang iya kasumpong sing 9-1 kontra sa iya.
english: About two weeks before the actual election, his opponent was leading 9-1 against him.

text: Apang wala ini nawad-an sing paglaum.
english: But it did not lose hope.

text: Kag gin-medyosan sini nga malab-ut ang madamo pa nga mga botante kag nag-todo na pagwa sing mabakud nga mga isyu kontra sa kasumpong.
english: And it has managed to reach more voters and has already raised strong issues against the opponent.

text: Tungod sini, sa wala ginpaabot sang kasumpong, nakahingagaw pa ini agud magdaug sa eleksyon.
english: As a result, unexpectedly for the opponent, he managed to win the election.

text:
***

Luyag ta man ipahanumdum sa aton mga pumuluyo

ang mga survey nga, nga samtang wala sing malisya, nagagamit lang sang pila lang ka sample respondent kag sang isa ukon pila lang ka grupo sa ila nagakalain-lain nga interes, nga indi “representative” sang kadam-an.
english:
***

We would also like to remind our residents

surveys that, which while harboring no malice, use only a very few sample respondents and only one or a few groups among their varying interests, who are not “representative” of the majority.

text: Kon si Senador Tito Sotto pa, indi pa masaligan ang resulta sini.
english: With Senator Tito Sotto, the results are still unreliable.

text: “Good guide” lang ini, sunu sa iya, agud makita sang kandidato ang una nga balatyagon sang bisan pila lang anay ka pumuluyo nga pwede pa nila mapa-improve sa sige nila nga pagpang-kampanya.
english: This is just a “good guide”, he said, so that the candidate can see the first feelings of even a few residents that they can still improve in their campaign.

text: Sunu gani sa Gallop Polls, nga kilala sa madamo sini nga positive prediction sa eleksyon sa Estados Unidos, dapat ang kadamuon sang random sample respondents indi magnubo sa 10% sang mga botante agud pwede na masaligan bisan may “margin of error” pa.
english: According to Gallop Polls, known for its many positive predictions in US elections, the number of random sample respondents must be at least 10% of the voters in order to be reliable even with a margin of error.

text: Sa mga poll survey sa subong, ugaling, halos 2,000 man lang ang mga sample respondent nga ginagamit halin sa aton mga 65 ka milyon nga mga botante sa Mayo 9, 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: In current poll surveys, however, only about 2,000 sample respondents are used from our approximately 65 million voters in the May 9, 2022 election.

text: Mga 0.03 ka porsyento (%) lang ini, nga indi pa masaligan para sa ano man nga prediksyon.
english: It’s only about 0.03 percent (%), which is still not reliable enough for any prediction.

text: Ini man gani ang rason kon ngaa gina-ban ang poll survey sang Fair Election Act, ukon RA 9006, kon malapit na ang eleksyon.
english: This is the reason why the Fair Election Act, or RA 9006, bans poll surveys when elections are near.

text: Ang Section 5.4 ngasiling nga indi na pwede ang pagpagwa sang mga poll survey 15 ka adlaw bag-o ang national elections kag pitu (7) ka adlaw bag-o ang lokal nga eleksyon.
english: Section 5.4 states that poll surveys shall not be released 15 days before national elections and seven (7) days before local elections.

text: Ginapatuman ini agud indi na mahaylo pa ang mga botante sa pagboto tungod lang sa “bandwagon mentality” kag kasubong nga “mind conditioning”, kag botohon gid ang angay nga botohon.
english: This is being implemented so that voters are not enticed to vote just because of the “bandwagon mentality” and similar “mind conditioning”, and vote for the right vote.

text: Merry Christmas & a Happy New Year to Everyone!/PN
english: Merry Christmas & a Happy New Year to Everyone!/PN

text: Matunog nga ginabati-bati ang reunion sang Taiwanese boy group nga F4 sa 2026.
english: A reunion of Taiwanese boy group F4 is being heavily rumored in 2026.

text: Base sa mga report, nagsugtanay sanday Jerry Yan, Vanness Wu, Ken Chu, kag Vic Chou nga mag-updanay para sa concert nga amo ang magamarka sang 25th anniversary sang ila nga debut.
english: According to reports, Jerry Yan, Vanness Wu, Ken Chu, and Vic Chou have agreed to work together for the concert that will mark the 25th anniversary of their debut.

text: Natukod ang F4 sang 2001 sang sanday Yan, Wu, Chu, kag Chou ang nag-updanay sa fictional group sang amo man nga pangalan sa hit drama nga Meteor Garden.
english: F4 was formed in 2001 when Yan, Wu, Chu, and Chou teamed up with the fictional group of the same name in the hit drama Meteor Garden.

text: Sa amo nga drama nga nagsikat ilabi na sa Pilipinas, bida man ang late Taiwanese actress kag singer nga si Barbie Hsu ukon si Shan Chai.
english: The drama, which became popular especially in the Philippines, also starred late Taiwanese actress and singer Barbie Hsu or Shan Chai.

text: Tatlo ka albums anay ang na-record sang F4 nga amo ang Meteor Rain (2001), Fantasy 4ever (2002), kag ang Waiting for You (2007) kun sa diin gin-tour pa nila ang Asya.
english: F4 has previously recorded three albums, Meteor Rain (2001), Fantasy 4ever (2002), and Waiting for You (2007) where they toured Asia.

text: Na-disband sila sang 2009, apang bisan separado na, aktibo sila sa show business bilang solo performers.
english: They were disbanded in 2009, but even after being separated, they are active in show business as solo performers.

text: Katapusan nga nag-reunite ang F4 sa Spring Festival Gala sang Jiangsu TV sa China sang 2013.
english: Katapusan nga nag-reunite ang F4 sa Spring Festival Gala sang Jiangsu TV sa China sang 2013.

text: Nasawi si Double Olympic champion Laura Dahlmeier matapos ang ginawa nitong pag-akyat.
english: Nasawi si Double Olympic champion Laura Dahlmeier matapos ang ginawa nitong pag-akyat.

text: Kinumpirma ng German Olympic Sports Confederation ang pagkasawi ng 31-anyos na retired German biathlete.
english: The German Olympic Sports Confederation confirmed the death of the 31-year-old retired German biathlete.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon na tinamaan ng nahulog na bato ang biktima habang ito ay umaakyat sa Laila Peak sa Karakoram mountain range.
english: According to the investigation, the victim was hit by a falling stone while climbing Laila Peak in the Karakoram mountain range.

text: Nagsagawa agad ng rescue operations matapos na magpakawala ng distress signal ang kasama nito sa pag-akyat na si Marina Eva.
english: Rescue operations were immediately conducted after his climbing partner Marina Eva gave a distress signal.

text: Nagpaabot naman ng labis na kalungkutan si Thomas Weikert, pangulo ng German Olympic Sports Confederation.
english: Thomas Weikert, president of the German Olympic Sports Confederation, expressed his condolences.

text: Si Dahlmeier ay nagtala ng kasaysayn sa 2018 Winter Olympics ng maging babaeng biathelete na nagwagi ng gold medal sa sprint at pursuit events.
english: Dahlmeier set history at the 2018 Winter Olympics by becoming a female biathlete winning gold medals in the sprint and pursuit events.

text: Nagwagi rin ito ng limang gintong medalya sa single world championship kung saan nagretiro na sito sa sports noong 2019 sa edad na 25.
english: He also won five gold medals in the singles world championship where he retired from sports in 2019 at the age of 25.

text: Nag-untat na sa byahe ang isa ka jeepney driver sa San Miguel, Iloilo bangud nga magamay nalang ang nagasakay nga pasahero sa iya ginamaneho nga jeep kag bangud man sa mas nagtaas nga presyo sang gatong nga nangin dako nga rason nga wala na halos sila sang ginakita.
english: A jeepney driver in San Miguel, Iloilo has stopped traveling because there are few passengers in his jeep and because of the increase in fuel prices that have become a major reason why they have almost no income.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Garry Sabinod, isa ka operator sang jeep kag temporaryo nga nangin driver, iya ginpahayag nga wala na sila halos sang madamo nga pasahero, apang nagdugang pa gid ang isa ka problema kaangay sang pagtaas sang presyo sang petrolyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Garry Sabinod, a jeep operator and temporary driver, said they have almost no passengers, but a problem such as the increase in petrol prices has increased.

text: Suno sa iya, kinahanglan nya gid nga magsakprisyo kag mangin temporary driver agud nga padayun ang pagbyahe sang iya nga jeep.
english: He said he had to make sacrifices and become a temporary driver to keep his jeep running.

text: Ginpakigbahin man niya nga mabudlay man kun pagataasan ang pamasahe sang pampubliko nga mga salakyan bangud wala man sang pagtaas sa sweldo sang ila nga mga pasahero, samtang padayun naman nga nagataas ang mga presyo sang mga balaklon.
english: He also shared that it is difficult to increase the fares of public transportation because there is no increase in the salaries of their passengers, while the prices of goods continue to rise.

text: Palakaon ka man bala sang laswa?
english: Do you eat vegetables too?

text: Nakahibalo ka bala nga ang dahon sang tugabang nga ginalakot sa amo nga niluto ang indi lang makabulong sa nanuhay-tuhay nga balatian kundi makahatag pa sang masanag nga panan-awan?
english: Did you know that the leaves of the tugabang mixed with the rice can not only cure various diseases but also give bright vision?

text: Suno kay Dr. Stephanie Nicole Nera, isa ka registered pharmacist, ang tugabang ang manggaranon sa Vitamin A kag Vitamin B6 nga nagaproteher sa mga mata kag nagapa-maintain sang good vision.
english: According to Dr. Stephanie Nicole Nera, a registered pharmacist, said tugabang is rich in Vitamin A and Vitamin B6 which protect the eyes and maintain good vision.

text: Ang vitamins E kag C, kag antioxidants sa tugabang ang nagaproteher man batok sa pagkaguba sang cells sa lawas sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: Vitamins E and C, and antioxidants in tugabang also protect against cell damage in an individual's body.

text: Ini nga vitamins kag antioxidants ang nagapalikaw sa pagkurinot sang panit kag nagabato sa infections nga nagaresulta sa nanuhay-tuhay nga balatian.
english: These vitamins and antioxidants prevent skin wrinkles and fight infections that result in various diseases.

text: Mataas man ang fiber content sang tugabang nga naga-regulate sang blood sugar kag madasig ini nga nagapabusog gani bentaha ini sa mga nagapabuhin sang kabug-aton.
english: Tugabang also has a high fiber content that regulates blood sugar and satisfies you quickly, making it an advantage for those who are losing weight.

text: Magluwas diri, bentaha man sa mga nagabusong ang pagkaon sang tugabang bangud ginapataas sini ang resistance sang iloy kag sang fetus batok sa diabetes-induced oxidative stress.
english: In addition, pregnant women are also advantageous to eat tugabang because it increases the resistance of the mother and fetus against diabetes-induced oxidative stress.

text: Ang ilong ang isa sa pinakasensitibo nga parte sang aton lawas kag dapat gid ini nga ginahalungan.
english: The nose is one of the most sensitive parts of our body and should be taken care of.

text: Apang kun kaisa, bisan ano nga paghalong, may matabo gid ya nga indi maayo.
english: But sometimes, no matter how careful you are, something goes wrong.

text: Kaangay sang natabo sa pito ka tuig nga bata sa China nga sa sulod sang duha ka tuig, gin-antos ang baho sang tuktukon nga turnilyo nga nagsupon sa iya ilong nga wala man siya sang hinalung-ong.
english: Like what happened to a seven-year-old boy in China who for two years, suffered the smell of a sharp screw that stuck in his nose without even realizing it.

text: Ang bata nagaistar sa Jiaozuo, sa Henan Province.
english: The child lives in Jiaozuo, in Henan Province.

text: Suno sa otoridad, ginasugid sang bata sa iya ginikanan nga may yara siya sang napanimahuan nga indi manami nga baho apang indi niya mahibaluan kun ano ini.
english: According to authorities, the child told his parents that he smelled something bad but did not know what it was.

text: Bangud indi man ini masimhutan sang iya ginikanan, wala na lang nila ini ginsapak sa pagdumdom nga imahinasyon lang ini sang bata.
english: Since his parents couldn't smell it, they ignored it thinking it was just a child's imagination.

text: Apang bangud nga sang damlag lang, masami na gid nagareklamo ang bata, nagdesisyon sila nga ipalantaw ini sa doktor.
english: But since recently, the child has been complaining more often, they decided to have him seen by a doctor.

text: Sa examination sa nostrils sang bata, nakit-an ang isa ka misteryoso nga butang sa iya ilong.
english: During the examination of the child's nostrils, a mysterious object was found in his nose.

text: Sang gin-operahan ini, didto na nakit-an ang turnilyo.
english: When it was operated on, the screw was found.

text: Amo na lang ang pagpasalamat nila nga natapos na ang duha ka tuig nga pag-antos sang ila bata.
english: That's how grateful they are that their son's two-year suffering is over.

text: Ginhingadlan na ang 16 ka mga abogado nga magadepensa kay Vice President Sara Duterte sa impeachment trial.
english: Sixteen lawyers have been named to defend Vice President Sara Duterte in the impeachment trial.

text: Suno sa Senate impeachment court, nabaton nila pasado alas singko kahapon sang hapon ang Appearance – Ad Cautelam halin sa Fortun Narvasa & Salazar law firm.
english: According to the Senate impeachment court, they received the Appearance – Ad Cautelam from the Fortun Narvasa & Salazar law firm around 5 pm yesterday.

text:
Ang mga abogado nga maga-represent sa bise-presidente amo ang mga masunod:

Philip Sigfried FortunGregorio NarvasaSheila SisonCarlo Joaquin NarvasaRoberto BatungbacalJustin Nicol GularLindon Miguel BacquelDavid Ronell Golla VIIMaria Selena Golda FortunClaraine RadocFrancesca Marie FloresMiguel Carlos FernandezMichael Wesley PoaReynold MunsayacMark VinluanRalph Bodota

Maga-umpisa ang impeachment trial ni Duterte sa idalom na sang 20th Congress.
english:
The lawyers who will represent the vice-president are as follows:

Philip Sigfried FortunGregorio NarvasaSheila SisonCarlo Joaquin NarvasaRoberto BatungbacalJustin Nicol GularLindon Miguel BacquelDavid Ronell Golla VIIMaria Selena Golda FortunClaraine RadocFrancesca Marie FloresMiguel Carlos FernandezMichael Wesley and Mark Munck VinluanRalph Bodota

Duterte's impeachment trial will begin under the 20th Congress.

text: Nangin sentro sang atensyon ang Senado subong nga Hunyo matapos ini gin-ulan sang mga kritisismo halin sa mga myembro sang Kamara, academe, legal experts kag iban pa matapos nga ginbalik sini ang impeachment case sa House of Representatives antes nagtakop ang 19th Congress sang nagligad nga semana.
english: The Senate became the center of attention this June after it was showered with criticism from members of the House of Representatives, academe, legal experts and others after it returned the impeachment case to the House of Representatives before the 19th Congress ended last week.

text: Bisan nga nakapanumpa na ang senator-judges, wala gin-umpisahan sang chamber ang impeachment proceedings bangud 18 sang mga senador ang nagboto nga i-remand ang kaso sa House prosecutors para sa dugang nga certification.
english: Although the senator-judges were sworn in, the chamber did not initiate impeachment proceedings because 18 of the senators voted to remand the case to House prosecutors for further certification.

text: Matandaan nga Pebrero 5 sang gin-impeach si Duterte sa Kamara kun sa diin lakip sa nangin basehan amo ang ginaalegar nga mga anomaliya sa paggamit sang confidential funds sa Office of the Vice President kag Department of Education, amo man ang nangin pamahog ni Sara batok kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, kag House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez.#
english: It can be recalled that Duterte was impeached in the House of Representatives on February 5, based on alleged anomalies in the use of confidential funds in the Office of the Vice President and the Department of Education, as well as Sara's threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza and Ferdinand Ferdinand. Romualdez.#

text: Gin-istoryahan nanday Pope Francis kag US President Joe Biden ang away sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas amo man ang iban pa nga gyera sa kalibutan.
english: Pope Francis and US President Joe Biden discussed the conflict between Israel and Hamas as well as other wars in the world.

text: Suno sa Vatican, naka-istoryahanay ang duha paagi sa telepono nga naglawig sang 20 minutos.
english: The Vatican said the two had a phone conversation that lasted 20 minutes.

text: Diri man suno sa Vatican natutukan ang pag-kinahanglan nga makatumod na sang paagi kun paano mabalik ang kalinong sa magtimbang nga bahin.
english: The Vatican also said it is focused on the need to identify a way to restore peace on both sides.

text:
Photo: CBS

May separado man nga pag-istoryahanay sanday Biden kag si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
english:
Photo: CBS

Biden also had separate talks with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

text: Nahibaluan nga naga-preparar ang Israel sang mas daku pa gid nga pagsalakay paagi sa ground assault sa Gaza duha ka semana matapos ang pagpang-atake sang Hamas nga nagpatay sang ginabanta 1,400 ka mga taga-Israel kag may nagapabilin nga masobra 200 ka mga bihag.
english: Israel is preparing an even bigger ground assault on Gaza two weeks after a Hamas attack killed an estimated 1,400 Israelis and left more than 200 hostages.

text: Kasunod naman sang traditional Angelus prayer sa Saint Peter’s Square sa Roma, naghingyo liwat si Pope Francis nga buksan na liwat ang alagyan para makasulod ang humanitarian aid sa Gaza kag dapat man nga hilwayon na ang hostages.
english: Following the traditional Angelus prayer in Saint Peter's Square in Rome, Pope Francis again called for the reopening of the road for humanitarian aid to enter Gaza and the release of hostages.

text: “War is always a defeat, it is a destruction of human fraternity.
english: “War is always a defeat, it is a destruction of human fraternity.

text: Brothers, stop!
english: Brothers, stop!

text: Stop!,” suno sa Santo Papa.
english: Stop!,” the Pope said.

text:
“I renew my call for spaces to be opened, for humanitarian aid to continue to arrive and for hostages to be freed.”

Lakip man sa nagpalala sa sitwasyon sa Gaza sang tinalikdan nga adlaw amo ang pagpang-atake sa isa ka Anglican hospital kag Greek Orthodox church.
english:
“I renew my call for spaces to be opened, for humanitarian aid to continue to arrive and for hostages to be freed.”

Also exacerbating the situation in Gaza in recent days were attacks on an Anglican hospital and a Greek Orthodox church.

text: Gintugutan ang dugang nga 17 ka mga truck nga makasulod sa Southern Gaza Strip paagi sa pagbukas liwat sang Rafah border.
english: An additional 17 trucks were allowed to enter the Southern Gaza Strip by reopening the Rafah border.

text: Ini nga convoy amo pa lang ang ikaduha nga batch nga ginpasugtan nga makasulod sa Gaza kasunod sang 20 ka trucks nga nagdul-ong sang bulong, pagkaon, kag tubig sa minilyon ka mga Palestinians sang Sabado.
english: This convoy is just the second batch to be allowed into Gaza following the 20 trucks that delivered medicine, food, and water to millions of Palestinians on Saturday.

text:
AP Photo/Mohammed Asad

Natabo ang pagdul-ong sang ayuda sa mga Palestinians samtang nga ginapanan-aw naman ang pagsugod sang ground offensive sang Israel Defense Forces.
english:
AP Photo/Mohammed Asad

The delivery of aid to the Palestinians took place while the Israel Defense Forces are expected to launch a ground offensive.

text: Una na nga ginbanta sang United Nations nga dapat nga 100 trucks kada adlaw ang kinahanglan nga makasulod para bastante ang bulig sa 2.4 million ka mga residente sa Gaza nga amo ang nagasuprer sa epekto sang away.
english: The United Nations had previously estimated that 100 trucks a day would need to enter to provide enough aid to the 2.4 million residents in Gaza who are suffering from the effects of the fighting.

text: Suno sa head sang UN agency for Palestinian refugees, mahubas na ang ila nga fuel supplies pagkaligad sang tatlo ka adlaw.
english: According to the head of the UN agency for Palestinian refugees, their fuel supplies will run out after three days.

text: Nagtambong sa kick-off rally sang Team USWAG si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sa Iloilo Freedom Grandstand kadungan sang imbukada nga adlaw sang local campaign period sang 2025 midterm elections.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas attended the kick-off rally of Team USWAG at the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand during the opening day of the local campaign period of the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa nangin mensahe sang alkalde, wala sini napunggan nga tawgon nga ‘pulahan’ ang kampo ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-Jam” Baronda nga Team Sulong Gugma.
english: In his message, the mayor did not hesitate to call the camp of Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-Jam” Baronda, Team Sulong Gugma, 'red'.

text: Ini bangud man sa ila nga campaign color nga pula, samtang duag blue na man ang sa Team USWAG.
english: This is also due to their campaign color of red, while Team USWAG's is blue.

text: Ginpunto man ni Treñas nga apisar sang madamo nga palamangkutanon ang ginhaboy sa iya sang piyak nga kampo nahanungod sa iya nga ikaayong-lawas, mas nagpabilin siya nga malig-on kag subong, nahimo pa nga mangampanya.
english: Treñas also pointed out that despite the many questions thrown at him by the other camp regarding his health, he remained more stable and now, he is able to campaign.

text: Nagpalabtik man ini sa kasumpong ni incumbent Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon sa pagka-bise alkalde nga nagalaragway nga indi sini luyag nga ang masunod nga vice mayor amo ang ‘obstructionist’ bangud makaapekto ini sa pag-uswag sang syudad.
english: He also criticized incumbent Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon's opponent for vice mayor, describing that he does not want the next vice mayor to be an obstructionist because it will affect the development of the city.

text: Gin-ako naman sang alkalde nga magapahuway ini anay sa pulitika rason man nga ginduso sini sa pagkaalkalde ang iya anak nga si Raisa Treñas.
english: The mayor acknowledged that he will take a break from politics, which is why he nominated his daughter Raisa Treñas for mayor.

text: Apang, nagpasalig ini nga kon magbalik sa patag sang pulitika ang ginlaragway sini nga ‘protector’ kag ‘pinansyer’, indi ini magduha-duha nga magbalik man sa pulitika agud bunggo-on ang ginatungdan sini nga mga indibidwal.
english: However, he assured that if what he described as a 'protector' and 'financier' returns to politics, he will not hesitate to return to politics to bump up the individuals he is responsible for.

text: Ginbuyagag man ni Treñas nga tuman kabudlay ang iya naagyan sang 2019 sa iya pagungko kasunod sang pagbansag sa syudad nga ‘most shabulized city’ sa pungsod.
english: Treñas also revealed that he went through a very difficult time in 2019 during his tenure following the naming of the city as the 'most shabulized city' in the country.

text: Gin-suportahan ni United States President Joe Biden ang pahayag sang Israel nga indi sila ang sa likod sang rocket strike sa ospital sa Gaza nga nagpatay sang 471 ka mga tawo.
english: United States President Joe Biden backed Israel’s claim that it was not behind a rocket strike on a Gaza hospital that killed 471 people.

text: Kadungan ini sang iya nga solidarity visit sa Israel agud magpakita sang suporta kay Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu kag sa bug-os nga pungsod sa tunga sang gyera sini batok sa Hamas militants.
english: This coincides with his solidarity visit to Israel to show support to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the entire country in the midst of its war against Hamas militants.

text: Nagasumpakilay ang mga pahayag kun sin-o ang responsable sa amo nga pag-atake sa Al-Ahli Baptist Hospital sa Gaza nga amo ang rason sang pag-ibwal sang kaakig indi lamang sang mga taga-Middle East kundi sang North Africa kag iban pa nga mga pungsod.
english: There are conflicting statements about who was responsible for the attack on the Al-Ahli Baptist Hospital in Gaza, which has sparked outrage not only from the Middle East but also from North Africa and other countries.

text:
Photo: President Joe Biden/Facebook

Madasig ang mga opisyal sa Gaza sa pagpasibangod sa Israel apang nagpanginwala naman ang Israel Defense Forces kag gintudlo sini ang palpak nga rocket launch sang Islamic Jihad nga isa pa ka militant group nga naga-operate man sa Gaza.
english:
Photo: President Joe Biden/Facebook

Officials in Gaza were quick to blame Israel but the Israel Defense Forces denied it and pointed to the failed rocket launch by Islamic Jihad, another militant group also operating in Gaza.

text: Nagdepensa naman ang Islamic Jihad kag nagsiling nga wala sang basehan ang akusasyon sang Israel.
english: Islamic Jihad has defended itself, saying Israel's accusations are baseless.

text: Suno sa amo nga militante nga grupo, wala sila nagagamit sang public facilities kaangay sang mga ospital para lamang sa military purposes.
english: According to the militant group, they do not use public facilities such as hospitals for military purposes only.

text:
Photo: ABED KHALED/AP

Apisar sini nga mga pahayag, pila na ka Arab countries lakip ang Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, United Arab Emirates kag Iraq ang nag-isyu sang statements nga naga-kondenar sa Israel kag nag-akusar sa Israeli military sa pagbomba sa ospital.
english:
Photo: ABED KHELED/AP

Despite these statements, several Arab countries including Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, the United Arab Emirates and Iraq have issued statements condemning Israel and accusing the Israeli military of bombing the hospital.

text: Linibo man ka protesters ang nagtipon sa Lebanon, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Egypt, Tunisia, kag mangin sa West Bank city of Ramallah agud nga isinggit ang kaugot sa Israel.
english: Thousands of protesters also gathered in Lebanon, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Egypt, Tunisia, and even the West Bank city of Ramallah to chant their hatred of Israel.

text: Mangin diri sa Pilipinas, nagtipon ang progresibo nga mga grupo agud pakamalauton ang amo nga hitabo.
english: Even here in the Philippines, progressive groups gathered to condemn the incident.

text: Kun si Biden naman ang pahambalon, base sa data sang Defense Department, indi iya sang Israeli military ang amo nga pagpasigabong sa ospital.
english: As for Biden, based on Defense Department data, the Israeli military did not belong to the hospital.

text: “And, based on what I’ve seen, it appears as though it was done by the other team, not you,” suno sa US President nga nagatumod sa Hamas kagIslamic Jihad nga pareho nga na-tag bilang “terrorist” groups sa US kag sa iban nga Western governments.
english: “And, based on what I’ve seen, it appears as though it was done by the other team, not you,” the US President said, referring to Hamas andIslamic Jihad, both of which have been tagged as “terrorist” groups in the US and other Western governments.

text: Ang National Security Council spokesperson ang nagpahayag man nga ang analysis sang hitabo ang nagasiling man nga indi Israel ang yara sa likod sang amo nga hitabo.
english: The National Security Council spokesperson also said that the analysis of the incident also said that Israel was not behind the incident.

text: Suno naman sa spokesman sang Israel Defense Forces nga si Rear Admiral Daniel Hagari, nakahibalo na ang Hamas nga ang ila kaalyado nga Islamic Jihad ang responsable sa pagpasigabong sa ospital apang indi lang sila mag-ako agud nga matum-ok ang Israel.
english: Israel Defense Forces spokesman Rear Admiral Daniel Hagari said Hamas is aware that its ally Islamic Jihad is responsible for the hospital attack but they will not admit it in order to overwhelm Israel.

text: Dugang naman nga promisa ni Biden, indi pagtalikdan sang Amerika ang Israel.
english: Biden also promised that America will not abandon Israel.

text: Ginpasalig man sini nga naga-trabaho sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika kaupod sa iban nga partners sa Middle East agud indi na madugangan ang mga trahedya para sa mga sibilyan.
english: He also assured that the United States of America is working with other partners in the Middle East to prevent further tragedies for civilians.

text: WESTERN VISAYAS– Nagtakop na ang training sessions sang Electoral Boards sa Western Visayas bilang preparasyon sa nagahilapit nga May Midterm Elections.
english: WESTERN VISAYAS – The training sessions of the Electoral Boards in Western Visayas have ended in preparation for the upcoming May Midterm Elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Commission on Elections (Comelec) Region 6 Director Atty. Dennis Ausan, iya ginpahayag nga kadam-an sa mga electoral boards ang mga beterano na nga nagapartisipar sa mga nagliligad nga eleksyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Commission on Elections (Comelec) Region 6 Director Atty. Dennis Ausan, he said that most of the electoral boards are veterans who participated in the previous elections.

text: Suno kay Ausan, nagserbe na lang nga refresher course ang training sa diin ginasiguro nga updated sa bag-o nga protocols kag teknolohiya ang mga electoral boards.
english: Ausan said the training served as a refresher course to ensure that the electoral boards are updated on new protocols and technology.

text: Importante ang katungdanan sang Electoral Board sa electoral process bangud sila ang nagasiguro nga smooth kag nagasunod sa pagsulundan ang voting procedures.
english: The Electoral Board plays an important role in the electoral process because they ensure that the voting procedures are smooth and compliant.
