text: Pahayag sang Director, may yara sang benepisyo nga mabaton ang electoral boards para sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: The Director said the electoral boards will receive benefits for the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Ang Chairperson sang Electoral Board ang makabaton sang P12,000 nga honorarium samtang P11,000 naman para sa Poll Clerk kag Third Member.
english: The Chairperson of the Electoral Board will receive P12,000 honorarium while the Poll Clerk and Third Member will receive P11,000.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, may yara sang gin-certify ang Department of Science and Technology (DOST) sang indi magnubo sa isa ka poll worker sa kada clustered precinct bilang IT-capable nga amo ang maga-manage maayo sa technical aspects sang voting kag counting processes.
english: He added that the Department of Science and Technology (DOST) has certified at least one poll worker in each clustered precinct as IT-capable who will manage the technical aspects of the voting and counting processes.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang eleksyon ang natalana sa Mayo 12, 2025 sa diin magabukas ang polling stations halin las singko sang aga tubtob las siete sang gab-i.
english: The election is scheduled for May 12, 2025 where polling stations will be open from 5 am to 7 pm.

text: Nagnubo ang importasyon sang bugas sang pungsod sa sulod sang una nga lima ka bulan sang tuig sa 12.55 porsyento sa tuigan nga basehan nga nagalab-ot sa kapin 2.5 million metric tons, suno sa Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI).
english: The country’s rice imports fell during the first five months of the year by 12.55 per cent on an annual basis amounting to more than 2.5 million metric tons, according to the Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI).

text: Santo sa pinakaulihi nga datos sang Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI), nagapakita nga ang importasyon sang bugas umpisa Enero tubtob Mayo naglab-ot sa 1.88 million metric tons, kapin 270,000 MT nga mas manubo kumpara sa 2.15 million metric tons nga narecord sa amo man nga panahon sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the latest data from the Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI), rice imports from January to May reached 1.88 million metric tons, more than 270,000 MT lower than the 2.15 million metric tons recorded in the same period last year.

text: Nagnubo ang importasyon sang bugas subong kumpara sang tinalikdan nga tuig bangud sa mataas nga carry-over stocks matapos nga ang pribado nga sektor nagdala sang mataas nga volume record nga 4.8 million metric tons sang 2024.
english: Rice imports declined today compared to last year due to high carry-over stocks after the private sector brought in a record high volume of 4.8 million metric tons in 2024.

text: Dugang pa diri, ang pagpatuman sang maximum suggested retail price sa mga imported premium rice nakabulig man sa pagpanubo sang importasyon sang bugas base sa obsernasyon sang mga negosyante.
english: In addition, the implementation of the maximum suggested retail price on imported premium rice has also helped reduce rice imports based on the observation of traders.

text: Napilitan ang health officials sa Gaza Strip nga i-sulod sa ice cream freezer trucks ang bangkay sang mga Palestinians bangud sa pagpanglakaak sang numero sang patay tuga sang air strikes sang Israel.
english: Health officials in the Gaza Strip have been forced to load the bodies of Palestinians into ice cream freezer trucks as the death toll from Israeli air strikes has risen.

text:
Photo:  REUTERS/ Stringer

Suno kay Dr. Yasser Ali sang Shuhada Al-Aqsa hospital sa Deir Al-Balah, 10 ka lawas lamang ang mabutang sa mga morgue sa ospital gani nga gindala na ang freezers sang ice cream halin sa ice cream factories agud may sudlan sang mga bangkay sang mga sibilyan.
english:
Photo:  REUTERS/ Stringer

According to Dr. Yasser Ali of Shuhada Al-Aqsa hospital in Deir Al-Balah, said only 10 bodies can be placed in the morgues at the hospital so the freezers of ice cream from ice cream factories have been brought to accommodate the bodies of civilians.

text: Sa rekord sang Palestinian Ministry of Health sa Gaza, yara na sa 2,450 ka mga tawo ang napatay sa Palestine halin sang nagtimalos ang Israel kag nagpatigayon sang air assault.
english: According to the records of the Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza, around 2,450 people have been killed in Palestine since Israel retaliated and carried out the air assault.

text: Gutok ang mga ospital bangud magluwas sa mga patay, masobra 10,000 ang nagkalasamaran kag kulang naman ang espasyaso sa mga patyo.
english: Hospitals are overcrowded because besides the dead, more than 10,000 people are injured and there is a lack of space in the cemeteries.

text: Matandaan nga una na naghatag sang ligwa ang Israeli military nga makaguwa ang Gazans sa northern Gaza antes ini magpatigayon sang ground kag air assault agud madugmok ang armado nga Hamas nga nagpatay sang masobra 1,300 ka Israeli sang nagligad nga Sabado.
english: It can be recalled that the Israeli military had earlier allowed Gazans to leave northern Gaza before launching a ground and air assault to crush the armed Hamas that killed more than 1,300 Israelis last Saturday.

text:
Walo ka police chiefs sa Metro Manila ang ginkakas sa puwesto bangud sa kapaltahan nga masunod ang “5-minute response time”

Suno kay PNP Chief Gen.
english:
Eight police chiefs in Metro Manila were removed from office for failing to follow the “5-minute response time”

According to PNP Chief Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III, wala nagsunod ang mga hepe nga ipatuman ang programa.
english: Nicolas Torre III, the chiefs did not comply to implement the program.

text: Ang mga pulis nga gin-relieve halin sa Navotas, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Mandaluyong, Marikina, San Juan, Parañaque, kag Makati.
english: The relieved policemen are from Navotas, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Mandaluyong, Marikina, San Juan, Parañaque, and Makati.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Torre nga may masunod pa nga mga opisyal nga posible nga pagakakson, lakip ang pila ka provincial directors sa Visayas.
english: Torre also said there are more officials who are likely to be removed, including some provincial directors in the Visayas.

text: Ang 5-minute response strategy, suno sa PNP, isa ka bag-o nga pamaagi nga nagapabakod sang mobile kag madasig nga serbisyo sa publiko.
english: The 5-minute response strategy, according to the PNP, is a new approach that strengthens mobile and fast services to the public.

text: Naglalapta kag nagkalawasak ang mga sandiya sa tunga sang dalan matapos nga natumba ang truck nga nagakarga sini sa Brgy.
english: Watermelons were scattered in the middle of the road after a truck carrying them overturned in Brgy.

text: Rizal-Tuguisan, Guimbal kahapon sang hapon.
english: Rizal-Tuguisan, Guimbal yesterday afternoon.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Liutenant Lario Esposo, hepe sang Guimbal Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga pakadto kuntani sa banwa sang Miagao ang truck nga may karga nga 1.3 tonelada sang sandiya sang hinali lang nga naglupok ang panguna nga goma sini sa wala nga bahin kag nadulaan sang control ang driver kag natumba ini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Lario Esposo, chief of the Guimbal Municipal Police Station, said the truck was heading to Miagao town when it suddenly burst its main tire on the left side and the driver lost control and fell.

text: Suno kay Esposo, bangud sa pagkatumba sang truck, nagkalaula ang karga sini nga sandiya kag nakaagum sang mga minor injuries ang mga pahinante sini nga tatlo ka bilog nga nagapungko sa likod.
english: According to Esposo, due to the overturning of the truck, its load of watermelon spilled and minor injuries were sustained by its three passengers sitting in the back.

text: Gilayon man nga gindapatan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong ang mga nasamaran sang emergency responder sang amo nga banwa.
english: The injured were immediately treated by the emergency responder of the town.

text: Nagpungko bilang pinakauna nga Officer-in-charge sang Police Regional Office-Negros Island Region (PRO-NIR) si Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky.
english: Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky took office as the first Officer-in-charge of the Police Regional Office-Negros Island Region (PRO-NIR).

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma mismo ni Wanky sa iya nga speech sa ginpatigayon nga activation sang PRO-NIR nga ginhiwat sa Bacolod City.
english: This was confirmed by Wanky himself in his speech at the activation of PRO-NIR held in Bacolod City.

text: Si Wanky ang nagapungko man nga Regional Director sang Police Regional Office 6.
english: Wanky is also the incumbent Regional Director of Police Regional Office 6.

text: Suno kay Wanky, buy-an lamang sini ang posisyon bilang PRO-6 director kun may bag-o na nga opisyal nga magabulos sa iya.
english: Wanky said he will only vacate the position as PRO-6 director if a new official replaces him.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang pagtukod sang PRO- NIR ang santo sa National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) Resolution No.
english: The establishment of PRO-NIR is in accordance with National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) Resolution No.

text: 2025-0055 nga ginpagwa sang Enero 9, 2025.
english: 2025-0055 issued on January 9, 2025.

text: Katuyuan sini nga mapadasig ang pagsaylo sang administratibo nga superbisyon kag operational control sa Police Provincial Offices sang Negros Oriental, Negros Occidental, Siquijor, kag Bacolod City Police Office.
english: The purpose of this is to expedite the transfer of administrative supervision and operational control to the Police Provincial Offices of Negros Oriental, Negros Occidental, Siquijor, and Bacolod City Police Office.

text: Napatay ang video journalist sang Reuters kag nasamaran ang anum ka iban pa nga katapo sang media sa Southern Lebanon matapos naigu sang missile nga ginapahayag ginpalupad halin sa direksyon sang Israel.
english: A Reuters video journalist was killed and six other members of the media in Southern Lebanon were wounded after being hit by a missile allegedly fired from the direction of Israel.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang international news agency nga ang ila empleyado nga nagtaliwan amo si Issam Abdallah nga sang amo nga tion naga-hatag sang live video signal para sa broadcasters.
english: The international news agency also confirmed that its employee who passed away was Issam Abdallah who at the time was providing a live video signal for broadcasters.

text: Suno sa reports, nagatutok ang camera sa nabukid nga area sang hinali lang, may tuman ka tunog nga lupok, nag-uyog ang camera, napuno sang aso ang palibot kag ang sunod nga nabatian amo ang mga singgit kag paghilibion.
english: According to reports, the camera was focusing on the mountainous area when suddenly, there was a very loud gunshot, the camera shook, the surroundings were filled with smoke and the next thing heard were screams and wailing.

text: Ang duha ka iban pa nga Reuters journalists nga sanday Thaer Al-Sudani kag Maher Nazeh ang lakip sa nasamaran sa insidente kag nakaguwa na sa ospital matapos nadapatan sang pagbulong.
english: Two other Reuters journalists, Thaer Al-Sudani and Maher Nazeh, were among those injured in the incident and have since been discharged from hospital after receiving treatment.

text: Suno kay Nazeh, nagakuha sang footages ang Reuters kag ang duha ka iban pa nga news organizations sa missile fire nga halin sa Israel sang hinali lang, naigu si Abdallah samtang nagapangabudlay ini sa pagpungko sa manubo nga pader.
english: Nazeh said Reuters and two other news organizations were taking footage of the missile fire from Israel when Abdallah was suddenly hit while he was struggling to sit on a low wall.

text: Pila ka segundos ang nagligad, may isa pa ka missile nga nag-igu sa salakyan nga ginagamit sang grupo sang mga katapo sang media rason nga nag-ibwal ang kalayo.
english: Seconds later, another missile struck a vehicle used by a group of media members, causing it to burst into flames.

text: Suno sa Agence France-Presse, duha sa ila nga journalists ang napilasan, samtang ang Qatari-funded broadcaster nga Al Jazeera ang nagkumpirma nga may empleyado man sila nga nakaangkon sang injuries.
english: According to Agence France-Presse, two of their journalists were injured, while Qatari-funded broadcaster Al Jazeera confirmed that an employee of theirs also sustained injuries.

text: Kasunod sang hitabo, ginbasol ni Lebanese Prime Minister Najib Mikati ang Israel.
english: Following the incident, Lebanese Prime Minister Najib Mikati blamed Israel.

text: Ginahulat man kun may ipagwa nga statement ang Israel Defense Forces.
english: The Israel Defense Forces are also awaiting a statement.

text: Pahayag naman sang UN envoy sang Israel nga si Gilad Erdan: “Obviously, we would never want to hit or kill or shoot any journalist that is doing its job.
english: Israeli UN envoy Gilad Erdan said: “Obviously, we would never want to hit or kill or shoot any journalist who is doing his job.

text: But you know, we’re in a state of war, things might happen.” Ginpasalig sini nga maga-imbestigar ang ila nga pungsod.
english: But you know, we’re in a state of war, things might happen.” He assured that their country will investigate.

text: Mangayo sang P733 million budget ang Office of the Vice President para sa 2026 sa diin may yara ini sang “minor adjustment” bangud sa inflation.
english: The Office of the Vice President will request a P733 million budget for 2026 with a minor adjustment due to inflation.

text: Matandaan nga may yara sang P733 million nga pondo ang opisina subong nga tuig matapos ginbuhinan sang Congress ang ginduso nga pondo nga P1.29 billion bangud sa ginaalegar iregularidad sang paggasto sang ahensya sang tinalikdan nga tuig.
english: It can be recalled that the office has a P733 million budget this year after Congress reduced the proposed fund of P1.29 billion due to alleged irregularities in the agency's spending last year.

text: Suno sa bise presidente, wala na siya nagpangayo sang mas dako nga podo sa iya opisina para sa masunod nga tuig agud malikawan nga mabutang ang mga opisyal sang Office of the Vice President sa kahuy-anan nga sitwasyon sa budget deliberations.
english: The vice president said he did not ask for a larger budget from his office for next year to avoid putting the officials of the Office of the Vice President in an embarrassing situation in the budget deliberations.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang ginbuhinan ang 2025 nga pondo, wala na ginpadayon sang OVP ang medical kag burial assistance programs amo man ang distribution sang tinapay sa pipila ka mga estudyante.
english: It was learned that when the 2025 fund was reduced, the OVP did not continue the medical and burial assistance programs as well as the distribution of bread to some students.

text: Magasugod na subong nga adlaw ang opisyal nga 45-day campaign period para sa local candidates para sa Mayo 12 nga eleksyon.
english: The official 45-day campaign period for local candidates for the May 12 elections will begin today.

text: Buot silingon, masako na ang mga kandidato nga nagapapili para sa 82 ka posisyon para sa pagka-gobernador kag bise- gobernador, 792 ka posisyon para sa provincial board members, 149 ka pwesto para sa city mayorships kag city vice mayorships, 1,682 city councilor posts, 1,493 municipal mayorships and vice mayorships, 11, 948 municipal councilor positions, kag 254 seats sa House of Representatives.
english: This means that candidates are already busy running for 82 positions for governor and vice-governor, 792 positions for provincial board members, 149 seats for city mayorships and city vice mayorships, 1,682 city councilor posts, 1,493 municipal mayorships, and vice mayorships. 11, 948 municipal councilor positions, and 254 seats in the House of Representatives.

text: Kaangot diri, nagpahanumdom si Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chairperson George Erwin Garcia sa tanan nga kandidato nga magsunod sa guidelines nga gin-set sang poll body para sa malinong kag matawhay nga midterm elections.
english: In this regard, Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chairperson George Erwin Garcia reminded all candidates to follow the guidelines set by the poll body for a peaceful and orderly midterm elections.

text: Base sa Comelec Resolution No.
english: Based on Comelec Resolution No.

text: 11086 nga nagaplastar sang pagsulundan para sa Republic Act No.
english: 11086 laying down the rules for Republic Act No.

text: 9006 ukon ang Fair Elections Act, natalana ang campaign period para sa local positions umpisa subong nga Marso 28 tubtob sa Mayo 10, 2025.
english: 9006 or the Fair Elections Act, the campaign period for local positions is scheduled from March 28 to May 10, 2025.

text: Ang campaign period naman para sa national candidates ang nagsugod sang Pebrero 11 tubtob May 10.
english: The campaign period for national candidates ran from February 11 to May 10.

text:
Wala naman ginatugutan ang mga kandidato nga magpangampanya sa Abril 17 (Maundy Thursday), Abril 18 (Good Friday), Mayo 11 (eve of Election Day), kag Mayo 12 (Election Day.)

Suno kay Garcia, magapatuman ang Comelec sang mas strikto nga mga tikang batok sa election campaign materials nga wala nagatuman sa size limitations ukon natapik sa indi otorisado nga public spaces.
english:
Candidates are not allowed to campaign on April 17 (Maundy Thursday), April 18 (Good Friday), May 11 (eve of Election Day), and May 12 (Election Day.)

Garcia said the Comelec will implement stricter measures against election campaign materials that do not comply with size limitations or are posted in unauthorized public spaces.

text: Striktuhan man sang Comelec ang kampanya batok sa vote-buying, vote-selling, kag pag-abuso sa state resources kadungan man sang paglunsar liwat sang Committee on Kontra-Bigay.
english: The Comelec will also tighten its campaign against vote-buying, vote-selling, and abuse of state resources while also relaunching the Committee on Kontra-Bigay.

text:
Yari ang dugang pa gid nga mga guidelines sa tion sang campaign period:

1.Ginadumilian ang paghatag sang donasyon umpisa Pebrero 11 tubtob May 12 sang isa ka kandidato, iya asawa ukon bana ukon paryente nga yara sa second civil degree of consanguinity ukon affinity, ukon ang iya campaign manager, agent, kag representative.
english:
Here are more guidelines during the campaign period:

1.Donations are prohibited from February 11 to May 12 by a candidate, his or her spouse or relative in the second civil degree of consanguinity or affinity, or his or her campaign manager, agent, and representative.

text: 2.Wala ginatugutan ang pag-appoint ukon paggamit sang kapulisan, confidential agents, ukon mga tawo nga naga-perform sang pareho nga functions.
english: 2.The appointment or use of police, confidential agents, or persons performing similar functions is not permitted.

text: 3.Umpisa Marso 28 tubtob Mayo 11, ipatuman man ang restrictions sa pag- transfer, pag- hire, kag pag- promote sang employees sa government offices.
english: From March 28 to May 11, restrictions will also be implemented on the transfer, hiring, and promotion of employees in government offices.

text: 4.Ang spending ban magaumpisa man sa sini nga period.
english: 4.The spending ban will also start during this period.

text: 5.Sa gab-i antes ang adlaw sang piniliay, ipatuman man ang liquor ban nationwide.
english: On the night before election day, a liquor ban will also be implemented nationwide.

text: Samtang, ginsiling ni Comelec Chair Garcia nga magapatigayon sila sang nationwide synchronized Grand Oplan Baklas subong nga aga agud kakasyn ang mga illegal campaign materials.
english: Meanwhile, Comelec Chair Garcia said they will conduct a nationwide synchronized Grand Oplan Baklas this morning to crack down on illegal campaign materials.

text: Nagalagas sa tyempo ang masobra isa ka milyon ka mga residente sa northern Gaza Strip agud makabakwit insigida pa-nabagatnan sa sulod sang 24 ka oras.
english: More than a million residents in the northern Gaza Strip are racing against time to evacuate immediately south within 24 hours.

text: Ini matapos nagpaulan sang leaflets ang Israeli military kag naghatag sang paandam nga indi dapat magbalik ang mga residente sa ila balay tubtub nga wala pa sang abiso halin sa Israel Defense Forces.
english: This comes after the Israeli military rained leaflets and warned residents not to return to their homes until there is a notification from the Israel Defense Forces.

text: May paandam man nga dapat wala sang magtinir pati sa public shelters sa Gaza City.
english: There is also a warning that no one should stay even in public shelters in Gaza City.

text: Dugang pa nga warning, posible nga mapatay ang bisan sin-o man sa Gaza nga magpalapit sa security fence nga amo ang naga-separar sa amo nga area sa Israel.
english: Additional warning, anyone in Gaza who approaches the security fence that separates the area from Israel could be killed.

text: Suno kay Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant, naga-impon ang Hamas militants sa mga sibilyan sa Gaza gani dapat sila nga i-separar gilayon.
english: According to Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant, Hamas militants are mixing with civilians in Gaza and should be separated immediately.

text:
Photo: Hatem Ali/AP

Agud maluwas suno sa Israeli military, dapat nga magkadto sa direksyon pa-nabagatnan bangud gub-on sang Israel ang kuta sang Hamas — lakip dira ang tanan nga imprastraktura, headquarters, kag militar sang amo nga militante nga grupo.
english:
Photo: Hatem Ali/AP

To escape, according to the Israeli military, it is necessary to go south because Israel will destroy the stronghold of Hamas — including all the infrastructure, headquarters, and military of the militant group.

text: Sa rekord sang United Nations, yara sa 1.1 milyon ka mga tawo ang nagapuyo sa northern Gaza.
english: According to United Nations records, around 1.1 million people live in northern Gaza.

text: Ang mensahe sang Israel military ang ginbasa man ni Lt.
english: The message of the Israeli military was also read by Lt. Col.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Jonathan Conricus, international spokesperson sang Israel Defense Forces, agud mapahibalo sa United Nations.
english: Jonathan Conricus, international spokesperson of the Israel Defense Forces, to brief the United Nations.

text: Naghatag naman sang national address si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga panason sini ang Hamas samtang nga naga-preparar na subong ang militar sang Israel sang ground invasion sa Gaza Strip.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu gave a national address to wipe out Hamas as the Israeli military prepares a ground invasion of the Gaza Strip.

text: Gin-deliver ang amo nga address Byernes sang kagab-ihon oras sa Israel ukon pila ka oras lang gid ang nagligad kun basehan ang oras diri sa Pilipinas.
english: The address was delivered Friday night Israel time or just a few hours ago based on Philippine time.

text: Naghingyo naman ang United Nations sa Israel nga bawion ang ila mandu nga magbakwit ang mga residente sa sulod lang sang 24 ka oras bangud imposible ini nga matabo samtang padayon ang airstrikes.
english: The United Nations has urged Israel to withdraw its order to evacuate residents within 24 hours as it is impossible to do so while the airstrikes continue.

text: Gin-report sang media office sang Hamas nga samtang nagapalalagyo ang mga tawo padulong sa nabagatnan, nagasige man ang pagpamomba sang warplanes sa mga salakyan kag as of press time, 70 na ang nagkalamatay.
english: Hamas' media office reported that as people fled south, warplanes continued to bomb vehicles and as of press time, 70 people had been killed.

text: May reports nga nagmandu man ang Hamas militants sa mga Palestinians nga magtinir sa ila balay — baliskad sa mandu sang Israeli military.
english: There are reports that Hamas militants have also ordered Palestinians to stay at home — contrary to Israeli military orders.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa pagtimalos sang Israel bangud sa pagpang-atake sang Hamas militans, 1,537 na ka Gaza residents ang napatay lakip na ang 500 ka kabataan.
english: It is known that in Israel's retaliation for the attacks of Hamas militants, 1,537 Gaza residents have been killed including 500 children.

text: May 6,600 man nga nasamaran suno pa sa Gaza Health Ministry.
english: There were also 6,600 injured, according to the Gaza Health Ministry.

text: Nagpaguwa sang Executive Order No.
english: Issued Executive Order No.

text: 26 si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga naga-suspend sang tanan nga face-to-face nga klase sa tanan nga level sa private kag public schools sa Iloilo City subong nga adlaw kadungan sang pagsugod sang local campaign period.
english: 26 Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas suspending all face-to-face classes at all levels in private and public schools in Iloilo City today in conjunction with the start of the local campaign period.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ang tikang ang sabat sa ginalauman nga pagdugok sang mga supporters sang tagsa ka mga partido.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said the move is in response to the expected influx of supporters of each party.

text: Tinutuyo man sang tikang nga malikaw sa huol ang mga estudyante.
english: The move also aims to avoid stress for students.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, lakip sa EO ang pagsirado sa pila ka mga dalan sa City Proper padulong sa Iloilo Freedom Grandstand.
english: According to Fantilaga, the EO includes the closure of several roads in City Proper leading to the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara sang hiwaton nga campaign kick-off rally ang Team Uswag sa Freedom Grandstand sugod las 4:00 sa hapon.
english: Team Uswag will hold a campaign kick-off rally at the Freedom Grandstand starting at 4:00 pm.

text: Samtang may yara man sang motorcade para sa kaadlawan ni Former President Rodrigo Duterte nga magasugod sa Sta.
english: Meanwhile, there will also be a motorcade for Former President Rodrigo Duterte's birthday starting at Sta.

text: Teresita Church pagkatapos sang las-2:00 sa hapon nga misa.
english: Teresita Church after the 2:00 pm mass.

text: Milagro nga nakaluwas sa katalagman ang kapid nga lapsag matapos nadala sa massacre ang ila iloy kag amay sang nagsalakay ang Hamas militants sa Israel.
english: The twin babies miraculously survived after their mother and father were massacred when Hamas militants attacked Israel.

text: Natabo ang brutal nga pagpamatay sa Kfar Aza kibbutz nga isa ka komunidad nga malapit lamang sa Gaza Strip nga teritoryo sang militante nga grupo.
english: The brutal massacre took place in the Kfar Aza kibbutz, a community just outside the militant group's Gaza Strip territory.

text: Suno sa Israeli Embassy sa France, lakip sa mga napatay sang Sabado amo ang mag-asawa nga sanday Itai kag Hadar Berdichevsky, pareho nga 30 anyos.
english: According to the Israeli Embassy in France, among those killed on Saturday were couple Itai and Hadar Berdichevsky, both in their 30s.

text:
Photo: Daily Mail UK

Apang dugang sang embahada, antes pa man nabawian sang kabuhi ang mag-asawa, nahingagaw nila luwas ang ila kapid nga anak nga naga-edad sang 10 ka bulan.
english:
Photo: Daily Mail UK

However, the embassy added that before the couple died, they were able to rescue their 10-month-old twin child.

text: Ginpahayag nga antes nagsulod ang mga terorista sa ila puluy-an sa Kfar Aza, natago sang mag-asawa ang kapid kag nagpabilin ang mga lapsag nga hilway sa katalagman sa masunod nga 14 ka oras antes nag-abot ang emergency services.
english: Reportedly, before the terrorists broke into their Kfar Aza home, the couple hid the twins and the babies remained safe for the next 14 hours before emergency services arrived.

text: Ginpahayag nga masobra 1,200 ka Israelis ang napatay kag masobra 3,000 ang nasamaran sang ginlunsar sang Hamas ang atake sang Sabado.
english: More than 1,200 Israelis were reportedly killed and more than 3,000 wounded when Hamas launched the attack on Saturday.

text: Sa Gaza naman — kun sa diin kabataan ang halos katunga sang Palestinians nga nagapuyo — masobra 1,200 ka tawo ang patay lakip ang ginatos ka mga bata sang nagtimalos na ang Israeli military.
english: In Gaza — where children make up nearly half of the Palestinians — more than 1,200 people were killed, including hundreds of children, when the Israeli military retaliated.

text: SA PAGHINUN-anon ni VP Leni sa mga negosyante sa Cebu sadtong Disyembre 13, 2021gin-proponer niya ang isa ka “Decentralized Government” nga iya pamunuan kon magdaug siya sa Mayo 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: IN VP Leni's discussion with businessmen in Cebu on December 13, 2021, she proposed a “Decentralized Government” that she will lead if she wins the May 2022 elections.

text: Paagi sini, paathag niya, ang poder sang pang-gobyerno indi ma-monopoliya sang isa ukon pila lang ka tawo.
english: In this way, he explained, government power cannot be monopolized by one or a few people.

text: Ihatag ini, sunu man sa iya, “in the hands of many” agud matagaan sing mabaskug nga tingog ang mga pumuluyo.
english: Give it, he said, “in the hands of many” to give the people a strong voice.

text: Wala nag-elaborate ang balita.
english: The news did not elaborate.

text: Obvious ugaling nga kon tagaan mo sing “tingog ang mga pumuluyo” angot sa kon ano ang pagpa-uswag sang ila lugar, matagaan mo man sila sang poder  agud mapaangat nila ang ila kahimtangan sunu sa ila partikular nga circumstancia kag kaugalian.
english: Obviously, however, if you give the people a “voice” about what is to improve their area, you can also give them the power to improve their situation according to their particular circumstances and customs.

text: Kon kilala na ini nga kapinasahe sang lokalidad, ang maayo nga himuon sang gobyerno nasyonal amo ang paghatag na lang sang mga bulig nga ila ginapangayo sunu sa ila kahimtangan sa karon.
english: Once this is known to the locality, the best thing for the national government to do is to provide the assistance they are asking for according to their current situation.

text: Diri mabuligan sila nga mapautwas kag makita nila ang ila mga problema kag bagay man nga mga solusyon, nga indi na diktahan sang gobyerno nasyonal, nga sa masami ang makita sini amo lang ang iya interes kag sang mga yara sa poder sa ibabaw.
english: Here they will be helped to express and find their problems and appropriate solutions, without being dictated by the national government, which often sees only its own interests and those in power at the top.

text: Matahum ini nga ideya ni VP Leni, no doubt.
english: This is a beautiful idea by VP Leni, no doubt.

text:
***

Diri ta man nahibal-an ang ideya sang Duterte Administration agud itukod ang isa ka federal nga gobyerno kon diin may gobyerno nasyonal kag napabaskug nga gobyerno lokal.
english:
***

Here we also know the idea of the Duterte Administration to establish a federal government where there is a national government and a strengthened local government.

text: Ini ang Federal-Parliamentary System, sa diin ang parliamento, nga isa ka asembliya sang mga representative sang kada lugar may gahum mismo sa pagpalakat sang kaayuhan sang pungsod sa idalom sang prime minister nga gina-recognize sang kadam-an.
english: This is the Federal-Parliamentary System, where the parliament, which is an assembly of representatives of each area has the power itself to run the welfare of the country under the prime minister who is recognized by the majority.

text: Pwede ini siya maislan “anytime” kon indi na maayo ang pagpalakat sini sang pang-gobyerno para sa kaayuhan sang tanan.
english: He can be replaced “anytime” if he is no longer running the government well for the benefit of all.

text: Yara man ang federal system sang United States nga nagahatag sang dalagku nga poder sa nagakalain-lain nga mga estado.
english: There is also the federal system of the United States which gives great power to the various states.

text: Kag yara man ang Canada nga nagahatag sing daku nga kahilwayan sa pagpalakat sang gobyerno sa provinces.
english: And then there is Canada which gives a lot of freedom to run the government in the provinces.

text: In fact, yara man ang European Union nga “confederation” sang mga pungsod sa Uropa, luas lang sa United Kingdom nga nagbulag sang sini lang (2020).
english: In fact, there is also the European Union, a confederation of European countries, except for the United Kingdom, which seceded recently (2020).

text: Diin bala nga klase sang federal system ang tumod ni VP Leni para sa iya ideya nga “decentralized government” nga, in fact, sabat man batok  sa “authoritarian” nga pang-gobyerno sang mga mala-diktador ukon diktador gid?
english: What kind of federal system is VP Leni referring to for her idea of ​​“decentralized government” which is, in fact, a response against the “authoritarian” government of quasi-dictators or dictators?

text: Kon ako lang, may yara na kita nga Local Government Code of 1991 nga nagapalawak na sang poder sang mga lokal nga gobyerno nga kinahanglan lang matagaan sing husto nga interpretasyon sa relasyon sang gobyerno nasyonal kag lokal.
english: If I were alone, we already have the Local Government Code of 1991 which expands the powers of local governments that need to be given the right interpretation in the relationship between national and local governments.

text: May pila man sini ka provision nga ma-amendar para sa maathag gid nga relasyon sining duha ka gobyerno.
english: There are also some of these provisions that can be amended for a very clear relationship between these two governments.

text: Katulad sang kinahanglan nga maathagan kon ano gid bala ang dapat mag-apply nga penalidad sa mga violation sang mga drayber sang Public Utility Vehicles.
english: Similarly, it is necessary to clarify what penalties should be applied to violations by drivers of Public Utility Vehicles.

text: Ang LTO nagpatuman sang mataas nga penalidad samtang ang lokal nga ordinansa nagapatong lang sang manubo nga penalidad.
english: The LTO imposed a high penalty while the local ordinance only imposes a low penalty.

text: Gani, ang nagakatabo nga depende kon ano ang makadakop sa imo.
english: So, what happens that depends on what catches you.

text: Ang LTO bala ukon ang tagapatuman sang lokal nga ordinansa?
english: Is it the LTO or the local ordinance enforcer?

text: Kag katulad man, kag labi na gid, ang pag-kontrol sang gobyerno nasyonal sang distribusyon sng Covid-19 vaccines paagi lang sa gobyerno nasyonal, samtang pwede man matigayon ini paagi sa mga gobyerno local kag private sector nga may pahanugot sang WHO.
english: And similarly, and especially, the national government's control of the distribution of Covid-19 vaccines only through the national government, while it can also be achieved through local governments and the private sector with the approval of the WHO.

text: Maayo lang kay may kaisug ang pila ka mga lokal nga mga lider agud ireklamo ining anomaliya sang may pinilian nga pagpanagtag sang mga vaccines.
english: Fortunately, some local leaders had the courage to complain about this anomaly of biased distribution of vaccines.

text: Katulad ni Mayor Treñas sang Iloilo City, nga tungod sini natagaan gid man ang siyudad sang dugang nga vaccines nga kinahanglan sini.
english: Like Mayor Treñas of Iloilo City, who was able to provide the city with the additional vaccines it needs.

text:
***

Sige man ang pagpangaluyag ni VP Leni sa private sector agud mabuligan ang mga probinsya kag mga siyudad agud mapalab-ut sa ila ang kinahanglan nga pagpa-uswag sang mga lokalidad, labi na gid ang paghatag sing trabaho.
english:
***

VP Leni also urged the private sector to assist the provinces and cities to deliver the necessary development of the localities, especially the creation of jobs.

text: Kon matigayon ining ideya nga “decentralization” ni VP Leni, wala na sing rason ang plano sang iban nga itukod ang Federal-Parliamentary System sang Duterte Administration, nga ginapatihan sang kadam-an nga ginplano lang agud ipabilin sa poder ang yara na sa karon sa poder.
english: If this idea of ​​“decentralization” of VP Leni is achieved, there will be no reason for the plan of others to establish the Federal-Parliamentary System of the Duterte Administration, which many believe was planned only to keep in power those who are now in power.

text: Indi man naton kinahanglan ang ideya sang decentralization ukonn federalismo sang iban nga pungsod kay lain man ang kahimtangan naton sangsa ila.
english: We don't need the idea of ​​decentralization or federalism of other countries because our situation is different from theirs.

text: The best still amo ang nasuguran na naton nga kinahanglan lang sing diutay nga pagtadlong./PN
english: The best still is the one we have already started that only needs a little correction./PN

text:
Siling nila, “a mother’s love knows no bounds.”

Siguro ang aton mga iloy mismo ang makapamatuod sini kag kita mismo ang maswerte nga naka-eksperyensya sang amo sini nga sahi sang pagpalangga.
english:
They say, “a mother’s love knows no bounds.”

Maybe our mothers themselves can attest to this and we ourselves are lucky enough to have experienced this kind of love.

text: Apang nakit-an mo na bala ini sa isa ka sapat?
english: But have you ever seen it in an animal?

text: Sa Bioparc Valencia nga isa ka zoo sa Spain, madamo ang nakakilala sa chimpanzee nga si Natalia — indi lang ang iya pangalan ang popular kundi ang tumalagsahon sini nga istorya.
english: At the Bioparc Valencia which is a zoo in Spain, many know the chimpanzee Natalia — it is not only her name that is popular but the unusual of its story.

text: Nagbata si Natalia sa iya baby chimpanzee sang Pebrero, apang duha ka semana ang nakaligad, sa masubo nga palad, napatay ang bata sini.
english: Natalia gave birth to her baby chimpanzee in February, but two weeks later, unfortunately, the child died.

text: Nangin mabudlay para kay Natalia nga magpaalam sa iya bata gani madamo gid ang nasakitan sang nakit-an kun ano ang iya nga ginhimo.
english: It was difficult for Natalia to say goodbye to her son and many were hurt when they saw what she had done.

text: Bisan patay na ang baby chimpanzee, wala gid ini ginbuy-an sang iya iloy kag ginakugos gid bisan diin siya magkadto.
english: Even though the baby chimpanzee was dead, his mother never let him go and hugged him wherever he went.

text: Wala sini ginhal-id ukon ginbutang sa duta ang iya baby tubtub nga naagnas na ini kag tul-an na lang ang nabilin.
english: She did not lay her baby on the ground until it was rotten and only bones remained.

text: Pito ka bulan sini nga ginkugos ang iya baby, kag subong nga bulan suno sa zoo, daw kaangay nga nabaton na ni Natalia ang kapalaran sang iya baby.
english: She carried her baby for seven months, and this month, according to the zoo, Natalia seems to have accepted her baby's fate.

text: Naghalong gid ini sa pagbutang sa bangkay sang iya bata sa kahilamunan kag gintalikdan.
english: She was very careful to put her son's body in the grass and abandoned it.

text: Gin-respeto sang mga zoo keeper ang paglalaw ni Natalia, kag sang ginbuy-an na sini ang baby chimpanzee, didto pa lang kag nagpahilabot na ang management kag ila ini ginlubong.
english: The zoo keepers respected Natalia's grief, and when she released the baby chimpanzee, the management intervened and buried it.

text: Antes gali ang natabo kay Natalia subong nga tuig, napatay man ang isa pa gid sini ka anak sang 2018 gani nga ginabantayan gid sang zoo ang iya nga behavior nga daw kaangay nga isa ini ka tawo.
english: Before what happened to Natalia this year, another of her children died in 2018 so the zoo is watching her behavior as if she were a human being.

text: Ginapaathag man sang zoo sa mga bisita ang pagginawi ni Natalia kag pati na ang pag-isahanon sini kun kaisa nga ginalantaw senyales gihapon sang pagpangasubo sini sa pagkadula sang iya nga bata.
english: The zoo also explains to visitors Natalia's behavior and even her loneliness at times which is still seen as a sign of her grief over the loss of her child.

text: ILOILO CITY- Ka-bombo, mahilig ka bala maggamit sang brown sugar bilang pampatam-is sa imo ilimnon ukon sa imo ginahimo nga dessert?
english: ILOILO CITY- Ka-bombo, do you like to use brown sugar as a sweetener in your drinks or desserts?

text: Matuod nga nagahatag ini sang satisfaction sa mga mahilig sa matam-is,apang ari pa gid ang pat-od nga magahatag sa imo sang satisfaction bangud indi lang ini para sa imo tutunlan kag tiyan, kundi sa imo man panit.
english: It is true that it gives satisfaction to those who love sweets, but here is something else that will surely give you satisfaction because it is not only for your throat and stomach, but also for your skin.

text: Suno kay Dr. Tsippora Shainhouse, isa ka board-certified dermatologist sa Santa Monica, California, ang brown sugar ang kilala nga ginagamit bilang scrub para sa pag-exfoliate sang panit.
english: According to Dr. Tsippora Shainhouse, a board-certified dermatologist in Santa Monica, California, brown sugar is known to be used as a scrub for exfoliating the skin.

text: Ini ang source saang glycolic acid nga amo ang pinakagamay nga alpha-hydroxy acid (AHA) nga maka-panalupsop sa panit agud pahalugon ang bonds sang skin cells nga naga-promote sang cell growth.
english: It is the source of glycolic acid which is the smallest alpha-hydroxy acid (AHA) that can penetrate the skin to strengthen the bonds of skin cells that promote cell growth.

text: Ang brown sugar isa man ka natural humectant nga nagabulig sa panit agud mangin mahumok kag hydrated.
english: Brown sugar is also a natural humectant that helps the skin stay soft and hydrated.

text: Ang application sang brown sugar sa panit ang nagapa-lighten sang panit kag nagapadula sang scars.
english: The application of brown sugar on the skin lightens the skin and eliminates scars.

text: Nagabulig man ang pagpahid sang brown sugar sa guya agud makalikaw sa pimples.
english: Rubbing brown sugar on the face also helps to get rid of pimples.

text: Ginabasol sa pinakadaku nga convention center sa North America ang indi kinaandan kag dungan nga kamatayon sang malapit 1,000 ka mga pispis sa Chicago, Illinois, USA.
english: The largest convention center in North America is being blamed for the unusual and simultaneous death of close to 1,000 birds in Chicago, Illinois, USA.

text: Kilala ang McCormick Place Lakeside Center nga isa ka iconic building sa amo nga estado bangud sa transparent glass nga amo ang nagaserbe nga mga pader sini, apang sa malain nga palad, indi ini makit-an sang mga pispis gani nagkalabunggo, napatay, kag naglalapta sa downtown area.
english: The McCormick Place Lakeside Center, an iconic building in the state, is known for its transparent glass walls, but unfortunately, the birds could not see it and it crashed, died, and spread to the downtown area.

text: Suno sa Chicago Bird Collision Monitors nga isa ka volunteer conservation project nga nakatutok sa pag-proteher sa migratory birds, ang natabo sang tinalikdan nga adlaw amo na ang pinakamataas nga numero sang pispis nga napatay sa sulod lamang sang isa ka adlaw bangud sa ila nga pagkabunggo.
english: According to the Chicago Bird Collision Monitors, a volunteer conservation project focused on protecting migratory birds, yesterday's incident was the highest number of birds killed in a single day due to collisions.

text:
Photo: Lauren Nassef/Chicago Field Museum via AP

Ginalantaw man nga mas magasaka pa ang numero bangud na-obserbaran nga may mga pispis nga nagtinguha pa nga makalupad apisar nagkalasamaran sa amo nga insidente.
english:
Photo: Lauren Nassef/Chicago Field Museum via AP

The number is expected to rise further as it was observed that some birds tried to fly despite being injured in the incident.

text:
Photo: Lauren Nassef/Chicago Field Museum, via Associated Press

Natukiban man nga sang amo nga tion, may yara sang event sa convention center gani bukas ang tanan nga suga nga amo ang posible rason kun ngaa nagsala-sala ang mga pispis.
english:
Photo: Lauren Nassef/Chicago Field Museum, via Associated Press

It was also discovered that at that time, there was an event at the convention center so all the lights were on which is the possible reason why the birds got lost.

text: May yara man sang bagyo sa nabagatnan sang Chigaco nga amo ang ginalantaw rason kun ngaa manubo ang ila nga paglupad.
english: There is also a typhoon south of Chigaco which is believed to be the reason why their flights are low.

text: Sandig sa pagbanta sang mga eksperto, isa ka bilyon nga mga pispis ang nagakapatay kada tuig bangud sa pagka-bunggo sa buildings nga ginahimo sang mga tawo, ilabi na ang mga building nga napalibutan sang glass.
english: According to expert estimates, one billion birds die each year from collisions with man-made buildings, especially glass-enclosed buildings.

text: Preparado ang katapo sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) para sa pagsugod sang local campaign period sang 2025 midterm elections buwas nga adlaw.
english: Members of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) are ready for the start of the local campaign period of the 2025 midterm elections tomorrow.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga may mga augmentation na sila sang kapulisan agud masiguro ang public safety kadungan sang kahiwatan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, said they have already augmented the police to ensure public safety during the event.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, kasado na ang comprehensive security measures para sa primero nga adlaw sang kampanyahanay sa lokal nga bahin.
english: According to Sangrines, comprehensive security measures are already in place for the first day of campaigning in the local area.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa publiko nga gilayon magpakig-angot sa ila kon may mga concern kag matukiban nga indi maayo nga akto may kaangtanan sa eleksyon.
english: He also advised the public to immediately contact them if they have concerns and discover any wrongdoing in connection with the election.

text: Ginpasigurado man sang traffic management sang ICPO nga maplastar sang maayo ang traffic visibility sa dalan sang syudad.
english: The traffic management of the ICPO also ensured that traffic visibility is maintained on the city's roads.

text: Nagbuya man ini sang pasalig nga bisan nagsugod na ang campaign period, magapabilin ang malig-on nga serbisyo sang kapulisan.
english: He also expressed his assurance that even after the campaign period has begun, the police service will remain stable.

text: Ginpunto sang Committee on Transportation sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang Iloilo nga mas maayo kon ipabilin sa Dumangas ang Roll-on, Roll-off (RoRo) operations.
english: The Committee on Transportation of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Iloilo pointed out that it is better to keep the Roll-on, Roll-off (RoRo) operations in Dumangas.

text: Ini kasunod man sang plano nga sayluhon ang RoRo operations sang Dumangas Port sa Fort San Pedro, Iloilo City.
english: This follows the plan to relocate the RoRo operations of Dumangas Port to Fort San Pedro, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ex-Officio Board Member Ramon Sullano, chairman sang Committee on Public Utilities, iya ginpahayag nga ang tikang ang mahimo makatuga sang masakit nga epekto sa palangabuhian sang mga taga-Dumangas.
english: Ex-Officio Board Member Ramon Sullano, chairman of the Committee on Public Utilities, said the move could have a devastating impact on the livelihood of Dumangas residents.

text: Suno kay Sullano, lantawon kag i-examine sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan kon mapasa gidman ang proposal antes maghimo sang desisyon ilabi na nga ginalantaw man nga mangin centralized ang transport facilities kon yara na ini sa syudad.
english: According to Sullano, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan will look at and examine if the proposal is passed before making a decision especially since the transport facilities are also expected to be centralized when they are in the city.

text: Indi man manegar nga may mga disbentaha man ini nga matuga, lakip na ang pagpugok sang trapiko kadungan sang pag-transfer sang operasyon sang Roll-on, Roll-off (RoRo) operations.
english: There is no denying that this will also cause disadvantages, including traffic congestion while transferring the operation of Roll-on, Roll-off (RoRo) operations.

text: Nagapati man si Sullano nga antes ang pinal nga desisyon, ibutang gid ang general welfare ukon ang ikamaayo sang publiko ilabi na sang mga pasahero.
english: Sullano also believes that before the final decision, the general welfare of the public especially the passengers should be put in mind.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginahingyo na sang Philippine Ports Authority (PPA) ang endorsement kag Resolution of No Objection (RONO) sang Iloilo City Council agud mapatuman ang Port Zone Delineation Plan sang Port of Iloilo.
english: The Philippine Ports Authority (PPA) is already seeking the endorsement and Resolution of No Objection (RONO) of the Iloilo City Council to implement the Port Zone Delineation Plan of the Port of Iloilo.

text: Indi magpasugot ang Israel nga maghatag sang humanitarian break sa Gaza Strip tubtub nga indi pagbuy-an sang militante nga grupo nga Hamas ang tanan nga mga bihag.
english: Israel will not agree to provide a humanitarian break in the Gaza Strip until the militant group Hamas releases all hostages.

text: Ini ang sabat ni Energy Minister Israel Katz kasunod sang apelar sang International Committee of the Red Cross nga pahanugutan ang pagbalik sang fuel antes pa mahimo nga mga morgue ang puno na nga daan nga mga ospital.
english: This was the response of Energy Minister Israel Katz following an appeal by the International Committee of the Red Cross to allow the return of fuel before the overcrowded old hospitals are turned into morgues.

text: Pahayag ni Katz, indi nila pag-ibalik ang suplay sang kuryente kag tubig kag indi pagpa-agyon ang fuel truck tubtub nga indi makapauli ang ginabanta 150 ka mga Israeli hostages.
english: Katz said they will not restore power and water supply and will not allow fuel trucks to pass until the estimated 150 Israeli hostages return home.

text: Ang pag-atake sang Israeli Army kag pagpaidalom sa Gaza Strip sa total siege ang kabahin sang ila nga pagtimalos kasunod sang makamamatay nga pagpang-atake man sang Hamas militants sa Israel sang Sabado kun sa diin ginatos ang patay.
english: The Israeli Army's attack and total siege on the Gaza Strip is part of its retaliation following a deadly attack by Hamas militants in Israel on Saturday that killed hundreds.

text:
Photo: Mohammed Salem/Reuters

Ang Gaza nga puluy-an sang 2.3 milyon ka mga tawo ang ginguba man sang Israel paagi sa ila pagpamomba nga amo ang pinakamabaskog sa sulod sang masobra pito ka dekada nga away sang Israel kag Palestine.
english:
Photo: Mohammed Salem/Reuters

Gaza home to 2.3 million people has also been devastated by Israel with its bombardment which is the most intense in more than seven decades of Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

text: Ginpatay ang naga-isahanon nga electric power station sa Gaza nga rason nga nahubsan sang fuel ang mga ospital nga amo kuntani ang kinahanglanon para sa emergency generators.
english: The only electric power station in Gaza was turned off, causing hospitals to run out of fuel that would have been needed for emergency generators.

text: Bangud sini suno sa Red Cross, nabutang sa alang-alang pati ang mga bata nga yara sa incubator kag ang mga tigulang nga nagakinahanglan sang oxygen.
english: As a result, according to the Red Cross, both children in incubators and the elderly who need oxygen are at risk.

text:
Nag-untat man ang kidney dialysis, wala na sang X-rays, kag “amat-amat na nga nagakahimo nga morgue ang mga ospital.”

Sa rekord naman sang U.N. Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, yara na sa 340,000 sa 2.3-milyon nga populasyon sang Gaza ang na-displace bangud sa gyera kag 65% sa ila ang nagatinir sa mga shelter kag sa mga eskwelahan.
english:
Kidney dialysis has also stopped, X-rays are no longer available, and “hospitals are slowly turning into morgues.”

According to the U.N. According to the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, about 340,000 of Gaza's 2.3-million population have been displaced by the war and 65% of them are living in shelters and schools.

text: Ginkakas sa pwesto ang walo ka mga hepe sang pulis sa Metro Manila bangud napaslawan nga ipatuman ang Five-Minute Response time nga polisa sang PNP.
english: Eight police chiefs in Metro Manila have been removed from their posts for failing to implement the PNP's Five-Minute Response Time policy.

text: Suno kay PNP spokesperson Brigadier General Jean Fajardo, ini nga mga hepe ang assigned sa Navotas, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Mandaluyong, Marikina, San Juan, Parañaque, kag Makati.
english: According to PNP spokesperson Brigadier General Jean Fajardo, these chiefs are assigned to Navotas, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Mandaluyong, Marikina, San Juan, Parañaque, and Makati.

text: Ginsiling naman ni PNP chief Police General Nicolas Torre III nga namalibad ang mga police officials nga mag-comply sa policy.
english: PNP chief Police General Nicolas Torre III said the police officials refused to comply with the policy.

text: Dugang ni Torre, may iban pa nga police officials nga kakson sa ila pwesto kalakip na ang provincial directors sa Central Visayas.
english: Torre added that there are other police officials who will be removed from their posts including provincial directors in Central Visayas.

text: Tuyo nga paimbestigaran ni Senator Joel Villanueva ang kontrobersyal nga Ungka Flyover sa Pavia, Iloilo.
english: Senator Joel Villanueva intends to investigate the controversial Ungka Flyover in Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Senator Villanueva, iya ginpahayag nga nahatagan sini igtalupangod ang Ungka Flyover kasunod man sang pagkarumpag sang Sta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Senator Villanueva said he paid attention to the Ungka Flyover following the collapse of Sta.

text: Maria Bridge sa Isabela.
english: Maria Bridge in Isabela.

text: Suno sa senador, nagpakig-angot na man siya sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), kon sa diin, nagpasalig man ang talatapan nga maghatag sang report sa nasambit nga proyekto.
english: The senator said he has already contacted the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), which promised to provide a report on the project.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagalaum siya nga mabaton ang report sa bulan sang Abril.
english: He also said he hopes to receive the report in April.

text: Tuyo man sang natungdan nga mahibaluan kon nagsunod sa policy ukon pagsulundan ang kontraktor.
english: He also wanted to know if the contractor followed the policy or regulations.

text: Nag-leave anay si Senador Robin Padilla bilang president sang Partido ng Demokratiko Pilipino Lakas ng Bayan (PDP Laban).
english: Senator Robin Padilla resigned as president of the Democratic Philippine People's Party (PDP Laban).

text: Ini agud mag-focus si Padilla sa iya katungdanan bilang senador sa masunod nga Kongreso.
english: This is to enable Padilla to focus on his duties as a senator in the next Congress.

text: Sa statement sang partido, gin-anunsyo nga si Davao City Vice Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte nga amo ang executive vice president, ang magabulos sa presidency base sa rule of succession sa konstitusyon sang partido.
english: In a statement, the party announced that Davao City Vice Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte, who is the executive vice president, will take over the presidency based on the rule of succession in the party constitution.

text: Ang chairman sang PDP Laban amo si former President Rodrigo Duterte nga detained subong sa The Hague.
english: The chairman of PDP Laban is former President Rodrigo Duterte who is currently detained in The Hague.

text: Bawian sang armas kag ipaidalom liwat sa training ang mga pulis nga napaslawan sa marksmanship training.
english: Police officers who failed marksmanship training will be disarmed and retrained.

text: Santo ini sa pahayag ni Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen.
english: This is according to a statement by Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III.
english: Nicolas Torre III.

text: Suno kay Torre, importante nga maalam ang pulis sa paggamit sang armas bangud nakataya diri ang kabuhi sang tawo.
english: According to Torre, it is important for policemen to be wise in using weapons because people's lives are at stake.

text: Ang simple nga sala suno sa iya ang maka-resulta sa kamatayon ukon sa collateral damage sa tion nga may yara sang armed encounters.
english: A simple mistake, he said, can result in death or collateral damage in the event of armed encounters.

text: Bilang hepe sang pulisya, nagpahayag si Torre nga magapaidalom man siya sa marksmanship test kag maga-retiro sa serbisyo kun mapalpak siya diri.
english: As police chief, Torre said he will also undergo a marksmanship test and retire from service if he fails it.

text: Sa PNP Press Corps 3rd Invitational Shoot Fest sa Quezon City, nagpahayag ini nga ang marksmanship training ang himuon niya nga requirement for promotion kag placement sa mataas nga positions.
english: At the PNP Press Corps 3rd Invitational Shoot Fest in Quezon City, he said he will make marksmanship training a requirement for promotion and placement in high positions.

text: Magluwas diri, luyag man ni Torre nga physically fit ang mga pulis sa tanan nga tion.
english: In addition, Torre also wants police officers to be physically fit at all times.

text: Bangud sini, ang mga naka-assign sa mga opisina kag sa mobile forces ang iga-require nga magpasakop sa sporting activities kaangay sang swimming kag badminton sa kada Martes kag Huwebes.
english: As a result, those assigned to offices and mobile forces will be required to participate in sporting activities such as swimming and badminton every Tuesday and Thursday.

text: Libre man sila suno kay Torre nga makapili sang sports activities sa kondisyon nga mapabilin nga fit ang ila nga mga lawas.
english: Torre said they are also free to choose sports activities provided they keep their bodies fit.

text: Naglapaw na sa 2,000 ka mga tawo ang nagkalamatay matapos ang 6.3-magnitude nga linog nga nagtay-og sa western Afghanistan.
english: More than 2,000 people have been killed after a 6.3-magnitude earthquake rocked western Afghanistan.

text: Ang sentro sini nga linog sang tinalikdan nga weekend ang yara sa 40 kilometros nakatundan sang Herat city sa western Herat province nga amo ang ikatatlo sa pinakadaku nga syudad sa Afghanistan.
english: The epicenter of last weekend's quake was 40 kilometers west of Herat city in western Herat province, the third largest city in Afghanistan.

text: Nabatyagan man ang pagtay-og sa kaiping nga mga probinsya sang Badghis kag Farah nga ginsundan sang aftershocks.
english: The quake was also felt in the neighboring provinces of Badghis and Farah followed by aftershocks.

text:
Photo Courtesy: AP/Ebrahim Noroozi

Suno kay Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mojahid, nagsaka na sa 2,053 ang nagtaliwan kag masobra naman 1,240 ka mga tawo ang nagkalasamaran.
english:
Photo Courtesy: AP/Ebrahim Noroozi

According to Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mojahid, the death toll has risen to 2,053 and more than 1,240 people have been injured.

text: Masobra man 1,300 ka mga balay ang nagkalaguba apang tanan ini nga numero ang posible nga magsaka pa.
english: More than 1,300 houses were also destroyed but all these numbers are likely to rise.

text: Suno pa sa Taliban, nakalab-ot na ang rescue teams sa probinsya sang Herat kag napadala naman sa mga residente ang kinahanglanon nga pagkaon, tubig, bulong, kag mga panapton.
english: According to the Taliban, rescue teams have reached Herat province and have sent essential food, water, medicine, and clothing to residents.

text: Nahibaluan nga sunod-sunod nga linog ang gina-suprer sang Afghanistan sini lang nga binulan nga naglubong pa gid sa pungsod sa tunga sang gina-atubang sini nga krisis sa ekonomiya.
english: It is known that Afghanistan has been suffering from a series of earthquakes in recent months that have further buried the country in the midst of its economic crisis.

text: Isa ini sa pinakapigado nga pungsod sa Asya kag labi pa nga nagluya ang abilidad nga mag-responde sa mga kalamidad halin sang gin-agaw sang Taliban ang pwesto sang gobyerno sang 2021.
english: It is one of the poorest countries in Asia and has further weakened its ability to respond to disasters since the Taliban took over the government in 2021.

text: Kasunod sang amo nga hitabo, gin-untat sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang kapin $7-billion ukon P396.8-billion sini nga ginahatag sa foreign reserves sang Afghanistan nga rason nabudlayan ang pungsod sa paghatag ayuda sa ila nga mga residente sa tion sang kalamidad.
english: Following the incident, the United States of America suspended more than $7-billion or P396.8-billion in Afghanistan's foreign reserves, making it difficult for the country to provide assistance to its residents in times of disaster.

text: Gina-usisa pa sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) kun ano ka matuod ang reports nga may mga Pinoy nga nalakip sa missing samtang ilabi pa nga naga-ibwal ang kinagamo sa tunga sang Israel kag Palestine.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) is still investigating the authenticity of reports that some Filipinos are among the missing as the conflict between Israel and Palestine escalates.

text: Sandig sa statement sang Filipino community leader sa Israel nga si Marc Pleños nga naka-base sa Tel Aviv, nagakahangawa ang iban nga mg Pinoy nga ang ila himata sa amo nga pungsod ang nabihag sang Palestinian militant group nga Hamas.
english: According to a statement by Filipino community leader in Israel Marc Pleños based in Tel Aviv, some Filipinos are worried that their relatives in the country have been captured by the Palestinian militant group Hamas.

text: Gin-athag sini nga wala sang kumpirmasyon nagikan sa Israeli Army apang may isa ka Pinoy nga nakatawag nga lakip ang iya bana sa gin-hostage kag gindala sa Gaza.
english: She explained that there was no confirmation from the Israeli Army but a Filipino called that her husband was among those taken hostage and taken to Gaza.

text: Gin-alegar pa sang Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) nga nabatian niya kag nakilala ang iya bana sa video nga gin-alegar gin-post pa sang Hamas.
english: The Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) alleged that she heard and recognized her husband in the video allegedly posted by Hamas.

text:
Photo courtesy: Ibrahim Dahman/CNN

May news aggregator man nga naga-claim nga may Thai kag Filipino workers nga na-hostage.
english:
Photo courtesy: Ibrahim Dahman/CNN

There is also a news aggregator claiming that there are Thai and Filipino workers who were taken hostage.

text: Suno naman kay Israeli Ambassador to the Philippines Ilan Fluss, may masobra 30,000 ka Filipino nationals sa Israel apang wala pa sang verification kun may iban sa ila nga na-kidnap.
english: According to Israeli Ambassador to the Philippines Ilan Fluss, there are more than 30,000 Filipino nationals in Israel but there is no verification if any of them have been kidnapped.

text: Sa bahin sang Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), ginatutukan naman ang monitoring sa 200 ka OFWs nga naka-base sa Gaza Strip kun sa diin nagbase ang Palestinian Islamist group nga Hamas sang nagpaulan sila sang rockets.
english: The Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) is focusing on monitoring 200 OFWs based in the Gaza Strip where the Palestinian Islamist group Hamas was based when they rained rockets.

text: Lakip sa na-mensyonar nga kritikal nga mga area sa Gaza strip amo ang Ashkelon, Ashdod kag Sderot.
english: Among the aforementioned critical areas in the Gaza strip are Ashkelon, Ashdod and Sderot.

text: Wala man sang nag-request nga Filipinos para sa repatriation apang bisan ano oras suno sa DFA, handa sila sa pagbulig.
english: No Filipinos have requested for repatriation but the DFA said they are ready to help at any time.

text:
Nahibaluan nga base sa latest statement sang military spokesperson sang Israel, 700 ka Israelis kag dinosena ang na-kidnap sa adlaw sang pagpangibot kag pagpang-atake sang Hamas nga amo ang ginkabig sang militar nga “pinakamalala nga massacre sa mga sibilyan sa bilog nga maragtas sang pungsod.”

Sa gilayon nga pagtimalos sang Israel sa Gaza Strip kun sa diin kontrolado sang Hamas, 370 ka Palestinians ang patay kag 2,200 ang pilason.
english:
It is known that based on the latest statement of Israel's military spokesperson, 700 Israelis and dozens were kidnapped on the day of the siege and attack by Hamas that the military considered "the worst massacre of civilians in the entire history of the country.

In Israel's immediate retaliation in the Hamas-controlled Gaza Strip, 370 Palestinians were killed and 2,200 wounded.

text: Sa sina nga numero, 300 ang napatay sa sulod lamang sang isa ka adlaw nga amo ang pinakamamatay nga adlaw para sa Palestinians sa Gaza halin sang 2008 ukon sa sulod sang 15 ka tuig.
english: Of that number, 300 were killed in just one day that was the deadliest day for Palestinians in Gaza since 2008 or in 15 years.

text: Lakip sa reported nga napatay sa pagbalos sang Israel paagi sa air strikes amo ang tatlo ka bulan nga kapid, ang ila iloy, kag ang tatlo pa ka mga iban nga kauturan.
english: Among those reportedly killed in Israel's retaliatory air strikes were three-month-old twins, their mother, and three other siblings.

text: Ginkondenar ni Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte Mayor Datu Lester Sinsuat ang pag-ambush sa ila election officer kag sa bana sini sang wala pa nakilala nga mga armado nga suspek sa Barangay Makir sa nasambit nga banwa.
english: Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte Mayor Datu Lester Sinsuat condemned the ambush on their election officer and her husband by unidentified armed suspects in Barangay Makir in the said town.

text: Sa amo nga insidente, patay si Maceda Lidasan Abo, Election Officer sang Datu Odin Sinsuat, kag pilason naman ang bana sini nga si Jojo Abo.
english: In the incident, Maceda Lidasan Abo, Election Officer of Datu Odin Sinsuat, was killed and her husband Jojo Abo was injured.

text: Padulong ang mag-asawa sa Dalican Election Offic sakay sang ila SUV sang ginluthang sang wala pa matumod nga mga suspek.
english: The couple were on their way to the Dalican Election Office in their SUV when they were shot by unidentified suspects.

text: Padayon naman ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad agud matumod ang motibo sa krimen kag makilala ang mga yara sa likod sang pag-ambush.
english: Authorities are still investigating to determine the motive of the crime and identify those behind the ambush.

text: Ginkumpirma naman ni Maguindanao del Norte Provincial Election Supervisor Atty. Nabil Mutia ang pagtaliwan ni Maceda Abo, samtang nagapaayo naman sa ospital ang iya bana.
english: Maguindanao del Norte Provincial Election Supervisor Atty. Nabil Mutia announced the death of Maceda Abo, while her husband is recovering in hospital.

text: Bangud sa hitabo, ginrekomendar ni Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Chairman George Erwin Garcia nga ipaidalom sa COMELEC Control ang Datu Odin Sinsuat agud masigurado ang seguridad kag malikawan ang paglala sang sitwasyon.
english: Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Chairman George Erwin Garcia recommended that Datu Odin Sinsuat be placed under COMELEC control to ensure security and prevent the situation from escalating.

text: Daku nga inspirasyon sa mga estudyante indi lamang sa India kundi sa bilog nga kalibutan ang ginhimo sang isa ka 92-anyos nga Lola nga pagpa-enrol sa eskwelahan sa labing-una nga tion sa bilog niya nga kabuhi.
english: A 92-year-old grandmother's enrollment in school for the first time in her life has been a great inspiration to students not only in India but around the world.

text: Ini amo si Lola Salima Khan, nabun-ag sang 1931, residente sang Bulandshahr sa northern state sang Uttar Pradesh sa India, kag may yara na subong sang mga apo sa tuhod.
english: This is Grandmother Salima Khan, born in 1931, resident of Bulandshahr in the northern state of Uttar Pradesh in India, and now has great-grandchildren.

text: Nagpakasal si Lola Salima sa edad nga 14-anyos — duha ka tuig antes ang pagtakop sang British colonial rule sa India.
english: Lola Salima married at the age of 14 — two years before the end of British colonial rule in India.

text:
Photo Courtesy: AFP/Supplied

Para sa iya, isa ka handum ang dumot ang makatuon sa pagbasa kag pagsulat bangud wala man sang mga eskwelahan sa ila nga lugar sang siya ang gamay pa lamang.
english:
Photo Courtesy: AFP/Supplied

For him, it was a dream to learn to read and write because there were no schools in his area when he was a child.

text: Anum ka bulan lang ang nagligad, amat-amat nga nahatagan sang katumanan ini nga handum sang nag-upod si Lola sa mga estudyante nga mas bata sa iya sang masobra walo ka dekada.
english: Just six months ago, this dream was gradually granted reality when Lola joined students who were more than eight decades younger than her.

text: Gina-updan siya sang asawa sang iya nga apo kun magkadto siya sa eskwelahan.
english: His grandson's wife accompanies him to school.

text: Sang nagligad lang nga semana, nagkuha siya sang literacy test nga opisyal nga nagdeklarar sa iya bilang literate.
english: Just last week, he took a literacy test that officially declared him as literate.

text: Sa subong, makahibalo na ini magpirma kag mag-isip sang kuwarta.
english: By now, it can sign and count money.

text: Suno kay Lola, gina-into-into pa siya anay sang iya nga mga apo kun magpangayo sila sang kuwarta bangud indi man siya makahibalo mag-isip, apang bangud sa iya pagbalik sa eskwelahan, suno sa iya, indi na siya maintuan.
english: According to Lola, her grandchildren used to tease her when they asked for money because she didn't know how to count, but when she returned to school, she said she couldn't be bothered.

text: Pahayag pa sang local education officer sa India, si Lola Salima ang nagapamatuod nga wala sang limitasyon kag wala sang edad ang pagpaninguha nga makatuon.
english: According to the local education officer in India, Lola Salima proves that there is no limit and no age to learn.

text: Halimbawa, bangud sa pagpa-enrol ni Lola sa eskwelahan, 25 ka mga babayi halin sa ila nga lugar ang nagsulod man sa literacy classes lakip na dira ang iya duha ka umagad.
english: For example, because of Lola's enrollment in the school, 25 women from their area also entered literacy classes including her two daughters-in-law.

text: Nagbulaganay na sanday Dakota Johnson kag Chris Martin matapos ang halos walo ka tuig nga relasyon.
english: Dakota Johnson and Chris Martin have split after nearly eight years of relationship.

text: Madumduman nga nag-umpisa ang ila relasyon sang tuig 2017, kag sang 2021 naghimo sang kanta si Martin para sa iya nobya nga ”My Universe” kag ini ang ginkanta niya sa isa ka concert sa London.
english: Their relationship began in 2017, and in 2021 Martin composed a song for his girlfriend called ”My Universe” and sang it at a concert in London.

text: Sa kapareho nga tuig nabalitaan na ang duha naga-upod na sa isa ka puluy-an.
english: In the same year, it was reported that the two were living together.

text: Sa pihak sang pagbulaganay, masako naman si Dakota sa iya nga trabaho kun sa diin mangin bida ini siya sa isa ka pelikula kag makaupod niya sanday Pedro Pascal at Chris Evans.
english: Despite the separation, Dakota is busy with her work where she will star in a movie and will be with Pedro Pascal and Chris Evans.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang may ginpaguwa nga official statement ang duha tuhoy sa ila pagbulaganay
english: As of now, the two have not released an official statement regarding their split

text: Madasig nga nadakpan ang suspek nga nagtuyo sa pag-hold up sa isa ka taxi driver sa Barangay Javellana, Jaro, Iloilo City matapos nga nabilin sini ang iya I.D. sa sulod mismo sang taxi.
english: A suspect who attempted to hold up a taxi driver in Barangay Javellana, Jaro, Iloilo City was quickly arrested after he left his I.D. right inside the taxi.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Eduardo Siacon Jr., hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 9, iya ginpahayag nga maka-apat ka beses man nga nadasma ang suspek samtang nga nagapalagyo kag nagapauli sa ila nga balay.
english: Police Major Eduardo Siacon Jr., chief of Iloilo City Police Station 9, said the suspect was also hit four times while fleeing and returning home.

text: Magluwas sa I.D., napang-check man ang CCTV footages kag natultulan ini sa Brgy.
english: Besides the I.D., the CCTV footages were also checked and traced to Brgy.

text: San Pedro, Jaro, Iloilo City paagi sa bulig sang barangay officials.
english: San Pedro, Jaro, Iloilo City with the help of barangay officials.

text: Suno sa pulis, may record nga alarm and scandal ang arestado.
english: According to police, the arrested person has a record of alarm and scandal.

text: May impormasyon man nga may involvement ini sa ilegal nga droga, apang gina-verify pa ini sang mga pulis.
english: There is also information that he is involved in illegal drugs, but the police are still verifying this.

text: Nagapabilin ini sa kustodiya sang mga pulis kag posible nga mag-atubang sa reklamo nga robbery hold-up.
english: He remains in police custody and is likely to face a robbery hold-up complaint.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang nagdeklarar sang hold-up ang suspek, nakakita sang kahigayunan ang taxi driver nga makalumpat sa salakyan.
english: It was learned that when the suspect declared a hold-up, the taxi driver saw an opportunity to jump into the vehicle.

text: Bangud sini, naglumpat man ang suspek kag nagkuyampad pauli.
english: As a result, the suspect jumped and ran home.

text: Gasgas sa kamot kag pagpalanakit sa likod naman ang naagom sang taxi driver bangud sa amo nga insidente.
english: The taxi driver sustained bruises on his hand and back pain in the incident.

text: LUYAG naton talupangdon diri sing una ang ginpahayag ni Senador Kiko Pangilinan angot sa “partial victory” sang 37 ka petitioner batok sa Anti-Terrorism Law nga ginhulugan na sing pamat-ud (ruling) sang Korte Suprema sang sining ulihi lang.
english: We would like to note here first the statement of Senator Kiko Pangilinan regarding the “partial victory” of 37 petitioners against the Anti-Terrorism Law that was ruled by the Supreme Court recently.

text: Gin-sponsor ining kasuguan sa Senado ni Senador Ping Lacson nga ginpirmahan dayon ni Presidente Duterte sang pag-abot sini sa iya.
english: The bill was sponsored in the Senate by Senator Ping Lacson and was immediately signed by President Duterte upon its receipt.

text: Angot ining pahayag ni Senador Pangilinan sa kinamatarong sang aton Hilway nga Pumuluyo sa aton Demokrasya, labi na gid ang kinamatarong sa Hilway nga Pagpahayag (Freedom of Expression), “due process”, kag ang universal human rights, sa kabug-usan, sa idalom sang Bill of Rights.
english: Senator Pangilinan's statement is related to the rights of our Free People in our Democracy, especially the right to Freedom of Expression, due process, and universal human rights, in general, under the Bill of Rights.

text: Ginpahangop ni Senador Pangilinan sa iya pahayag nga nagapasalamat siya sa ining “partial victory” sang Hilway nga Pumuluyo batok sa Anti-Terrorism Law.
english: Senator Pangilinan explained in his statement that he is grateful for this “partial victory” of the Free People against the Anti-Terrorism Law.

text: Ugaling, ipasaka gihapon nila ang ila Motions for Reconsideration sa Korte Suprema agud madula na sing lubos ang dalit sining kasuguan sa Kahilwayan kag “Rule of Law” sa pangabuhi sang mga pumuluyo.
english: However, they will still file their Motions for Reconsideration in the Supreme Court so that the harm of this law to the Freedom and “Rule of Law” in the lives of the people will be completely eliminated.

text: “Luyag naton ang isa ka kasuguan nga naga-protejer sang mga pumuluyo batok sa terorismo, indi ang kasuguan nga naga-terrorize sa ila,” siling pa gani niya.
english: “We want a law that protects citizens against terrorism, not a law that terrorizes them,” he even said.

text: Ining “partial victory” sang mga Hilway nga mga Pumuluyo nagalakip sang paathag (qualifier) sa exception sa idalom sang Section 4.
english: This “partial victory” of the Free Peoples includes a qualifier in the exception under Section 4.

text: Ginapat-ud diri nga wala nalakip sa “acts of terrorism” ang mga “… advocacy, protest, dissent, stoppage of work, industrial or mass action, and other similar exercises of civil and political rights”.
english: It specifies that “acts of terrorism” do not include “… advocacy, protest, dissent, stoppage of work, industrial or mass action, and other similar exercises of civil and political rights”.

text: Gin-botohon ini sang mga SC justices sing 12-3.
english: The SC justices voted 12-3.

text: Gin-deklarar man sang SC nga “unconstitutional”, voting 9-6, ang pagtugot sa Anti-Terrorism Council sa pag-adopt sang mga pangabay sang iban nga “jurisdictions or supranational jurisdictions” sa pag-designar kon sin-o ang mga “terrorists”.
english: The SC also declared it “unconstitutional”, voting 9-6, to allow the Anti-Terrorism Council to adopt requests by other “jurisdictions or supranational jurisdictions” to designate who are “terrorists”.

text: Ang luyag pa itulod sang 37 ka petitioners sa ila Motions for Reconsideration amo ang ila pagpamatok sa mga pila pa ka provision sang Anti-Terrorism Law nga naga-apektar sa “due process” kag iban pa nga kinamatarong sang akusado, nga nagalakip sa “arrest, detention, designation by Anti-Terror Council, freezing of funds, (etc)”.
english: What the 37 petitioners want to push in their Motions for Reconsideration is their opposition to several other provisions of the Anti-Terrorism Law that affect the “due process” and other rights of the accused, which include “arrest, detention, designation by Anti-Terror Council, freezing of funds, etc”.

text:
***

Sa liwan nga hitabo, ang Rappler nagbalita nga may nakuha sila nga screen shot sa isa ka Facebook post nga naga-requirer sa mga student scholar sang Passi City Government sa pagsuksok sang pula nga T-shirt kag magpasakop sa political caravan sang BBM-Sara tandem sa Iloilo.
english:
***

In another incident, Rappler reported that they had obtained a screen shot of a Facebook post requiring student scholars of the Passi City Government to wear red T-shirts and participate in the political caravan of the BBM-Sara tandem in Iloilo.
