text: Ining political caravan sang BBM-Sara tandem ginhiwat sadtong Disyembre 11 halin sa Taft North, Iloilo City tubtub sa Passi City.
english: The political caravan of the BBM-Sara tandem was held on December 11 from Taft North, Iloilo City to Passi City.

text: Wala diri makaupod si Marcos Jr.
english: Marcos Jr. was not present.

text: kag Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio.
english: and Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio.

text: Ngaa kuno, ugaling, gina-requirer gid ining mga student scholar sa pag-upod sa political caravan sang BBM-Sara tandem?
english: Why, then, are these student scholars required to join the political caravan of the BBM-Sara tandem?

text: Indi man kuno kinahanglan obligahon gid ining kabataan agud sug-alawan ining duha ka kandidato kay indi man sila scholars sining mga kandidato nga kinahanglan pakitaan sing respeto kag pagpasalamat sa ila pag-abot.
english: These children should not be forced to meet these two candidates because they are not scholars of these candidates who should be shown respect and gratitude for their arrival.

text: In fact, wala man kita sing nahibal-an nga luyag mismo nanday Mayor Stephen Palmares kag Vice Mayor Jesry Palmares nga sug-alawan sila sining mga kabataan sa ila pag-abot.
english: In fact, we don't know that Mayor Stephen Palmares and Vice Mayor Jesry Palmares themselves want these children to meet them when they arrive.

text: Kon sa luyag-luyag lang basi, pero lain ina ya kon obligahon mo sila.
english: If it's just a choice, maybe, but it's different if you oblige them.

text: Indi ini sila dapat entrahan sang pamulitika kay ang tuyo lang sang gobyerno sa ila amo ang pagpatuon sa ila nga may suporta sang gobyerno tungod sang ila kapinasahe nga kinaalam, nga sang ulihi mapuslan sila sang bug-os nga komunidad kag indi lang kon sin-o nga pulitiko.
english: They should not be involved in politics because the government's only purpose for them is to educate them with the support of the government because of their excellent knowledge, which will eventually benefit the entire community and not just any politician.

text: Ang katulad nila daw mga civil service employees nga ginasagud sang gobyerno pero indi ginatugutan sa pagkampanya sa kon sin-o nga mga kandidato sa eleksyon kay ang ila serbisyo para sa tanan kag indi kay kon sin-o lang nga pulitiko.
english: They are like civil service employees who are supported by the government but are not allowed to campaign for any candidates in the elections because their service is for everyone and not just any politician.

text: Gani, indi bagay nga obligahon ini sila sa pamulitika ni Passi Mayor Stephen Palmares kag Vice Mayor Jesry Palmares sa ila pagsug-alaw sa ila kandidato nga sanday BBM kag Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio sang Partido Lakas CMD.
english: Therefore, it is not appropriate to oblige them to the politics of Passi Mayor Stephen Palmares and Vice Mayor Jesry Palmares in their meeting with their candidate BBM and Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio of Partido Lakas CMD.

text: Si Mayor Palmares amo ang chairman sang Lakas CMD sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Mayor Palmares is the chairman of the Lakas CMD in Iloilo province.

text: Well, nakuha man naton ang bahin ni Vice Mayor Palmares angot sining reklamo nga gina-obligar ining mga student scholar sa pag-upod sa political caravan sang BBM-Sara tandem.
english: Well, we also got the side of Vice Mayor Palmares regarding this complaint that these student scholars are being obliged to join the political caravan of the BBM-Sara tandem.

text: Boluntaryo lang kuno ang hingyo sa ila nga mag-upod sa sining kahiwatan.
english: They were asked to participate in this event on a voluntary basis.

text: Ginpasalig man niya nga indi maapektuhan ang scholarship sang mga kabataan bisan pa ang pila sa ila nakapautwas man sang ila reklamo.
english: He also assured that the scholarship of the children will not be affected although some of them have also raised their complaints.

text: Good to know that!/PN
english: Good to know that!/PN

text: Liwat nga irepresentar sang Philippine volleyball icon nga si Alyssa Valdez ang pungsod sa isa sa pinakadako nga stage sa patag sang sports.
english: Philippine volleyball icon Alyssa Valdez will once again represent the country on one of the biggest stages in the sports field.

text: Ang Ateneo de Manila University legend ang indi maghampang, sa baylo siya ang magaserbe nga ambassador para sa FIVB Volleyball Men’s World Championship 2025 nga i-host sang Pilipinas sa Setyembre.
english: The Ateneo de Manila University legend will not play, instead he will serve as an ambassador for the FIVB Volleyball Men’s World Championship 2025 to be hosted by the Philippines in September.

text: Pagaupdan ni Valdez ang iban pa nga mga stars nga sanday Bryan Bagunas kag Eya Laure bilang ambassadors para sa world championships.
english: Valdez will join other stars Bryan Bagunas and Eya Laure as ambassadors for the world championships.

text: Bilang kabahin sang 100-day countdown sa main event, mangin host ang pungsod sa Invitationals sang Alas Pilipinas halin Hunyo 10-12 kun sa diin i-feature ang men’s national team nga magahampang batok sa mga guests nagikan sa Indonesia, Thailand, kag Korea.
english: As part of the 100-day countdown to the main event, the country will host the Alas Pilipinas Invitationals from June 10-12 where the men’s national team will be featured against guests from Indonesia, Thailand, and Korea.

text: Ang Alas Invitationals ang hiwaton sa Araneta Coliseum sa Cubao samtang ang FIVB men’s world championship ang natalana sa Setyembre 12 tubtob 28.
english: The Alas Invitationals will be held at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao while the FIVB men’s world championship is scheduled for September 12 to 28.

text: Nangin indi kinaandan ang hulag sang grupo sang mga karnero matapos ginpangharab ang ginabanta 100-kilos sang cannabis sa isa ka uma sa Thessaly, Greece.
english: The movement of a group of sheep became unusual after an estimated 100-kilograms of cannabis were grazed in a field in Thessaly, Greece.

text: Bangud sang heatwave, wildfire, kag lapnagon nga pagbaha nga sunod-sunod nga natabo sa Greece subong nga mga binulan, apektado katama ang mga kaumhan kag halos na makakita ang mga sapat sang maayo nga mga hilamon nga ila makaon.
english: Due to the heatwave, wildfire, and widespread flooding that have hit Greece one after another in recent months, the countryside has been severely affected and animals can hardly find good grass to eat.

text: Halimbawa diri amo ang grupo sang mga karnero nga nakatultol sa isa ka nabaw-ing nga lugar kun sa diin ginapatubo ang mga marijuana.
english: An example of this is a group of sheep that found themselves in a recovered area where marijuana is grown.

text:
Photo Courtesy: AP

Suno sa tag-iya sang amo nga duta, ang amo nga pananum ang nahalitan na sang bag-o lang naglaslas nga Bagyo Daniel, kag ang mga karnero ang nagbulos kag nag-ubos sa pagharab sa nabilin nga tanum.
english:
Photo Courtesy: AP

According to the owner of the land, the crop was damaged by the recent Typhoon Daniel, and the sheep took over and finished grazing the remaining crop.

text: Ginpahayag pa sang tag-iya nga indi siya makahibalo kun mahibi ukon makadlaw sang nakit-an ang amo nga hitabo bangud una, nabatyagan sini ang heatwave kag nanaog ang produksyon; nagsunod ang bagyo kag baha kun sa diin halos nag-anaw man sa lugar kag naubos man ang ila propiedad; kag subong, nakit-an niya ang mga sapat nga sa sobra ka gutom, nagmantinir sang marijuana.
english: The owner said he did not know whether to cry or laugh when he saw the incident because first, he felt the heatwave and production went down; the typhoon and flood followed which almost flooded the area and destroyed their property; and now, he found animals that in extreme hunger, maintained marijuana.

text: Base sa reports, nakit-an sang nagabantay nga lain na ang hulag sang mga karnero kag halos taas pa sa kanding ang sarang sini malumpat.
english: According to reports, the shepherd noticed that the sheep were moving differently and could jump almost higher than a goat.

text: Nahibaluan nga legal ang marijuana sa Greece para sa pagpamulong halin pa sang 2017.
english: Marijuana has been legal in Greece for speech since 2017.

text: Sini lang nga 2023 sang gin-inagurahan sang amo nga pungsod ang labing-una sini nga medicinal cannabis production plant nga nagbulig man sang daku sa ekonomiya sang Greece.#
english: The country inaugurated its first medicinal cannabis production plant in 2023, which has also contributed greatly to the Greek economy.

text: Magasaulog sang duha ka mga dalagko nga okasyon ang Archdiocese of Jaro sa palaabuton nga Abril 1 tubtub 2 sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.
english: The Archdiocese of Jaro will celebrate two major occasions on April 1 to 2 at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.

text: Ini amo ang Golden Sacerdotal Jubilee ni Most Rev.
english: This is the Golden Sacerdotal Jubilee of Most Rev. Fr.

text: Jose Romeo O. Lazo, D.D. Archbishop-emeritus of Jaro, kag ang Solemn Canonical Installation ni Most.
english: Jose Romeo O. Lazo, D.D. Archbishop-emeritus of Jaro, and the Solemn Canonical Installation of Most.

text: Rev.
english: Rev.

text: Midyphil B. Billones, D.D., bilang ika-pito nga Metropolitan Archbishop sang Jaro.
english: Midyphil B. Billones, D.D., as the seventh Metropolitan Archbishop of Jaro.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Fr.

text: Agelo Collada, Director sang Commission on Social Communications sa Archdiocese of Jaro, iya ginpahayag nga sa Abril 1, Martes, alas-9 sang aga, may pagahiwaton nga Solemn Pontifical nga misa para sa ika-50 nga anibersaryo sang pagkapari ni Lazo.
english: Agelo Collada, Director of the Commission on Social Communications in the Archdiocese of Jaro, said that on April 1, Tuesday, at 9 am, there will be a Solemn Pontifical mass for the 50th anniversary of Lazo's priesthood.

text: Sa alas-4 naman sang hapon, patigayunon ang Arrival and Civic and Liturgical Reception ni Billones.
english: At 4 pm, Billones' Arrival and Civic and Liturgical Reception will be held.

text: Samtang, sa Abril 2 naman, patigayunon ang procession sa alas 8:30 sa aga halin sa Archbishop Residence padulong sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.
english: Meanwhile, on April 2, the procession will be held at 8:30 am from the Archbishop Residence to the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.

text: Sa alas 9 sa aga, patigayunon naman ang Solemn Pontifical Mass kag rite of Canonical Installation ni Billones.
english: At 9 am, the Solemn Pontifical Mass and rite of Canonical Installation of Billones will be held.

text: Ginaagda naman ni Collada ang mga tumuluo nga magtambong sa nasambit nga kahiwatan.
english: Collada invites the faithful to attend the event.

text: Magatingob-pwersa ang China kag ang Saudi Arabia sa naval drills sa masunod nga bulan bilang pagpakita sang pagpadalom pa sang relasyon sang Beijing sa amo nga pungsod sa Middle East.
english: China and Saudi Arabia will join forces in naval drills next month as a demonstration of Beijing's deepening ties with the Middle Eastern country.

text: Ang drills nga pagatawgon nga “Blue Sword 2023” ang matabo sa southern province sang China nga Guangdong.
english: The drills, which will be dubbed “Blue Sword 2023” will take place in China’s southern province of Guangdong.

text:
Photo Courtesy: Reuters

Suno sa defense ministry sang pungsod, magatutok ang joint training sa overseas maritime counter-terrorism operations, pagpatigayon sang exercises sa sniper tactics, boat driving, helicopter landing, kag joint rescue.
english:
Photo Courtesy: Reuters

According to the country's defense ministry, the joint training will focus on overseas maritime counter-terrorism operations, conducting exercises in sniper tactics, boat driving, helicopter landing, and joint rescue.

text: 2019 sang ulihi nga nagpatigayon ang duha ka pungsod sang joint naval drills.
english: 2019 was the last time the two countries conducted joint naval drills.

text: Ini nga exercises ang himuon samtang nagatindog ang China bilang “peacemaker” sa Middle East.
english: These exercises will be conducted as China stands as a “peacemaker” in the Middle East.

text: Sini nga tuig sang ginpangunahan sang China ang kasugtanan agud nga magbalikanay sang buot kag magbukas sang tagsa ka embahada ang madugay na magkaaway nga Saudi Arabia kag Iran.#
english: This year, China led an agreement to reconcile and open embassies between longtime rivals Saudi Arabia and Iran.

text: Matapos ang pito ka tuig sa space, nagbalik na ang National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) capsule sa Utah, USA dala ang pinakadaku nga samples sang asteroid nga natipon.
english: After seven years in space, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) capsule has returned to Utah, USA with the largest asteroid samples ever collected.

text: Daku ang ginalauman sang scientists sa amo nga sample bangud ini posible ang makapahangop kun paano nahimo ang solar system, kun paano nangin posible ang kabuhi diri sa kalibutan.
english: Scientists have high hopes for the sample because it may explain how the solar system was formed, how life on Earth became possible.

text: Suno sa space agency, ang OSIRIS-REx — nga nagakahulugan sang Origins, Spectral Interpretation, Resource Identification, Security, Regolith Explorer — ang ginlunsar sang 2016 kag naglibot sa asteroid nga Bennu sang 2018.
english: According to the space agency, OSIRIS-REx — which stands for Origins, Spectral Interpretation, Resource Identification, Security, Regolith Explorer — was launched in 2016 and orbited asteroid Bennu in 2018.

text: Ang Bennu nga 500 metros (1,640 ka tapak) in diameter ang manggaranon sa carbon — building block sang kabuhi diri sa kalibutan — kag may yara man ini sang water molecules.
english: Bennu which is 500 meters (1,640 feet) in diameter is rich in carbon — the building block of life here on Earth — and it also contains water molecules.

text: Halin sang 2016 launch, nakatipon ang probe sang 250 gramos sang yab-ok halin sa batuhon nga surface.
english: Since its 2016 launch, the probe has collected 250 grams of dust from the rocky surface.

text: Bisan amo lang sini kagamay suno sa NASA, makabulig ini sa pagtuon sa sahi sang asteroids nga pamahog sa Earth kag matun-an man ang maragtas sang solar system.
english: Even if it is so small, according to NASA, it will help to study the type of asteroids that threaten the Earth and also learn about the history of the solar system.

text: Gintipon sang spacecraft ang sample sang 2020 kag nag-umpisa sa misyon nga makabalik sa Earth sang Mayo 2021.
english: The spacecraft collected the sample in 2020 and embarked on a mission to return to Earth in May 2021.

text: Ang kabug-usan nga mission ang nagdangat sa 3.86 billion miles — kabug-usan pakadto sa Bennu kag pabalik sa kalibutan.
english: The total mission amounted to 3.86 billion miles — total to Bennu and back to earth.

text: Suno pa sa NASA, maragtason ang pag-abot sang amo nga samples kag amo ini ang pinakadaku nga sample halin sang nadala man sang Apollo ang mga bato halin sa bulan.
english: According to NASA, the arrival of these samples is historic and is the largest sample since Apollo brought rocks from the moon.

text: Kadam-an sang sample ang gamiton sa pagtuon para sa masunod nga mga henerasyon.
english: Most of the sample will be used to study for future generations.

text: Ang ginapahayag one-fourth sini ang gamiton sa eksperimento kag may gamay naman nga amount nga ipadala sa mission partners nga Japan kag Canada.
english: One-fourth of it will be used for the experiment and a small amount will be sent to mission partners Japan and Canada.

text: Ginapauntat sang pila ka mga abogado, sa pagpanguna ni Atty. Israelito Torreon ang ‘impeachment trial’ batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Some lawyers, led by Atty. Israelito Torreon the 'impeachment trial' against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Mabasa sa ila nga ginpasa nga ‘supplemental petition’ ang ila nga mga hingyo sa Korte Suprema tuhoy sa ‘impeachment proceedings’ sang senate impeachment court.
english: They filed a supplemental petition with their requests to the Supreme Court regarding the impeachment proceedings of the senate impeachment court.

text: Ginahingyo nila nga mag-isyu ang Supreme Court sang Temporary Restraining Order kag Writ of Preliminary Injunction para punggan ang Senado nga magpatigayon sang impeachment trial.
english: They are asking the Supreme Court to issue a Temporary Restraining Order and Writ of Preliminary Injunction to prevent the Senate from conducting an impeachment trial.

text: Nagpaathag ang pamunuan sang Jaro 1 Elementary School sa pagdumili sa mga ginikanan sa pagsulod sa eskwelahan.
english: The management of Jaro 1 Elementary School explained the ban on parents entering the school.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Gracia Malazarte, Principal sang nasambit nga eskwelahan, iya ginpahayag nga apat na ka beses na sila nga nagpatigayon sang meeting kaupod ang Parent Teacher Association (PTA) sa diin naistroyahan ang nasambit nga polisa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Gracia Malazarte, principal of the school, said they have held four meetings with the Parent Teacher Association (PTA) to discuss the policy.

text: Suno kay Malazarte, nasaad sa Child Protection Policy sang Department of Education (DEPED) nga wala dapat sang ginikanan nga magsulod sa mga eskwelahan para sa safety sang mga kabataan.
english: According to Malazarte, the Child Protection Policy of the Department of Education (DEPED) states that no parents should enter schools for the safety of children.

text: Ginpanugyanan man ni Malazarte, ang mga ginkanan nga intindihon ang polisa.
english: Malazarte also advised parents to understand the policy.

text: Dugang pa niya, mahimo man makasulod ang mga ginikanan kun may mga importante nga okasyon sa eskwelahan.
english: He added that parents can also enter when there are important occasions at the school.

text: Gin-detain na ang 16 ka mga opisyal sa Libya samtang nagapadayon ang imbestigasyon sa makamamatay nga baha nga nagluntad sa syudad sang Derna subong nga Septyembre bangud sang pag-collapse sang duha ka dams.
english: Sixteen officials have been detained in Libya as investigations continue into the deadly floods that hit the city of Derna this September due to the collapse of two dams.

text: Sa statement sang attorney general, lakip sa na-detain amo ang alkalde sang syudad kag ang present kag former water infrastructure authorities.
english: According to the attorney general's statement, among those detained were the city mayor and the present and former water infrastructure authorities.

text: Septyembre 10 sang nagluntad ang baha sa amo nga syudad nga ginkamatay sang halos 4,000 ka mga tawo kag yara sa 9,000 ang nagapabilin nga missing suno sa World Health Organization (WHO).
english: The floods hit the city on September 10, killing nearly 4,000 people and leaving 9,000 missing, according to the World Health Organization (WHO).

text: Sang nagligad lang nga semana, nagguwa ang mga tawo sa Derna para mag-protesta kag magpanawagan nga kakasan sang posisyon ang otoridad.
english: Just last week, people came out in Derna to protest and call for the removal of the authority.

text: Gina-imbestigaran man subong sang prosecutors ang tanan nga iligal nga naka-benepisyo sa reconstruction project sang amo nga syudad.
english: Prosecutors are also investigating all those who illegally benefited from the reconstruction project of the city.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang 1942, lima na ka makamamatay nga baha ang natabo sa Libya bangud sa ila nga dam reservoirs.
english: Since 1942, five deadly floods have occurred in Libya due to their dam reservoirs.

text: Ang duha ka mga dam nga narusdak sang sini nga bulan ang natukod sang 1973 tubtub 1977, kag gin-report nga wala na napaidalom sa maintenance halin sang 2002.
english: The two dams that collapsed this month were built from 1973 to 1977, and have reportedly been out of maintenance since 2002.

text: Nagsumpa sanday Cong.
english: Cong.

text: Julienne Baronda, incoming city Vice Mayor Lady Julie Grace Baronda, kag incoming city Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog kay Senator JV Ejercito sa iya nga opisina sa Senado kahapon.
english: Julienne Baronda, incoming city Vice Mayor Lady Julie Grace Baronda, and incoming city Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog to Senator JV Ejercito at his Senate office yesterday.

text: Si Ejercito ang anay boss ni Cong.
english: Ejercito is the former boss of Cong.

text: Baronda sang nag-obra siya bilang staff sang senador antes siya nangin Kongresista.
english: Baronda when he worked as a senator's staff before he became a Congressman.

text: Sa statement ni Cong.
english: In a statement, Cong.

text: Baronda ginpasalamatan niya ang mga Ilonggo nga nagsalig sa iya nga ulihi nga termino bilang Lone District Representative sang siyudad.
english: Baronda thanked the Ilonggos who trusted him in his last term as Lone District Representative of the city.

text: Pagkatapos sang ila nga pagsumpa nag-attend ang tatlo ka opisyal sa ika-55 nga Senate Plenary kahapon sa pag-convene sang mga Senador para sa impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: After their swearing-in, the three officials attended the 55th Senate Plenary yesterday to convene Senators for the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Duha ka tuig nga manimuron sa presuhan ang isa ka babayi sa Indonesia nga nag-video sa iya kaugalingon nga nagsambit sang kabahin sang pangamuyo sang mga Muslim antes siya nagkaon sang baboy.
english: An Indonesian woman who videotaped herself reciting part of a Muslim prayer before eating pork has been sentenced to two years in prison.

text: Ini amo ang 33-anyos nga si Lina Lutfiawati nga nagagamit sang Indian name nga “Lina Mukherjee” bangud sa iya nga hilig sa Bollywood movies.
english: This is 33-year-old Lina Lutfiawati who uses the Indian name “Lina Mukherjee” because of her passion for Bollywood movies.

text: Gina-identify niya ang iya kaugalingon nga Muslim.
english: He self-identifies as Muslim.

text: Isa man siya ka lifestyle influencer, may masobra duha ka million nga TikTok followers, kag nagapanag-iya sang negosyo sa India.
english: She is also a lifestyle influencer, has over two million TikTok followers, and owns a business in India.

text: Sang Marso, nag-post siya sang video kun sa diin iya ginsambit ang tinaga nga “Bismillah” ukon ang Arabic phrase nga nagakahulugan nga “in the name of God”.
english: In March, he posted a video in which he mentioned the word “Bismillah” or the Arabic phrase that means “in the name of God”.

text: Ginhimo niya ini antes siya nagkaon sang crispy nga panit sang baboy.
english: He did this before he ate the crispy pork skin.

text: Sang amo nga tion, naga-byahe siya sa Bali, isa ka tourist hotspot sa Indonesia nga (indi kaangay sang nabilin nga bahin sang pungsod) may majority nga Hindu population.
english: At the time, he was traveling in Bali, a tourist hotspot in Indonesia that (unlike the rest of the country) has a majority Hindu population.

text: Ginpanindugan sini nga sang amo nga tion, nagtilaw siya sang agud bulngon ang iya nga kuryosidad.
english: He insisted that at the time, he tried something to satisfy his curiosity.

text: Milyon-milyon ang nagpakalamaot kag nainsulto sa video bangud ginadumilian ang baboy sa Islam nga amo ang dominant religion sa Indonesia.
english: Millions of people were offended and insulted by the video because pork is forbidden in Islam, the dominant religion in Indonesia.

text:
Sunod siya nga gin-report sa pulis bangud sa paglapta sang “hateful information” nga isa ka sahi sang “act of hostility over ethnicity, religion, and race.”

Sang sini lang, gin-desisyunan sang korte sa Palembang, South Sumatra, Indonesia nga “guilty” ang amo nga influencer sa paglapta sang impormasyon nga nagapakamalaot sa religious individuals kag partikular nga mga grupo.
english:
He was subsequently reported to the police for spreading “hateful information” which is a form of “act of hostility over ethnicity, religion, and race.”

Recently, a court in Palembang, South Sumatra, Indonesia ruled that the influencer was “guilty” of spreading information that defamed religious individuals and specific groups.

text: Magluwas nga ma-preso ang babayi, ginpabayad man ini sang $16,200 ukon P918,000.
english: Besides being jailed, the woman was also fined $16,200 or P918,000.

text: Kun indi niya ini mabayaran, madugangan sang tatlo ka bulan ang kalawigon sang iya pagtinir sa sulod sang presuhan.
english: If he fails to pay, his sentence will be extended by three months.

text: Gintawag sang White House nga wala sang basehan ang alegasyon batok kay United States President Joe Biden kasunod sang ginlunsar sang Republican lawmakers nga impeachment inquiry.
english: The White House called the allegations against United States President Joe Biden baseless following the launch of an impeachment inquiry by Republican lawmakers.

text: Wala pa gihapon sang komento ang 80-anyos nga presidente kaangot sa amo nga impeachment, apang nagapanindugan naman ang iya nga spokesperson nga kahimuan lamang ini sang iya kasumpong sa pulitika.
english: The 80-year-old president has yet to comment on the impeachment, but his spokesperson insists that it is the work of his political opponent.

text: Suno kay Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre, bilog nga tuig nga nag-imbestigar ang Republicans agud pangitaan sang sala ang presidente apang wala sila sang matipon nga ebidensya bangud wala man ini sang ginhimo nga iregularidad.
english: According to Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre, the Republicans have been investigating the president all year to find fault but they have not gathered any evidence because he has not committed any irregularities.

text: Antes sini, una na nga gin-akusaran sang Republican House members si Biden nga nagbutig sa Americans kaangot sa kontrobersyal nga mga buluhaton sang iya anak nga si Hunter sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: Earlier, Republican House members accused Biden of lying to Americans about his son Hunter's controversial activities abroad.

text: Si Hunter amo ang anak ni Biden nga isa anay ka drug addict kag ginaimbestigaran sang Justice Department special counsel bangud sa posible nga tax evasion kag posible nga kasuhan man subong nga bulan bangud sa firearms violation.
english: Hunter is Biden’s son who is a former drug addict and is being investigated by the Justice Department special counsel for possible tax evasion and is also likely to be charged this month for a firearms violation.

text: Apang suno sa White House, indi gani makatipon ang Republicans sang bastante nga suporta agud nga maka-boto ang House kag maaprubahan ang impeachment inquiry.
english: But the White House says Republicans won’t even be able to muster enough support to get the House to vote and approve the impeachment inquiry.

text: Ang ginaduso nga impeachment inquiry ang kadungan man sa ginalantaw nga rematch nanday Biden kag former president Donald Trump sa presidential election sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The proposed impeachment inquiry also coincides with the expected rematch between Biden and former President Donald Trump in next year's presidential election.

text: Gin-anunsiyo sang Department of Education (DepEd) nga umpisa subong nga tuig, makabaton na sang tuigan nga medical allowance nga nagabalor sang 7,000 ang mga manunudlo kag non-teaching personnel sang Department of Education (DepEd).
english: The Department of Education (DepEd) announced that starting this year, teachers and non-teaching personnel of the Department of Education (DepEd) will receive an annual medical allowance worth P7,000.

text: Kabahin ini sang ginpasangkad nga suporta sa ikaayong lawas sang mga empleyado sang gobyerno.
english: This is part of expanded health support for government employees.

text: Katuyuan sini nga mabuhinan ang gasto sang mga empleyado sa pagpabulong kag mapaayo ang ila trabaho, ilabi na na sa mga lugar nga malayo kag delikado.
english: It aims to reduce employees’ medical costs and improve their work performance, especially in remote and dangerous areas.

text: Suno pa kay Education Secretary Sonny Angara, pamaagi ini sang pagpakita sang pagpasalamat sa ila nga dedikasyon.
english: According to Education Secretary Sonny Angara, this is a way to show gratitude for their dedication.

text: Naglapaw na sa 5,000 ang ginabanta numero sang casualties sa Libya kasunod sang makamamatay nga baha sa eastern city sang Derna sa amo nga pungsod sa North Africa.
english: The death toll in Libya has risen to more than 5,000 following deadly floods in the eastern city of Derna in the North African country.

text: Suno sa International Organization for Migration sang United Nations,10,000 ka mga tawo ang gin-deklarar nga missing kag 30,000 naman ang na-displace.
english: According to the United Nations' International Organization for Migration, 10,000 people have been declared missing and 30,000 displaced.

text: Nagagutok man ang mga morgue kag ospital sa lawas sang mga biktima.
english: Morgues and hospitals are also overwhelmed with the bodies of victims.

text: Kun basehan ang director sang Al-Bayda Medical Center, ginakahangaw-an nga maglapaw sa 20,000 ang patay samtang nagapadayon pa ang search and rescue operations.
english: According to the director of the Al-Bayda Medical Center, the death toll is feared to exceed 20,000 while search and rescue operations are still ongoing.

text: Matandaan nga Domingo sang daw kaangay nga tsunami nga baha ang nagluntad sa Derna sang nawasak ang dam samtang nagalaslas si Bagyo Daniel matapos nga naglaslas man sa Greece, Bulgaria kag Turkey.
english: It can be recalled that a tsunami-like flood occurred in Derna on Sunday when the dam collapsed while Typhoon Daniel was raging after it also hit Greece, Bulgaria and Turkey.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa ang monitoring sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) kun may mga Pinoy nga apektado sang pagbaha.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) is still monitoring if there are Filipinos affected by the floods.

text: Suno kay Foreign Affairs spokesperson Teresita Daza, wala pa sang reported nga napatay apang padayon pa nga gina-kontak ang mga Filipinos bangud may 1,100 ka mga Pinoy sa Eastern Libya kag sa sini nga numero, 90 ang naga-istar sa lugar nga natam-an gid sang naglabay ang bagyo.
english: According to Foreign Affairs spokesperson Teresita Daza, no deaths have been reported but Filipinos are still being contacted because there are 1,100 Filipinos in Eastern Libya and of this number, 90 are living in the area that was hit hardest by the typhoon.

text: Nagsulat ang Western Visayas Alliance of Transport Cooperatives and Corporation, Inc.
english: The Western Visayas Alliance of Transport Cooperatives and Corporation, Inc.

text: (WVATCCI) kay Department of Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon nga nagahingyo sang suporta sa Public Transport Modernization Program sang gobyerno.
english: (WVATCCI) to Department of Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon seeking support for the government's Public Transport Modernization Program.

text: Sang February 2025 lang nagpungko bilang Secretary sang DOTr si Dizon tal-os kay Jaime Bautista nga nag-resign bangud sa health issues.
english: In February 2025, Dizon took over as Secretary of the DOTr, replacing Jaime Bautista who resigned due to health issues.

text: Suno kay Mr. Rizalito Alido, Consultant sang Iloilo City Alliance of Operators and Drivers Transport Cooperatives (ICAODTC), yara na sa 97% ang consolidation sa Iloilo City samtang 99% naman sa Iloilo Province —- patimaan lamang nga compliant ang mga transport coop sa luyag nga modernisasyon sang gobyerno.
english: According to Mr. Rizalito Alido, Consultant of the Iloilo City Alliance of Operators and Drivers Transport Cooperatives (ICAODTC), said the consolidation is already at 97% in Iloilo City while 99% in Iloilo Province —- a sign that the transport coops are compliant with the government's modernization.

text: Ginapabugal man Apang nagapanawagan ang mga transport groups sa gobyerno ilabi na sa Kamara kag Senado nga himuon na nga layi ang public transport modernization program agud mapainan sang pondo bangud sa pagkamatuod lang, kulanga ng budget sang gobyerno para sa programa.
english: However, transport groups are calling on the government especially in the House and Senate to make the public transport modernization program a law to allocate funds because in fact, the government does not have enough budget for the program.

text: Wala man gina-deny sang natungdan nga may yara kun kaisa sang deperensya sa kooperatiba apang gina-adjust man ini pahayag niya agud malab-ot ang success sang operation apang daw ginakulang suno sa iya ang suporta sang gobyerno.
english: He did not deny that there are sometimes defects in the cooperative but he said it is adjusted to achieve the success of the operation but he said the government's support seems to be lacking.

text: Kun kaisa may epekto man ang lain-lain nga DOTr secretary bangud tagsa sa ila ang may ila man nga lain-lain nga teorya.
english: Sometimes different DOTr secretaries have an impact because each of them has their own theory.

text: Ginakasubo sang transport coop nga ang nagaguwa sila pa nga nag upod sa gobyerno ang dehado kag wala ginapamatian.
english: The transport coop regrets that those who go out with the government are defeated and not listened to.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Russian Defense Minister Sergei Shoigu nga naga-istoryahanay ang Russia kag ang North Korea para sa posible pagpatigayon sang joint military excercises.
english: Russian Defense Minister Sergei Shoigu confirmed that Russia and North Korea are in talks for the possible conduct of joint military exercises.

text: Una na naguwa ang reports halin sa intelligence agency sa South Korea nga ang Russia ang nag-propose kay North Korean leader Kim Jong Un nga magpatigayon sila sang magkaupod nga naval exercise nga kaupod pa gid sa China.
english: Earlier, reports from South Korea's intelligence agency said Russia had proposed to North Korean leader Kim Jong Un to conduct a joint naval exercise with China.

text: Madumduman nga nagkitaay si Shoigu kag si Kim sang nagligad nga Hulyo sang nagbisita ini sa North Korea para sa 70th anniversary sang pagtakop sang Korean War nga ginatawag sa North Korea nga “Victory Day”.
english: Shoigu and Kim met last July when he visited North Korea for the 70th anniversary of the end of the Korean War, known in North Korea as “Victory Day”.

text: Ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika naman ang una na nagpahayag sang nagligad nga semana nga padayon ang negosasyon sang Pyongyang kag Moscow sa ila nga mga armas, kag nagtilaw pa ang Moscow nga kumbinsehon ang Pyongyang nga magbaligya sang artillery ammunition sa Russia.
english: The United States earlier said last week that Pyongyang and Moscow are continuing negotiations on their weapons, and Moscow has tried to convince Pyongyang to sell artillery ammunition to Russia.

text: Una naman nagpaandam ang Washington nga posible maghatag ang North Korea sang hinganiban sa Moscow agud gamiton sa away sa Ukraine.
english: Earlier, Washington warned that North Korea might provide weapons to Moscow for use in the war in Ukraine.

text: Nahibaluan nga anum na ka nuclear tests ang napatigayon sang North Korea halin sang 2006 kag nagapalupad man ini sang nanuhay-tuhay nga missiles apang malaka lamang ini naga-upod sa kaiping nga mga pungsod kun magpatigayon sang military exercises.
english: North Korea has conducted six nuclear tests since 2006 and has launched various missiles but rarely joins neighboring countries in military exercises.

text: Nag-plead sang ‘not guilty’ si anay US President Donald Trump sa kaso nga ginpahayag gintuyo niya nga baliskaron ang resulta sang presidential elections sa Georgia sang 2020.
english: Former US President Donald Trump has pleaded not guilty to a case of allegedly trying to overturn the results of the 2020 presidential elections in Georgia.

text: Indi man ini magpakita sa arraignment hearing nga gin-set sang Fulton County Superior Court Judge sa masunod nga semana.
english: Nor will he appear at the arraignment hearing set by a Fulton County Superior Court Judge next week.

text: Magluwas kay Trump, may 18 ka iban pa nga nakasuhan bangud sa gin-alegar scheme agud i-sabotahe ang eleksyon sa amo nga estado batok sa kasumpong ni Trump nga si United States President Joe Biden.
english: Besides Trump, 18 others have been charged in connection with an alleged scheme to sabotage the state's election against Trump's opponent, United States President Joe Biden.

text: Pila sa mga akusado ang indi man magtambong sa arraigment.
english: Several of the defendants also will not attend the arraignment.

text: Antes sini, matandaan nga nagsungka si Trump sa Fulton County Jail sa Georgia sang Agusto 24 apang napaguwa bangud sa pyansa nga 200,000 USD ukon P11.3-million.
english: Earlier, Trump surrendered to the Fulton County Jail in Georgia on August 24 but was released on bail of 200,000 USD or P11.3-million.

text: Siya man ang labing-una nga former president sang Amerika nga may yara sang mug shot.
english: He is also the first American former president to have a mug shot.

text: Magluwas diri nga kaso, na-indict man si Trump sa tatlo ka iban pa nga kaso lakip na ang paghatag sang hush-money payment sa adult-film star sang 2016 sa Manhattan; gin-alegar nga mishandling sang classified national defense documents; kag may isa pa ka federal investigation sa iya tuyo nga baliskaron ang resulta sang 2020 election sa amo nga pungsod.
english: In addition to this case, Trump has also been indicted on three other charges including giving a hush-money payment to an adult-film star in 2016 in Manhattan; alleged mishandling of classified national defense documents; and there is another federal investigation into his attempt to overturn the results of the 2020 election in that country.

english: A woman in India who filed for divorce from her husband in just 40 days because he took a bath only once or twice a month is being discussed.

text: Ini nga asawa nga halin sa Agra, sa Uttar Pradesh state sang India, ang nag- approach sa local family counseling center agud ireklamo ang iya bana bangud sa mala-kanding sini nga baho.
english: This wife from Agra, in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh, approached the local family counseling center to complain about her husband's goat-like smell.

english: She said he almost never changed his clothes and when they had sex, she felt like she was drowning in the smell of her husband.

text: Kasunod sini, nagpromisa ang bana nga mag-improve sa iya hygiene kag maligo adlaw-adlaw apang nanindugan ang pamilya sang babaye nga indi na ini luyag nga magpadayon pa ang ila pag-updanay.
english: Subsequently, the husband promised to improve his hygiene and take a bath every day but the woman's family insisted that he did not want to continue their relationship.

text: Inilarawan ng kilalang strength and conditioning coach na si Alex Ariza si Kenneth Llover bilang isang batang boksingerong may galaw at lakas na kahalintulad ng istilo ni boxing legend Manny Pacquiao.
english: Well-known strength and conditioning coach Alex Ariza described Kenneth Llover as a young boxer with movement and strength similar to the style of boxing legend Manny Pacquiao.

text: Ayon kay Ariza, nakita niya ang potensyal ng undefeated Filipino boxer sa kabila ng pagiging baguhan nito sa propesyonal na boksing, dala ng taglay nitong bilis, footwork, at punching power.
english: According to Ariza, he saw the potential of the undefeated Filipino boxer despite his novice in professional boxing, with his speed, footwork, and punching power.

text: Sinabi rin ni Ariza na halata ang impluwensiya ni Pacquiao sa istilo ng pagboboksing ni Llover.
english: Ariza also said that Pacquiao's influence on Llover's boxing style is obvious.

text: Ibinahagi ni Ariza na matagal na siyang retirado sa larangan ng boksing sa Pilipinas, ngunit muling nahikayat na bumalik matapos siyang imbitahan na maging bahagi ng training team ni Llover.
english: Ariza shared that he has been retired from boxing in the Philippines for a long time, but was inspired to return after he was invited to be part of Llover's training team.

text: Giit ng beteranong trainer, bagama’t mahaba pa ang landas na tatahakin ng batang boksingero, marami umano ang naaaliw sa kaniyang istilo at nakakakuha na ito ng pansin sa loob at labas ng bansa.
english: The veteran trainer said that although the young boxer still has a long way to go, many are attracted to his style and it is already attracting attention inside and outside the country.

text: Aniya, may fan-friendly approach si Llover na maaaring magdala rito sa mas malaking tagumpay sa hinaharap.
english: He said Llover has a fan-friendly approach that could lead to greater success in the future.

text: Si Llover ay may perpektong rekord na 14 panalo at walang talo.
english: Llover has a perfect record of 14 wins and no losses.

text: Mas lalong lumakas ang kaniyang pangalan matapos ang dalawang sunod na first-round stoppages sa Japan.
english: His name grew even stronger after two consecutive first-round stoppages in Japan.

text: Kaugnay nito, nakipagkasundo na ang kaniyang promoter na si Gerry Peñalosa ng Gerrypens Promotions sa Kameda Promotions ng Japan para sa isang three-fight deal.
english: In this regard, his promoter Gerry Peñalosa of Gerrypens Promotions has already signed an agreement with Kameda Promotions of Japan for a three-fight deal.

text: Nakatakda ang laban ni Llover kontra kay dating two-division world champion Luis Concepcion sa darating na Agosto 17 sa Winford Resort and Casino sa Maynila
english: Llover's fight against former two-division world champion Luis Concepcion is scheduled for August 17 at the Winford Resort and Casino in Manila

text: Sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic, halos ginadumilian na ang Public Display of Affection (PDA) kaangay sang holding hands.
english: In the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic, Public Display of Affection (PDA) such as holding hands is almost banned.

text: Apang suno sa mga eksperto, ”socially acceptable” man nga sahi sang public act of intimacy ang pagkapyotanay sang mga kamot, tuman ka bentaha sa ikaayong lawas kag mahimo ini nga himuon sang bisan sin-o, kag sa bisan ano oras.
english: But according to experts, holding hands is also a socially acceptable public act of intimacy, very healthy and can be done by anyone, and at any time.

text: Suno kay experimental psychologist Dr. Matt Hertenstein, ang pagholding hands ang napamatud-an nga nagapasanyog sang relationships, nagapahagan-hagan sang anxiety, nagapabuhin sang stress kag nagapadula sang pain.
english: According to experimental psychologist Dr. Matt Hertenstein, holding hands has been shown to enhance relationships, ease anxiety, reduce stress and relieve pain.

text: Ini bangud ang epekto sang mainit kag supportive nga hikap pinaagi sa holding hands ang nagapabuhin sang stress hormone cortisol, nagapanubo sang blood pressure kag nagapahinay sang heart rates.
english: This is because the effect of warm and supportive touch through holding hands reduces the stress hormone cortisol, lowers blood pressure and slows heart rates.

text: Essential man suno sa doktor ang human touch bangud santo sa mga pagtuon, prone sa mental health issues kaangay sang depression kag anxiety ang mga indibidwal nga wala gid nakaagi holding hands, ukon bisan nakahakos sa iya abyan ukon pamilya.
english: The doctor said human touch is also essential because according to studies, individuals who have never held hands, or even hugged a friend or family, are prone to mental health issues such as depression and anxiety.

text: Dugang pa niya, sa tion nga magholding hands and duha ka indibidwal, naga-release man ang lawas sang ”cuddle hormone” nga oxytocin kag serotonin nga amo ang nagapabuhin sang pain.
english: He added that when two individuals hold hands, the body also releases the cuddle hormone oxytocin and serotonin which reduce pain.

text: ANG pagkuha sang simpatiya kag boto sang mga botante sang isa ka kandidato halos pareho lang ini sa pagpaninguha agud mabaligya ang isa ka produkto sa merkado.
english: GAINING the sympathy and votes of a candidate's voters is almost like trying to sell a product in the market.

text: Una sa tanan, kinahanglan mo anay, kon kandidato ka, mahibal-an ang kapinasahe sang mga botante – personal kag upod sa ila pamilya, ugali bilang Filipino, kinaiya sa ila partikular nga tribu ukon localidad, kag ang ila mga kinahanglanon kag luyag matigayon agud mapa-ugwad ang ila pangabuihi.
english: First of all, if you are a candidate, you need to know the voters' needs – personally and with their families, their character as Filipinos, the characteristics of their particular tribe or locality, and their needs and desires to improve their lives.

text: Ikaduha, kon nahibal-an mo na ining ila kapinasahe, kinahanglan may programa ka nga angay sa ila pagka-kinahanglan.
english: Second, once you know their needs, you need to have a program that fits their needs.

text: Ikatatlo, dapat masaligan ka gid nila sa imo kilala nga personalidad bilang sinsero, matutom  nga tawo kag may ihibalo kag ikasarang sa pag-serbisyo sa pumuluyo.
english: Third, they must trust you with your known personality as a sincere, honest person with the knowledge and ability to serve the people.

text: Kon mabakud na ang pagsalig nila sa imo, segurado nga wala sing tentasyon, kwarta man ukon pabor, nga makatulod sa ila agud talikdan ang imo kandidatura.
english: Once their trust in you is strong, surely no temptation, whether money or favor, will induce them to abandon your candidacy.

text: Kuhaon man lang nila ang kwarta ukon pabor nga ina, kon mapilitan gid sila nga batunon ina, kag botohon ka gihapon tungod ikaw gid ang ila naluyagan kag masaligan.
english: They will take that money or favor, if they are forced to accept it, and still vote for you because you are the one they really like and trust.

text: Natural lang nga suportado man si VP Leni sang maki-Demokrasya nga mga pungsod katulad sang United States, European Union kag Japan, nga makabulig sa pagpaseguro sang aton soberanya sa West Philippine Sea batok sa China./PN
english: Naturally, VP Leni is also supported by pro-democracy countries such as the United States, European Union and Japan, which will help ensure our sovereignty in the West Philippine Sea against China./PN

text: Indi pa mahulag sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG)-Antique ang transition sang mga mabulos temporaryo sa walo ka mga Board Members nga ginsuspend sang Office of the Ombudsman bangud wala pa mahibalo-an kun san-o ang effectivity sang suspension order.
english: The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG)-Antique has not yet moved the transition of the temporary replacements of the eight Board Members suspended by the Office of the Ombudsman because it is not yet known when the effectiveness of the suspension order.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay DILG Antique Provincial Director John Ace Azarcon, iya ginpahayag nga gin-inform lang sila pinaagi sa Human Resource Managememt sang Provincial Government natuhoy sa suspension order nanday Board Members Egidio Elio, Rony Molina, Victor Condez,Alfie Jay Niquia, Plaridel Sanchez IV, Mayella Mae Ladislao, Keneth Dave Gasalao kag Julius Cezar Tajanlangit.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, DILG Antique Provincial Director John Ace Azarcon said they were only informed through the Human Resource Management of the Provincial Government regarding the suspension order of Board Members Egidio Elio, Rony Molina, Victor Condez, Alfie Jay Niquia, Plaridel, Sanchela IV, Kennedy Lavender, Kennedy Lavender. Gasalao and Julius Cezar Tajanlangit.

text: Nag-ugat ang suspension order sang walo bangud sa grave abuse of authority, grave misconduct kag conduct unbecoming of a public officer.
english: The suspension order of the eight stemmed from grave abuse of authority, grave misconduct and conduct unbecoming of a public officer.

text: Suno kay Azarcon, nagpakig-angot man ang DILG Antique sa Central Office kun ano ang mangin epekto sang Omnibus Election Code bangud gina-challenge sang walo ka mga Board Members ang nangin desisyon sang Office of the Ombudsman .
english: Azarcon said the DILG Antique also contacted the Central Office on the impact of the Omnibus Election Code because eight Board Members are challenging the decision of the Office of the Ombudsman.

text: Ang gin-cite sang mga board members amo ang Omnibus Election Code, Section 261, paragraph X nga nagasiling, ang suspension sang elective local officials ang ginadumilian sa tion sang election period.
english: What the board members cited was the Omnibus Election Code, Section 261, paragraph X which states, the suspension of elective local officials is prohibited during the election period.

text: Bangud sini, ginpakamaayo sang DILG Province of Antique nag mag-usisa sa legal services sang Central Office agud sila mismo ang makapakig-angot sa Commission on Elections (COMELEC).
english: Because of this, the DILG Province of Antique decided to check with the legal services of the Central Office so that they themselves can contact the Commission on Elections (COMELEC).

text: Apang sa tion nga maathag na kun san-o ang effectivity sang suspension, may yara sang Administrative Order No.15 ang DILG nga may katuyuan nga maghatag sang pamaagi agud indi mabakante ang position sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan.
english: However, once the effectiveness of the suspension is clear, the DILG has an Administrative Order No. 15 that aims to provide a way to prevent the position from becoming vacant in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan.

text: May kaangtanan sa walo ka mga board members, lima sa ila ang yara sa idalom sang isa lamang ka partido gani ang ila nga polical party amo ang maga-nominate sang temporaryo nga magabulos sa ila sa pwesto.
english: Regarding the eight board members, five of them are under one party so their political party will nominate a temporary replacement.

text: Samtang ang tatlo ka mga Ex-Officio members ang pagabuslan base sa nagasunod sa ila nga rangko.
english: Meanwhile, the three Ex-Officio members will be replaced based on their rank.

text: May kaangtanan naman sa pagtambong sa session, indi luyag sang DILG nga pangunahan ini sa baylo mahulat na lang sang interpretation sang layi ang opisina halin sa COMELEC kag sa Office of the Ombudsman.
english: Regarding the attendance of the session, the DILG does not want to lead it instead the office will wait for the interpretation of the law from the COMELEC and the Office of the Ombudsman.

text: Nagboto ang Senado, nga nagapungko bilang impeachment court, nga ibalik sa House of Representatives ang mga articles of impeachment batok kay Bise Presidente Sara Duterte, kag wala gin-dismiss ukon gin-terminate ang kaso.
english: The Senate, which sits as the impeachment court, voted to return to the House of Representatives the articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte, and did not dismiss or terminate the case.

text: Gin-aprubahan ang mosyon sa boto nga 18 ang pabor, lima ang kontra, kag wala sang abstensyon.
english: The motion was approved by a vote of 18 in favour, five against, and no abstentions.

text: Ini nga desisyon ang kasunod sa mosyon ni Sen.
english: The decision follows a motion by Sen.

text: Bato Dela Rosa nga ibasura ang impeachment batok kay VP Sara Duterte.
english: Bato Dela Rosa to dismiss the impeachment against VP Sara Duterte.

text: Yari pamatian naton ang panawagan ni Bato.
english: Let's listen to Bato's call.

text: Matapos ang malawig nga deliberasyon sa impeachment court, nagdesisyon ang mga senador-judges nga i-remand ukon ibalik sa Kamara ang impeachment complaint batuk kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: After a long deliberation in the impeachment court, the senator-judges decided to remand or return to the House the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ini ang gin-motion ni Senator Alan Peter Cayetano.
english: This was motioned by Senator Alan Peter Cayetano.

text: Samtang, yari naman listahan sang mga senador-judges nga nagpamatok sa pagbalik sang impeachment sa kamara.
english: Meanwhile, here is a list of senator-judges who opposed the return of impeachment in the chamber.

text: Kag yari man ang nagpabor sa pagbalik sang nasambit nga articles of impeachment sa Kamara.
english: And here are those who favored the return of the said articles of impeachment to the House.

Sa pihak nga bahin, nag-isyu ang Senado nga nagaserbe nga impeachment court sang writ of summons kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english:
Juan Miguel Zubiri

Meanwhile, the Senate, which serves as the impeachment court, issued a writ of summons to Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ginamanduan si VP Duterte nga magsumiter sang iya sabat sa sulod sang non-extensible period nga 10 ka adlaw halin sa pagbaton niya sang summon.
english: VP Duterte is directed to submit his response within a non-extendable period of 10 days from receipt of the summons.

text: Ini para makasabat ang Kamara sa sulod naman sang lima ka adlaw.
english: This is so that the House can respond within five days.

text: Kaangot sini, indi na pagpadayunon ang presentasyon sang House prosecutors sa articles of impeachment subong nga adlaw, nga suno kay Senate President kag Presiding Judge Francis Escudero, ‘rendered moot’ na ini bangud nag-convene na ang Senado, kag nag-isyu na sang summon sa bise presidente.
english: In this regard, the presentation of the House prosecutors on the articles of impeachment today will not be continued, which according to Senate President and Presiding Judge Francis Escudero, is 'rendered moot' because the Senate has already convened, and issued a summons to the vice president.

text: Anum na ka mga Pinoy ang kumpirmado nga nalakip sa napatay sa lapnagon nga wildfires sa Lahaina sa Maui, Hawaii, USA.
english: Six Filipinos have been confirmed among the dead in the widespread wildfires in Lahaina in Maui, Hawaii, USA.

text: Ini amo sanday Salvador Coloma, 77; Carlo Tobias, 54; Rodolfo Rocutan, 76; Conchita Sagudang, 75; Danilo Sagudang, 55; kag Alfredo Galinato, 79.
english: They are Salvador Coloma, 77; Carlo Tobias, 54; Rodolfo Rocutan, 76; Conchita Sagudang, 75; Danilo Sagudang, 55; and Alfredo Galinato, 79.

text: Ginapangita pa subong sang otoridad ang walo pa ka mga myembro sang pamilya ni Salvador Coloma lakip na ang iya asawa nga si Lydia, kag ang mga himata nga sanday Joel Villegas, Adela Villegas, Junmark Quijano, Felimon Quijano, Luz Bernabe, kag Glenda Yabes.
english: Authorities are still searching for eight other family members of Salvador Coloma including his wife Lydia, and relatives Joel Villegas, Adela Villegas, Junmark Quijano, Felimon Quijano, Luz Bernabe, and Glenda Yabes.

text: Sandig sa pinakaulihi nga report sa Maui, yara na sa 115 ka mga tawo ang napatay sang natabo ang sunog sang Agusto 8 kag amo ang ginakabig pinakamakamamatay nga wildfires sa maragtas sang Estados Unidos sa sulod sang isa ka siglo.
english: According to the latest reports in Maui, about 115 people have died since the fire broke out on August 8 and is considered the deadliest wildfire in US history in a century.

text: Duha ka semana matapos ang amo nga sunog, lapaw pa sa 1,000 ang ginapatihan nga missing samtang padayon naman ang paghingyo sang Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) sa mga pamilya nga magbulig agud madasig nga ma-identify ang pangalan sang mga bangkay.
english: Two weeks after the fire, more than 1,000 people are believed to be missing while the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) continues to urge families to help quickly identify the names of the bodies.

text: Gin-dismiss sa serbisyo ang walo ka mga pulis bangud sa police misconduct matapos nagpatigayon sang illegitimate search sa isa ka balay sa Taguig City sang Pebrero.
english: Eight policemen were dismissed from service for police misconduct after conducting an illegitimate search of a house in Taguig City in February.

text: Suno sa National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO), lima diri ang nakit-an nga liable para sa Grave Misconduct, Less Grave Misconduct, kag Conduct Unbecoming of a Police Officer; ang tatlo naman ang liable para sa Less Grave Misconduct and Conduct Unbecoming of a Police Officer.
english: According to the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO), five of them were found liable for Grave Misconduct, Less Grave Misconduct, and Conduct Unbecoming of a Police Officer; the other three are liable for Less Grave Misconduct and Conduct Unbecoming of a Police Officer.

text: Gindagdagan naman ang ila commander sa Police Substation 5 sang one-rank demotion bangud man sa grave neglect of duty.
english: Their commander at Police Substation 5 was given a one-rank demotion for grave neglect of duty.

text: Isa naman ka police officer ang naabswelto.
english: Another police officer was acquitted.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Pebrero 9, pwersahan nga ginsulod sang mga personnel sang Police Substation 5 ang balay sang tagreklamo nga wala sang valid warrant, nagkumiter sang physical abuse, kag gin-alegar nga nangawat sang kapin P76,000 nga cash kag mga electronic devices.
english: On February 9, personnel of Police Substation 5 forcibly entered the complainant's house without a valid warrant, committed physical abuse, and allegedly stole more than P76,000 in cash and electronic devices.

text: Ang complainants pwersahan man nga gindala sang mga pulis kag ginpilit nga magpirma agud indi magpasaka sang kaso.
english: The complainants were also forcibly taken by the police and forced to sign to avoid filing charges.

text: Nalakip ang pangalan sang lider sang Russian mercenary group nga Wagner nga si Yevgeny Prigozhin sa lista sang mga pasahero nga nakasakay sa eroplano nga nagtibusok sa Moscow.
english: The name of the leader of the Russian mercenary group Wagner Yevgeny Prigozhin was included in the list of passengers on board the plane that crashed into Moscow.

text:
Suno sa reports sang state media sang Russia, may ginlunsar na subong nga imbestigasyon kaangot sa plane crash nga natabo sa Tver region north-east sang Moscow sang Myerkules sang gab-i.

Nagtibusok ang private Embraer Legacy aircraft sang halin ini sa Moscow kag padulong kuntani sa St.
english:
According to reports by Russian state media, an investigation has now been launched into the plane crash that occurred in the Tver region north-east of Moscow on Wednesday night.

The private Embraer Legacy aircraft crashed while flying from Moscow to St. Petersburg.

text: Petersburg.
english: Petersburg.

text: 10 ka mga tawo ang sakay lakip ang tatlo ka crew members.
english: 10 people were on board including three crew members.

text: Sandig sa inisyal nga impormasyon, patay ang tanan nga sakay sa eroplano, apang walo pa lang ka bangkay ang na-recover.
english: According to initial information, all on board were killed, but only eight bodies have been recovered.

text: Antes sini, nauna na sa pagpaandam ang mga opisyal sang Amerika nga maghalong si Prigozhin bangud posible nga patyon ini sang Kremlin matapos nga nagpanguna ini sa armado nga rebelyon batok sa militar sang Russia sang nagligad nga bulan nga ginkabig pinakadaku nga pagtilaw sa rehimen ni Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: Earlier, American officials warned Prigozhin to be careful because the Kremlin could kill him after he led an armed rebellion against the Russian military last month that was seen as the biggest test of Russian President Vladimir Putin's regime.

text: Natapos lamang ang amo nga rebelyon sang may deal nga natabo kun sa diin ginpakadto sanday Prighozhin kag ang iya hangaway sa Belarus nga suod man nga kaalyado sang Moscow.
english: The rebellion ended only after a deal was reached that sent Prighozhin and his army to Belarus, which is also a close ally of Moscow.

text: Ang pwersa sang Wagner ang involved sa pagsakop sa mga syudad sang Soledar kag Bakhmut sa Ukraine kasunod sang pag-atake sang Russia sang Pebrero 2022.
english: Wagner forces were involved in the occupation of the Ukrainian cities of Soledar and Bakhmut following Russia’s February 2022 invasion.

text: Pagkatapos sadto, binulan man nga ginpakamalaot ni Prigozhin ang liderato sang militar sa Russia.
english: After that, Prigozhin also spent months denouncing the military leadership in Russia.

text: Nasunog kag nagtuga sang mga paglupok ang barko nga may bandera sang Singapore nga Wan Hai 503 samtang nagapadulong sa Mumbai, nga nagtuga sang pagkahulog sang 40 ka mga suludlan sa Arabian Sea kag ang pila ka mga tripulante naglumpat sa dagat agud makapalagyo.
english: The Singapore-flagged ship Wan Hai 503 caught fire and caused explosions on its way to Mumbai, causing 40 containers to fall into the Arabian Sea and several crew members jumping into the sea to escape.

text: Suno kay Shekhar Kuriakose sang Kerala State Disaster Management Authority, natabo ang insidente mga 144 kilometros gikan sa baybayon sang Kerala, India.
english: According to Shekhar Kuriakose of the Kerala State Disaster Management Authority, the incident occurred about 144 kilometers off the coast of Kerala, India.

text: Suno sa una nga impormasyon may 22 ka mga trabahador nga sakay sang barko 18 ang naglumpat sa baybayon kag yara sa mga rescue boat kag gintinguhaan pa nga maluwas sila.
english: According to preliminary information there are 22 workers on board the ship 18 jumped to shore and are in rescue boats and attempts are still being made to rescue them.

text: Sa mga laragway nga ginpaambit sang Indian Coast Guard sa social media platform X (Twitter anay) nagapakita sang madamol nga aso gikan sa barko kag mga nasunog nga mga suludlan malapit sa ginhalinan sang sunog.
english: In pictures shared by the Indian Coast Guard on social media platform X (formerly Twitter) showed thick smoke from the ship and burnt containers near the source of the fire.

text: Suno sa defense ministry, nagakalayo kag nagalutaw sa kadagatan ang amo nga barko.
english: According to the defense ministry, the ship was on fire and floating in the sea.

text: Wala pa gin-anunsyo kon ano nga sahi sang kargamento ang dala sang mga container, kag nagapadayon ang imbestigasyon sa gintunaan sang mga paglupok.
english: It has not been announced what kind of cargo the containers were carrying, and an investigation into the cause of the explosions is ongoing.

text: Isa man ka container vessel ang naglugdang sa amo man nga rehiyon sang tinalikdan nga bulan rason nga nagkalahulog sa dagat ang 100 ka containers, apisar nga wala sang ginreport nga oil spill.
english: A container vessel also sank in the same region last month, causing 100 containers to fall into the sea, although no oil spill was reported.

text: Personal nga nagbisita si North Korean leader Kim Jong-Un sa navy unit sang pungsod kag nanguna sa iya ginmandu nga cruise missile test nga kadungan man sang joint military drills sa tunga sang South Korea kag United States.
english: North Korean leader Kim Jong-Un personally visited the country's navy unit and led his ordered cruise missile test that coincided with joint military drills between South Korea and the United States.

text: Suno sa state media sang Pyongyang, nagpatigayon si Kim sang inspection sa navy sa East Sea ukon mas kilala nga Sea of Japan, kag didto gin-stage sang crew ang cruise missiles.
english: According to Pyongyang's state media, Kim conducted a navy inspection in the East Sea or better known as the Sea of ​​Japan, and there the crew staged the cruise missiles.

text: Wala partikular nga gin-athag kun ano ini nga mga missile apang ginlaragway nga ini ang klase nga maigu ang target nga wala gid sang sala.
english: It was not specifically explained what these missiles were but they were described as the type that could hit a target without any mistakes.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-umpisahan naman sang Seoul kag sang Washington ang tuigan nga “Ulchi Freedom Shield” drills ukon ang major joint exercise sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod nga magalawig tubtub sa Agusto 31.
english: Seoul and Washington have also launched the annual “Ulchi Freedom Shield” drills or the major joint exercise between the two countries that will last until August 31.

text: Lakip diri ang 30 field training events nga gin-base sa mga senaryo pananglitan matabo na ang gyera.
english: This includes 30 field training events based on scenarios in case war breaks out.

text: Matandaan nga una na ini gintawag sang Pyongyang nga rehearsal sa patigayunon nga invasion kag una na ini nagpaandam nga magabalos sila bangud sa amo nga joint military drills.#
english: It can be recalled that Pyongyang had earlier called it a rehearsal for the invasion and had earlier warned that they would retaliate for the joint military drills.

text: Magapadulong sanday US President Joe Biden kag first lady Jill Biden sa Hawaii sa masunod nga semana agud mangamusta kag lantawon ang nabilin nga halit sang makamamatay nga wildfires sa resort town sang Lahaina sa Maui.
english: US President Joe Biden and first lady Jill Biden will visit Hawaii next week to say hello and view the damage left by the deadly wildfires in the resort town of Lahaina on Maui.

text: Suno sa statement sang White House, una nga atubangon sang presidente ang responders, survivors, amo man ang federal, state kag local officials.
english: According to the White House statement, the president will first meet with responders, survivors, as well as federal, state and local officials.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa 106 ka mga tawo ang napatay sa Lahaina, 2,200 buildings ang naguba, kag nagdangat sa $5.5 billion masobra P311.2-billion ang balor sang kahalitan.
english: So far, 106 people have been killed in Lahaina, 2,200 buildings have been destroyed, and the damage has reached $5.5 billion more than P311.2-billion.

text: Ginatos ka tawo ang ginapatihan nga missing sa gihapon kag padayon nga ginapangita sa disaster zone sa bulig sang 20 ka cadaver dogs.
english: Hundreds of people are still believed to be missing and are being searched in the disaster zone with the help of 20 cadaver dogs.

text: Sa latest nga impormasyon halin kay Governor Josh Green, 27% pa lamang sang disaster site ang napaidalom sa search.
english: According to the latest information from Governor Josh Green, only 27% of the disaster site has been searched.

text: Ginakahangaw-an nga magsaka ang numero sang patay, ukon posible nga mag-doble, sa masunod nga 10 ka adlaw.
english: The death toll is feared to rise, or possibly double, in the next 10 days.

text: Pasado na sa third and final reading sa Kamara ang pagpalawig sa termino sang elective barangay kag Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) officials sa anum ka tuig.
english: The extension of the term of elective barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) officials to six years has passed on third and final reading in the House of Representatives.

text: Sa plenary session subong nga Lunes, 153 ka mga kongresista ang nagpabor sa House Bill (HB) No.
english: In the plenary session this Monday, 153 congressmen voted in favor of House Bill (HB) No.

text: 11287, apat ang negative, kag isa ang nag-abstain.
english: 11287, four were negative, and one abstained.

text: Sa idalom sini nga hagna, amyendaran ang Section 42 sang Republic Act No.
english: Under this bill, Section 42 of Republic Act No.

text: 7160 agud patigayunon ang masunod nga barangay and SK elections sa ikaduha nga Lunes sang Mayo 2029, samtang ang elected barangay officials ang magaserbe naman sang six-year terms sa baylo sang subong ginasunod nga tatlo ka tuig.
english: 7160 agud patigayunon ang masunod nga barangay and SK elections sa ikaduha nga Lunes sang Mayo 2029, samtang ang elected barangay officials ang magaserbe naman sang six-year terms sa baylo sang subong ginasunod nga tatlo ka tuig.

text: Sa idalom sini nga hagna nga ang principal author amo si House Speaker Martin Romualdez kag iban pa nga House leaders, nakasaad nga wala sang elective barangay official ang magaserbe sang masobra sa duha ka consecutive terms sa kapareho nga posisyon; kag dapat nga wala man sang elective SK official ang magaserbe sang masobra sa isa ka termino.
english: Sa idalom sini nga hagna nga ang principal author amo si House Speaker Martin Romualdez kag iban pa nga House leaders, nakasaad nga wala sang elective barangay official ang magaserbe sang masobra sa duha ka consecutive terms sa kapareho nga posisyon; and no elective SK official shall serve more than one term.

text: Sa sini nga measure, ang incumbent Barangay and SK officials nga naeleher sang nagligad nga October 30, 2023 ang magapabilin sa posisyon tubtub sa masunod nga eleksyon sa Mayo 2029 MAGLUWAS LANG kun kakason ukon i-suspend bangud sa pila ka mga rason.
english: Under this measure, incumbent Barangay and SK officials elected on October 30, 2023 will remain in office until the next election in May 2029 UNLESS they are removed or suspended for certain reasons.

text: Matandaan nga sang Enero, sa Senado, gin-aprubahan man sa third and final reading ang Senate Bill 2816 nga naga-set sang term of office sang elected barangay officials kag SK members sa apat ka tuig.
english: It can be recalled that in January, the Senate also approved in third and final reading Senate Bill 2816 which sets the term of office of elected barangay officials and SK members at four years.

text: Sa bersyon sang Senado, may limit nga three consecutive terms sa kapareho nga posisyon para sa barangay officials.
english: In the Senate version, there is a limit of three consecutive terms in the same position for barangay officials.

text: Sa amo nga Senate bill, ginsiling nga ang masunod nga regular barangay and SK elections ang himuon sa una nga Lunes sang October 2027.#
english: The Senate bill states that the next regular barangay and SK elections will be held on the first Monday of October 2027.#

text: Nagasingkal pa ang sitwasyon sa Maui, Hawaii, indi bangud sa padayon nga paglamon sang kalayo — kundi bangud sa kaakig sa mga tawo kun ngaa kulang ang warning nga ginhatag sa ila antes ang wildfires.
english: The situation in Maui, Hawaii is still raging, not because of the continued engulfment of fire — but because of anger at people about why there was not enough warning given to them before the wildfires.

text: Subong nga nagsaka na sa 99 ang mga patay sa Lahaina sa isla sang Maui, ini na ang ginakabig pinaka-makamamatay nga wildfire sa Amerika sa sulod sang isa ka siglo nga lapaw pa sa 85 nga napatay sang 2018 sa Butte County sa Northern California.
english: Now that the death toll in Lahaina on the island of Maui has risen to 99, it is now considered America’s deadliest wildfire in a century topping the 85 that died in 2018 in Butte County in Northern California.

text: Suno kay Bombo Jerry Saludez, international correspondent sa Hawaii, nagabinasulay na ang mga tawo kun ngaa wala nagtunog kag wala na-activate ang warning sirens antes naglapta ang kalayo.
english: According to Bombo Jerry Saludez, international correspondent in Hawaii, people are already arguing why the warning sirens were not sounded and activated before the fire spread.

text: Nahibaluan nga may 400 ka alarms sa amo nga estado kag amo ang ginakabig pinakadaku nga warning system sa kalibutan, apang suno sa Hawaii Emergency Management Agency, matinong ang mga sirena sang tion nga naglamon ang kalayo.
english: It is known that there are 400 alarms in the state and is considered the largest warning system in the world, but according to the Hawaii Emergency Management Agency, the sirens were silent when the fire broke out.

text: Pila sa mga residente ang nagsiling nga nahibaluan lang nila nga may sunog sang malapit na ang kalayo sa ila nga balay kag nagasininggit na ang mga residente.
english: Some of the residents said they only learned of the fire when the fire was near their house and the residents were screaming.

text: May ginlunsar na subong nga imbestigasyon agud malantaw kun paano nag-responde ang otoridad sa lapnagon nga sunog.
english: An investigation has now been launched to see how the authorities responded to the widespread fire.

text: Ginalantaw man nga labi pa nga magsaka ang numero sang mga patay bangud sa ginabanta 1,000 nga missing nga padayon pa ginapangita.
english: The death toll is also expected to rise due to the estimated 1,000 missing persons who are still being sought.

text: Naglunsyar ang Israel sang panibag-o nga mga pag-atake sa Lebanon kag Iran sa ikapito nga adlaw ukon isa na ka semana sang gyera sa Middle East.
english: Israel launched new attacks on Lebanon and Iran on the seventh day or a week of the war in the Middle East.

text: Ini ginkumpirmar sang Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) kahapon nga adlaw nga nagpatigayon sila sang lapnagon nga serye sang airstrikes sa capital sang Lebanon nga Beirut nga nagtarget sa mga lugar nga ginakabig base sang Hezbollah.
english: The Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) confirmed yesterday that they conducted a widespread series of airstrikes in the Lebanese capital Beirut targeting areas considered Hezbollah bases.

text: Lakip sa gin-atake amo ang mga command center kag pila ka panalgan sang mga building sa kapital, pati man ang pasilidad kun sa diin ginapamutang ang mga drone sang militante nga grupo nga ila ginagamit sa mga pag-atake batok sa mga tropa kag estado sang Israel.
english: Among the attacks were command centers and several floors of buildings in the capital, as well as the facility where the militant group's drones are housed that they use in attacks against Israeli troops and the state.

text: Suno sa Israeli Defense Forces, nagalab-ot na sa 26 ka serye sang strikes ang ila ginlunsyar sa Dahiyeh area sang Lebanon nga kadam-an sang nagaestar amo ang mga Shia Muslim.
english: According to the Israeli Defense Forces, they have launched 26 series of strikes in the Dahiyeh area of ​​Lebanon, which is predominantly Shia Muslim.

text: Ginatan-aw man sang Israel ang amo nga lugar bilang isa ka balwarte ukon kuta sang Hezbollah.
english: Israel also sees the area as a Hezbollah stronghold or stronghold.

text: Bangod sini, nagsaka pa ang numero sang napatay sa mga pag-atake sang Israel sa Lebanon sini nga semana sa 123 ka tawo samtang 683 naman ang nasamaran, base sa datos sang Lebanese Ministry of Public Health.
english: This brings the death toll from Israeli attacks in Lebanon this week to 123 people while 683 were injured, according to data from the Lebanese Ministry of Public Health.

text: Base man sa report sang Iranian state media, naglab-ot na sa 1,045 ang kabug-usan nga numero sang mga napatay sa Iran halin sang ginlunsyar ang joint attack sang Israel kag Estados Unidos.
english: According to Iranian state media, the total number of deaths in Iran since the launch of the joint attack by Israel and the United States has risen to 1,045.

text: Natuslok sang salsalon ang isa ka 65-anyos nga lola samtang nagapuksi sang balunggay sa Brgy.
english: A 65-year-old woman was stabbed with an iron rod while picking bananas in Brgy.

text: San Agustin, Novaliches.
english: St. Augustine, Novaliches.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, nakadanlog ang tigulang rason nga natuslok gid ang guya sini sang salsalon sang plantbox kun sa diin nagatindog ang puno sang balunggay.
english: According to the investigation, the elderly man fell and was hit in the face by the iron of the plantbox where the banana tree was standing.

text: Sang nagresponde ang mga katapo sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), naggamit pa sang hydraulic cutter kag ginbuka ang porsyon sang konkreto nga bahin sang plantbox agud maluwas ang babaye.
english: When members of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) responded, they used a hydraulic cutter and opened a portion of the concrete part of the plantbox to rescue the woman.

text: Naglawig sang 30 minutos ang rescue operation.
english: The rescue operation lasted 30 minutes.

text: Sa maayo nga palad, wala sang apektado nga mayor nga ugat sa tigulang kag nagarekober na ini.
english: Fortunately, no major arteries were affected in the old man and he is recovering.

text: Isa sa importante nga senyales agud mahibaluan nga may bukol na sa baga sang bata amo ang kulani ukon lymph node nga mahikapan sa liog.
english: One of the most important signs to know that a child has a lung tumor is a lymph node in the neck.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Trixy Chu, pediatric oncologist, iya ginpahayag nga indi dapat maglapaw sa 2 centimeters ang kadakuon sang bukol bangud mahimo ini nga malignancy ukon cancer.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Trixy Chu, pediatric oncologist, said the tumor should not exceed 2 centimeters in size because it could be malignancy or cancer.

text: Tumalagsahon lamang ang lung malignancy sa mga kabataan apang kumon nga makita sa ila amo ang lymphoma nga isa sa anom nga ginkilala sang World Health Organization bilang “treatable cancers”.
english: Lung malignancy is rare in children but commonly seen in them is lymphoma which is one of the six treatable cancers recognized by the World Health Organization.

text: Ang bukol nga makit-an sa bata ang indi na kumon bangud sa cancer biology, may yara ang tanan nga tawo sang cancer suppresor genes sa lawas nga amo ang nagapugong agud indi mag-form ang cancer.
english: Tumors found in children are no longer common because of cancer biology, everyone has cancer suppressor genes in the body that prevent cancer from forming.

text: Isa ka area nga delikado man kun may yara sang magtubo nga bukol sa baga suno kay Dr. Chu amo ang abaga sa diin kinahanglan na nga magdangop sa espesyalista agud nga evaluate kag ma-assess ang pasyente.
english: An area that is also dangerous if there is a tumor in the lungs, according to Dr. Chu is the shoulder where it is necessary to turn to a specialist to evaluate and assess the patient.

text: Pahayag niya, kun timprano pa gindala sa espesyalista ang bata, ginarefer ini gilayon sa surgeon agud nga makuha ang isa ka porsyon sang bukol kag gina-biopsy para mahatagan sang insakto nga bulong sa amo nga balatian.
english: He said that if the child is brought to the specialist early, he is immediately referred to the surgeon to remove a portion of the tumor and biopsied to give the right treatment for the disease.

text: Kun late na ginpa-check up ang pasyente, posible nga mabudlayan ini magginhawa bangud mahimo nga mag-ipit ang bukol sa mga major vessels.
english: If the patient is checked up late, he or she may have difficulty breathing because the tumor may be stuck in the major vessels.

text: Ang nasambit nga sitwasyon ang ginakabig medical emergency dugang sang doctor sa diin kinahanglan ma-operahan kag ma umpisahan ang chemotherapy agud nga masalbar ang kabuhi sang bata
english: The situation is considered a medical emergency, the doctor said, and surgery is required to start chemotherapy to save the child's life.

text: Ginakabahala subong sang mga pungsod France, Britain kag Canada ang nagalala nga humanitarian situation sa Gaza.
