english: France, Britain and Canada are now concerned about the deteriorating humanitarian situation in Gaza.

text: Nagapanawagan naman ini sa Israel nga maghimo gilayon sang tikang agud nga masolusyunan ang nagalala nga problema.
english: He called on Israel to take immediate steps to address the worsening problem.

text: Suno sa British Foreign Office nga dapat pahanugutan sang Israel ang mga non-governmental organizations nga magtrabaho sa Gaza para sa isa ka sustained kag predictable nga paagi.
english: According to the British Foreign Office that Israel should allow non-governmental organizations to work in Gaza for a sustained and predictable way.

text: Ini agud masiguro man nga magapadayon ang UN sa ila trabaho sa Palestinian enclave.
english: This is to ensure that the UN continues its work in the Palestinian enclave.

text: Dugang pa diri nga dapat kuhaon sang Israel ang ginatawag sini nga ”unreasonable restrictions” sa pila sini ka imports kabahin na ang medical kag shelter equipment agud mapadasig ang pagsulod sang humanitarian aid.
english: He added that Israel should lift what it calls "unreasonable restrictions" on some of its imports including medical and shelter equipment to speed up the entry of humanitarian aid.

text: GAMURUG-OT gid ang abyan naton nga abogado batok sa mga binutig nga propaganda sang mga “trolls” sang isa ka presidential candidate batok kay VP Leni.
english: OUR friend the lawyer is very angry against the false propaganda of the “trolls” of a presidential candidate against VP Leni.

text: Surprisingly, indi gani niya kandidato sa pagka-Presidente si VP Leni sa sining pagsugod na sang “campaign” sa subong pa lang.
english: Surprisingly, VP Leni is not even his presidential candidate at the beginning of the campaign.

text: Tungod sini daku gid ang pagpasalamat sa iya sang mga sumulunod ni VP Leni.
english: For this, the followers of VP Leni are very grateful to him.

text: Samtang, ginapasalamatan man nila ang iban nga mga abogado, upod dira ang pila ka bar topnotcher kag ang former IBP president, nga nagpahayag gid sa social media sang ila pagsuporta kay VP Leni.
english: Meanwhile, they also thanked other lawyers, including some bar topnotcher and the former IBP president, who expressed their support for VP Leni on social media.

text:
***

By the way, indi pa man sa karon maakusaran ining mga kandidato sing “illegal campaigning” sa ila pakighambaro na sa mga pumuluyo sa ila paglibut-libot sa pungsod.
english:
***

By the way, these candidates are not yet accused of “illegal campaigning” in their talks to the people during their tours of the country.

text: Ina tungod ang opisyal nga kampanyahanay (campaigning) para sa mga kandidato sa pagka-Presidente, Bise Presidente, senador kag partylist nga mga grupo sa Pebrero 8 pa tubtub Mayo 7 para sa Mayo 9, 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: This is because the official campaigning for candidates for President, Vice President, senator and partylist groups will be held from February 8 to May 7 for the May 9, 2022 elections.

text: Ang opisyal naman nga kampayahanay para sa mga myembro sang House of Representatives kag ang nagadalagan sa regional, provincial, city kag municipal posts nakatalana pa sa Marso 25 tubtub Mayo 7.
english: The official campaign for members of the House of Representatives and those running for regional, provincial, city and municipal posts is scheduled for March 25 to May 7.

text: Indi tugot, sunu man sa Comelec, ang kampanyahanay sa Holy break sa Abril 14 (Holy Thursday) kag 15 (Good Friday).
english: The Comelec also said that campaigning during the Holy break on April 14 (Holy Thursday) and 15 (Good Friday) is not allowed.

text: Ang mga kandidato gina-prohibir man sa ini nga tinion sa paghatag sang donasyon in cash or kind.
english: Candidates are also prohibited at this time from making donations in cash or kind.

text: Indi man tugot sa ila ang pag-appoint ukon paggamit sang mga special policemen or confidential agents.
english: They are also not allowed to appoint or use special policemen or confidential agents.

text: Indi man tugot sa ila ang pag-hire sang mga bag-o nga empleyado, pag-construct sang public works, kag ang pag-release sang public funds.
english: They are also not allowed to hire new employees, construct public works, and release public funds.

text:
***

Indi ta na seguro kinahanglan ipahayag diri kon sin-o ang luyag nga kandidato, nga indi si VP Leni, sang aton abyan nga abogado sa sining pagsugod pa lang sang “kampanyahanay” sa subong kay basi magliwat pa ang iya pensar sa ulihi.
english:
***

We probably don't need to reveal here who the candidate is, who is not VP Leni, our friend the lawyer at the beginning of the “campaign” now because he might change his mind later.

text: Strange though nga ginapangapinan niya si VP Leni nga indi man niya kandidato sa karon.
english: Strange though that he is defending VP Leni who is not his candidate at the moment.

text: Ina, tungod kay grabe gid kuno ining mga “trolls” ka butigon kag sobra-sobra kon mang-insulto, gani luyag sini pasugtan ang iya (VP Leni) mga sumulunod agud e-boycott ining kontra kandidato  sa kon diin man ini luyag mangampanya.
english: That's because these trolls are very liars and exaggerated when they insult, so she wants to allow her (VP Leni) followers to boycott this opposing candidate wherever he wants to campaign.

text: Ugaling, sang mahibal-an ini ni VP Leni samtang nagalibut upod si vice-presidential candidate Kiko Pangilinan sa isa ka lugar sa Luzon, nagpanugyan gid ini nga indi nila pagahimuon ato.
english: However, when VP Leni learned of this while touring with vice-presidential candidate Kiko Pangilinan in a place in Luzon, she strongly advised them not to do so.

text: Indi matarong, sunu sa iya, ang pag-boycott sa iya mga kasumpong kon diin man luyag nila magduaw kag makighambaro sa mga tawo kay kinamatarong ina sang bisan sin-o nga kandidato sa aton Demokrasya.
english: It is not fair, he said, to boycott his opponents wherever they want to visit and talk to the people because that is the right of any candidate in our democracy.

text: Kinahanglan gid, sunu man sa iya, nga magdaug kita sa matarong nga paagi, which we owe sa aton mga pumuluyo, sa aton Demokrasya kag sa Diyos.
english: It is necessary, he said, that we win in a fair way, which we owe to our people, our Democracy and God.

text: Kon parti sa masakit nga binutig sang mga “trolls” sa ila malisyoso nga propaganda, upod kita dira kay attorney.
english: As for the painful lies of the trolls in their malicious propaganda, we are with the attorney.

text: Sa nahibal-an ko sa aton Christian Faith, daku nga kasal-anan sa Diyos ang pagbinutig, labi na gid agud pakalainon ang reputasyon kag patu-patuan lang sing kasal-anan kon sin-o man.
english: As far as I know in our Christian Faith, it is a great sin against God to lie, especially to defame and accuse someone.

text: Tungod sini, sa dugang naton nga sabat sa aton abyan nga abogado, dapat matuod mahadlok ining naga-fake news batok kay VP Leni, kag sa iban pa nila nga kasumpong sa pulitika.
english: Therefore, in our further response to our friend the lawyer, these fake news against VP Leni, and their other political opponents should be afraid.

text: Pero, ngaa ayhan wala sila nahadlok sa ining binutig nila nga mga isyu, dugang ta pa nga tugda.
english: But, why are they not afraid of these false issues, we further suggest.

text: Basi seguro may nagapasalig sa ila nga sa ila pensar mataas pa sa Diyos, sugpon ko pa.
english: Maybe someone is reassuring them that they think they are higher than God, I would add.

text: May isa nga nagsabat sa aton nga nahibal-an niya kon sin-o ang nagapasalig sa ila agud magtomar sing kaisug sa paghimo sining binutig nga isyu batok sa mga kontra kandidato.
english: Someone replied to us that he knows who is assuring them to take the courage to make this false issue against the opposing candidates.

text: Wala sing liwan kuno kundi sa Satanas, nga kontra sang Diyos nga ang hampang sini amo gid ang magsugyot sa tawo agud maghimo sing kalainan.
english: It is said to be none other than Satan, the opponent of God whose game is to incite man to do evil.

text: Tani mapensar man sining mga “trolls” nga ini ang kasuguan sang Diyos sa pagsugid sing wala limbong kag pagyamuhat agud magdala lang sang isyu nga sandig sa kamatuoran.
english: I hope these trolls will think that this is God's law to tell without deceit and to act only to bring issues based on truth.

text: Indi kay patu-pato agud manghalit lang.
english: Not just to hurt.

text: Which we owe to our reverence for the Most High and fear of His punishment for our evil deeds!/PN
english: Which we owe to our reverence for the Most High and fear of His punishment for our evil deeds!/PN

text: Nagpasalig ang 3rd Infantry Division sang Philippine Army nga mangin alerto sa gihapon sa Western Visayas apisar nga wala sang lugar sa rehiyon ang yara sa red election hotspot sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: The 3rd Infantry Division of the Philippine Army has assured that it will remain alert in Western Visayas despite the fact that no area in the region is in the red election hotspot in the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Colonel Erwin Rommel Lamzon, assistant division commander sang 3rd Infantry Division Philippine Army, iya ginpahayag nga apisar nga wala sang red hotspots, may yara sa gihapon sang mga orange hotspots ang rehiyon nga dapat tutokan sa palaabuton nga eleksyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Colonel Erwin Rommel Lamzon, assistant division commander of the 3rd Infantry Division of the Philippine Army, said that although there are no red hotspots, there are still orange hotspots in the region that should be focused on in the upcoming elections.

text: Suno kay Lamzon, indi man kinahanglan mangin kampante apisar nga napapas na ang kalabanan sang mga katapo sang Communist Party of the Philippines (CCP) – New People’s Army (NPA) sa rehiyon.
english: Lamzon said there is no need to be complacent despite the fact that most of the members of the Communist Party of the Philippines (CCP) - New People's Army (NPA) in the region have been eliminated.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang mga parameters nga ginapatuman sa public safety and security sang tinalikdan nga eleksyon ang mahimo man nga ipatuman subong, apang nakasanto na sa parameter sang orange election hotspot nga ginpasaka sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC).
english: He also explained that the parameters implemented in public safety and security during the last election can also be implemented now, but in accordance with the parameters of the orange election hotspot raised by the Commission on Elections (COMELEC).

text: Gintuad man sang natungdan nga sa subong, wala pa sang nabalhag nga mga dalagko nga encounter sa tunga sang mga rebelde kag katapo sang gobyerno.
english: He also acknowledged that so far, there have been no major encounters between the rebels and government officials.

text: Ginalantaw man ni Lamzon nga may mga reclassification sa mga lugar sa rehiyon nga mahimo islan bangud man sa pagbuhin sang pwersa sang rebelde.
english: Lamzon also expects that there will be reclassifications in areas in the region that could be changed due to the reduction of rebel forces.

text: Mayorya sang mga Pilipino ang nagapabor nga mag-atubang si Vice President Sara Duterte sa Senado ukon impeachment court agud sabton ang mga kaso batok sa iya kag pamatud-an nga wala siya sang sala.
english: A majority of Filipinos are in favor of Vice President Sara Duterte appearing before the Senate or impeachment court to answer the charges against her and prove her innocence.

text: Base sa resulta sang Tugon ng Masa (TNM) survey sang OCTA Research, 78% sang mga Pilipino ang luyag nga mag-atubang si VP Sara sa impeachment court.
english: Based on the results of the Tugon ng Masa (TNM) survey by OCTA Research, 78% of Filipinos want VP Sara to face the impeachment court.

text: Ginpahayag sang OCTA nga ang survey ang may margin of error nga ±3% sa 95% nga confidence level.
english: OCTA said the survey had a margin of error of ±3% at the 95% confidence level.

text: Suno pa sa OCTA, ang subnational estimates para sa mga lugar nga sakop sang survey ang may margins of error sa 95% confidence level: ±6% para sa Metro Manila, Balance Luzon, Visayas, kag Mindanao.
english: According to the OCTA, the subnational estimates for the areas covered by the survey have margins of error at the 95% confidence level: ±6% for Metro Manila, Balance Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao.

text: Sang Pebrero 5, ginpasar sang House of Representatives ang impeachment batok kay Duterte, nga gin-aprobahan sang kapin 200 ka mga kongresista.
english: On February 5, the House of Representatives passed the impeachment bill against Duterte, which was approved by more than 200 congressmen.

text: Sa amo man nga adlaw, ginpadala sa Senado ang Articles of Impeachment, apang wala ini natandog gilayon bangud nag-adjourn ang Senado.
english: On the same day, the Articles of Impeachment were sent to the Senate, but they were not acted upon immediately as the Senate adjourned.

text: Sang Pebrero 25, ginpahayag ni Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero nga magasugod ang proseso sang impeachment trial sang Hunyo 2.
english: On February 25, Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero announced that the impeachment trial process will begin on June 2.

text: Apang sang Mayo 29, gin-anunsyo ni Escudero ang pagpresentar sang impeachment articles sa Hunyo 11 agud unahon anay ang mga prayoridad sang administrasyon antes matapos ang ika-19 nga Kongreso.
english: But on May 29, Escudero announced the presentation of impeachment articles on June 11 to prioritize the administration's priorities before the end of the 19th Congress.

text: Ginsiling naman ni Senador Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa nga siya kag iban nga mga senador nagapreparar sang resolution nga nagapanawagan nga untaton ang impeachment case batok kay Duterte.
english: Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa said he and other senators are preparing a resolution calling for the suspension of the impeachment case against Duterte.

text: Ginpasakaan si Duterte sang mga reklamo nga naangot sa paglapas sa pagsalig sang publiko, paglapas sa Konstitusyon, pagkumiter sang korapsyon, kag iban pa nga seryoso nga krimen.
english: Duterte was charged with complaints related to violation of public trust, violation of the Constitution, commission of corruption, and other serious crimes.

text: Natalana nga panubuon na naman sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) para sa imported rice umpisa sa Hulyo.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) is scheduled to increase the maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) for imported rice starting July.

text: Ini ang sunod sa direktiba ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This is in line with the directive of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga magpadayon sang pagpangita sang paagi agud nga mabuhinan ang palas-anon sang Filipino consumers.
english: to continue finding ways to reduce the burden of Filipino consumers.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr., mahimo nga i-implementar ang P43 kada kilo nga MSRP umpisa sa Hulyo 1.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr., the P43 per kilo MSRP could be implemented starting July 1.

text: Halin ini sa ginapatuman subong nga P45 kada kilo.
english: This is from the current P45 per kilo.

text: Matandaan nga una nga ginpatuman ini nga tikang sang Enero kun sa diin nagsugod ang MSRP sa P58 kada kilo tubtub nga nag-us-os pa sa P45 kada kilo sang Marso 31.
english: It can be recalled that this measure was first implemented in January where the MSRP started at P58 per kilo until it dropped to P45 per kilo on March 31.

text: Nagalaum man si Secretary Tiu Laurel sang kaangay man nga adjustments sa presyo sang bugas sa idalom sang Rice-for-All program.
english: Secretary Tiu Laurel also hopes for similar adjustments in the price of rice under the Rice-for-All program.

text: Magaupdanay ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika, Japan, kag South Korea sa isa ka trilateral summit sa Agusto 18.
english: The United States of America, Japan, and South Korea will join forces at a trilateral summit on August 18.

text: Ang summit ang ginalauman nga tambungan mismo ni US President Joe Biden, Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida, kag South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol sa Camp David presidential retreat sa Maryland malapit sa Washington.
english: The summit is expected to be attended by US President Joe Biden, Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida, and South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol at the Camp David presidential retreat in Maryland near Washington.

text: Pananglitan madayon ang amo nga plano, ini amo ang mangin labing-una nga standalone summit sa tunga sang mga lider sang tatlo ka nasambit nga pungsod apisar nga may yara man sila anay sang trilateral meetings kadungan sang mga ginatambungan nga international conference kag mga okasyon.
english: If the plan goes ahead, it will be the first standalone summit between the leaders of the three countries despite the fact that they have previously held trilateral meetings in conjunction with international conferences and occasions.

text: Sa sunod nila nga pagkit-anay, ang ginalantaw nga mayor nga agenda amo ang pagsabat sa pagpamahog sang North Korea nga padayon sa pagpalupad sang ballistic missile.
english: In their next meeting, the main agenda is expected to be to respond to North Korea's threat to continue launching ballistic missiles.

text: Ginalantaw nga planuhan kun paano makakuha sang temprano nga impormasyon kun magpalupad sang missile ang North Korea.
english: It is expected to plan how to get early information if North Korea launches a missile.

text: Sa subong, ang Amerika ang may yara sang system nga naka-angot sa Tokyo kag Seoul agud ma-detect kag ma-track ang missiles sang Pyongyang; apang ang iban nila nga Asian security allies ang wala sang mekanismo agud gilayon nga masugid ang impormasyon sa isa kag isa.
english: Currently, the United States has a system linked to Tokyo and Seoul to detect and track Pyongyang's missiles; but some of their Asian security allies do not have the mechanism to immediately share information with each other.

text: Duha ka mga bombero halin sa Guimaras ang magapaindis-indis sa nagahilapit nga Search for Mr. and Ms. Bumbero For Purpose (BFP) 2025.
english: Two firefighters from Guimaras will compete in the upcoming Search for Mr. and Ms. Firefighter For Purpose (BFP) 2025.

text: Si Fire Officer 1 Gindel Padalhin, 28, nga nagsulod sa serbisyo sang 2021 bilang kabahin sang Class BAGSIK, ang magatiglawas bilang Mr. BFP Guimaras.
english: Fire Officer 1 Gindel Padalhin, 28, who entered the service in 2021 as part of Class BAGSIK, will represent Mr. BFP Guimaras.

text: Samtang si Fire Officer 1 Katrina A. Jardeleza, 25, miyembro sang Class SALAKNIB halin sa 2023, ang magatiglawas naman bilang Ms. BFP Guimaras.
english: Meanwhile, Fire Officer 1 Katrina A. Jardeleza, 25, a member of Class SALAKNIB since 2023, will represent Ms. BFP Guimaras.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Padalhin, iya ginpahayag nga isa siya ka Civil Engineer, apang sang tion sang pandemya, nagdesisyon ini nga magsulod sa Bureau of Fire Protection.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Padalhin said he was a Civil Engineer, but during the pandemic, he decided to join the Bureau of Fire Protection.

text: Indi naman bag-o si Padalhin sa pageantry bangud sang kolehiyo, nagapasakop naman ini sa pageant.
english: Padalhin is not new to pageantry because since college, she has been participating in pageants.

text: Luyag man ni Padalhin nga ipakita indi lang ang ila dedikasyon sa serbisyo bilang bombero kundi mangin sa ila pag-amlig sa kasapatan sa tion sang emerhensya.
english: Padalhin also wanted to show not only their dedication to the service as firefighters but also to their protection of animals in times of emergency.

text: Samtang, suno naman kay Jardeleza, nagtapos ini sa kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Criminology sa University of Iloilo – Phinma Education.
english: Meanwhile, Jardeleza said he graduated with a Bachelor of Science in Criminology from the University of Iloilo – Phinma Education.

text: Suno kay Jardeleza, ini naman ang pinakauna sini nga pagpasakop sa pageant, apang positibo nga makuha ang korona.
english: According to Jardeleza, this is her first time participating in the pageant, but she is positive to win the crown.

text: Sa idalom sang ila advocacy nga “Voice FUR the Voiceless,” katuyuan niya nga ibatak ang ihibalo sa fire safety sang mga kasapatan kag ang importansya sang emergency preparedness kag disaster response.
english: Under their advocacy “Voice FUR the Voiceless,” he aims to raise awareness on wildlife fire safety and the importance of emergency preparedness and disaster response.

text: Nag-file sang “not guilty” ang Director sang kontrobersyal nga pelikula nga “The Rapists of Pepsi Paloma” (TROPP) nga si Daryl Yap sa duha ka kaso sang cyberlibel nga ginpasaka batok sa iya ni veteran actor kag TV host Vic Sotto.
english: Director of the controversial film “The Rapists of Pepsi Paloma” (TROPP) Daryl Yap has filed a “not guilty” plea to two cyberlibel cases filed against him by veteran actor and TV host Vic Sotto.

text: Ginpahayag sang abogado ni Yap nga si Atty. Raymond Fortun, sa press matapos ang arraignment sa Muntinlupa Regional Trial Court Branch 203.
english: Yap's lawyer, Atty. Raymond Fortun, to the press after the arraignment at the Muntinlupa Regional Trial Court Branch 203.

text: Ginsiling ni Atty. Fortun nga may yara sang mandatory mediation conference nga pagahimoon agud talakayon ang posibilidad sang settlement antes ang una nga hearing sa Agosto 19.
english: Atty. Fortun said a mandatory mediation conference will be held to discuss the possibility of a settlement before the preliminary hearing on Aug. 19.

text: Samtang, ang abogado ni Sotto nga si Atty. Enrique Dela Cruz nagsiling nga wala pa sila nakaestoryahanay parte sa posible nga settlement.
english: Meanwhile, Sotto's lawyer, Atty. Enrique Dela Cruz said they have not yet discussed a possible settlement.

text: Kauyon ka man bala sang rabanos nga ginalakot sa nanuhay-tuhay nga linuto?
english: Do you agree with radishes being used in various dishes?

text: Nakahibalo ka bala ang dahon sang amo nga utan ang makasolbar sa nanuhay-tuhay man nga problema sa ikaayong lawas?
english: Did you know that the leaves of this vegetable can also solve various health problems?

text: Suno kay Shilpa Marwah, registered dietitian sa India, ang dahon sang rabanos ang pinakamaayo nga source sang vitamin C, vitamin A kag thiamine.
english: According to Shilpa Marwah, registered dietitian in India, radish leaves are the best source of vitamin C, vitamin A and thiamine.

text: Ang nasambit nga mga antioxidant ang nagapalikaw sa cell damage kag fatigue kag nagapadugang sang immunity.
english: These antioxidants prevent cell damage and fatigue and increase immunity.

text: Pahayag sang dietician, ang duga sang dahon sang rabanos ang nagapaayo man sang balatian nga rheumatism kag diabetes.
english: According to the dietician, the juice of radish leaves also cures rheumatism and diabetes.

text: Ini bangud ang dahon sang rabanos ang makabig nga natural diuretic, manggaron sa laxative properties kag natukiban nga nagapanubo sang high blood sugar levels.
english: This is because radish leaves are considered a natural diuretic, rich in laxative properties and have been found to reduce high blood sugar levels.

text: BETTER LATE BUT BETTER PREPARED.
english: BETTER LATE BUT BETTER PREPARED.

text: Amo ini seguro ang sa pensar sang kampo ni anay Davao City Mayor Rodrigo Duterte sa pagpadalagan sa iya sa pagka-Presidente sadtong eleksyon sang Mayo 2016.
english: This is probably what the camp of former Davao City Mayor Rodrigo Duterte had in mind when he ran for president in the May 2016 elections.

text: Una anay nagbutang sila sing placeholder nga kandidato sa tion sang Filing of Candidacy (Oktubre 12-16, 2015), kag ugaling ginduso sang PDP-Laban ang kandidatura ni Duterte bulos sa ginpa-withdraw nga si Martin Dino sang malapit na ang deadline sang Substitution Period sadtong Disyembre 10, 2015, nga wala ginhimo sang iya mga kasumpong.
english: They first nominated a placeholder candidate during the Filing of Candidacy (October 12-16, 2015), but the PDP-Laban proposed Duterte's candidacy to replace the withdrawn Martin Dino when the deadline for the Substitution Period approached on December 10, 2015, which his opponents did not do.

text: Ambot kon ngaa ginpasugtan man ini nga klase sang Substitution Rule sang Comelec kay samtang kilala na nga butigon ang kadam-an ta nga mga pulitiko, ginatudluan ta pa sila sa pagbinutig pa gid.
english: I don't know why the Comelec allowed this kind of Substitution Rule because while most of our politicians are known to be liars, we are still teaching them to lie more.

text: Imagine, himo ka anay sang peke nga kandidato agud malimbungan indi lang ang mga kasumpong kundi pati na ang mga pumuluyo!
english: Imagine, you make a fake candidate to deceive not only the opponents but also the people!

text: Amo man ini seguro ang rason kon ngaa napaslawan si Duterte.
english: This is probably the reason why Duterte failed.

text: Binutig gali ang iya pangako nga tapuson ang problem sa droga sa anom (6) lang ka bulan, kag ang dalagku nga mga krimen kag korapsyon.
english: His promise to end the drug problem in just six months, and the major crimes and corruption, is a lie.

text: Naglala pa gani!
english: It even got worse!

text:
***

Sa ining palaabuton nga eleksyon sa Mayo 2022, amo man gihapon ang game plan sang kampo ni Duterte – may placeholder nga mga kandidato kag ugaling magduso sang segurado na nga mga kandidato sang Partido PDP-Laban kon diin tsirman si Presidente Duterte.
english:
***

In the upcoming elections in May 2022, the game plan of the Duterte camp is still the same – to have placeholder candidates and then to propose the secured candidates of the PDP-Laban Party where President Duterte is chairman.

text:
Sa ini nga kampanyahanay ugaling, ang kampo ni Duterte ang yara sa “defensive” kag ang political opposition naman ang yara sa “offensive” sa mayor nga proposition nga “Dapat bala saligan pa liwat ang grupo ni Duterte sa pagdala sang ryenda sang pang-gobyerno?”

Syempre, ang ideya sang away sang Duterte Camp amo nga ipabilin gihapon ang PDP-Laban kag mga alyansya sini sa poder.
english:
In this campaign, however, the Duterte camp is on the defensive and the political opposition is on the offensive on the main proposition that “Should the Duterte group be trusted again to carry the reins of government?”

Of course, the idea of ​​the fight of the Duterte Camp is to keep the PDP-Laban and its alliances in power.

text: Sa bahin sang political opposition, nga ginapangunahan ni Vice President Leni Robredo, nangin hayag sila dayon parti sa ila mga kandidatura sa pag-file pa lang sang ila candidacy – tubtub Oktubre 8, 2021- nga wala na maghulat sang Substitution Period sa deadline sini sa Nobyembre 15.
english: On the part of the political opposition, led by Vice President Leni Robredo, they immediately became transparent about their candidacies as soon as they filed their candidacies – until October 8, 2021- without waiting for the Substitution Period on its November 15 deadline.

text: Si VP Leni nagliwat lang sang iya kandidatura bilang “Independent” sa Filing of Candidacy, although suportado gihapon sang Liberal Party nga sadto ginapangunahan niya.
english: VP Leni just changed her candidacy as “Independent” in the Filing of Candidacy, although still supported by the Liberal Party that she used to lead.

text: Ginpakitaan man siya sing daku nga suporta sang madamo nga mga pumuluyo nga nagahinugyaw gid sa iya paglibut-libot sa pungsod.
english: He was also shown a lot of support by many citizens who were very excited about his tour of the country.

text:
***

Ti, ano ang makapadaug nga game plan para sa Duterte Administration kay karon yara na ini sa “defensive”?
english:
***

So, what is the winning game plan for the Duterte Administration now that it is on the “defensive”?

text: Sa karon, dalagku gid ang problema sang Duterte Camp.
english: Today, the Duterte Camp has serious problems.

text: Buka na ang PDP-Laban Party sa Cusi Wing kag Pacquiao Wing, samtang gaatubang man sang mabug-at nga salabton sa mga pumuluyo.
english: The PDP-Laban Party is now open in the Cusi Wing and Pacquiao Wing, while also facing heavy responsibility to the people.

text: Wala magdalagan ang anak ni Duterte nga sa Davao City Mayor Sara sa pagka-Presidente kundi pagka-VP lang sa idalom sang Lakas-CMD.
english: Duterte's daughter, Davao City Mayor Sara, did not run for President but for VP under Lakas-CMD.

text: Ngaa ayhan sa pagka-VP lang kay sa inisyal nga survey nagapanguna si Sara?
english: Why is it that Sara is leading in the initial survey?

text: Tungod seguro kay mabug-at ang mga kasumpong sa pagka-Presidente.
english: Probably because the opponents for the Presidency are heavy.

text: Kag sa pagka-VP lang ang nakita nila nga may kadalag-an ini “in the long run”.
english: And only in being VP did they see that it had success “in the long run”.

text: May problema ugaling sa pagduso sa iya bilang ka-tandem ni Bongbong Marcos sang Kilusang Bagong Lipunan (KBL) nga nagadalagan sa pagka-Presidente.
english: There is a problem, however, in pushing him as a tandem with Bongbong Marcos of the Kilusang Bagong Lipunan (KBL) who is running for president.

text: May mabug-at kuno ini nga bagahe, sunu mismo kay Presidente Duterte.
english: It is said to have heavy luggage, according to President Duterte himself.

text: Ining bagahe ni Bongbong amo seguro ang padayon nga isyu sang ila ill-gotten wealth, nga sunu sa Supreme Court nagalab-ut sa $658 ka milyon samtang ang known lawful income sang mag-asawa nga Marcos tubtub lang sa $304,372.43.
english: Bongbong's luggage is probably the ongoing issue of their ill-gotten wealth, which according to the Supreme Court amounts to $658 million while the known lawful income of the Marcos couple is only $304,372.43.

text: Found guilty man sang tax evasion si Bongbong sa indi pagbayad sing buhis halin sa 1982 tubtub 1984.
english: Bongbong was also found guilty of tax evasion for failing to pay taxes from 1982 to 1984.

text: Isa ini sang daku nga isyu ni VP Leni batok kay Bongbong bilang nagapanguna nga kandidato sa pagka-Presidente sang political opposition.
english: This is one of the big issues of VP Leni against Bongbong as the leading candidate for the presidency of the political opposition.

text: Indi man makasiling si Bongbong kag mga utod niya nga wala sila labot sa ill-gotten wealth sang ila mga ginikanan.
english: Bongbong and his siblings cannot say that they have nothing to do with their parents' ill-gotten wealth.

text: Bilang mga eredero, na-enjoy kag ma-enjoy man nila ining ill-gotten wealth sang ila ginikanan.
english: As heirs, they have enjoyed and will enjoy this ill-gotten wealth of their parents.

text: May daku man nga isyu si Presidente kay Bongbong.
english: The President also has a big issue with Bongbong.

text: Siya bala ato ang kandidato nga may bisyo sang droga nga cocaine?
english: Is he the candidate with the cocaine addiction?

text: Isa pa, may kandidato man sa pagka-Presidente si Presidente Duterte nga si Bong Go sang PDP-Laban Cusi Wing.
english: In addition, President Duterte also has a presidential candidate, Bong Go of the PDP-Laban Cusi Wing.

text: In fact, nagagwa nga ang bottom line sang game plan sang Duterte Camp sa national scene amo lang ang pagpadaug kay Sara sa pagka-VP kag sang ila mga kandidato sa pagka-senador, lakip na si Presidente Duterte nga nagadalagan man sa pagka-senador.
english: In fact, it turns out that the bottom line of the Duterte Camp's game plan on the national scene is to defeat Sara for VP and their senatorial candidates, including President Duterte who is also running for senator.

text: Mabudlay seguro mapadaug ining ila handom./PN
english: It must be difficult to overcome their dream./PN

text: Ginapatuman na sang Iloilo State University of Fisheries Science and Technology umpisa sang Pebrero 2, 2026 ang 4 day compressed workweek para sa bilog nga 2nd semester sang academic year.
english: Iloilo State University of Fisheries Science and Technology is implementing starting February 2, 2026 the 4 day compressed workweek for the entire 2nd semester of the academic year.

text: Ini amo ang nangin resulta matapos ang ginpatigayon nga survey sa mga staff kag studyante sang ISUFST nga naga-ugyon sa pagpatuman sang 40-hour workweek kun sa diin ginre-organize ang schedule sang mga klase.
english: This is the result after a survey conducted among the staff and students of ISUFST who agree with the implementation of the 40-hour workweek where the schedule of classes was reorganized.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Herman Lagon, Director of the Public Affairs, Marketing, and Media Communications Office (PAMMCO), ISUFST, iya ginpahayag nga sa baylo sang nakaandan nga pagbalik-balik sa eskwelahan humalin lunes tubtob byernes, mangin lunes tubtob huwebes na lang ang klase kag opisina.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Herman Lagon, Director of the Public Affairs, Marketing, and Media Communications Office (PAMMCO), ISUFST, said that instead of the usual back and forth to school from Monday to Friday, classes and offices will be Monday to Thursday.

text: Matapos ang isa ka bulan nga implementasyon, nakabatun ini sang positibo nga feedback halin sa mga studyante kag sa mismo nga mga personnel sang unibersidad.
english: After a month of implementation, it received positive feedback from students and university personnel themselves.

text: Suno pa kay Lagon, isa ka work efficient, cost-efficient kag may maayo nga resulta sa ikaayong lawas sa ila nga mga staff kag studyante ang nasambit nga 4 day compressed workweek.
english: According to Lagon, the 4-day compressed workweek is a work efficient, cost-efficient and has good health results for their staff and students.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Jescel Bito-onon, Vice President for Administration and Finance sang ISUFST, iya gin-athag nga may ara sang nagasunod sa gihapon sa daan nga schedule nga mga staff sang farm, fishponds kag agricultural stations sang unibersidad bangud man sa ila ginabantayan nga mga livestocks.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Jescel Bito-onon, Vice President for Administration and Finance of ISUFST, explained that there are staff of the university's farm, fishponds and agricultural stations who are still following the old schedule because of the livestocks they are monitoring.

text: Dugang pa niya nga madamo sila sang ginapang-ubra nga mga tikang antes nga maaprubahan sang board of regents ang nasambit nga 4 day compressed workweek
english: He added that they are taking many steps before the board of regents approves the 4 day compressed workweek

text: Nagduso ang National Unity Party (NUP) sang isa ka hagna nga may tinutuyo nga ma-ban ang mga kongresista nga mag-engage sa mga infrastructure contracts sang gobyerno.
english: The National Unity Party (NUP) has proposed a bill aimed at banning congressmen from engaging in government infrastructure contracts.

text: Suno kay Ronaldo Puno, House Deputy Speaker kag NUP chairman, ang ila proposal amo ang Anti-‘Cong-tractor’ Bill nga may katuyoan nga mapauntat ang mga ginpahayag “cong-tractors” nga nagaserbe bilang government contractors sa pila ka mga proyekto sang pungsod.
english: According to Ronaldo Puno, House Deputy Speaker and NUP chairman, their proposal is the Anti-‘Cong-tractor’ Bill which aims to stop the alleged “cong-tractors” who serve as government contractors in some of the country’s projects.

text: Sa idalom sa sini nga hagna, ang mga kongresista kag ang ila pamilya tubtob fourth degree of consanguinity ukon affinity, ang ginadumilian nga magkuha sang mga infrastructure kag construction contracts sa mga government agencies, ilabi na sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: Under the bill, congressmen and their families up to fourth degree of consanguinity or affinity, are prohibited from taking infrastructure and construction contracts from government agencies, especially the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: Ginpakigbahin pa ni Puno nga kun ini amo ang maaprubahan, dako ang posibilidad nga makakas ang isa ka mamalidha bilang myembro sang House of Representatives kun ini amo ang madakpan nga nagalapas sa layi.
english: Puno shared that if this is approved, there is a high possibility that a lawmaker will be removed as a member of the House of Representatives if he is caught violating the law.

text: Nahibaluan nga pending pa sa gihapon ang nasambit nga proposal, apang nakabatun na ini snag suporta halin sa 130 ka mga kongresista.
english: The proposal is still pending, but has already received support from 130 congressmen.

text: Madumduman nga sang nagligad nga 2025, may ara sang mga natukiban ginpahayag ‘Cong-tractors’ ukon kongresista nga isa man ka kontraktor ang involved sa palpak nga mga flood control projects sa pungsod.
english: It can be recalled that in 2025, there were discoveries of alleged 'Cong-tractors' or congressmen who are also contractors involved in failed flood control projects in the country.

text: Gindayaw ni US President Donald Trump ang natabo nga pagpakig-hinun-anon sini sa tunga nila ni Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelensky bangud nakahimo sila sang madamo nga mga progreso.
english: US President Donald Trump praised the talks between him and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for making a lot of progress.

text: Sa pagkitaay sang duwa matapos ang bilateral talks, ginpakigbahin sang duwa ka mga lider ang ila nga gin-istoryahan bilang maayo kag positibo para sa isa ka peace plan.
english: During the meeting after the bilateral talks, the two leaders shared their discussion as good and positive for a peace plan.

text: Ginpasalamatan man ni Trump ang mga US official nga nagpanguna sa negosasyon para sa peace plan.
english: Trump also thanked the US officials who led the negotiations for the peace plan.

text: Suno pa kay Zelensky, naugyunan na ang 100% nga security guarantees apang ginpahayg ni Trump nga malapit pa lang sa 95% ang naugyunan sa security guarantee para sa Ukraine.
english: According to Zelensky, 100% of the security guarantees have been agreed but Trump said that only close to 95% of the security guarantees for Ukraine have been agreed.

text: Ginpakigbahin man ni Ukraine President nga nakatalana nga makigkita ang negotiator team sang Ukraine sa European leaders upod ang NATO sa sunod nga mga semana.
english: Ukraine President also shared that Ukraine’s negotiator team is scheduled to meet with European leaders along with NATO in the coming weeks.

text: Gintuad man ni Zelensky nga handa na ang Ukraine para maaguman ang ila kahilwayan.
english: Zelensky also acknowledged that Ukraine is ready to achieve its independence.

text: Samtang sa bahin naman ni Trump, iya gintuad nga sa idalom sang US peace plan pagadumalahan sang US ang pinakadako nga nuclear power plant amo man sang Ukraine upod ang Russia.
english: Meanwhile, Trump acknowledged that under the US peace plan, the US will manage the largest nuclear power plant as well as Ukraine's with Russia.

text: Apang, wala ginpasugtan ni Zelensky ang anuman nga commercial involvement sang Russia.
english: However, Zelensky did not allow any commercial involvement by Russia.

text: Sa pagpakighinun-anon ni Trump kay Putin, nagpangako ang Russian leader nga magabulig ini sa pagbangon sang Ukraine kun mtapoa na ang gyera.
english: During Trump's meeting with Putin, the Russian leader promised to help Ukraine recover when the war ends.

text: Dugang pa sini nga gusto sang Russia nga mangon madinalag-on ang Ukraine bangud suno sa US President dako ang nabulig sang Russia kabahin angpagsupply sang kuryebnte nga may manubo nga presyo.
english: He added that Russia wants Ukraine to be successful because according to the US President, Russia has helped a lot in terms of supplying electricity at low prices.

text: ILOILO – Apisar mabudlay, wala nangin upang sa isa ka Most Outstanding Female Solo Parent ang pagpadako sini sa iya anak apisar isa siya ka solo parent.
english: ILOILO – Despite the difficulties, a Most Outstanding Female Solo Parent has not been able to raise her child despite being a solo parent.

text: Ini amo si Roselia Jardenil, 56, sang Barangay Pagsangaan, Pavia, Iloilo kag may isa ka anak.
english: This is Roselia Jardenil, 56, of Barangay Pagsangaan, Pavia, Iloilo and has one child.

text: Si Jardenil ang ginpasidunggan kadungan sang Ang Ilongga Awards.
english: Jardenil was honored during the Ang Ilongga Awards.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jardenil, iya ginpahayag nga apisar wala siya sang bana, napalibutan ini sang iya pamilya kag mga abyan nga naghatag sang pagpalangga sa iya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jardenil said that although she is single, she is surrounded by her family and friends who gave her love.

text: Suno kay Jardenil, nahatag man sini ang pagpalangga nga kinahanglanon sang iya anak, apang indi man malikawan nga makaangkon man ini sang problema sa pinansyal ilabi na nga yara na ini sa kolehiyo.
english: According to Jardenil, he also gave his son the love he needed, but it is also inevitable that he will also have financial problems especially now that he is in college.

text: Sa subong, nagaserbe si Jardenil bilang presidente sang Federation of Solo Parents, Luzvimin Inc.
english: Jardenil currently serves as the president of the Federation of Solo Parents, Luzvimin Inc.

text: humalin pa sang 2022.
english: since 2022.

text: Bilang isa ka solo parent, suportado man sini ang pag-ammend sang Republic Act 8972 ukon ang Solo Parents’ Welfare Act of 2000.
english: As a solo parent, she also supports the amendment of Republic Act 8972 or the Solo Parents’ Welfare Act of 2000.

text: Maga-deploy ang Philippine National Police (PNP) sang 37,000 ka mga police personnel sa bilog nga pungsod para sa pagbukas sang School Year 2025-2026 subong nga bulan.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) will deploy 37,000 police personnel nationwide for the opening of the School Year 2025-2026 this month.

text: Suno kay PNP spokesperson Police Brigadier General Jean Fajardo, nahanda na nila ini nga mga personnel para masigurado ang seguridad kag ang assistance sa mga kabataan.
english: According to PNP spokesperson Police Brigadier General Jean Fajardo, they have already prepared these personnel to ensure security and assistance to the children.

text: 5,000 diri ang ibutang sa mga police assistance desk sa mga eskwelahan.
english: 5,000 of which will be placed at police assistance desks in schools.

text: Magluwas diri, may yara man sang police mobile kag foot patrollers nga malapit man sa mga buluthuan.
english: In addition, there are also police mobile and foot patrollers near the schools.

text:
Sandig sa Department of Education (DepEd), matabo ang pormal nga pagbukas sang panibag-o nga school year sa Hunyo 16, 2025

Ini ang pagbalik sa pre-pandemic school calendar nga sunod sa nakabutang sa DepEd Order No.
english:
According to the Department of Education (DepEd), the formal opening of the new school year will take place on June 16, 2025

This is a return to the pre-pandemic school calendar in accordance with DepEd Order No.

text: 12, Series of 2025.
english: 12, Series of 2025.

text: Ini nga school year ang magatakop sa Marso 31, 2006 nga buot silingon naga-cover sang 197 class days lakip na ang End-of-School-Year (EOSY) rites.
english: This school year will end on March 31, 2006 which means it covers 197 class days including the End-of-School-Year (EOSY) rites.

text: ILOILO – Ginpakigbahin sang isa ka Ilongga ang masakit nga kamatuoran sa iya nagligad sa diin ginbaligya siya sa balor nga P700 sang 11 months pa lang siya.
english: ILOILO – An Ilongga shared the painful truth about her past where she was sold for P700 when she was 11 months old.

text: Ini amo si Mae Joy Amora, 28, residente sang Barangay Cubay, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: This is Mae Joy Amora, 28, resident of Barangay Cubay, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Amora, iya ginpahayag nga ginbaligya siya sang iya iloy sang 1996 kag gin-adopt ni Virginia Amora nga isa ka laon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Amora said she was sold by her mother in 1996 and adopted by Virginia Amora, an elderly woman.

text: Suno kay Amora, isa ka semana matapos ang transaksyon, gindala siya sa Barangay Bantayanan, Tubungan, Iloilo, sa diin siya nagdako.
english: According to Amora, a week after the transaction, he was taken to Barangay Bantayanan, Tubungan, Iloilo, where he grew up.

text: Sa pihak sang kabudlay nga naagyan, nagapabilin siya nga determinado sa kabuhi.
english: Despite the hardships she has gone through, she remains determined in life.

text: Bata pa lang siya, nagtuon na siya nga magbaligya sang mga utanon halin sa bukid samtang nagatuon.
english: As a child, he learned to sell vegetables from the mountains while studying.

text: Natapos ni Amora sa Victoria Elementary School kag sekondarya sa Lanag Norte National High School sa Tubungan, Iloilo.
english: Amora completed her secondary education at Victoria Elementary School and secondary school at Lanag Norte National High School in Tubungan, Iloilo.

text: Sang 3rd year college ioni, nakilala niya ang iya amay, apang nangin malip-ot lang ang ila pag-istoryahanay sa diin nahibaluan man sini nga may bag-o na ini nga pamilya na sa Negros Occidental kag may anom siya ka mga utod.
english: When he was in 3rd year college, he met his father, but their conversation was brief and he learned that he had a new family in Negros Occidental and that he had six siblings.

text: Ginpadayon sini ang iya pagtuon sa kolehiyo kag nagkuha sang kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Office Administration sa Cabalum Western College, sa diin nakatapos ini sang 2018.
english: She continued her college studies and pursued a Bachelor of Science in Office Administration degree at Cabalum Western College, where she graduated in 2018.

text: Matapos ang graduation, ginbaton siya gilayon sa trabaho sa kaangay man nga kolehiyo.
english: After graduation, he was immediately hired at the same college.

text: Matapos sini, nagtrabaho siya sa isa ka call center sa sulod sang duha ka tuig antes nagpadulong sa Singapore bilang domestic helper kag tutor humalin sang 2022 tubtob 2024.
english: After that, she worked in a call center for two years before heading to Singapore as a domestic helper and tutor from 2022 to 2024.

text: Nagalaom man si Amora nga magaserbe nga inspirasyon ang iya istorya sa mga kabataan nga gin-adopt, apang naninguha sa pangabuhi.
english: Amora also hopes that her story will serve as an inspiration to children who have been adopted, but are struggling to survive.

text: Tatlo ka milyon nga mga box sang family food packs ang naka-preposition na sa masobra 900 ka mga warehouse sa bilog nga pungsod bilang preparasyon sa malain nga tyempo kag mga bagyo.
english: Three million boxes of family food packs have been prepositioned in more than 900 warehouses nationwide in preparation for bad weather and typhoons.

text: Suno kay Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) Secretary Rex Gatchalian, kabahin ini sang “Buong Bansa Handa” program nga nagasanto sa direktiba sang presidente nga handa ang supply chain sa tion sang kalamidad.
english: According to Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) Secretary Rex Gatchalian, this is part of the “Buong Bansa Handa” program in line with the president's directive that the supply chain is ready in times of disaster.

text: Nagmandu na ang tiglikom sa disaster response management group nga butangan gid sang food packs ilabi na ang mga rehiyon kun sa diin masami may baha kag mga bagyo.
english: The secretary has ordered the disaster response management group to provide food packs especially in regions where floods and typhoons are frequent.

text: Ini nga whole-of-nation approach suno sa ahensya amo ang nagapadasig sang pagresponde sang gobyerno kun may kalamidad agud nga mabuligan gilayon ang apektado nga mga pamilya.
english: This whole-of-nation approach, according to the agency, is what speeds up the government's response to disasters so that affected families can be helped immediately.

text: Kahapon sang aga, Hunyo 6, sang nagsulod na sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang isa ka Low Pressure Area (LPA) kag ginalantaw nga mangin bagyo subong nga weekend.
english: Yesterday morning, June 6, a Low Pressure Area (LPA) entered the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) and is expected to become a typhoon this weekend.

text: Pagatawgon ini sa local name nga Auring nga amo ang mangin una nga bagyo sa Pilipinas sa 2025.
english: It will be called by the local name Auring which will be the first typhoon in the Philippines in 2025.

text: Ini nga potential tropical cyclone ang magahulag palapit sa Eastern Visayas kag Bicol subong nga Sabado kag buwas, Domingo, kag mahimo man sini pabaskugon pa ang southwest monsoon ukon habagat.
english: This potential tropical cyclone will move closer to Eastern Visayas and Bicol this Saturday and tomorrow, Sunday, and may also strengthen the southwest monsoon or habagat.

text: Nag-release ang Department of Agriculture (DA) sang P10 million para sa pesticide procurement agud matapna na ang red-striped soft scale insects (RSSI) infestation nga amo ang daku nga pagpanghangkat sa sugar production sa Negros Island.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has released P10 million for pesticide procurement to curb the red-striped soft scale insects (RSSI) infestation which is a major challenge to sugar production in Negros Island.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., paagi sa suporta sang Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA), ginalauman nga madasig nga matapna ang infestation.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., with the support of the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA), the infestation is expected to be curbed quickly.

text: Nagmandu man mismo si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. himself ordered the

text: sa DA nga tapnaon gilayon ang infestation kag maghimo sang tikang nga malikawan nga maglapta pa ini sa Negros.
english: to the DA to immediately stop the infestation and take steps to prevent it from spreading further in Negros.

text: Base sa SRA data, sa Visayas region nagahalin ang 71% sang national sugar output kun sa diin ang kontribusyon sang Negros Island pa lamang nagalab-ot na sa 63% sang total.
english: Based on SRA data, the Visayas region accounts for 71% of the national sugar output, with the contribution of Negros Island alone reaching 63% of the total.

text: Ang iban pa nga nagaamot sang produksyon sa Visayas amo ang sugar plantations sa Panay, Cebu, kag Leyte.
english: Other contributors to production in the Visayas are sugar plantations in Panay, Cebu, and Leyte.

text: Ginaplano na sang Russia ang natalana nga pagbisita ni President Vladimir Putin sa China.
english: Russia is already planning President Vladimir Putin’s scheduled visit to China.

text: Suno kay Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, iga-anunsyo lang ang petsa sang byahe ni Putin kun na-finalize na ini.
english: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said the date of Putin's trip would only be announced once it was finalized.

text: Suno pa sa natungdan, subong ang tyempo nga importante nga ma-maintain ang maayo nga bilateral Russian-Chinese relations.
english: He said now is the time to maintain good bilateral Russian-Chinese relations.

text: Nahibaluan nga mas nagbaskog pa ang economic, trade, political kag military ties sang Russia sa China matapos nga naglain man ang tamdanay sini sa iban nga pungsod sa West nga amo ang nagaapin sa Ukraine.
english: Russia's economic, trade, political and military ties with China have strengthened after its attitude towards other Western countries that are defending Ukraine has also deteriorated.

text: Una na nga nagkomiter sanday Putin kag Chinese President Xi Jinping nga may yara sang “no limits” partnership sinemana antes naglunsar ang Russia sang “special military operation” sa Ukraine sang Pebrero 24, 2022.
english: Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping had previously committed to having a “no limits” partnership weeks before Russia launched a “special military operation” in Ukraine on February 24, 2022.

text: Marso subong nga tuig sang nagbisita si Xi sa Russia kag may mga naselyuhan na nga mga economic kag iban pa nga agreements sa abyan sini nga si Putin.
english: Xi visited Russia in March this year and has already sealed economic and other agreements with his friend Putin.

text: Ang China amo ang isa ka major buyer sang Russian oil and gas.
english: China is a major buyer of Russian oil and gas.

text: May gin-presentar ini nga papel nga nagapanawagan sa paghagan-hagan sang away kag ceasefire sa Ukraine, apang pareho nga ginbasura sang Kyiv kag sang kaalyado nga mga pungsod sa West bangud nagapati sila nga paagi ini agud mahigot sa interes sang Russia.
english: It had presented a paper calling for an easing of the fighting and a ceasefire in Ukraine, but both Kyiv and allied countries in the West rejected it because they believed it was a way to be tied to Russian interests.

text: Sa natalana nga byahe ni Putin sa Beijing, lauman nga istoryahan sang duha ka presidente ang bilateral trade kag economic cooperation kag iban pa nga global issues.#
english: During Putin's scheduled trip to Beijing, the two presidents are expected to discuss bilateral trade and economic cooperation and other global issues.

text: Nalakip ang anum ka tuig nga bata nga babaye sa grupo nga gin-aresto sa Myanmar bangud sa pagpatay sa isa ka retired military officer sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: A six-year-old girl was among the group arrested in Myanmar for the murder of a retired military officer last month.

text: 16 tanan ka mga indibidwal ang ginpangdakop kun sa diin 13 ang mga lalaki kag tatlo ang babaye.
english: A total of 16 individuals were arrested of which 13 were males and three were females.

text: Ang 6-anyos nga bata ang anak sang ginaalegar nga assassin.
english: The 6-year-old is the son of the alleged assassin.

text: Naka-blur ang itsura sang bata sa online version sang newspaper apang kit-anon naman sa iban nga social media posts sang junta authorities.
english: The child's face is blurred in the online version of the newspaper but can be seen in other social media posts by the junta authorities.

text: Gintawag sila sang militar sang Myanmar nga mga “terorista” kag amo ang ginatudlo nga sa likod sa pagluthang kay Cho Htun Aung, 68, isa ka retired brigadier general nga naka-serbe man anay bilang ambassador.
english: The Myanmar military has called them “terrorists” and is believed to be behind the shooting of Cho Htun Aung, 68, a retired brigadier general who also served as an ambassador.

text: Ang pagpatay sa iya sa Yangon sang Mayo 22 amo ang isa sa high profile assassinations sa Myanmar halin sang natabo ang civil war nga nag-umpisa sa kudeta sadtong Pebrero 2021.
english: His killing in Yangon on May 22 was one of the high profile assassinations in Myanmar since the civil war that began with a coup in February 2021.

text: Una na nga nag-ako ang anti-junta insurgent group nga Golden Valley Warriors nga sila ang nagpatay sa retired general bangud sa iya padayon nga pagsuporta sa military operations lakip na sa pagpang-atake sa mga sibilyan.
english: Earlier, the anti-junta insurgent group Golden Valley Warriors admitted that they killed the retired general because of his continued support for military operations including attacks on civilians.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang nagsugod ang kudeta sa amo nga pungsod, 29,000 na ka mga tawo ang ginpangdakop sang awtoridad lakip na ang masobra 6,000 ka mga babaye kag 600 ka kabataan sandig sa record sang activist group nga Assistance Association of Political Prisoners.
english: Since the coup began in the country, authorities have arrested 29,000 people, including more than 6,000 women and 600 children, according to records from the activist group Assistance Association of Political Prisoners.

text: ILOILO CITY – Updan sang France ang Britanya sa pag-suplay sa Ukraine sang long-range cruise missiles nga maka-travel sang 250 km.
english: ILOILO CITY – France will join Britain in supplying Ukraine with long-range cruise missiles that can travel 250 km.

text: Bangud sini, mahimo na nga ma-igo sang Ukranian forces ang Russian troops.
english: As a result, Ukrainian forces can now hit Russian troops.

text: Suno sa presidente sang France nga si Emmanuel Macron, nagdesisyon ini nga pabaskugon ang military aid sa Ukraine kadungan sang iya pag-abot sa summit sang 31-member North Atlantic Treaty Organization alliance sa Lithuania.
english: French president Emmanuel Macron said he decided to step up military aid to Ukraine in conjunction with his arrival at the summit of the 31-member North Atlantic Treaty Organization alliance in Lithuania.

text: Sa isa ka French diplomatic source, 50 ka mga SCALP missiles nga gin-produce sang European manufacturer nga MBDA ang ihatag sang France.
english: According to a French diplomatic source, 50 SCALP missiles produced by European manufacturer MBDA will be provided by France.

text: Ini ang magahalin sa existing French military stocks suno sa isa ka French military source.
english: It will come from existing French military stocks according to a French military source.

text: Sang nagligad, nag-suplay man ang Paris sang Mistral shoulder-launched anti-aircraft missiles sa Ukraine kag Crotale short-range anti-air missiles nga gingamit sa pag-intercept sang low-flying missiles kag aircraft.
english: In the past, Paris has also supplied Mistral shoulder-launched anti-aircraft missiles to Ukraine and Crotale short-range anti-air missiles that have been used to intercept low-flying missiles and aircraft.

text: Ang Ukraine ang madugay na nga nagapangayo sang longer-range missiles apang ang main supplier nga Estados Unidos ang wala pa nagpasugot nga mag-suplay sa ila.
english: Ukraine has been asking for longer-range missiles for some time but the main supplier, the United States, has not yet agreed to supply them.

text: Anum ang patay sa isa ka stabbing incident sa kindergarten sa probinsya sang Guangdong sa China.
english: Six people were killed in a stabbing incident at a kindergarten in China's Guangdong province.

text: Suno sa local government unit sang Lianjiang kun sa diin natabo ang pagpangbuno, ang mga biktima amo ang duha ka ginikanan, tatlo ka estudyante, kag isa ka manunudlo.
english: According to the local government unit of Lianjiang where the shooting occurred, the victims were two parents, three students, and a teacher.

text: Arestado naman ang 25-anyos nga suspek nga may apelyido nga Wu.
english: A 25-year-old suspect, surnamed Wu, was arrested.

text: Luno sa local police, makabig nga hungod ang pagpang-atake nga natabo.
english: According to local police, the attack was considered deliberate.

text: Nahibaluan nga tuman ka istrikto ang China sa paggamit sang pusil, apang may pila na ka insidente sang pagpangbuno sa nagkalain-lain nga tuig kun sa diin ang masami nga target amo ang mga estudyante kag mga eskwelahan.
english: China is known to be very strict on the use of guns, but there have been several incidents of shootings in different years where students and schools are often targeted.

text: Sulod na naman ang Pilipinas sa listahan sang 10 worst countries para sa mga mamumugon.
english: The Philippines is once again on the list of 10 worst countries for workers.

text: Santo ini sa International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC) Global Rights Index nga ginpaguwa kahapon, Hunyo 6.
english: This is according to the International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC) Global Rights Index released yesterday, June 6.

text: Suno sa Workers Rights Watch nga amo ang nag-release sang report, ini na ang pang-siyam nga sunod-sunod nga tuig nga nalakip ang Pilipinas sa sini nga listahan.
english: According to Workers Rights Watch, which released the report, this is the ninth consecutive year that the Philippines has been included in the list.

text: Kaupod sang Pilipinas sa Top 10 amo ang Bangladesh, Belarus, Ecuador, Egypt, Eswatini, Myanmar, Nigeria, Tunisia, kag Turkey.
english: Joining the Philippines in the Top 10 are Bangladesh, Belarus, Ecuador, Egypt, Eswatini, Myanmar, Nigeria, Tunisia, and Turkey.

text: Base sa report, ang kinamatarong nga magpatigayon sang strike amo ang pinaka-ginalapas nga kinamatarong sang mamugon sa Pilipinas nga nagalab-ot sa 87%.
english: According to the report, the right to strike is the most violated right of workers in the Philippines at 87%.

text: Ginasundan ini sang gina-violate man nga right to collective bargaining agreement nga 80%; ang right to establish or join union sa 75%; kag ang right to justice sa 72%.
english: This is followed by the also violated right to collective bargaining agreement of 80%; the right to establish or join a union at 75%; and the right to justice at 72%.

text: Ginpahayag sang grupo nga kadamo pa sang dapat nga ubrahon agud nga mag-updanay na ang gobyerno kag employers para makakas ang Pilipinas sa sini nga lista.
english: The group said there is still a lot of work to be done so that the government and employers can work together to remove the Philippines from this list.

text: Nahibaluan nga nalakip sa Workers Rights Watch ang Federation of Free Workers, Kilusang Mayo Uno, Unyon ng mga Manggagawa sa Agrikultura, National Federation of Sugar Workers, Alliance of Concerned Teachers.
english: The Workers Rights Watch includes the Federation of Free Workers, Kilusang Mayo Uno, Union of Agricultural Workers, National Federation of Sugar Workers, and Alliance of Concerned Teachers.

text: Kilusan ng Manggagawang Kababaihan, Confederation for Unity, Recognition and Advancement of Government Employees, Public Services Labor Independent Confederation, Bukluran ng Manggagawang Pilipino (BMP), Migrante Philippines, kag ang Center for Trade Union and Human Rights.
english: Women's Workers' Movement, Confederation for Unity, Recognition and Advancement of Government Employees, Public Services Labor Independent Confederation, Bukluran ng Manggawang Pilipino (BMP), Migrante Philippines, and the Center for Trade Union and Human Rights.

text: Missing ang ginabanta 300 ka mga migrants halin sa Senegal nga nagbyahe padulong kuntani sa Canary Islands sa Espanya.
english: About 300 migrants from Senegal are missing on their way to the Canary Islands in Spain.

text: Suno sa migrant aid group nga Walking Borders, may duha ka sakayan nga may karga nga masobra 120 ka mga tawo nga nadula sa sulod na sang 15 ka adlaw.
english: According to the migrant aid group Walking Borders, two boats carrying more than 120 people have been missing for 15 days.

text: Magluwas sa nauna nga duha ka sakayan, may ikatatlo man ka migrant vessel nga naghalin sa Senegal sang Hunyo 27 sakay naman ang masobra 200 ka mga tawo.
english: In addition to the previous two boats, a third migrant vessel left Senegal on June 27 carrying more than 200 people.

text: Wala naman sang ihibalo ang mga pamilya kun ano na ang nagkalatabo sa ila halin sang nagbiya sa Senegal sang amo nga adlaw.
english: The families do not know what has happened to them since they left Senegal that day.

text: Ang tatlo ka sakayan ang palareho nga naghalin sa Kafountine sa south sang Senegal nga ginabanta 1,700 kilometers (1,057 miles) ang kalayuon halin sa Tenerife nga isa sa Canary Islands.
english: The three boats both came from Kafountine in southern Senegal, about 1,700 kilometers (1,057 miles) from Tenerife, one of the Canary Islands.

text: Ang Canary Islands amo ang mayor nga destinasyon sang migrants nga gusto makalab-ot sa Spain.
english: The Canary Islands are the main destination for migrants who want to reach Spain.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara sang migrants nga nagapangisog gid sa pagtabok sa Mediterranean Sea padulong sa Spanish mainland.
english: It is known that there are migrants who dare to cross the Mediterranean Sea to the Spanish mainland.

text: Ang summer amo naman ang pinakamasako nga tion sa pagtuyo sang mga tawo nga makatabok sa sini nga area.
english: Summer is also the busiest time for people to try to cross this area.

text:

english:
#

text: Nakit-an ini sa Port of Arinaga sa Gran Canaria, Spain, June 7, 2022.
english: It is spotted at the Port of Arinaga in Gran Canaria, Spain, June 7, 2022.

text: Picture taken June 7, 2022.
english: Picture taken June 7, 2022.

english: REUTERS/Borja Suarez)

text: Liwat nga nalakip ang Pilipinas sa listahan sang 10 worst countries para sa mga trabahante suno sa 2024 Global Rights Index nga ginpagwa sang International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC).
english: The Philippines has once again been included in the list of 10 worst countries for workers according to the 2024 Global Rights Index released by the International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC).

text: Ini na ang ikasiyam nga sunod-sunod nga tuig nga nalakip ang Pilipinas sa listahan sang mga pungsod nga may kalabanan nga paglapas sa mga kinamatarong sang mga trabahador, suno sa mga grupo pareho sang Kilusang Mayo Uno, Unyon ng mga Manggagawa sa Agrikultura, National Federation of Sugar Workers, Alliance of Concerned Teachers, Kilusan ng Manggagawang Kababaihan, Confederation for Unity, Recognition and Advancement of Government Employees, Public Services Labor Independent Confederation, Bukluran ng Manggagawang Pilipino (BMP), Migrante Philippines, kag Center for Trade Union and Human Rights.
english: This is the ninth consecutive year that the Philippines has been included in the list of countries with the most violations of workers' rights, according to groups such as Kilusang Mayo Uno, Union ng mga Manggagawa sa Agrikultura, National Federation of Sugar Workers, Alliance of Concerned Teachers, Kilusang Mango Confederation Unity, Recognition and Advancement of Government Employees, Public Services Labor Independent Confederation, Bukluran ng Manggagawang Pilipino (BMP), Migrante Philippines, and Center for Trade Union and Human Rights.

text: Nalakip man sa listahan amo ang Bangladesh, Belarus, Ecuador, Egypt, Eswatini, Myanmar, Nigeria, Tunisia, kag Turkey.
english: Also on the list are Bangladesh, Belarus, Ecuador, Egypt, Eswatini, Myanmar, Nigeria, Tunisia, and Turkey.

text: Ang pinakadamo nga kaso sang paglapas sa Pilipinas amo ang karapatang magwelga (87%), ginasundan sang paglapas sa collective bargaining (80%), katungdanan sa pagpatukod kag pagsulod sa unyon (75%), kag hustisya (72%).
english: The most common violation cases in the Philippines are the right to strike (87%), followed by violations of collective bargaining (80%), duty to form and join a union (75%), and justice (72%).

text: Nagsumiter na naman sang ikapito nga batch sang ebidensya ang International Criminal Court (ICC) batok kay anay President Rorigo Duterte sa ginapangatubang nga kaso sang crimes against humanity bangud sa iya kontrobersyal nga kampanya kontra droga.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has submitted a seventh batch of evidence against former President Rorigo Duterte in the case of crimes against humanity over his controversial anti-drug campaign.

text: Sang Mayo 30, nagsumite ang mga piskal sang dugang nga 129 ka dokumento nga nagdala sang kabug-usan nga ebidensya nga nasumiter sa 396 umpisa sang magsugod ang opisyal nga disclosure phase sang Abril 30.
english: On May 30, prosecutors submitted an additional 129 documents bringing the total evidence submitted to 396 since the official disclosure phase began on April 30.

text: Suno kay ICC Prosecutor Karim Khan, bisan temporaryo siya nga naka-leave bangud sa ginapangatubang man nga imbestigasyon batok sa iya, padayon ang operasyon sang opisina niya.
english: ICC Prosecutor Karim Khan said that although he is on temporary leave due to the investigation against him, his office continues to operate.

text: Ginklaro man sang prosecution nga kapin 130,000 ka mga dokumento ang yara subong sa ila relativity database, kag kada isa sini kinahanglan mag-agi sa legal nga proseso antes pormal nga isumite sa korte.
english: The prosecution also clarified that more than 130,000 documents are currently in its relativity database, and each of these needs to go through a legal process before being formally submitted to the court.

text: Gin-set ang deadline sang prosecution tubtob Hulyo 1 agud makumpleto ang pagsumiter sang tanan nga ebidensya.
english: The prosecution has set a deadline of July 1 to complete the submission of all evidence.

text: Ini nga preparasyon ang kabahin sang ginaplano nga hearing sa Setyembre 23.
english: This preparation is part of the planned hearing on September 23.

text: Madumduman nga gin-aresto si Duterte sang Marso 11, bangud sa ginapahayag nga libo-libo nga extrajudicial killings nga natabo sa iya kampanya kontra droga.
english: Duterte was arrested on March 11 for allegedly thousands of extrajudicial killings during his anti-drug campaign.

text: Suno sa mga human rights groups, masobra 30,000 ka tawo ang ginapatay sa nasambit nga kampanya.
english: According to human rights groups, more than 30,000 people are being killed in the campaign.

text: Subong, yara si Duterte sa ICC detention facility sa The Hague, samtang ginapadayon ang proseso sang kaso.
english: Duterte is currently in the ICC detention facility in The Hague, while the case continues.

text: Ginkilala sang Philippine National Police (PNP) ang Muslim Community bilang kabahin sang pagmentinar sang kalinong kag pag-uswag kadungan sang selebrasyon sang Eid’l Adha.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) recognized the Muslim Community as part of maintaining peace and development during the celebration of Eid'l Adha.

text: Ginhatagan pagtamod sang PNP ang importante nga papel sang pagtuo kag pagkamapainubuson nga amo ang sadsaran nga kalidad sang Islam kag nagapakita man sang espiritu sang pagka-Pilipino.
english: The PNP emphasized the important role of faith and humility which are fundamental qualities of Islam and also reflect the spirit of Filipino identity.

text: Ginkilala man sang organisasyon ang papel sang Muslim Community sa pagmentinar sang kalinungan kag bisan sa nation-building nga amo ang pundasyon kag umpisa sang pag-asenso sang mas developed nga Pilipinas.
english: The organization also recognized the role of the Muslim Community in maintaining peace and even in nation-building which is the foundation and beginning of the advancement of a more developed Philippines.

text: Kasunod sini, ginpasalig sang PNP nga padayon sila nga magatindog nga malig-on sa pagmentinar sang kalinong kag katawhay sang pumuluyong Pilipino.
english: Following this, the PNP assured that they will continue to stand firm in maintaining the peace and order of the Filipino people.

text: Samtang, padayon naman ang pagduso sang PNP sang kalinong, paghiliusa kag paghangpanay sa nagkalain-lain nga sektor sang katilingban ano man ang ila relihiyon.
english: Meanwhile, the PNP continues to promote peace, unity and understanding among various sectors of society regardless of their religion.

text: Samtang, ang Office of Civil Defense (OCD) sa pagpanguna ni Defense Sec.
english: Meanwhile, the Office of Civil Defense (OCD) led by Defense Sec.

text: Si Gilberto Teodoro naga-upod man sa selebrasyon sang Eid’l Adha.
english: Gilberto Teodoro also joins the celebration of Eid’l Adha.

text: Ginpalab-ot sang secretary ang iya panamyaw sa mga Muslim Communities sa pungsod bilang pagdumdom sang Feast of Sacrifice sa Islam.
english: The secretary extended his greetings to the Muslim Communities in the country in commemoration of the Feast of Sacrifice in Islam.

text: Nag-ululupod ang law enforcement officials halin sa Ukraine, European Union, kag United States agud magbukas sang international center agud mag-establisar sang mga kaso batok sa pagpang-atake sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: Law enforcement officials from Ukraine, the European Union, and the United States have joined forces to open an international center to establish cases against Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.

text: Ini ang ginatawag International Centre for the Prosecution of the Crime of Aggression nga naka-base sa The Hague sa Netherlands kun sa diin yara man ang International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: It is called the International Center for the Prosecution of the Crime of Aggression based in The Hague in the Netherlands where the International Criminal Court (ICC) is also located.

text: Suno sa Ukrainian top prosecutor nga si Andriy Kostin, ini nga bag-o nga center ang magatipon sang mga ebidensya sa posible ikaso batok sa Russian military kag political leaders nga responsable sa away sa Ukraine.
english: According to Ukrainian top prosecutor Andriy Kostin, this new center will gather evidence in possible prosecution against Russian military and political leaders responsible for the conflict in Ukraine.

text: Suportado ini sang European Union, United States, kag Joint Investigation Team for Ukraine, kag ini ang mangin forerunner sang special tribunal para sa pagpang-atake kag maka-file sang kaso nga mahimo mapasaka sa korte.
english: It is supported by the European Union, the United States, and the Joint Investigation Team for Ukraine, and it will be the forerunner of the special tribunal for the attack and will be able to file a case that could be brought to court.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa subong, gina-review na sang Ukrainian authorities ang masobra 93,000 ka reports sang war crimes kag naka-file na sang kaso sa 207 ka mga suspek sa domestic courts.
english: Ukrainian authorities are currently reviewing more than 93,000 reports of war crimes and have filed cases against 207 suspects in domestic courts.

text: Wala sang papel si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. has no role.

text: sa impeachment case batuk kay Vice President Sara Duterte suno kay Senate Minority Leader Koko Pimentel.
english: in the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte, according to Senate Minority Leader Koko Pimentel.

text: Ini bangud wala sang kinalain ang presidente kay VP Sara, nga pwede man mapahalin sa pwesto base sa Konstitusyon.
english: This is because the president is no different from VP Sara, who can also be removed from office based on the Constitution.

text: Suno kay Pimentel, indi na importante ang panindugan ni President Marcos sa circulating draft Senate Resolution nga ibasura ang trial batuk sa bise presidente sang pungsod.
english: Pimentel said President Marcos' position on the circulating draft Senate Resolution to dismiss the trial against the country's vice president is no longer important.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpanindugan ni Pimentel nga daku nga sala ang pagbasura sa kaso nga impeachment batuk kay Duterte.
english: On the other hand, Pimentel insisted that it is a big mistake to dismiss the impeachment case against Duterte.

text: Ginsiling sini nga base sa Konstitusyon, kinahanglan nga gilayon nga ipatigayon sang Senado ang pagbista sa isa ka impeachable official.
english: He said that based on the Constitution, the Senate must immediately conduct a trial of an impeachable official.

text: Ginsiling sini nga wala na sang mahimo ang Senado kundi magpatigayon sang impeachment trial batok kay VP Sara.
english: He said the Senate has no choice but to conduct an impeachment trial against VP Sara.

text: Amo gani nga nagapati si Pimentel nga sarang mabalhin halin sa ika-19 nga kongreso pakadto sa ika-20 nga kongreso ang impeachment proceedings batok sa bise presidente.
english: That's why Pimentel believes that the impeachment proceedings against the vice president can be moved from the 19th congress to the 20th congress.

text: Ano ang paminsaron kag batyagon mo kun pahilabtan kag ihaboy sang iban nga mga tawo ang bagay nga ginahalungan kag ginapabaloran?
english: How would you think and feel if other people touched and threw away something you cherished and valued?

text: Mahimo nga maakig ka gid ukon magpanukot, apang ano abi kun si Nanay mo ang nakahimo sini?
english: You may become very angry or demanding, but what if your mother did this?

text: Amo ini ang natabo sa isa ka 20-anyos nga soltero sa Taiwan nga mahilig gid sa paghupot sang mga komiks.
english: This is what happened to a 20-year-old young man in Taiwan who loved to keep comic books.

text: Nagapuyo ang lalaki kaupod sa iya 64-anyos nga iloy sa Chiayi City, Taiwan.
english: The man lives with his 64-year-old mother in Chiayi City, Taiwan.

text: Natak-an na ang nanay bangud nga naga-damo nga naga-damo ang comic collection sang iya anak, kag pamatyagan niya naga-gutok na ang ila balay.
english: The mother is tired of her son's growing comic collection, and she feels that their house is getting crowded.

text: Isa ka adlaw, samtang nagapanglimpyo ang iloy, nakit-an sini ang 32-volume nga “Attack on Titan” manga collection sang iya bata.
english: One day, while the mother was cleaning, she found her son’s 32-volume “Attack on Titan” manga collection.

text: Nanotisyaran sini nga daw daan na kag medyo basa pa ang mga libro gani nag-mato-mato siya nga i-recycle ini kag ihaboy ang iban para nga magligwa na.
english: He noticed that the books looked old and a little wet so he decided to recycle them and throw away the others to get rid of them.

text: Wala na siya nagpamangkot sa iya bata kun okay lang, gani nga sang nag-abot ang bata, amo na lang ang kaakig sini sa iya nanay.
english: She didn't ask her son if he was okay, so when the son arrived, he was so angry with his mother.

text: Sa sobra niya nga kalain sang buot, nagpatawag pa siya sang pulis.
english: He was so angry that he called the police.

text: Sang ulihi, indi pa gid madala sa istorya ang bata, kag ginpasaka pa gid sini sa korte ang reklamo bangud suno sa iya, ginguba ang iya propiedad nga wala sang pahanugot halin sa iya.
english: Later, the child could not be brought into the story, and he filed a complaint in court because, according to him, his property was destroyed without his permission.

text: Base sa argumento sang bata, ang “Attack on Titan” ang isa ka tuman ka popular nga manga gani pat-od nga mabudlay na makapangita sang kumpleto nga collection bangud wala na gani sang print sang 32 volumes bangud makabig na ini nga collector s items.
english: Based on the child's argument, “Attack on Titan” is a very popular manga so it will be difficult to find a complete collection because there is no print of the 32 volumes because they are considered collector s items.

text: Nagrason man ang nanay nga medyo basa naman ang manga volumes kag nagapagutok lang sa ila balay.
english: The mother also argued that the volumes were a bit wet and were just crowding their house.
