text: Nagpahayag pa ini nga kun pwede, istoryahan na lang nila ini nga duha apang nagpamalibad ang bata.
english: He said that if possible, they would just talk to the two but the child refused.

text: Pebrero pa natabo ang insidente apang subong lamang nagpaguwa sang desisyon ang Chiayi District Court.
english: The incident occurred in February but the Chiayi District Court issued its decision only now.

text: Ginmultahan ang nanay sang 5,000 Taiwanese dollars ($160 ukon masobra P8,900) bangud sa property damage.
english: The mother was fined 5,000 Taiwanese dollars ($160 or more than P8,900) for property damage.

text: Ini nga sentensya ang mahimo ma-commute sa community service.
english: This sentence is commutable to community service.

text: Suno sa korte, indi husto nga wala sini gintahod ang property rights sang iya bata.
english: According to the court, it was wrong that he did not respect his son's property rights.

text: Ang malala suno pa sa Taiwanese media, tubtub subong, nagalain gihapon ang buot sang bata kag wala ini sang gana nga magpakig-istorya sa iya iloy matapos ang ginhimo sini sa iya paborito nga manga collection.#
english: Worse, according to Taiwanese media, the child is still upset and does not want to talk to his mother after what she did to his favorite manga collection.

text: Puno sang excitement kag kalipay nga gin-abi-abi sang fans kag Miss Grand International (MGI) officials ang Filipina beauty queen nga si Christine Juliane “CJ” Opiaza sa iya pag-abot sa Thailand.
english: Filipina beauty queen Christine Juliane “CJ” Opiaza was greeted with excitement and joy by fans and Miss Grand International (MGI) officials on her arrival in Thailand.

text: Lakip sa MGI officials nga nag-welcome sa iya amo ang big boss sa organisasyon nga si Nawat Itsaragrisil.
english: Among the MGI officials who welcomed him was big boss of the organization Nawat Itsaragrisil.

text: Subong na adlaw, Hunyo 3, natalana ang opisyal nga koronasyon kay CJ bilang titleholder sa 2024 edition matapos ang natabo nga kontrobersiya sa anay gindeklarar nga winner nga si Rachel Gupta sang India.
english: Today, June 3, CJ is scheduled to be officially coronated as the titleholder of the 2024 edition after the controversy over the former declared winner Rachel Gupta of India.

text: Isa ka season pageant girl ukon kontisera si CJ halin sa Zambales nga kilala sa iya matahum nga pasarela kag nagbulig man sa paghanas sa iban nga beauty queens sa Pilipinas.
english: CJ is a season pageant girl from Zambales who is known for her beautiful catwalk and has also helped train other beauty queens in the Philippines.

text: Base sa gin-anunsyo sang MGI organization, alas tres karon sa hapon ang ‘crowning ceremony’ sa MGI Hall of Bravo BKK sa Bangkok.
english: Based on the announcement of the MGI organization, the crowning ceremony will be held at 3 pm today at the MGI Hall of Bravo BKK in Bangkok.

text: Ini ang una nga golden crown sang Pilipinas matapos ang first runner-up finish nanday Nicole Cordoves kag Samantha Bernardo sang 2016 kag 2020.
english: This is the Philippines' first golden crown after Nicole Cordoves and Samantha Bernardo's first runner-up finishes in 2016 and 2020.

text: Ginpili sang beterano nga point guard nga si Chris Paul nga magbalik sa Los Angeles Clippers para sa ginapanan-aw nga katapusan sini nga season sa National Basketball Association (NBA).
english: Veteran point guard Chris Paul has chosen to return to the Los Angeles Clippers for what is expected to be the end of this season in the National Basketball Association (NBA).

text: Suno kay Lawrence Frank, president sang basketball operations sang Clippers, nagsugtanay ang team kag si CP3 sa minimum deal nga $3.6 million ukon P205.36-million.
english: According to Lawrence Frank, president of basketball operations of the Clippers, the team and CP3 agreed on a minimum deal of $3.6 million or P205.36-million.

text: Antes ang desisyon, lakip sa nagpangaluyag sa 40-anyos nga guard amo ang Milwaukee Bucks, Charlotte Hornets, kag Dallas Mavericks.
english: Before the decision, among those interested in the 40-year-old guard were the Milwaukee Bucks, Charlotte Hornets, and Dallas Mavericks.

text: Matandaan nga halin si Paul sa San Antonio Spurs sang nagligad nga season kag nakahampang sang 82 games.
english: Paul came from the San Antonio Spurs last season and played 82 games.

text: Siya ang una nga player sa NBA history nga nakahampang sang 82 games sa isa lang ka season sa iya 20th season ukon mas madugay pa.
english: He is the first player in NBA history to play 82 games in a single season in his 20th season or longer.

text: Sa pagbalik sang 12-time All-Star sa Los Angeles, magahampang siya sa iya 21st season nga mas malapit sa iya pamilya.
english: With the 12-time All-Star returning to Los Angeles, he will play his 21st season closer to his family.

text: Matandaan nga anum ka seasons siya nga naghampang anay sa amo nga franchise (2011-12 tubtub 2016-17) kun sa diin siya nangin five-time All-Star.
english: He played for the franchise for six seasons (2011-12 to 2016-17) where he became a five-time All-Star.

text: Naga-uyat siya sang record nga 4,023 assists sa Clippers nga amo ang pinakamataas sa franchise history.
english: He holds a record of 4,023 assists with the Clippers which is the most in franchise history.

text: Siya man ang latest veteran addition sa Clippers matapos nakuha man ang shooting guard nga si Bradley Beal, power forward nga si John Collins kag center nga si Brook Lopez sa offseason.
english: He is also the latest veteran addition to the Clippers after also acquiring shooting guard Bradley Beal, power forward John Collins and center Brook Lopez in the offseason.

text: Maswerte nga nakaluwas ang isa ka 22-anyos nga delivery rider matapos naglumpat  sa suba sa Valenzuela City.
english: A 22-year-old delivery rider was lucky enough to survive after jumping into a river in Valenzuela City.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, gin-akigan ini sang iya iloy kag wala ginhatagan sang kwarta gani nagsunggod.
english: According to reports, his mother was angry with him and did not give him money.

text: Sunod ini nga nagkadto sa suba kag naglumpat.
english: Next it went to the river and jumped.

text: Madasig naman nga nagpangayo sang bulig ang mga tawo nga nakakita sa iya kag natigayon gilayon nga ma-rescue.
english: People who saw him quickly called for help and were immediately rescued.

text:
PINAKAMASAKIT na seguro sa palamatin-an sang aton kubos nga mga pumuluyo ang panugdaon sang katulad nila, nga nangin biktima sang Inhustisya, nga “Ang kasuguan sa Filipinas para lang gali sa manggaranon kag poderoso (lakip ang abusado nga gobyerno).”

Labi na gid kay nagakatabo ini sa pagpuyo naton sa karon sa Hilway kag Demokrasyahanon nga pungsod, kon diin nagapasalig mismo ang aton 1987 Constitution sa pagpatuman sang kaayuhan sang tanan (common good) kag patas nga kinamatarong sa idalom sang Bill of Rights.
english:
IT IS probably the most painful thing for our poor people to hear the suggestion of those like them, who have been victims of injustice, that “The law in the Philippines is only for the rich and powerful (including the abusive government).”

Especially since this is happening in a free and democratic country, where our 1987 Constitution itself promises to implement the common good and equal rights under the Bill of Rights.

text: Gin-explicar ining problema sang isa naton ka pumuluyo sa kaso sang isa ka tin-edyer sa Manila nga suspetsado pa lang sa pagbaligya sang droga.
english: One of our residents explained this problem in the case of a teenager in Manila who was just suspected of selling drugs.

text: Gindakop ini, gin-kastigo kag ginluthang patay sang mga trigger-happy nga mga pulis bisan wala ini sang dala sing ano man nga armas.
english: He was arrested, beaten and shot dead by trigger-happy police even though he was not carrying any weapon.

text: Balibad lang nga nagbatu.
english: Just refused to resist.

text: Sang ano?
english: Of what?

text: Sang iya tudlo?
english: Of his finger?

text: Sa aton mismo 1987 Constitution, nga gindaug naton sa Edsa Revolution batok sa mapintas nga rehimen ni Diktador Marcos, ginakilala nga inosente ang sin-o man nga akusado sang krimen tubtub mapamatud-an gid nga “guilty” sa husgado.
english: In our own 1987 Constitution, which we won in the Edsa Revolution against the brutal regime of Dictator Marcos, anyone accused of a crime is recognized as innocent until proven guilty in court.

text:
***

Ining panugdaon sa ibabaw batok sa patas nga kasuguan, nangin ordinaryo na lang gani nga panugdaon sang madamo batok sa mapintas nga Drug War ni Presidente Duterte, kon diin sa sobra 10,000 na nga napatay sa Drug War isa gid lang ang napasakaan sing kaso.
english:
***

This above suggestion against equal law, has become an ordinary suggestion of many against President Duterte's brutal Drug War, where out of more than 10,000 people who have died in the Drug War, only one has been prosecuted.

text: Ginpasakaan na gani siya sang “crimes against humanity” sa International Criminal Court.
english: He has even been charged with “crimes against humanity” at the International Criminal Court.

text: Samtang sige man ang iya sugo sing “kill!
english: While he kept ordering “kill!

text: Kill!
english: Kill!

text: Kill!” Ginhangop ini sang mga bobo nga mga pulis nga makapagusto na sila sa pagpamatay sang mga suspetsado (lakip na ang nakursunadahan lang).
english: Kill!” The stupid policemen understood that they could kill suspects (including those who were just in love).

text: Labi na gid kay ginpasalig man niya sila nga tagaan sing “pardon” kon madutlan sa mga kaso batok sa ila.
english: Especially since he also assured them that they would be given “pardon” if they were caught in the cases against them.

text: Pamahog lang kuno ini kag indi gid intensyon ni Presidente nga pamatyon lang ang mga supetsado bisan wala sing “due process” ukon bagay nga procedimiento sa kasuguan.
english: He said this is just a threat and it is not the intention of the President to kill the suspects even if there is no “due process” or appropriate procedure in the law.

text: Ayhan?
english: Perhaps?

text: Ukon ga-enjoy gid man siya magpamatay katulad sang akusasyon sa iya sang pila nga naggwa nga mga testigo sa nagkatabo sa Davao City kon diin meyor pa lang siya?
english: Or does he really enjoy killing as some witnesses accused him of in the incident in Davao City where he was still mayor?

text:
***

In fact, mga 61 na ka abogado ang ginpamatay man sugod sadtong 2016 sang pagpungko na ni Presidente Duterte, nga ang suspetso ang sugo mismo ni Presidente.
english:
***

In fact, about 61 lawyers have been killed since 2016 when President Duterte took office, suspected of being ordered by the President himself.

text: Mas madamo ini sangsa ginpamatay nga mga abogado sa panahon sang anom (6) ka administrasyon nga nagligad.
english: This is more than the number of lawyers killed during the previous six (6) administrations.

text: Madamo sini sa ila ang may kaso angot sa ilegal nga droga kag tungod sa  “red tag” angot sa suspetso nga may kaangtanan sila sa  mga rebelde.
english: Many of them have cases related to illegal drugs and because of the “red tag” on suspicion of having links with the rebels.

text: Sunu sa ila, ugaling, ina tungod indi nila mabalibaran ang obligasyon sang abogado nga pangapinan ang sin-o man sa ila kinamatarong sa isa ka “fair trial”, nga dapat naintiendihan tani ni Presidente kay isa man siya ka abogado.
english: According to them, however, that is because they cannot deny the obligation of a lawyer to defend anyone in their rights in a “fair trial”, which the President should have understood because he is a lawyer.

text:
***

Problema pa gid kay indi gali naton soldado ang AFP kag PNP.
english:
***

The problem is that the AFP and PNP are not our soldiers.

text: Siling ni Presidente nga ang mga soldado – lakip na ang mga pulis nga gintagaan niya sing ranggo sang mga soldado – iya lang soldado ang mga ini.
english: The President said that the soldiers – including the policemen whom he gave the rank of soldiers – are his only soldiers.

text: Tinawag niya ini sila nga “My soldiers!” kag indi “Our soldiers!” ukon soldado sang mga pumuluyo.
english: He called them “My soldiers!” and not “Our soldiers!” or soldier of the people.

text: Amo gani seguro nga balewala sa mga pulis ang kinamatarong sa “due process” sang mga suspetsado nga pumuluyo, kag kon ano lang ang  ginasugo ni Presidente Duterte ang ila ginasunod, labi na gid ang angot sa iya sugo nga “Kill!
english: That's probably why the police ignore the right to due process of suspected citizens, and follow only what President Duterte orders, especially regarding his order to “Kill!

text: Kill!
english: Kill!

text:
Kill!”

Ang pensar ko iya sang aton mga pumuluyo ang mga soldado, kag indi kay Presidente Duterte lang!
english:
Kill!”

I think the soldiers belong to our people, and not just to President Duterte!

text: Kon soldado lang sila ni Presidente Duterte, kontra man nila ang mga kontra ni Presidente, lakip na ang mga kontra niya sa pulitika kag bisan ang mga ordinaryo nga pumuluyo nga naga-kritikar sa iya.
english: If they are only soldiers of President Duterte, they are also against the President's opponents, including his political opponents and even the ordinary people who criticize him.

text: Aba, makahaladlok nga kamatuoran ina!
english: Alas, that is a terrible truth!

text: Basi ang dalaganan na gid lang sang mga pumuluyo amo ang NPA kon may problema sila sa Inhustisya.
english: Maybe the people will run to the NPA when they have a problem with injustice.

text: Dapat athagon ni Presidente Duterte ang ining pagtawag niya sa mga soldado kag mga pulis naton nga “My soldiers” agud indi kita mang-alag-ag sa pagpangayo sing bulig sa ila, labi na gid ang naga-kritikar sa Presidente sang ila lehitimo nga mga reklamo.
english: President Duterte should clarify his calling our soldiers and policemen “My soldiers” so that we do not hesitate to ask for help from them, especially those who criticize the President for their legitimate complaints.

text: Tani makabaton kita sing bisan gamay man lang nga panugdaon angot diri sa pila naton ka mga abyan sa kapulisan.
english: I hope we can get some advice on this from some of our friends in the police.

text: Ano abe sa imo, Ma’am Sheila?
english: What do you think, Ma’am Sheila?

text: Nahibal-an mo man seguro ang email address ko./PN
english: You probably know my email address./PN

text: Gintay-oy sang magnitude 6.6 nga linog ang rehiyon sang Taiwan kahapon sang kagab-i, suno sa Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology ukon PHIVOLCS.
english: A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck the Taiwan region last night, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS).

text: Natabo ang linog PASADO alas-11:05 sang gab-i kun sa diin narecord sa 429 kilometer north-northwest sang Itbayat, Batanes, nga may kadalumon nga 68 kilometer.
english: The quake occurred around 11:05 pm and was recorded at 429 kilometers north-northwest of Itbayat, Batanes, with a depth of 68 kilometers.

text: Na-record naman sa Basco, Batanes ang paglinog nga may Intensity I, ang pinakamanubo nga lebel sa PHIVOLCS Earthquake Intensity Scale, nga nagakahulugan nga mahinay ini kag halos indi nabatyagan.
english: The quake was recorded in Basco, Batanes with Intensity I, the lowest level on the PHIVOLCS Earthquake Intensity Scale, which means it was slow and barely felt.

text: Nagpasalig naman ang PHIVOLCS nga wala sang tsunami threat kag luwas ang mga baybayon sang Pilipinas sa posibilidad sang Tunami.
english: PHIVOLCS assured that there is no tsunami threat and the Philippine coasts are safe from the possibility of a tsunami.

text: Maga-isyu ang Commission on Elections (Comelec) sang motu proprio show-cause order batok sa first nominee sang Duterte Youth.
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) will issue a motu proprio show-cause order against the first nominee of the Duterte Youth.

text: Suno kay Comelec chairperson George Erwin Garcia, suguon sang Law Department si Drixie Mae Cardema nga magsabat sa alegasyon nga naggamit ini sang lain nga apelyido sa iya nga Certificate of Acceptance of Nomination (CONA) sa 2025 elections.
english: According to Comelec chairperson George Erwin Garcia, the Law Department will order Drixie Mae Cardema to respond to the allegation that she used a different surname in her Certificate of Acceptance of Nomination (CONA) in the 2025 elections.

text: Sandig ini sa reports sa social media nga ang full name sini amo ang “Drixie Mae Suarez” kag indi Cardema.
english: This is based on reports on social media that her full name is “Drixie Mae Suarez” and not Cardema.

text: Ginklaro ni Garcia nga indi maapektuhan sang kaso ang nomination kag possible proclamation ni Drixie bangud wala man sang formal petition nga napasaka para ikanselar ang iya nominasyon.
english: Garcia clarified that the case will not affect the nomination and possible proclamation of Drixie because there is no formal petition filed to cancel his nomination.

text: Apang suno pa sa iya, ginasumpaan ang CONA nga ginapasa gani nga kun may gindeklarar diri nga indi matuod, makabig ini nga perjury kag election offense.
english: However, he said, the CONA is sworn to be passed so if anything is declared false, it is considered perjury and election offense.

text: “Ang Law Department namin ay kumilos na sa allegations and any moment from now, ang nominee ng Duterte Youth ay maaaring makatanggap ng SCO dahil sa allegations ng paggamit ng ibang family name,” suno sa chairperson sang poll body.
english: “Our Law Department is already acting on the allegations and any moment from now, the nominee of Duterte Youth will be able to receive an SCO because of the allegations of using other family names,” said the chairperson of the poll body.

text:
“Maganda yun para kahit paano mapasagot ang naturang first nominee dahil napaka-unfair din naman sa kanya na inaakusahan sya ng kung ano-ano sa social media.”

Dugang sini: “Ang isang kandidato pag nag-submit sa Comelec, ang lahat ng sina-submit nya katulad ng certificate of candidacy ay under oath.
english:
“It's good to somehow answer the first nominee because it's very unfair to him that he's being accused of something on social media.”

He added: “When a candidate submits to the Comelec, everything he submits such as the certificate of candidacy is under oath.

text: Pinanumpaan yan at therefore, kapag hindi ka nagsabi ng totoo, perjury yan and election offense.
english: It's sworn and therefore, if you don't tell the truth, it's perjury and election offense.

text:
Kaya gusto natin alamin din, kaya ang kumikilos ng motu proprio ay ang Law Department.”

Matandaan nga nagpangaduha ang Duterte Yourth sa eleksyon sang party-list matapos nakakuha sang 2.3 million votes; apang ginpa-iway anay sang Comelec ukon sang National Board of Canvassers ang proklamasyon sa grupo bangud sang ila pending nga mga kaso.
english:
So we want to know too, so the one who acts motu proprio is the Law Department.”

It can be recalled that Duterte Yourth came second in the party-list election after getting 2.3 million votes; but the Comelec or the National Board of Canvassers postponed the proclamation to the group due to their pending cases.

text: Nagbuylog ang Iloilo Provincial Government sa nationwide nga Earth Hour agud mapasangkad ang ihibalo sang mga Ilonggo sa climate change.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government joined the nationwide Earth Hour to raise awareness among Ilonggos on climate change.

text: Ang kahiwatan ang ginhiwat sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol.
english: The event was held at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol.

text: Isa sa nangin dinapit nga bisita amo si Iloilo Provincial Environmental and Natural Resources Office (PENRO) Head Atty. Cesar Emmanuelle Buyco Jr.
english: One of the invited guests was Iloilo Provincial Environmental and Natural Resources Office (PENRO) Head Atty. Cesar Emmanuelle Buyco Jr.

text: Sa iya mensahe, ginpunto sini ang importansya sang Earth Hour, kon sa diin, isa ka dako nga palaagyan agud makabulig sa planeta ilabi na nga naga-eksperyensya ang kalibutan sang tuman nga pag-init.
english: In his message, he pointed out the importance of Earth Hour, which is a great way to help the planet especially as the world is experiencing extreme warming.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga sugod sang 2024, yara na sa 116,273 hours ang napatigayon Ligum Dulom ukon Earth Hour sa pungsod.
english: He also said that starting in 2024, there will be 116,273 hours of Ligum Dulom or Earth Hour in the country.

text: Lakip sa kahiwatan amo ang aktibidad nga Zumba for the Earth nga naghatag man sang kalingawan sa kadam-an.
english: The event included the Zumba for the Earth activity which also entertained the crowd.

text: Nagpakigbahin man sang talento ang Pughanan Rondalla paagi sa acoustic jamming.
english: Pughanan Rondalla also shared their talents through acoustic jamming.

text: Naglawig sugod alas-8:30 tubtob alas-9:30 ang Earth Hour nga ginbuylugan sang nagkalain-lain nga organisasyon sa Iloilo.
english: The Earth Hour lasted from 8:30 to 9:30 and was joined by various organizations in Iloilo.

text: Nagtambong man ang Metro Iloilo Water District (MIWD) sa ginpatigayon nga Earth Hour sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol.
english: The Metro Iloilo Water District (MIWD) also attended the Earth Hour held at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol.

text: Suno kay Mr. Alfredo Tayo, General Manager sang MIWD, iya ginpahayag nga ang isa ka oras nga pagpatay sang mga suga ang dako nga bulig para sa kalibutan.
english: According to Mr. Alfredo Tayo, General Manager of MIWD, said the one-hour power outage is a big help for the world.

text: Dugang sini nga ang tikang ang isa man ka paagi agud nga mabuhinan ang paggamit sang fossil fuel sa electric power.
english: He added that the move is also a way to reduce the use of fossil fuels in electric power.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang tuman sang paggamit sang fossil fuel ang makapatunaw man sang glaciers sang kalibutan.
english: He also said that the excessive use of fossil fuels could also melt the world's glaciers.

text: Ini ang nagatuga man sang pagtaas sang lebel sang tubig sa bilog nga kalibutan nga nagaapekto sa minilyon ka mga pumuluyo nga yara sa coastal areas.
english: This is also causing water levels to rise around the world affecting millions of people in coastal areas.

text: Wala sang pangatubangon nga kaso kriminal ang American rapper nga si Travis Scott apisar nga 10 ka tawo ang napatay sa iya concert sa Texas sa Estados Unidos sang Nobyembre 2021.
english: American rapper Travis Scott is not facing any criminal charges despite the fact that 10 people were killed at his concert in Texas in the United States in November 2021.

text: Madumduman nga 50,000 ka mga tawo ang naggilinutok sa NRG Park sa Houston para sa Astroworld music festival sang amo nga tuig sang hinali lang nagdis-uganay ang mga tawo sa entablado sang naga-perform na ang rapper.
english: It can be recalled that 50,000 people packed NRG Park in Houston for the Astroworld music festival that year when the rapper suddenly started fighting on stage.

text: Bangud kulang ang hangin kag espasyo, ginatos ang na-samaran, may mga nagkalalipong, kag 10 ang patay lakip na ang siyam ka tuig nga bata.
english: Due to lack of air and space, hundreds were injured, some fainted, and 10 died including a nine-year-old child.

text: Apisar sang mga nagpakitluoy kag nagpangayo sang tabang, nadugayan pa antes nadesisyunan sang organizers nga untaton ang music kag mag-evacuate sa area.
english: Despite pleas and pleas for help, it took a long time before the organizers decided to stop the music and evacuate the area.

text: Suno sa Houston grand jury, masubo man nga may 10 ka kabuhi nga nadula samtang naga-enjoy lang kuntani sa musika kag entertainment; apang suno sa korte, indi man tanan nga trahedya makabig nga krimen, kag indi tanan nga kamatayon, makabig nga homicide.
english: According to the Houston grand jury, it is also sad that 10 lives were lost while enjoying music and entertainment; but according to the court, not every tragedy can be considered a crime, and not every death, can be considered a homicide.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes ang desisyon, sampaw sampaw nga kaso ang ginpasaka batok sa Astroworld festival organizers bangud sa kapalpakan nga siguruhon ang safety sang concertgoers.
english: Before the decision, multiple cases were filed against the Astroworld festival organizers for failing to ensure the safety of concertgoers.

text: Ang ruling sang korte amo lamang ang para sa criminal proceedings, samtang mahimo nga mapadayon ang civil lawsuits.
english: The court’s ruling is only for criminal proceedings, while civil lawsuits can be pursued.

text: Gindala na sa Canada ang nagkalabilin nga parte ukon debris sang Titan submersible nga naglupok sang padulong kuntani ini sa naglugdang nga barko nga Titanic.
english: The remains of the Titan submersible that exploded on its way to the Titanic have been brought to Canada.

text: Base sa nakit-an nga video, naputos sa white tarp ang debris kag ginabutong sang crane halin sa Horizon Arctic vessel sa St.
english: According to the video, the debris was wrapped in a white tarp and being lifted by a crane from the Horizon Arctic vessel in St. Petersburg.

text: John’s harbor sa Newfoundland.
english: John’s harbor in Newfoundland.

text: Ini nga debris ang ginalauman nga makabulig sa imbestigasyon kun ngaa naglupok ang amo nga vessel samtang sakay ang lima ka tawo nga amo sanday OceanGate Expeditions CEO Stockton Rush; British billionaire Hamish Harding; Pakistani businessman Shahzada Dawood kag 19-anyos nga anak nga si Suleman; kag French oceanographer nga si Paul-Henri Nargeolet.
english: The debris is expected to help in the investigation into why the vessel exploded while five people were on board, namely OceanGate Expeditions CEO Stockton Rush; British billionaire Hamish Harding; Pakistani businessman Shahzada Dawood and 19-year-old son Suleman; and French oceanographer Paul-Henri Nargeolet.

text: Indi pa subong maathag kun sa diin sunod dal-on ang amo nga debris.
english: It is not yet clear where the debris will be taken next.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Canadian kag US authorities nga gin-umpisahan na ang imbestIgasyon sa amo nga insidente.
english: Earlier, Canadian and US authorities said they had launched an investigation into the incident.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga semana, nakit-an sang robotic diving vehicle ang debris sa kadalumon nga 1,600 ka tapak (488 meters) halin sa bow sang Titanic nga amo ang pagtakop sang lima ka adlaw nga rescue efforts kag amo man ang adlaw sang deklarasyon nga wala sang survivor.
english: Last week, a robotic diving vehicle found the debris at a depth of 1,600 feet (488 meters) from the bow of the Titanic, marking the end of five days of rescue efforts and the day of the declaration of no survivors.

text: Nag-plead nga not guilty sa charges nga illegal possession of explosives sa Manila Regional Trial Court Branch 12 ang ginpahalin nga si anay congressman Arnolfo Teves Jr.
english: Dismissed former congressman Arnolfo Teves Jr. pleaded not guilty to charges of illegal possession of explosives in the Manila Regional Trial Court Branch 12.

text: Ini ang iya una nga arraignment kasunod sang liwat nga pag-aresto sa iya kag pag-deport halin sa Timor Leste sang nagligad nga semana.
english: This is his first arraignment following his re-arrest and deportation from Timor Leste last week.

text: Nag-abot si Teves sa korte kaina sang 7:18 sang aga nga may suksok nga bulletproof vest kag Kevlar helmet, sa idalom sang hugot nga seguridad sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI).
english: Teves arrived in court yesterday at 7:18 am wearing a bulletproof vest and Kevlar helmet, under tight security of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI).

text: Ang arraignment may kaangtanan sa iya kaso sa illegal possession of explosives.
english: The arraignment was related to his illegal possession of explosives case.

text: Ang Branch 12 man ang nagauyat sang isa sa mga murder cases nga ginpasaka batok sa iya.
english: Branch 12 also handles one of the murder cases filed against him.

text: Mas nagainit pa ang istorya sa tunga sang Kamara kag Senado kaangot sa isyu kun madayon ukon indi ang impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The talks between the House and Senate are getting more heated over the issue of whether or not to proceed with the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Natabo ang word war matapos nga gin-isol ni Senate President Chiz Escudero ang pagbasa sang articles of impeachment sa Hunyo 11 sa baylo sang orihinal nga schedule ini nga Hunyo 2.
english: The word war broke out after Senate President Chiz Escudero postponed the reading of the articles of impeachment to June 11 instead of the original schedule of June 2.

text: Apisar may statement si House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga ginatugyan na nila sa Senado ang impeachment case, may iban naman nga mamalidha nga nagpaguwa sang statement nga nagaduso sa upper chamber nga magpadayon na sa trial.
english: Despite House Speaker Martin Romualdez's statement that they are handing over the impeachment case to the Senate, other lawmakers issued a statement urging the upper chamber to proceed with the trial.

text: Ang orihinal nga nag-endorso sang impeachment complaint ang hayagan pa gani nga nagpamangkot kay Escudero kun nahadlok bala ini kay Duterte.
english: The original endorser of the impeachment complaint even openly asked Escudero if he was afraid of Duterte.

text: Sabat naman sang Senate President, daw kaangay nga naanad ang pila ka mga kongresista nga diktahan ang Senado sa kun ano ang gusto nila matabo.
english: The Senate President replied that some congressmen seem to be accustomed to dictating to the Senate what they want to happen.

text: Suno sa iya, kun may mga mamalidha nga sunod-sunuran kay Speaker Romualdez, dapat nila hangpon nga indi ini paghimuon sang Senate.
english: He said that if there are lawmakers who follow Speaker Romualdez, they should understand that the Senate will not do so.

text: “Ang mga kongresista tila nasasanay na diktahan ang Senado kaugnay sa gusto nilang mangyari sa impeachment.
english: “Congressmen seem to be accustomed to dictating to the Senate what they want to happen with impeachment.

text: Pwes, kung trabaho ng ilang mambabatas na maging sunud-sunuran kay Speaker Romualdez na gusto klaro ang impeachment na ito, hindi naming trabaho ‘yan sa Senado,” pahayag ni Escudero, Hunyo 4.
english: So, if it's the job of some lawmakers to be obedient to Speaker Romualdez who wants this impeachment to be clear, it's not our job in the Senate,” Escudero said, June 4.

text: “Hindi ko rin trabaho ‘yan bilang taga-pangulo ng Senado.
english: “It's not my job as Senate president either.

text: Para sa akin, gagampanan namin ang aming tungkulin ayon sa aming paniniwala na tamang proseso na naaayon sa batas,” sabat sini.
english: For me, we will do our duty according to what we believe is the right process in accordance with the law,” he replied.

text: “Noong inupuan nila na mahigit dalawang buwan itong impeachment complaint, may narinig ba sila sa amin?” pagkwestyon man sini sa mga kongresista.
english: “When they sat on the impeachment complaint for more than two months, did they hear from us?” also questioning the congressmen.

text: Himuon ang impeachment trial suno kay Chiz nga santo sa kun ano ang husto nga proseso sa idalom sang layi.
english: Chiz said the impeachment trial will be conducted in accordance with the proper process under the law.

text: Nagsabat naman sa Senate official ang pila ka mga mamalidha lakip na si Manila 2nd District Representative Rolando Valeriano nga nagsiling nga ang iya boto agud iimpeach si Sara sang nagligad nga Pebrero ang indi bangud sa sugo ni Romualdez.
english: Several lawmakers including Manila 2nd District Representative Rolando Valeriano responded to the Senate official who said his vote to impeach Sara last February was not because of Romualdez's order.

text: “My vote on the impeachment is the vote of the second district of Manila.
english: “My vote on the impeachment is the vote of the second district of Manila.

text: That was proven in the last election.
english: That was proven in the last election.

text: I was elected again for a third term,” suno kay Valeriano.
english: I was elected again for a third term,” according to Valeriano.

text: Sabat naman ni Bataan Rep.
english: Bataan Rep.

text: Geraldine Roman, wala sila ginadiktahan sang House Speaker.
english: Geraldine Roman, they are not dictated by the House Speaker.

text: Wala sang basehan ang pahayag sang senate president suno sa iya.
english: The senate president's statement is baseless, he said.

text: Pahayag pa sini, ang panawagan lamang nila amo nga sundon ang Konstitusyon, kag wala man sila nagamando sa Senado kun i-convict nila ukon i-acquit ang bise-president sa impeachment trial.
english: He said their only call is to follow the Constitution, and they do not order the Senate whether to convict or acquit the vice-president in the impeachment trial.

text: “I do not think there is basis for what Senate President Chiz Escudero said,” suno kay Roman.
english: “I do not think there is basis for what Senate President Chiz Escudero said,” according to Roman.

text: Sa statement naman ni Gabriela Representative Arlene Brosas, ginpahayag sini nga wala sila nagasunod-sunod lang sa Speaker, bangud kilala sila sa Makabayan nga may independence.
english: In a statement, Gabriela Representative Arlene Brosas said they are not just following the Speaker, because they are known in Makabayan for having independence.

text: Indi na dapat paglainon pa ang isyu suno kay Brosas, kag sabton na lang ang pamangkot kun san-o ang impeachment trial kag kun ngaa wala pa ini gina-umpisahan.
english: Brosas said the issue should not be complicated, and the question of when the impeachment trial will be held and why it has not yet been started should be answered.

text: “Makabayan is not subservient to the Speaker of the House.
english: “Makabayan is not subservient to the Speaker of the House.

text: We all know that.
english: We all know that.

text: Because Makabayan has independence,” kabahin sang statement ni Brosas.
english: Because Makabayan has independence,” Brosas said in a statement.

text: “Let’s not divert the issue to other matters, just answer the question.
english: “Let’s not divert the issue to other matters, just answer the question.

text: When will the impeachment trial be?
english: When will the impeachment trial be?

text: Why hasn’t it started?”#
english: Why hasn’t it started?”#

text: Nadakpan ang 39-anyos nga vlogger sa ginpatigayon nga cyber patrol sang National Bureau of Investigation sa Oslob, Cebu matapos nga nagpost ini sang altered version sang pahayag ni Presidente Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: The 39-year-old vlogger was arrested in a cyber patrol conducted by the National Bureau of Investigation in Oslob, Cebu after he posted an altered version of President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr.'s statement.

text: Suno kay NBI Cebu Regional Director Atty. Rennan Oliva, ila na-track down ang vlogger matapos nag-viral ang post sini sa social media.
english: According to NBI Cebu Regional Director Atty. Rennan Oliva, they tracked down the vlogger after his post went viral on social media.

text: Mensahe halin sa nadakpan nga vlogger, nagalaum nga patawaron siya sang presidente.
english: Message from the arrested vlogger, hoping the president will pardon him.

text: Magapangatubang ang vlogger sang kaso nga illegal use of publication in relation to cybercrime law nga may sentensya nga pagkapreso sang anum ka bulan tubtub anum ka tuig kag multa nga indi magsobra sa P200,000.
english: The vlogger will face charges of illegal use of publication in relation to cybercrime law with a jail sentence of six months to six years and a fine not exceeding P200,000.

text: Samtang, liwat nga nagpagwa sang paandam si NBI Director Jaime Santiago sa mga vloggers nga nagapalapta sang fake news kag misinformation online.
english: Meanwhile, NBI Director Jaime Santiago once again issued a warning to vloggers who spread fake news and misinformation online.

text: Suno kay NBI Director Santiago, gina-imbestigaran man nila ang iban pa nga mga vlogger.
english: NBI Director Santiago said they are also investigating other vloggers.

text: Ang isa sa ila may 2 ka warrant of arrest para sa libel.
english: One of them had 2 warrants of arrest for libel.

text: Ginabanta 50 ka tawo ang ginpang-detain sang mga pulis sa Turkey kadungan sang tuigan nga Pride March nga ginpatigayon sang LGBT community.
english: About 50 people were detained by police in Turkey during the annual Pride March organized by the LGBT community.

text: Suno pa sa Amnesty International-Turkey office, isa ang nakaangkon sang head injuries sang gin-detain sang otoridad.
english: According to the Amnesty International-Turkey office, one sustained head injuries while being detained by the authorities.

text: Sang ginpatigayon ang pride march sang weekend, nagbutang ang mga pulis sang barikada sa central Taksim Square kag sa Istiklal Avenue nga amo ang tradional nga venue sa Pride march.
english: When the pride march was held over the weekend, police set up barricades at central Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue, the traditional venue for the Pride march.

text: Ginsuspinde man ang operasyon sang pampubliko nga mga salakyan.
english: Public transport operations were also suspended.

text: Indi banned ang homosexuality sa Turkey, apang lapnagon ang pagpakamalaot kag mas nagaistrikto pa ang pagbantay sang mga pulis sa pride marches sa kada tuig.
english: Homosexuality is not banned in Turkey, but it is widely condemned and police surveillance of pride marches is getting stricter every year.

text: Ginpahayag man sang organizers nga ang LGBT amo gid ang target ni President Tayyip Erdogan.
english: The organizers also claimed that LGBT people were actually targeted by President Tayyip Erdogan.

text: “We don’t accept this hate and denial policy,” kabahin sang statement sang Istanbul LGBTI+ Pride Week.
english: “We don’t accept this hate and denial policy,” part of the statement of Istanbul LGBTI+ Pride Week.

text: Nanindugan ang Iloilo City Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) nga ang pag-request nila sang car pass amo bangud sa pag-violate sang mga Public Utility Jeepney (PUJ) sang Pavia sa ila nangin kasugtanan agud nga makasulod sa Iloilo City.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) insisted that their request for the car pass was due to the violation of the Public Utility Jeepneys (PUJ) of Pavia in their agreement to enter Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Traffic Transportation and Management Office, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa mga bayolasyon nga ila ginbasehan amo ang mga jeep ang nagasulod sa syudad apisar nga wala sila sang car pass.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Traffic Transportation and Management Office, said that among the violations they based on jeeps entering the city despite not having a car pass.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, wala sang may natabo nga pagpauntat sang ila nga byahe.
english: According to Garbanzos, there was no cancellation of their flight.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga antes natabo ang indi nila pagbyahe, nag-request ang talatapan nga ibalik ang kustodiya sang car pass.
english: He also explained that before their non-travel happened, the office requested to return the custody of the car pass.

text: Apang, apisar sini, wala gyapon sang may na-confiscate ang talatapan bangud ginhatag nila balik ang car pass sa mga kooperatiba.
english: However, despite this, the office did not confiscate anything because they gave back the car pass to the cooperatives.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sang natungdan nga ang mga PUJ drivers ang masami nagasulod syudad nga masobra sa masobra 25% nga nakatalana para sa ila.
english: He also revealed that PUJ drivers often enter the city more than the more than 25% allocated for them.

text: Nagapati si Garbanzos nga nga isa ini ka paglapas sa ila nga franchise.
english: Garbanzos believes that this is a violation of their franchise.

text: May appreciation post ang P-pop Kings nga SB19 kasunod sang two-day concert sa Philippine Arena nga amo ang pagsugod sang ila nga “Simula at Wakas” world tour.
english: P-pop Kings SB19 posted an appreciation post following their two-day concert at the Philippine Arena which marked the beginning of their “Simula at Wakas” world tour.

text: “There’s no better way to end The Simula at Wakas World Tour Kickoff than with our A’TIN.
english: “There’s no better way to end The Simula at Wakas World Tour Kickoff than with our A’TIN.

text: With your unwavering support, we’ll keep on reaching for the stars together.
english: With your unwavering support, we’ll keep on reaching for the stars together.

text: See you at our next tour stops,” kabahin sang social media post sang grupo.
english: See you at our next tour stops,” part of the group’s social media post.

text:
Sa pag-umpisa sang ila concert sa atubang sang Pinoy fans sang Mayo 31, ginkanta nanday Pablo, Josh, Ken, Stell kag Justin ang “Dam” kag ang iban pa nga hit songs kaangay sang “What,” “Golden Hour,” “Dungka,” “Creamzone,” kag “Gento.”

Ang magasunod sa Philippine leg sang tour amo ang konsyerto sa Taipei, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Toronto, Calgary, Vancouver, Temecula, Honolulu, Singapore, Dubai, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, kag iban pa.
english:
Kicking off their concert in front of Filipino fans on May 31, Pablo, Josh, Ken, Stell and Justin sang “Dam” and other hit songs like “What,” “Golden Hour,” “Dungka,” “Creamzone,” and “Gento.”

Following the Philippine leg of the tour will be concerts in Taipei, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Toronto, Calgary, Vancouver, Temecula, Honolulu, Singapore, Dubai, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, and others.

text: Matandaan nga gin-release sang SB19 ang ila “Simula at Wakas” EP back sang Abril.
english: SB19 released their “Simula at Wakas” EP back in April.

text: “Simula at Wakas encapsulates everything we’ve been through: the struggles, the growth, the milestones.
english: “Simula at Wakas encapsulates everything we’ve been through: the struggles, the growth, the milestones.

text:
We hope it speaks not only to those who’ve been with us from the start but also welcomes new listeners into our world,” pahayag sang grupo sa nauna nga press release.#

Photo: SB19/FB
english:
We hope it speaks not only to those who’ve been with us from the start but also welcomes new listeners into our world,” the group said in an earlier press release.#

Photo: SB19/FB

text: May kilala ka bala, ukon ikaw mismo, naga-eksperyensya sang sleepwalking?
english: Do you know someone, or do you yourself, experience sleepwalking?

text: Delikado ini bangud nagakatulog ka gihapon apang nagabangon ka kag maglakat… kag kun kaisa nagakabunggo ka pa.
english: It's dangerous because you're still asleep but you get up and walk... and sometimes you get hit.

text: Ginatawag man ini nga somnambulism, ginaangot sang researchers sa genetics, masami nga nagakatabo sa mga bata, apang nagakadula man kun magdalagku na sila.
english: Also called somnambulism, researchers link it to genetics, it often occurs in children, but also disappears when they grow up.

text: Sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika partikular sa state sang Louisiana, may yara sang isa ka 10-anyos nga bata nga malayo ang nalab-utan bangud sa iya paglakat samtang nagakatulog.
english: In the United States of America specifically in the state of Louisiana, there is a 10-year-old child who is far away because of his sleepwalking.

text:
Natabo ini kay Peyton Saintignan nga na-report nga nadula alas dies sang nagligad nga gab-i.

Nangayo na sang bulig ang mga ginikanan sini kag indi lamang ang Louisiana State Police ang nagpangita kundi ginatos na ka mga volunteer agud nga pangitaon kun sa diin ayhan nakalab-ot ang bata.
english:
This happened to Peyton Saintignan who was reported missing at 10 pm last night.

His parents have already asked for help and not only the Louisiana State Police have searched but hundreds of volunteers to find where the child may have gone.

text: Lakip sa nagbulig amo ang drone operator nga si Josh Klober nga nagbyahe pa halin sa Arkansas pakadto sa Louisiana agud nga makabulig lang nga matultulan ang bata gamit ang iya drone.
english: Among those who helped was drone operator Josh Klober who traveled from Arkansas to Louisiana just to help find the child using his drone.

text: Nalakip ang thermal imaging camera sa iya drone, kag samtang naka-set up ang mga gamit, madamo man ang nagalantaw sa flat screen TV.
english: A thermal imaging camera is attached to his drone, and while the equipment is set up, many also watch on a flat screen TV.

text: Pasado na alas onse sang nakit-an ang bata nga nagabarikutot sa duta, wala na ang isa ka tsinelas, kag yara sa sulod sang kagulangan samtang mahamuok gihapon ang tulog.
english: It was past eleven o'clock when the child was found curled up on the ground, one slipper missing, and inside the forest while still fast asleep.

text: Tuman ang kalipay sang pamilya nga nakita ang bata, kag sang ginpukaw ini kag gin-check, nakit-an nga nakagat lang ini sang lamok kag wala na sang iban pa nga samad sa lawas.
english: The family was overjoyed to see the child, and when he was woken up and checked, he was found to have been bitten by a mosquito and had no other injuries.

text: Suno sa pamilya, masami gid man nga naga-sleepwalk ang bata apang ini ang una nga bes nga nakaguwa na ini sa balay kag yara na sa tunga sang kagulangan samtang mahamuok gihapon ang katulugon.
english: According to the family, the child often sleepwalks but this is the first time he has been out of the house and in the middle of the forest while still fast asleep.

text: Ang pag-sleepwalk masami nagakatabo isa tubtub duha ka oras matapos nga matulugan ang isa ka tawo.
english: Sleepwalking usually occurs one to two hours after a person falls asleep.

text: Apisar nga ginaangot ini sa genetics ukon sulundon sa pamilya, ginaangot man ini sa pila ka mga rason kaangay sang stress, sleep deprivation, sleep schedule disruptions, brain-related diseases, kag mangin ang pila ka medications.
english: Although it is associated with genetics or family patterns, it is also associated with several reasons such as stress, sleep deprivation, sleep schedule disruptions, brain-related diseases, and even certain medications.

text: Padayon nga mataas ang kumpyansa sang mga foreigner nga naga-invest sa Pilipinas sa pihak sang imbestigasyon sa ginapahayag nga korapsyon sa flood control projects.
english: Foreign investors in the Philippines remain confident despite investigations into alleged corruption in flood control projects.

text: Ini ang gintagaan igtalupangod ni Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs Secretary Frederick D. Go.
english: This was highlighted by Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs Secretary Frederick D. Go.

text: Ginpahayag ni Go nga padayon sa gihapon ang pagsulod sang mga investments pledges sa pungsod.
english: Go said investments pledges continue to come into the country.

text: Ginsabat man sini ang mga nagalapta nga report sa ginapahayag nga pagnubo sang stock market bangud sa isyu sa imprastraktura, kag gintawag pa niya ini nga fake news.
english: He also responded to reports circulating on the alleged decline in the stock market due to infrastructure issues, and even called it fake news.

text: Suno kay Go, gin-aprubahan na kag ginpadala sa Office of the President ang labing una nga benepisyaryo sang CREATE MORE Act isa ka Korean company nga maga-invest sang masobra $1 billion sa pungsod.
english: According to Go, the first beneficiary of the CREATE MORE Act, a Korean company that will invest more than $1 billion in the country, has been approved and sent to the Office of the President.

text: Ang CREATE MORE (Republic Act No.
english: The CREATE MORE (Republic Act No.

text: 12066) isa ka layi nga nagatuyo nga pabaskugon ang ekonomiya pinaagi sa mga insentibo sa negosyo.
english: 12066) is a law that aims to stimulate the economy through business incentives.

text: Ginsabat sang prosekusyon ang pamangkot sang defense kun may maga-imbestigar man bala sa “vigilante killings” nga nagakatabo sa idalom sang Marcos administration.
english: The prosecution answered the defense's question whether anyone would investigate the vigilante killings that occurred under the Marcos administration.

text: Sang Huwebes sang gab-i, matandaan nga sa isa ka bahin sang presentasyon sang defense counsel nga si Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, ginsiling sini nga nagpadayon man ang pagpamatay sang state forces bisan nga wala na si Duterte sa pwesto.
english: On Thursday night, it can be recalled that in one part of the presentation of defense counsel Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, he said that the killings of state forces continued even though Duterte was no longer in office.

text: Ginpresentar pa sini ang data kun pila ang mga kaso sang pagpamatay sa idalom sang Marcos administration, kag ginpamangkot sini ang prosecutors kun imbestigaran man bala nila ini.
english: He also presented data on the number of murder cases under the Marcos administration, and asked prosecutors whether they would investigate them.

text: “Clearly, I’m forced to ask myself whether anyone on the other side of this room has thought of investigating the Marcos regime and the related phenomenon and holding someone accountable,” pamangkot ni Kaufman sang tion nga siya ang nagpresentar sang iya argumento.
english: “Clearly, I’m forced to ask myself whether anyone on the other side of this room has thought of investigating the Marcos regime and the related phenomenon and holding someone accountable,” Kaufman asked at the time he presented his argument.

text: Ginhingalitan naman ni Prosecution senior trial lawyer Julian Nicholls ang iya tion sa closing statement kagab-i agud nga sabton ang pamangkot ni Kaufman.
english: Prosecution senior trial lawyer Julian Nicholls took his time in his closing statement last night to answer Kaufman's question.

text: Suno kay Nicholls, si Duterte mismo nga kliyente ni Kaufman ang may kahimuan kun ngaa indi na sila maka-imbestigar bangud sang pag-withdraw sang Pilipinas sa Rome Statute.
english: According to Nicholls, Duterte himself, Kaufman's client, is responsible for why they can no longer investigate because of the Philippines' withdrawal from the Rome Statute.

text: “He [Kaufman] made a small point I just have to respond to, making a call, ‘Why are there more investigations?’ ‘Why are crimes being investigated now in the Philippines?’ Well, his client prevented all that by withdrawing the Philippines from the Rome Statute when he thought he might be prosecuted.
english: “He [Kaufman] made a small point I just have to respond to, making a call, ‘Why are there more investigations?’ ‘Why are crimes being investigated now in the Philippines?’ Well, his client prevented all that by withdrawing the Philippines from the Rome Statute when he thought he might be prosecuted.

text: Thereby ensuring that we would not have jurisdiction after a certain period,” suno kay Nicholls.
english: Thereby ensuring that we would not have jurisdiction after a certain period,” according to Nicholls.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2018 sang gin-anunsyo ni Duterte ang pag-withdraw sa ICC nga naka-base sa The Hague matapos nga gin-umpisahan sang tribunal ang imbestigasyon sa iya nga drug war.
english: In 2018, Duterte announced his withdrawal from the Hague-based ICC after the tribunal launched an investigation into his drug war.

text: Marso 2019 naman sang pormal nga nag-withdraw ang pungsod sa Rome Statute.
english: In March 2019, the country formally withdrew from the Rome Statute.

text: Apisar sadto, ginapanindugan sang korte nga may hurisdiksyon pa ini sa mga krimen nga ginaalegar nahimo ni Duterte sa tunga-tunga sang Nobyembre 2011 kag Marso 2019 nga amo ang naga-cover sang termino ni Duterte bilang mayor sa Davao City kag bilang presidente sang Pilipinas.
english: However, the court insists that it still has jurisdiction over the crimes allegedly committed by Duterte between November 2011 and March 2019, which covered Duterte's term as mayor of Davao City and as president of the Philippines.

text: Sa closing statement sang prosekusyon kagab-i, nangin mabakod man ang rebuttal sini batok sa mga naratibo sang defense, particular na sa isyu sang death squad.
english: In the closing statement of the prosecution last night, it also strongly rebutted against the narratives of the defense, particularly on the issue of the death squad.

text: Suno kay Nicholls, “The facts can’t be denied by these sprinklings.
english: According to Nicholls, “The facts can’t be denied by these sprinklings.

text: He ran a death squad in Davao that he created.
english: He ran a death squad in Davao that he created.

text: He ran it for 20 years before he became president.
english: He ran it for 20 years before becoming president.

text: His promise was to kill thousands, and he did.”#
english: His promise was to kill thousands, and he did.”#

text: LUYAG naton updan si Mayor Jerry Treñas sa iya paglaum nga mangin malipayon na gid man ang aton pagsaulog sang panahon sang Paskwa sa lubos naton nga pagkatawo – ispiritual kag sa unod.
english: We would like to join Mayor Jerry Treñas in his hope that our celebration of the Christmas season will be happy in our full being – spiritually and physically.

text: Ina kay sige-sige na ang pagtaas sang nabakunahan nga mga pumuluyo diri sa siyudad.
english: That's because the number of vaccinated residents in the city is increasing.

text: “Tungod sini,” siling niya sa iya Facebook Page, “nagadamo man ang aton mga pumuluyo nga matagaan sing proteksyon batok sa delikado nga igu sang virus (COVID-19)”.
english: “Because of this,” he said on his Facebook Page, “more and more of our citizens are being protected against the dangerous virus (COVID-19)”.

text: In fact, nalab-ut na sang siyudad ang 86% ka porsyento sang mga pumuluyo nga nabakunahan na, kag sige gihapon ang pagpabakuna sang taga-siyudad pati na sang taga-gwa nga luyag magpabakuna diri.
english: In fact, the city has already reached 86% of the population vaccinated, and the city residents as well as foreigners who want to be vaccinated are still vaccinated.

text: Kapareho na ining aton sitwasyon sa National Capital Region (NCR) nga may sobra 80% ang nabakunahan na.
english: This is similar to our situation in the National Capital Region (NCR) where more than 80% of the population has been vaccinated.

text: Sa subong gani diri sa siyudad, madamo naman nga mga 12-17 anyos ang nabakunahan na.
english: Even now here in the city, many 12-17 year olds have been vaccinated.

text: Isunod na ang mga kabataan nga may edad paidalom tubtub 5 anyos.
english: Children under the age of 5 will be followed.

text: Agud mapabakud pa gid ang “immunity”, ga-preparar man gani ang siyudad sa pag-administer na sang mga “booster shots”, una para sa mga frontliners kag mga may “comorbidities”, ukon ang may mga balatian nga nagapahina sang ila “immunity”.
english: To further strengthen immunity, the city is also preparing to administer booster shots, first for frontliners and those with comorbidities, or those with diseases that weaken their immunity.

text: Ginpagwa naman gani ni meyor ang iya Executive Order 132-A, nga napetsahan Nobyembre 5, 2021, agud dulaon na ang “curfew”, ukon ang limitasyon sa paglagaw sang tawo sa mga publiko nga mga lugar.
english: The mayor even issued his Executive Order 132-A, dated November 5, 2021, to abolish the curfew, or the limit on movement of people in public places.

text: Lakip man diri ang pagpahanugot na sa mga salakyan pampubliko sa pagbaton sang mga pasahero sa 70% sang ila capacidad.
english: This includes allowing public transportation to receive passengers at 70% of their capacity.

text: Ginasugo man sini ang “optional” na lang nga paggamit sang “face shield”, kay sunu sa pagtuon indi man ini makapugong sa paghaklo sang aerosols – gagmay nga mga virus – nga makapabilin pa sa paglutaw sa hangin, nga mahimo naman sang “face mask”.
english: It also recommends the optional use of face shields, because according to the study it does not prevent the inhalation of aerosols - small viruses - that can remain floating in the air, which the face mask can do.

text: Tungod sini madamo na sang aton mga pumuluyo ang luyag maglagaw-lagaw sa plaza, maligo sa baybayon, magbisita sa mga matahum nga mga tourist spots, kag mag-shopping kag magpalamig sa aircon nga mga “mall”.
english: Because of this, many of our residents want to walk around the plaza, bathe on the beach, visit the beautiful tourist spots, and go shopping and cool off in the air-conditioned malls.

text: Mahimo naman nila ang mas makahulugan na nga pag-selebrar sang panahon sang Paskwa sa naandan na nila nga pamatasan agud ma-enjoy ini sing lubos.
english: They can also celebrate the Christmas season in a more meaningful way in their usual way to enjoy it to the fullest.

text: Sa naandan na naton, gina-selebrar naton ang Paswa sugod sa Oktubre tubtub sa pagkatawo ni Kristo sa Disyembre 25, kag tubtub pa gani sa Tatlo ka Hari sa una nga Domingo sang sunod nga tuig.
english: Traditionally, we celebrate Easter from October until the birth of Christ on December 25, and even until Three Kings on the first Sunday of the following year.

text: Amat-amat naman tingkad ang kasanag sa kagab-ihon nga dala sang mga parol kag mga Christmas lights sa mga puluy-an kag palibut.
english: The night lights brought by lanterns and Christmas lights in the homes and surroundings are gradually brightening.

text: Nga gina-enjoy naman sang aton mga pumuluyo!
english: Which our residents are enjoying!

text: Merry Christmas to one and all!
english: Merry Christmas to one and all!

text:
***

Of course, bilang paniguro kay indi pa mapat-ud sang aton health authorities ang aton ikasarang agud lupigon sing lubos ang COVID-19, sige lang anay ang pagpatuman naton sang bagay nga himuon bisan sa mas hilway na naton nga panghulag sa palibut.
english:
***

Of course, as a precaution because our health authorities are not yet sure of our ability to completely defeat COVID-19, we will continue to implement the right thing to do even in our freer movement around.

text: Mayor diri ang padayon nga pagpatuman gihapon sang “health protocols”, pagpatuman sang “infection control system” kon diin bagay, paglikaw gihapon sa “crowd gathering” kag “unprotected travel”, kag ang padayon nga pagbakuna sang aton mga pumuluyo.
english: These include the continued implementation of health protocols, the implementation of infection control systems where appropriate, the continued avoidance of crowd gatherings and unprotected travel, and the continued vaccination of our citizens.

text: Samtang ginapatihan sang pila ka health experts nga basi makaligad pa ang duha ka tuig agud lubos mahilway kita sa COVID-19.
english: Meanwhile, some health experts believe that it may take two years for us to be completely free from COVID-19.

text: Tungod sini sige pa ang pagbantay sang aton mga health experts kon ano pa gid ang mahimo sang COVID-19 kag sang “mutations” ukon “variants” sini nga sige man ang pagpanublag sa katauhan.
english: Because of this, our health experts are still monitoring what else COVID-19 and its mutations or variants can do.

text: Ang mga kandidato sa Mayo 2022 nga eleksyon ginapaabot naton gani nga makapahayag man sang ila plano angot sa sige pa naton nga problema sa COVID-19.
english: The candidates for the May 2022 elections are also expected to express their plans regarding our ongoing problem of COVID-19.

text: Isa sa sining maayo nga plano amo ang iya ni VP Leni.
english: One of these good plans is that of VP Leni.

text: Ang iban wala pa naton nahibal-an kon ano gid ang ila plano angot diri.
english: Some of us don't know what their plans are yet.

text:
***

Importante man nga matagaan naton sing pagsalig ang mga health authorities sa mahatag nila sa mga pumuluyo kag sa aton mga pamunuan nga mga masaligan nga “statistics” kag “metrics” para man sa masaligan nga “trends” para sa ila nagakaigu nga desisyon.
english:
***

It is also important that we give confidence to the health authorities in providing the people and our leaders with reliable statistics and metrics for reliable trends for their appropriate decisions.

text: Pila ka healh experts luyag magpati nga mas masaligan ang “trend” sang pagnubo sang COVID-19 kon ginapakita sini ang masaligan nga week-after-week nga data sang “hospitalization” sang mga pasyente.
english: Some health experts want to believe that the trend of decline in COVID-19 is more reliable if it shows reliable week-after-week data of hospitalization of patients.

text: Otherwise, kon may hitabo nga “unusual” katulad sang “erratic pattern” sang “trend” sini dapat maabtik man naton ma-aksyonan dayon ini agud makoreharan kag indi na maglala pa./PN
english: Otherwise, if there is an event that is “unusual” such as the “erratic pattern” of its “trend” we should also act quickly to correct it and not get worse./PN

text: Kun magpaligo kita sa baybay masami nga makit-an naton ang sea vegetables nga gulaman ukon seaweed nga ginalakot sa nanuhay-tuhay nga linuto kaangay sang ensalada, sinabawan, sushi rolls kag iban pa.
english: When we swim on the beach, we often see sea vegetables such as gulaman or seaweed added to various dishes such as salads, sinabawan, sushi rolls and others.

text: Ang seaweed ang may duag nga pula, green, brown kag black kag suno sa mga eksperto, indi lang ini basta-basta nga sahi sang utan bangud tuman kadamo ang mahatag sini nga benepisyo sa ikaayong lawas.
english: Seaweed comes in red, green, brown and black and according to experts, it is not just a vegetable because it has so many health benefits.

text: Suno kay Sharon O’Brien, registered dietician sa Ireland, ang seaweed ang may yara sang concentrated source sang iodine kag amino acid nga ginatawag tyrosine.
english: According to Sharon O’Brien, registered dietician in Ireland, seaweed contains a concentrated source of iodine and an amino acid called tyrosine.

text: Ang tyrosine ang kinahanglan sang thyroid gland agud maka-function sang maayo, maka-release sang hormones nga naga-kontrol sang growth, energy production, reproduction kag naga-repair sang damaged cells sa lawas.
english: Tyrosine is needed by the thyroid gland to function properly, release hormones that control growth, energy production, reproduction and repair damaged cells in the body.

text: Manggaranon man ang seaweeds sa antioxidants, kaangay sang vitamins A, C kag E, carotenoids kag flavonoids nga naga-proteher sa lawas batok sa cell damage.
english: Seaweeds are also rich in antioxidants, such as vitamins A, C and E, carotenoids and flavonoids that protect the body against cell damage.

text: Nagabulig man sa pagpaniwang ang seaweeds bangud puno ini sang fiber kag fucoxanthin, nga nagapadugang sang metabolism.
english: Seaweeds also help with weight loss because they are packed with fiber and fucoxanthin, which increase metabolism.

text: Ang Fucoxanthin kag iban pa nga compounds sa seaweed ang nagabulig man sa pagpanubo sang blood sugar levels, kag risgo sa pag-angkon sang balatian nga diabetes.
english: Fucoxanthin and other compounds in seaweed also help reduce blood sugar levels, and risk of developing diabetes.

text: Umatras si Two-time world champion at Cebuana billiards star Rubilen Amit sa 2025 World Pool Championships na gaganapin sa Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
english: Two-time world champion and Cebuana billiards star Rubilen Amit has withdrawn from the 2025 World Pool Championships to be held in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

text: Sa kaniyang social media ay kinumpirma nito ang hindi pagsali na magsisimula ngayong Hulyo 21.
english: On his social media, he confirmed the absence from July 21.

text: Sinabi nito na nagkaroon ito ng problema sa kalusugan kaya minabuti niyang huwag ng sumali.
english: He said he had health problems so he decided not to join.

text: Naging mahirap aniya ang nasabing desisyon subalit sinunod niya lamang ang payo ng kaniyang doctor kaya ito umatras na.
english: He said the decision was difficult but he followed his doctor's advice so he withdrew.

text: Mas mahalaga aniya na pangahalagahan ang kalusugan para sa mas maraming mga laban na susunod.
english: He said it is more important to take care of health for more fights to come.

text: Ang mga lalahok na lamang sa nasabing torneo ay sina Johann Chua, Carlo Biado, Patric Gonzales, AJ Manas, Jefrey Roda, Bernie Regalario, ay James Aranas.
english: The only participants in the tournament are Johann Chua, Carlo Biado, Patric Gonzales, AJ Manas, Jefrey Roda, Bernie Regalario, and James Aranas.

text: Ginkwestyon ni Akbayan Party-list Representative Perci Cendaña si Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero tuhoy sa padayon nga pagpa-delay sang impeachment trial batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Akbayan Party-list Representative Perci Cendaña questioned Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero about the continued delay of the impeachment trial against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Suno kay Cendaña, kada adlaw nga delay, nagahatag ini sang mensahe nga ang liderato sang Senado posible nga nahadlok kay Vice President Duterte — ukon, mas malala pa, ginaprotektahan siya.
english: Cendaña said every day of delay sends a message that the Senate leadership is likely afraid of Vice President Duterte — or, worse, protecting him.

text: Si Cendaña isa sa mga kongresista nga nag-endorso sang una nga impeachment complaint batok kay VP Duterte sa House of Representatives.
english: Cendaña was one of the congressmen who endorsed the first impeachment complaint against VP Duterte in the House of Representatives.

text:
Gin-athag pa gid ni Cendaña nga ang pag-convene sang Senado bilang impeachment court isa ka “solemn constitutional duty.”

Suno sa iya, indi ini dapat tratuhon nga isa lang ka “seasonal accessory” nga ginasuksok lang kung luyag, kag ginabutang base sa political weather ukon personal nga interes sang mga opisyales.
english:
Cendaña further explained that the convening of the Senate as an impeachment court is a “solemn constitutional duty.”

He said it should not be treated as a seasonal accessory that is worn at will, and placed based on political weather or personal interests of officials.

text: Yari pamatian naton ang pahayag ni Akbayan Party-list Representative Perci Cendaña.
english: Here we listen to the statement of Akbayan Party-list Representative Perci Cendaña.

text: Ginkasubo sang Public Information Office sang Iloilo City Government ang paglapta sang fake news sa social media.
english: The Public Information Office of the Iloilo City Government regrets the spread of fake news on social media.

text: Isa na diri ang fake news nga magapatigayon sang candle lighting kag prayer rally ang city government para kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: One of these is the fake news that the city government will hold a candle lighting and prayer rally for former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lucy Sinay, head sang Public Information Office sang Iloilo City Government, iya ginpahayag nga padayon ang mga tikang nga ginapatuman sang talatapan nga nagapakampanya batok sa fake news.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Lucy Sinay, head of the Public Information Office of the Iloilo City Government, said the office continues to implement measures to campaign against fake news.

text: Suno kay Sinay, kinahanglan nga ginaubra gid sang publiko ang pagpang-check sang impormasyon nga gina-share sa social media agud nga indi na magsangkad ang disinformation kag misinformation.
english: According to Sinay, the public should do their best to check the information shared on social media so that disinformation and misinformation do not spread.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa publiko nga magkoordinar sa ila nga social media accounts agud matumod kon legit ukon indi ang isa ka impormasyon nga nagahalin sa city government.
english: He also advised the public to coordinate with their social media accounts to identify whether or not an information coming from the city government is legit.

text: Nagalaum man ang natungdan nga mangin responsable ang kadam-an sa paggamit sang social media.
english: He also hopes that the public will be responsible in their use of social media.

text: Aprubado na sa third and final reading sa Senado ang hagna nga ginduso agud maghatag sang libre nga funeral services sa mga pigado nga pamilya nga mamatyan sang himata.
english: The bill to provide free funeral services to poor families who lose a loved one has been approved on third and final reading in the Senate.

text: Nakakuha ang Senate Bill No.
english: Senate Bill No.

text: 2965 sang 22 affirmative votes, zero negative vote, kag zero abstention.
english: 2965 by 22 affirmative votes, zero negative vote, and zero abstention.

text: Ang sponsor sang bill amo si Senator Imee Marcos.
english: The bill’s sponsor is Senator Imee Marcos.

text: Ihatag ini nga bulig sa mga pamilya nga yara sa crisis situations nga pagatumuron sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).
english: This assistance will be given to families in crisis situations that will be targeted by the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).

text: Lakip diri ang indigent families ukon ang mga apektado sang kalamidad ukon emergency circumstances nga rason kun ngaa indi sila makasarang sang disente nga lubong.
english: This includes indigent families or those affected by disasters or emergency circumstances that prevent them from affording a decent burial.

text:
Lakip sa ipakita sang pamilya ukon ila representative amo ang:

Ang maga-implementar sini amo ang DSWD samtang ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang maga-monitor kag maga-regulate sang presyuhanay sa pagpalubong lakip na ang presyo sang lungon.
english:
Among the things that the family or their representative must show are:

The DSWD will implement it while the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) will monitor and regulate the price of burials including the price of coffins.

text: Nagpasar si Iloilo City Councilor Candice Tupas, chairperson sang Committee on Public Information, sang ordinansa nga nagahingyo sang paghimo sang official website para sa Iloilo City Government.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Candice Tupas, chairperson of the Committee on Public Information, passed an ordinance requesting the creation of an official website for the Iloilo City Government.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Tupas, iya ginpahayag nga pasado na sa first reading ang ordinansa nga may katuyuan nga maghimo sang website nga amo ang mahimo lantawon sang mga pumuluyo para sa mga updates sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Tupas said the ordinance has already passed the first reading with the aim of creating a website that residents can view for updates in the city.

text: Suno kay Tupas, ini agud nga malikawan nga mabiktima sang fake news ang publiko.
english: According to Tupas, this is to prevent the public from becoming victims of fake news.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan sa naglapta nga Facebook post nga nagasiling nga nag- organisar sang candle lighting ang syudad para kay anay presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: This is in connection with a Facebook post that spread that the city organized a candle lighting for former president Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Pahayag niya, indi madali-dali nga ma-hack ang website gani mas masaligan ini nga source sang impormasyon.
english: He said the website is not easily hacked so it is a more reliable source of information.

text: Plano naman ni Tupas nga i-incorporate sa website ang e-library agud nga mas accessible sa mga tawo, ilabi na sa mga estudyante, ang mga libro nga ila kinahanglan nga mabasa.
english: Tupas plans to incorporate the e-library into the website to make it more accessible to people, especially students, the books they need to read.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ini sa publiko nga indi gilayon nga magpati sa mga post nga makit-an sa social media kag usisaon gid sang maayo ang mga impormasyon.
english: He also reminded the public not to immediately believe posts found on social media and to check the information carefully.

text: Arestado sa Clark, Pampanga ang isa pa ka suspek nga may kahilabtanan sa kaso nga qualified trafficking in persons batok kay anay Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque kag Cassandra Ong.
english: Another suspect in connection with the case of qualified trafficking in persons against former Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque and Cassandra Ong.

text: Ginkilala ang nadakpan nga suspek nga si “Mariano,” isa sa 49 nga co-accused ni Roque kag Ong sa human trafficking case nga nagluntad sa Lucky South 99 Outsourcing Inc., isa ka Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) nga nahamtang sa Porac, Pampanga.
english: The arrested suspect was identified as “Mariano,” one of the 49 co-accused of Roque and Ong in the human trafficking case that occurred at Lucky South 99 Outsourcing Inc., a Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) located in Porac, Pampanga.

text: Suno sa Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG), si Mariano isa sa mga security guard nga naka-duty sang natabu ang insidente.
english: According to the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG), Mariano was one of the security guards on duty when the incident occurred.

text: Ginpaandaman ni CIDG Director Police Major General Nicolas Torre III ang iban pa nga co-accused nga mag-surrender na antes pa man sila madakpan, bangud padayon ang law enforcement operations sa pagpangita sa mga ginapangita nga personalidad.
english: CIDG Director Police Major General Nicolas Torre III warned the other co-accused to surrender before they are arrested, as law enforcement operations continue to search for the wanted personalities.

text: Matandaan nga gin-isyu sang Regional Trial Court sang Angeles City sang Mayo 15, 2024 ang mga arrest warrant batok kanday Roque, Ong, kag sa iban pa nga ginatudlo nga mga katapo sa krimen.
english: It can be recalled that the Regional Trial Court of Angeles City issued on May 15, 2024 arrest warrants against Roque, Ong, and other alleged members of the crime.

text: Sang Mayo 22, una na nga nadakpan si “Marlon,” isa man sa mga co-accused, sa entrapment operation sa Mabalacat City, Pampanga.
english: On May 22, “Marlon,” also one of the co-accused, was first arrested in an entrapment operation in Mabalacat City, Pampanga.

text: Sa pihak sini, ginpanginwala ni Atty. Harry Roque ang mga alegasyon nga wala siya sang ano man nga koneksyon sa illegal nga POGO kag indi man siya abogado sang Lucky South 99.
english: Meanwhile, Atty. Harry Roque denied the allegations that he has no connection with the illegal POGO and that he is not a lawyer of Lucky South 99.

text: Sa subong, padayon sagihapon nga nagatenir si Roque sa Netherlands kag nagapangayo man ini sang asylum amo nga pungsod.
english: Roque is currently living in the Netherlands and is also seeking asylum in that country.

text: ILOILO CITY – Amat-amat na nga naga-recover si Pope Francis nagikan sa hernia operation apang indi magtambong sa Angelus prayer subong nga adlaw.
english: ILOILO CITY – Pope Francis is slowly recovering from hernia surgery but will not attend the Angelus prayer today.

text: Si Pope Francis ang nagpaidalom sa tatlo ka oras nga operasyon sa Gemelli hospital sa Rome nga amo ang pinakaulihi nga health procedure para sa 86 anyos nga lider sang Simbahang Katolika.
english: Pope Francis underwent a three-hour operation at the Gemelli hospital in Rome, the latest health procedure for the 86-year-old leader of the Catholic Church.

text: Ang tanan nga papal audiences ang ginkanselar tubtob sa Hunyo 18 agud nga mahatagan sang nagaka-igo nga tion ang Santo Papa nga mag-recover.
english: All papal audiences have been canceled until June 18 to give the Pope enough time to recover.

text: Sa pihak sang iya kondisyon, nagpadayon ini sa gihapon sang iya trabaho samtang nga yara sa iya hospital room.
english: Despite his condition, he continued his work while in his hospital room.

text: Suno sa surgeon nga nag-opera sa Santo Papa, wala ini sang hilanat kag ang tanan nga cardio-respiratory functions ang normal sa gihapon.
english: According to the surgeon who operated on the Pope, he had no fever and all cardio-respiratory functions were still normal.

text: Apang, ginrekomendar sang mga doctor nga indi anay magtambong sa public Angelus prayer si Pope Francis agud nga malikawan ang stress sa abdominal muscles.
english: However, doctors recommended that Pope Francis not attend the public Angelus prayer to avoid stress on the abdominal muscles.

text: Si Pope Francis ang nagasuprer sa hernia sa pilas nagikan sa nagligad nga operasyon.
english: Pope Francis is suffering from a hernia from a wound from a previous operation.

text: Kung madumduman, sang Marso, nagtinir man ini sang tatlo ka gab-i sa ospital matapos gin-treat sang antibiotics para sa respiratory infection.
english: In March, he also spent three nights in the hospital after being treated with antibiotics for a respiratory infection.

text: Sang Hulyo sang nagligad nga tuig, nagpaidalom man ini sa operasyon sa diverticulitis kun sa din, nagtinir ini sang 10 ka adlaw sa ospital.
english: In July last year, he also underwent surgery for diverticulitis and spent 10 days in the hospital.

text: Nagapati ang Chairman sang Committee on Women and Family sa Iloilo City Council nga dako ang responsibilidad sang mga ginikinan sa pagpahangop sa ila mga kabataan sang mga butang nga indi dapat nila pag-ubrahon.
english: The Chairman of the Committee on Women and Family in the Iloilo City Council believes that parents have a great responsibility to explain to their children the things they should not do.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa nagluntad nga insidente kun sa diin nadakpan ang mga pamatan-on nga nagahimo sang kamala-malahan sa La Paz Cemetery.
english: This is in connection with the incident where youths were caught committing crimes in La Paz Cemetery.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Frances Grace Parcon, iya ginpahayag nga importante nga mahibaluan sang mga kabataan ang resulta sang mga desisyon nga ginpanghimo nila.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Frances Grace Parcon said it is important for children to know the consequences of the decisions they make.

text: Suno sa konsehal, nakatalana ini makig-angot sa City Social Welfare and Develeopment Office kag Department of Social Welfare and Development Office agud maistoryahan ang mga interventions nag mahimu mapatuman.
