english: The councilor said he is scheduled to contact the City Social Welfare and Development Office and the Department of Social Welfare and Development Office to discuss interventions that can be implemented.

text: Ginplastar man niya ang importansya sang sex education agud matudluan sang insakto nga ihibalo ang mga kabataan sa mga bagay nga indi nila dapat pagbuhaton.
english: He also stressed the importance of sex education to teach children the right knowledge of things they should not do.

text: Gin-activate sang Taiwan ang ila defense systems matapos gin-report nga 37 ka mga Chinese military aircraft ang nagalupad subong sa sulod mismo sang ila nga air defense zone kag sa western Pacific.
english: Taiwan activated its defense systems after it was reported that 37 Chinese military aircraft are now flying within its air defense zone and in the western Pacific.

text: Suno sa defense ministry sang isla, lakip sa ginpadala sang China nga air force planes amo ang J-11 kag J-16 fighters, kag nuclear-capable nga H-6 bombers nga naglupad sa southwestern corner sang ila nga air defense identification zone.
english: According to the island's defense ministry, among the air force planes sent by China were J-11 and J-16 fighters, and nuclear-capable H-6 bombers that flew in the southwestern corner of their air defense identification zone.

text: Ini nga zone amo ang gina-monitor kag ginapatrolya sang Taiwan agud mahatagan sang dugang nga tyempo ang pwersa-militar nga maka-responde.
english: This zone is monitored and patrolled by Taiwan to give the military more time to respond.

text: Nagpadala man ang Taiwan sang mga eroplano kag barko agud nga mapadayon ang pagbantay sa hulag sang Chinese aircraft.
english: Taiwan has also sent aircraft and ships to continue monitoring the movements of Chinese aircraft.

text: Gin-activate ang land-based missile systems — kaangay kun paano ini normal nga naga-responde kun may aktibidad ang China sa amo nga teritoryo.
english: Land-based missile systems were activated — similar to how they normally respond when China has activity in the territory.

text: Matandaan nga bag-o lang nakatapos ang China sa joint air patrols kaupod ang Russia sa Western Pacific.
english: It can be recalled that China recently completed joint air patrols with Russia in the Western Pacific.

text: Ginselebrar ni Vice President Sara Duterte ang iya ika-47 nga kaadlawan sa The Hague sa Netherlands sa tunga sang kontrobersyal nga impeachment case batuk sa iya.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte celebrated her 47th birthday in The Hague in the Netherlands amid the controversial impeachment case against her.

text:
Sa iya pahayag, ginkumpara ni Duterte ang trial sa isa ka “crucifixion” kag ginbansagan ini nga isa ka “bloodbath.”

Ginpahayag man sang Bise Presidente nga luyag niya nga magpadayon ang impeachment trial agud makit-an ang matuod.
english:
In his statement, Duterte compared the trial to a “crucifixion” and called it a “bloodbath.”

The Vice President also said he wants the impeachment trial to continue to find the truth.

text: Gin-athagy niya nga ang ginatawag niya nga “bloodbath” ginkasubo sang iban, apang ginpanindugan niya nga may konteksto ang iya mga tinaga.
english: He acknowledged that what he called a “bloodbath” was regretted by some, but insisted that there was context to his words.

text: Ginpabutyag man niya nga ang impeachment ang isa ka pulitikal nga pagpangguba.
english: He also said that the impeachment is a political sabotage.

text: Sa pihak sang mga isyu, ginpasiguro sang legal nga grupo ni VP.
english: Despite the issues, VP's legal team assured.

text: Sara nga handa sila sa impeachment trial, sa diin may natabo man nga diskusyon kun madayon pa ang ini bangud ang 19th Congress ang magatapos na subong nga bulan.
english: Sara said they are ready for the impeachment trial, where there was also a discussion whether to continue because the 19th Congress will end this month.

text: Ginbalhin naman ni Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero ang presentasyon sang articles of impeachment halin Hunyo 2 pakadto Hunyo 11 agud maghatag lugar sa mga importante nga legislative nga buluhaton.
english: Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero postponed the presentation of the articles of impeachment from June 2 to June 11 to make room for important legislative work.

text: Madumduman nga gin-impeach sang House of Representatives si Duterte sadtong Pebrero bangud sa mga isyu pareho sang paggamit sang confidential funds, posible nga may kaangtanan sa extrajudicial killings sa Davao City, kag sa controversial nga pahayag nga may gin-kontrata siya para patyon si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: The House of Representatives impeached Duterte in February over issues such as the use of confidential funds, possibly related to extrajudicial killings in Davao City, and the controversial statement that he had contracted to kill President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: kun ini siya ang mapatay.
english: if he dies.

text: Arestado ang 15 tanan ka foreign nationals sa Lagos, Nigeria bangud sa kaso nga cyber-terrorism kag internet fraud.
english: A total of 15 foreign nationals were arrested in Lagos, Nigeria on charges of cyber-terrorism and internet fraud.

text: Suno kay Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) spokesman Dele Oyewale, 11 sa mga nadakpan ang mga pinoy, duha ang Chinese, isa ka Malaysian kag isa ka Indonesian.
english: According to Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) spokesman Dele Oyewale, 11 of the arrested are Filipinos, two are Chinese, one is Malaysian and one is Indonesian.

text: Ang mga ini ang ginsentensyahan sang isa ka tuig nga pagkapreso kag ginpamulta sang tig-$630 kada isa.
english: They were sentenced to one year in prison and fined $630 each.

text: Gin-akusaran ang mga ini sa pagpang-recruit sang mga kabataan nga Nigerians para sa identity theft.
english: They were accused of recruiting Nigerian children for identity theft.

text: Ginbansagan na nga internet fraudsters ang Nigeria nga pinakabantog nga pungsod sa Africa.
english: Nigeria, the most famous country in Africa, has been called internet fraudsters.

text: Ipauntat sang National Historical Commission of the Philippines ang plano sang local government unit sang Dingle nga pagguba sang makasaysayan nga hagdan sang St.
english: The National Historical Commission of the Philippines will stop the plan of the local government unit of Dingle to demolish the historic staircase of St.

text: John the Baptist Church sa nasambit nga banwa.
english: John the Baptist Church in the said town.

text: Madugay na nga nagaguwa ang impormasyon nahanungod sa pag-demolish sang hagdan apang ginkaalarma ini subong sang mga pumuluyo bangud sa mga nakit-an nga backhoe malapit sa simbahan.
english: Information about the demolition of the stairs has been coming out for a long time but the residents are now alarmed by the backhoes found near the church.

text: Apang nagapadayon subong ang amat-amat nga pagkaayo sang plaza nga madugay man nga nag-untat.
english: But the gradual renovation of the plaza, which has been stalled for a long time, is now underway.

text: Ang simbahan ang yara lang sa tabok sang plaza sang banwa.
english: The church is just across the town plaza.

text: Marso 3, 2025, nag-issue ang National Historical Commission of the Philippines sang Cease-and-Desist Order (CDO) ukon pagpauntat sang tanan nga aktibidad nga makaapekto sa hagdan sang nasambit nga simbahan.
english: On March 3, 2025, the National Historical Commission of the Philippines issued a Cease-and-Desist Order (CDO) or stop all activities affecting the stairs of the said church.

text: Ginpahibalo ni NHCP Chair Regalado Trota José Jr.
english: NHCP Chair Regalado Trota José Jr.

text: si Dingle Mayor Rufino Palabrica III nga ang 19th-century staircase, bilang Important Cultural Property (ICP), ang ginaprotektahan gikan sa ano man nga modification ukon demolition.
english: Dingle Mayor Rufino Palabrica III said the 19th-century staircase, as an Important Cultural Property (ICP), is protected from any modification or demolition.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-request ang LGU sang Dingle sa Archdiocese of Jaro nga i-demolish ang hagdan bilang kabahin sang nagapadayon nga redevelopment sang drainage sang public plaza.
english: The LGU of Dingle requested the Archdiocese of Jaro to demolish the stairs as part of the ongoing redevelopment of the drainage of the public plaza.

text: Suni kay José, nagakadapat nga ginakonsulta ang NHCP sa ano man nga intervention nga makaapekto sa integridad sang istruktura antes ang implementasyon.
english: José said the NHCP should be consulted on any intervention that would affect the integrity of the structure before implementation.

text: Ginmanduan man sini ang alkalde nga magpasa sang pirmado nga development plan para sa redevelopment sang plaza sa diin nagakadapat nga pagasundon ini sa National Cultural Heritage Act of 2009.
english: He also ordered the mayor to submit a signed development plan for the redevelopment of the plaza which should be in accordance with the National Cultural Heritage Act of 2009.

text: Sa tion nga indi masunod ang nasantu sa National Cultural Heritage Act of 2009 pahayag niya, magapasaka ang NHCP sang kaso batuk sa LGU.
english: In case of non-compliance with the National Cultural Heritage Act of 2009, he said, the NHCP will file a case against the LGU.

text: Natapos ang tatlo ka oras nga operasyon kay Pope Francis sa ospital sa Roma nga wala sang kumplikasyon.
english: Pope Francis' three-hour operation at a Rome hospital was completed without complications.

text: Suno sa Vatican, sa Gemelli Hospital naka-admit ang 86-anyos nga Santo Papa kag ginalauman nga magatinir pa didto sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw apisar tapos na ang surgery.
english: According to the Vatican, the 86-year-old Pope was admitted to the Gemelli Hospital and is expected to stay there for several days despite the surgery.

text: Kanselado naman tubtub sa Hunyo 18 ang tanan nga papal audiences.
english: All papal audiences are canceled until June 18.

text: Una na nga ginkumpirma ni Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni nga pagkatapos sang colon surgery ni Pope Francis sang 2021, nagsuprer naman ini sang hernia nga nagatuga sang sulit-sulit, masakit, kag masami nga pagguwa sang sintomas.
english: Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni earlier confirmed that after Pope Francis' colon surgery in 2021, he suffered a hernia that causes repeated, painful, and frequent symptoms.

text: Ginpahayag man una ni Bruni nga ipaidalom ang Santo Papa sa general anesthesia para sa laparotomy kag abdominal wall surgery nga amo ang nagatumod sa surgical incision sa abdominal cavity.
english: Bruni also said earlier that the Pope will undergo general anesthesia for laparotomy and abdominal wall surgery, which refers to a surgical incision in the abdominal cavity.

text: Suno naman kay Vatican Secretary of State Pietro Parolin, kun matapos na ang operasyon kag kun may importante nga mga butang nga kinahanglan desisyunan na gilayon, dal-on ini sa Santo Papa sa ospital agud nga siya ang maka-desisyon.
english: Vatican Secretary of State Pietro Parolin said that when the operation is completed and if there are important matters that need to be decided immediately, it will be taken to the Pope in the hospital so that he can decide.

text: Ang pagkansela naman sang audiences sang Santo Papa tubtub sa Hunyo 18 ang kabahin sang precautionary measure suno sa Vatican press office.
english: The cancellation of the Pope's audiences until June 18 is part of a precautionary measure, the Vatican press office said.

text: Kun basehan ang latest schedule nga ginpaguwa sang Vatican, magabyahe si Pope Francis sa Portugal sa una nga bahin sang Agusto; kag pagasundan ini sang byahe sa Mongolia umpisa sa Agusto 31.
english: Based on the latest schedule released by the Vatican, Pope Francis will travel to Portugal in early August; and will be followed by a flight to Mongolia starting August 31.

text: Ano ang masarangan mo ubrahon bilang isa ka ginikanan para lang mabantayan mo ang imo kabataan?
english: What can you do as a parent just to keep an eye on your children?

text: Kag paano kun ang imo anak may buot naman pero gusto mo bilang ginakanan, nahibaluan mo ang tanan niya nga hulag kag ginakadtuan.
english: And what if your child has a mind but you want as a parent, you know all his movements and where he is going.

text: Pat-ud nga indi mo masarangan ang ginhimo sang isa ka amay sa Pakistan para lang masiguro nga safe ang iya bata nga babaye.
english: Surely you cannot afford what a father in Pakistan did just to make sure his daughter was safe.

text: Ang iya ginhimo, ginpabutangan niya sang surveillance camera ang ulo sang iya bata agud ma- monitor ang iya mga aktibidad sa bilog nga adlaw.
english: What she did was put a surveillance camera on her son's head to monitor his activities throughout the day.

text: Sang ginpamangkot naman ang bata, ginsiling niya nga wala man sang problema ini sa iya.
english: When asked, the child said he had no problem with it.

text: Apisar madamo ang naham-ot, madamo man ang nakahangop sa amay kun ngaa ginahimo niya ini sa iya anak.
english: Although many were shocked, many also understood the father why he did this to his son.

text: Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte – Patay ang isa ka election officer samtang pilason naman ang bana sini matapos gin-ambush sang wala pa nakilala nga mga armado nga suspek sa Barangay Makir, Datu Odin Sinsuat.
english: Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte – An election officer was killed while her husband was injured after being ambushed by unidentified armed suspects in Barangay Makir, Datu Odin Sinsuat.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Maceda Lidasan Abo, Election Officer sang Datu Odin Sinsuat, kag bana sini nga si Jojo Abo.
english: The victims were identified as Maceda Lidasan Abo, Election Officer of Datu Odin Sinsuat, and her husband Jojo Abo.

text: Padulong ang mag-asawa sa Dalican Election Offic sakay sang ila SUV sang ginluthang sang wala pa matumod nga mga suspek.
english: The couple were on their way to the Dalican Election Office in their SUV when they were shot by unidentified suspects.

text: Padayon naman ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad agud matumod ang motibo sa krimen kag kilalahanon ang mga yara sa likod sang pag-ambush.
english: Authorities are conducting an investigation to determine the motive of the crime and identify those behind the ambush.

text: Ginkumpirma naman ni Maguindanao del Norte Provincial Election Supervisor Atty. Nabil Mutia ang pagtaliwan ni Maceda Abo, samtang nagapaayo naman sa ospital ang iya bana.
english: Maguindanao del Norte Provincial Election Supervisor Atty. Nabil Mutia announced the death of Maceda Abo, while her husband is recovering in hospital.

text: Nagapabilin sa Mexican-American boxer nga si Mario Barrios ang WBC welterweight title matapos nagtakop sa majority draw ang hampang nila ni eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 20.
english: Mexican-American boxer Mario Barrios retains the WBC welterweight title after his fight with eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao ended in a majority draw today, July 20.

text: Sa 12-round showdown sa MGM Grand Garden Arena sa Las Vegas, Nevada, isa ka judge ang nagpabor kay Barrios, 115-113, samtang duha naman ang nag-skor sang draw, 114-114.
english: In the 12-round showdown at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada, one judge favored Barrios, 115-113, while two scored a draw, 114-114.

text: Bangud sa desisyon, ginkabos ang 46-anyos nga Pinoy boxing icon nga ma-reset ang iya record bilang pinakatigulang nga welterweight champion, isa ka record nga nahimo niya sang ginlutos si Keith Thurman sang USA paagi sa split decision sang 2019 agud makuha ang WBA belt sa edad nga 40.
english: The decision deprived the 46-year-old Filipino boxing icon of resetting his record as the oldest welterweight champion, a record he set when he defeated Keith Thurman of the USA by split decision in 2019 to win the WBA belt at the age of 40.

text: Matapos gin-anunsyo ang resulta, gin-ako ni Pacquiao nga nagpinsar siya nga siya ang nagdaog sa sambuwa.
english: After the results were announced, Pacquiao admitted that he thought he won the fight.

text: Gindayaw man sini si Barrios sa ginpakita sini nga istilo sa ring.
english: He also praised Barrios for his style in the ring.

text: “I thought I won the fight,” suno sa Hall of Famer.
english: “I thought I won the fight,” the Hall of Famer said.

text: “It was a close fight.
english: “It was a close fight.

text: My opponent was very tough.
english: My opponent was very tough.

text: Barrios is a wonderful fighter,” pahayag sini sa iya 30-anyos nga kasumpong.
english: Barrios is a wonderful fighter,” he said of his 30-year-old opponent.

text: Nahibaluan nga apat ka tuig na halin sang nagretiro si Pacquiao sa sini nga sports event matapos ginlutos ni Yordenis Ugas.
english: It is known that it has been four years since Pacquiao retired from this sports event after being defeated by Yordenis Ugas.

text: Sa official weigh-in sang Sabado, nagpahayag ini nga nalipay siya nga makabalik sa ring: “I’m so happy I’m back because boxing is my passion and I missed boxing.”#
english: At the official weigh-in on Saturday, he said he was happy to be back in the ring: “I’m so happy I’m back because boxing is my passion and I missed boxing.”#

text: Patigayunon na 9:00 subong nga gab-i oras sa Pilipinas ang koronasyon sang Miss World 2025.
english: The coronation of Miss World 2025 will be held at 9:00 pm Philippine time.

text: Hiwaton ang finals sa Hyderabad, India.
english: The finals will be held in Hyderabad, India.

text: Sa Final Hot picks nga ginpaguwa sang pageantry expert nga Missosology subong gid lamang nga hapon, nagapang-anum ang tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga si Krishnah Gravidez.
english: In the Final Hot picks released by pageantry expert Missosology this afternoon, Philippine representative Krishnah Gravidez is sixth.

text:
Yari ang kumpleto nga lista:

Target ni Krishnah ang ikaduha nga Miss World Crown sa Pilipinas kasunod sa titulo nga nakuha ni Megan Young sang 2013.
english:
Here is the complete list:

Krishnah is targeting the Philippines' second Miss World Crown following the title won by Megan Young in 2013.

text: Sa Instagram, nag-post man ini subong nga adlaw sang iya stunning pictures: “Para sa inyo.
english: On Instagram, she also posted today her stunning pictures: “For you.

text: Para sa bansa.
english: For the country.

text:
Para sa lahat ng nangangarap.”

Sa preliminary events, ginpakita sini ang iya talent sa pagkanta, ginduso sini ang advocacy for children, kag nakakuha man sang pwesto sa Top 20 sang Multimedia Challenge.#
english:
For all the dreamers.”

In the preliminary events, she showcased her singing talent, promoted advocacy for children, and also secured a place in the Top 20 of the Multimedia Challenge.#

text: TION yadto sa pungsod sang padayon nga peace talks sa tunga sang gobyerno kag Muslim rebels para sa malinong nga pagpakigpuyo sang mga Muslim upod sa mga Kristiyano, kon diin ginaistoryahanan na ang Bangsamoro Basic Law sa idalom ni Presidente Aquino.
english: IT WAS a time in the country of ongoing peace talks between the government and Muslim rebels for the peaceful coexistence of Muslims with Christians, where the Bangsamoro Basic Law under President Aquino is being discussed.

text: Tion man ato nga nabantugan ang Davao City sa idalom ni anay Mayor Rodrigo Duterte bilang isa ka malinong nga siyudad.
english: It was also the time when Davao City became famous under former Mayor Rodrigo Duterte as a peaceful city.

text: Diri, wala kuno sing dalagku nga mga kriminal kag maisip mo lang ang madakpan nga naga-droga.
english: Here, they say there are no big criminals and you can only count those caught doing drugs.

text: Tungod bala kay madamo diri sang mga trabaho agud indi matentar ang mga tawo sa paghimo sang krimen agud mabuhi?
english: Is it because there are many jobs here so that people are not tempted to commit crimes to survive?

text: Ukon nahadlok lang ang kon sin-o man nga may kriminal nga panghuna-huna sa salsalon nga kamot kag wala patawad nga pagdumala ni Duterte?
english: Or is anyone with a criminal mind just afraid of Duterte's iron fist and unforgiving rule?

text: Ukon, sa may uslitan nga panghuna-huna, tungod bala kontrolado sang sindikato ang mga negosyo diri nga wala man sing reklamo kay padayon man ang ila maayo nga kita?
english: Or, in a biased way, is it because the syndicate controls the businesses here that there are no complaints because they continue to make good income?

text: In fact, panahon man ato sang indi gihapon matapna nga problema sa droga, kriminalidad kag korapsyon sa gobyerno sa aton pungsod, nga tubtub subong handom sang tanan nga tani mahimo sang kon sin-o nga makapasalig sa ila.
english: In fact, it was also a time of unstoppable drug problems, crime and government corruption in our country, which until now everyone wishes could be done by someone who can trust them.

text: Tion man ato sang pagpatigayon sang gobyerno sang Oplan Exodus agud tultolon kag arestohon ang mga high-ranking terrorists nga nagapanago sa isa ka barangay sa Mamasapano, Maguindanao.
english: It was also the time when the government conducted Oplan Exodus to track down and arrest high-ranking terrorists hiding in a barangay in Mamasapano, Maguindanao.

text: Ginpatigayon ining “daring mission” sang kaagahon sadtong Enero 25, 2015.
english: This “daring mission” was conducted on the morning of January 25, 2015.

text: Nangin mabungahon ini sa pagkapatay sang terorista kag experto sa paghimo sing bomba nga si Zulkifli Abdhir.
english: It proved fruitful with the death of terrorist and bomb-making expert Zulkifli Abdhir.

text: Masakit lang ugaling kay ang kabaylo sini amo ang kabuhi sang 44 ka myembro sang Special Action Force (SAF) sang PNP, bisan pa dala man nila sa ila kamatayon ang kabuhi sang 18 ka myembro sang MILF kag BIFF nga nakigsumpong sa ila.
english: It is painful, however, because the price is the lives of 44 members of the Special Action Force (SAF) of the PNP, even though they also brought with them the lives of 18 members of the MILF and BIFF who fought against them.

text: Ginbasol diri sang mga pumuluyo, labi na sang mga pamilya sang Fallen 44, si Presidente Aquino kag DILG Secretary Mar Roxas.
english: The people, especially the families of the Fallen 44, blamed President Aquino and DILG Secretary Mar Roxas.

text: Kag wala na madayon ang pag-aprubar sang Kongreso sang Bangsamoro Basic Law.
english: And the approval of the Bangsamoro Basic Law by Congress did not take place.

text: Naaprubahan lang ini sang ulihi sa panahon ni Presidente Duterte.
english: It was only approved later during the time of President Duterte.

text:
***

Malapit na sadto ang eleksyon sang Mayo 2016.
english:
***

The May 2016 election was just around the corner.

text: Kag nangin daku ini nga isyu batok sa kay Roxas kag iban nga kandidato ni Aquino.
english: And it became a big issue against Roxas and other Aquino candidates.

text: Napierde gid si Roxas sa iya pagdalagan sa pagka-Presidente.
english: Roxas lost his presidential race.

text: Samtang, gin-updan kag ginpili man sang mga pumuluyo ang pasalig nga “milagro” ni Davao City Mayor Rodrigo Duterte sa away batok sa droga, krimen kag korapsyon sa gobyerno.
english: Meanwhile, the residents also supported and chose the promise of “miracle” of Davao City Mayor Rodrigo Duterte in the fight against drugs, crime and corruption in government.

text: In fact, lubos na gid napierde ang mga kandidato ni Aquino sa eleksyon sang 2019.
english: In fact, Aquino's candidates were completely defeated in the 2019 elections.

text:
***

Wala ugaling natabo ang “milagro” nga ginpasalig ni Presidente Duterte.
english:
***

However, the “miracle” promised by President Duterte did not happen.

text: Kon may natuman man nga “Duterte goals” wala ini makapalipay sa mga Filipino.
english: If any of the “Duterte goals” were achieved, it did not please the Filipinos.

text: Tungod taliwas gali ang pagpatuman sini sa “values” sang mga Filipino nga maka-Diyos, may pagtaha sa kabuhi sang tawo, kag may pag-respeto sa “rule of law” kag Demokrasyahanon nga pangabuhi.
english: Because its implementation is contrary to the values ​​of Filipinos who are God-fearing, have respect for human life, and have respect for the rule of law and democratic life.

text: Karon gani lakip ini sa mga isyu batok sa mga kandidato ni Duterte sa Mayo 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: Now it is among the issues against Duterte's candidates in the May 2022 elections.

text: Kuno matapna niya ang drug menace sa sulod lang sang anom (6) ka bulan.
english: He claims to be able to stop the drug menace in just six (6) months.

text: Lima na ka tuig ang nagligad, yara pa gihapon ini kag naglala pa gani.
english: Five years later, it’s still there and even worse.

text: Kuno tapnaon niya ang kriminalidad, pero ang istastika nagasiling nga nagtaas pa gani sing 60% ang “murder cases”, nga madamo sini matudlo sa mga riding-in-tandem nga ang suspetso matudlo sa mga vigilantes kag ang Duterte Death Squad.
english: He is supposed to curb crime, but statistics say that murder cases have increased by 60%, many of which can be attributed to riding-in-tandems whose suspicions can be pointed to vigilantes and the Duterte Death Squad.

text: Kuno tapnaon ang korapsyon, sus a!
english: Supposedly stop corruption, sus a!

text: Pati gani ang pagbakal sang pandemic supplies gin-entrahan pa sang korapsyon sang mga pila ka tauhan kag abyan ni Presidente.
english: Even the purchase of pandemic supplies was involved in corruption by some of the President's staff and friends.

text: Imagine, P625,000 lang ang kapital, sobra P8 ka bilyon nga pandemic supplies ang nadaug sa bidding!
english: Imagine, only P625,000 capital, more than P8 billion pandemic supplies won in the bidding!

text: Madamo man ang pinatay – sobra 10,000 – sang mga trigger-happy nga mga pulis sa sugo niya nga “Kill!
english: Many were also killed – more than 10,000 – by trigger-happy policemen on his order “Kill!

text: Kill!
english: Kill!

text: Kill!”.
english: Kill!”.

text: In fact, nagaatubang si Presidente Duterte sang kaso nga “crimes against humanity” nga gina-imbestigahan sa karon sang International Criminal Court.
english: In fact, President Duterte is facing charges of “crimes against humanity” that are currently being investigated by the International Criminal Court.

text: Gina-protestahan man ang kulang nga pagkabalaka sang gobyerno ni Duterte sa kahimtangan sang mga medical frontliners agud lubos sila maprotektahan kag matagaan sang nagakaigu nga mga benepisyo samtang ginahalad ang ila kabuhi agud mabuligan ang mga biktima sang Covid-19.
english: They also protest the Duterte government's lack of concern for the plight of medical frontliners so that they can be fully protected and given appropriate benefits while sacrificing their lives to help the victims of Covid-19.

text: Samtang, halos indi man mahibal-an sini kon paano suportahan ang pangabuhi sang kadam-an, nga madamo sini nawad-an sing trabaho, kag kon may tabang man kakurampot lang./PN
english: Meanwhile, it almost does not know how to support the livelihood of the masses, many of whom have lost their jobs, and if there is any help, it is scarce./PN

text: Sini nga tigtulugnaw nagatubo man ang tropical fruits kaangay sang Chico.
english: This winter also grows tropical fruits like Chico.

text: Ang Chico ukon Sapodilla ang ginarekomenda sang mga eksperto nga ilakip sa diet bangud manggaranon ini sa dietary fiber, vitamin C, kag anti-inflammatory agents.
english: Chico or Sapodilla is recommended by experts to include in the diet because it is rich in dietary fiber, vitamin C, and anti-inflammatory agents.

text: Suno kay Shirley Johanna, registered dietician sa India, ang Chico ang wala lang nagapabakod sang intestines kundi nagapasanyog man sang immunity kag nagapalikaw sa nanuhay-tuhay nga bacterial infections bangud sa presensya sang vitamin C sa nasambit nga prutas.
english: According to Shirley Johanna, registered dietician in India, Chico not only strengthens the intestines but also boosts immunity and prevents various bacterial infections due to the presence of vitamin C in the fruit.

text: Pahayag ni Johanna, ang mataas nga content sang anti-imflammatory agent nga ”tannins” sa prutas nga Chico ang nagabulong man sa balatian nga esophagitis, enteritis, kag gastritis.
english: Johanna said the high content of anti-inflammatory agent tannins in Chico fruit also cures esophagitis, enteritis, and gastritis.

text: Magluwas diri, natukiban man nga ang chemical compounds nga yara sa Chico ang makabulong man sa ubo kag ang antioxidants kag vitamins A kag B sang prutas ang nagapugong naman sa formation sang tumour cells kag nagapanubo sang risgo sa pag-angkon sang isa ka indibidwal sang balatian nga cancer.
english: In addition, it was also discovered that the chemical compounds in Chico can also cure coughs and the antioxidants and vitamins A and B of the fruit prevent the formation of tumor cells and reduce the risk of developing cancer.

text: Dugang pa sang dietician, bulong man sa kaluyahon ang pag-inom sang juice ukon shake sang Chiko bangud napamatud-an nga isa ka ”energy booster” ang ini nga sahi sang prutas.
english: The dietician added that drinking Chiko juice or shake is also a cure for weakness because it has been proven to be an energy booster.

text: Natalana nga i-lift sang Marcos Administration ang rice importation sa Enero 2026 apang liwat ini nga ipatuman sa Pebrero tubtob Abril sa amo man nga tuig.
english: The Marcos Administration is scheduled to lift rice importation in January 2026 but will re-implement it from February to April of the same year.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., wala sang ‘end date’ ang Executive Order 93 nga nagasuspend sang importasyon sang regular milled kag well-milled rice sa sulod sang 60 ka adlaw sa diin nangin epektibo ini sang Setyembre 1.
english: According to Department of Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., Executive Order 93, which suspends the importation of regular milled and well-milled rice for 60 days when it became effective on September 1, has no end date.

text: Pahayag niya, harvest season ang Pebrero tubtob Abril sa diin ang mga humay sang mga mangunguma amo ang mangin mayor nga supply sa merkado kag indi ang mga imported rice.
english: He said the harvest season is from February to April where the rice of the farmers will be the main supply in the market and not the imported rice.

text: Nagtipon ang Duterte supporters sa atubang sang International Criminal Court (ICC) sa The Hague, Netherlands agud magpanawagan sa tribunal nga hilwayon kag papaulion na si former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Duterte supporters gathered in front of the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague, Netherlands to call on the tribunal to release and send home former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ini nga rally ang ginapangunahan ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga naga-selebrar man sang iya 47th birthday subong nga Mayo 31.
english: The rally was led by Vice President Sara Duterte who is also celebrating her 47th birthday on May 31.

text: Gin-organisar sang Filipino communities sa Europa ini nga aktibidad.
english: Filipino communities in Europe organized this activity.

text: Kahapon, sa iya pag-abot sa The Hague, nakabisita na si Sara sa iya amay kun sa diin kaupod sini ang iya iloy nga si Elizabeth Zimmerman.
english: Yesterday, upon her arrival in The Hague, Sara visited her father, who was accompanied by her mother, Elizabeth Zimmerman.

text: Ginpakigbahin sini ang mga mensahe sang former president, lakip na ang pahayag sini nga maga-sumpa siya bilang mayor sang Davao City kun hilwayon siya sang korte.
english: He shared the former president's messages, including his statement that he will be sworn in as mayor of Davao City if the court releases him.

text: Nahibaluan nga Mayo 30, Hunyo 2, kag Hunyo 3 ang scheduled visits ni Sara sa iya amay sa detention facility sandig sa impormasyon nga gin-release sang Office of the Vice President (OVP).
english: Sara's scheduled visits to her father in the detention facility are on May 30, June 2, and June 3, according to information released by the Office of the Vice President (OVP).

text: Nag-upod man sa byahe sang bise presidente sa The Hague si presidential sister Imee Marcos, apang ginklaro sang VP nga wala ini sang papel sa kaso sang amay nga Duterte.
english: Presidential sister Imee Marcos also accompanied the vice president's trip to The Hague, but the VP clarified that she had no role in the case of Duterte's father.

text: Antes nag-abot sa The Hague, nagbisita anay ang vice president sa Qatar kag nagpakigkita sa Filipino community nga mainit man nga nag-abi-abi sa iya.
english: Before arriving in The Hague, the vice president visited Qatar and met with the Filipino community who also warmly welcomed him.

text: Marso 11 sang gindakop si former President Duterte sa gahum sang arrest warrant sang ICC bangud sa kaso sini nga crimes against humanity nga ginpahayag nag-ugat sa iya maduguon nga implementasyon sang drug war.
english: Former President Duterte was arrested on March 11 under an ICC arrest warrant for crimes against humanity allegedly stemming from his bloody implementation of the drug war.

text: Natalana ang confirmation of charges sa Septyembre 23, 2025.#
english: Confirmation of charges is scheduled for September 23, 2025.#

text: Gin-sentensyahan sang 10 ka tuig nga pagka-preso ang isa ka lalaki sa Wisconsin sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika bangud sa sex trafficking sa pila ka mga menor de edad sa Pilipinas.
english: A man in Wisconsin in the United States of America was sentenced to 10 years in prison for sex trafficking several minors in the Philippines.

text: Suno sa United States Department of Justice, nagbyahe si Donald Stenson, 67, sa Pilipinas halin sang 2007 kag sulit-sulit nga naghimo sang sexual activity sa mga menor de edad sa pungsod.
english: According to the United States Department of Justice, Donald Stenson, 67, traveled to the Philippines since 2007 and repeatedly engaged in sexual activity with minors in the country.

text: Sang 2016 tubtub 2019, ginpilit man sini ang lima ka mga biktima edad 11-17 anyos nga magpakigbahin sa commercial sex arrangements.
english: From 2016 to 2019, he also forced five victims aged 11-17 to participate in commercial sex arrangements.

text: Nagpakighilawas siya sa mga biktima kabaylo sang kuwarta kag mga regalo.
english: He had sex with the victims in exchange for money and gifts.

text: Nakit-an man sa electronic devices ni Stenson ang mga laragway kag videos sang mga menor de edad lakip na mismo ang akto sang pagpakighilawas ni Stenson sa biktima.
english: Stenson's electronic devices also contained pictures and videos of minors including the act of Stenson having sex with the victim.

text: Suno pa sa US DOJ, may nakit-an man nga mga bastos nga mensahe sa mga menor de edad, kag gintulod man ni Stenson ang mga biktima nga magpakighilawas sa isa pa ka lalaki nga si John Burgdorff, 66, nga residente man sang West Allis sa Wisconsin.
english: According to the US DOJ, obscene messages were also found to minors, and Stenson also pushed the victims to have sex with another man, John Burgdorff, 66, also a resident of West Allis, Wisconsin.

text: Nag-upod si Burgdorff kay Stenson sa Pilipinas kag gin-haylo ni Stenson ang mga biktima nga magpakigkita sa iya nga upod.
english: Burgdorff accompanied Stenson to the Philippines and Stenson persuaded the victims to meet with him.

text: Na-identify si Stenson paagi sa CyberTipline Report halin sa National Center for Missing and Exploited Children.
english: Stenson was identified through a CyberTipline Report from the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children.

text: Pareho nga gindakop sanday Stenson kag Burgdorff sa balay ni Burgdorff sa West Allis kag ginkasuhan bilang co-defendants may kaangtanan sa sex trafficking sa minor victims.
english: Both Stenson and Burgdorff were arrested at Burgdorff’s home in West Allis and charged as co-defendants in connection with sex trafficking to minor victims.

text: Suno pa sa US DOJ, na-sentensyahan si Burgdorff sang Nobyembre 2022 sang duha ka tuig kag tunga nga pagka-preso.
english: According to the US DOJ, Burgdorff was sentenced in November 2022 to two and a half years in prison.

text: Si Stenson naman ang mapreso sa 10 ka tuig kag ginmanduan nga magbayad sang $40,000 ukon masobra P2.2-million sa restitution kag $10,000 ukon masobra P560,000 sa special assessment.
english: Stenson was sentenced to 10 years in prison and ordered to pay $40,000 or more than P2.2-million in restitution and $10,000 or more than P560,000 in special assessment.

text: Kun makaguwa na sa presuhan, ipaidalom gihapon ang 10 ka tuig sini sa supervised release.
english: Once released from jail, he will still be subject to 10 years of supervised release.

text: Nagbulig sa imbestigasyon sa kaso ang Pilipinas kaupod sa Homeland Security Investigations sang Milwaukee kag Bangkok, kag amo man ang Manila Transnational Criminal Investigation Unit.
english: The Philippines assisted in the investigation of the case along with the Homeland Security Investigations of Milwaukee and Bangkok, as well as the Manila Transnational Criminal Investigation Unit.

text: Luyag klaruhon ni Senate Minority Leader Koko Pimentel kay Senate President Francis Escudero kun ngaa gin-isol sini ang presentasyon sang articles of impeachment batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Senate Minority Leader Koko Pimentel wants to clarify to Senate President Francis Escudero why he postponed the presentation of the articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Natalana kuntani ini sa Hunyo 2 ukon sa Lunes na apang gin-saylo sang senate president sa Hunyo 11 bangud may unahon suno sa iya nga mga hagna nga dapat ipasar.
english: It was scheduled for June 2 or Monday but the senate president moved it to June 11 because he said there were priorities for bills to be passed.

text: Ini suno kay Escudero amo man ang items nga yara sa legislative agenda sang administrasyon nga kinahanglan ipasar antes magtakop ang 19th Congress sine die sa Hunyo 14.
english: Escudero said these are also items on the legislative agenda of the administration that need to be passed before the end of the 19th Congress sine die on June 14.

text: Apang para kay Pimentel, dapat nga mas mahatagan sang ligwa ang impeachment proceedings kag ini ang santo sa nakabutang mismo sa probisyon sa impeachment rules sa Senado.
english: However, for Pimentel, the impeachment proceedings should be given more flexibility and this is in accordance with the provisions of the impeachment rules in the Senate.

text: Dugang sini, indi na dapat paglainon pa ang impeachment calendar bangud nga matabo na sa Hulyo ang full-blown trial batok sa bise-presidente.
english: He added that the impeachment calendar should not be changed because the full-blown trial against the vice-president will take place in July.

text: Sanday Senator Sherwin Gatchalian, Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada, kag Senator Imee Marcos ang naga-ugyon naman sa desisyon sang Senate President.
english: Senator Sherwin Gatchalian, Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada, and Senator Imee Marcos agreed with the Senate President's decision.

text: Sa joint statement nanday House deputy minority leader kag ACT Teachers party-list Rep.
english: In a joint statement, House deputy minority leader and ACT Teachers party-list Rep.

text: France Castro kag ACT Teachers party-list Rep.-elect Antonio Tinio, ila ginpahayag ang kahangawa sa desisyon ni Escudero.
english: France Castro and ACT Teachers party-list Rep.-elect Antonio Tinio, they expressed concern over Escudero's decision.

text: Ginsiling nga ang kada delay sa impeachment trial ang nagapataas sang espekulasyon nga pagbasura sa articles of impeachment.
english: It is said that every delay in the impeachment trial increases the speculation that the articles of impeachment will be rejected.

text: Para naman sa bise-presidente, wala sang problema sa iya kun ma-delay ini kag ginatugyan na sini sa iya mga abogado ang dalan sang trial.
english: As for the vice-president, he has no problem if it is delayed and he is leaving the trial to his lawyers.

text: Gin-ugyunan man ni Sara ang recent findings sang Social Weather Stations nga 88% sa 1,800 respondents ang nagasiling nga sabton sini ang impeachment charges kag ang mga alegasyon nga ginahaboy batok sa iya agud malimpyuhan man ang iya pangalan.
english: Sara also agreed with the recent findings of Social Weather Stations that 88% of 1,800 respondents say she will answer the impeachment charges and the allegations thrown against her to clear her name as well.

text: Pebrero sang gin-impeach sang Kamara ang vice president.
english: The House impeached the vice president in February.

text: Yara ini subong sa The Hague, Netherlands agud magbisita sa iya amay nga si former President Rodrigo Duterte nga naka-detain sa ICC facility.#
english: He is currently in The Hague, Netherlands to visit his father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, who is detained at the ICC facility.

text: Ginklaro sang Department of Health (DOH) nga mild variant lamang sang monkeypox cases ang na-detect subong sa Pilipinas nga amo ang tayuyon nga gina-monitor sang awtoridad.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) clarified that only mild variant of monkeypox cases have been detected in the Philippines which is being constantly monitored by the authorities.

text: Suno kay Health Secretary Ted Herbosa, ini nga mpox Clade II ang tuman ka tahaw kag sarang maglaton paagi sa skin-to-skin contact.
english: According to Health Secretary Ted Herbosa, this mpox Clade II is very contagious and can be transmitted through skin-to-skin contact.

text: Gin-athag man sang ahensya nga pila sa fatalities nga ila na-rekord ang wala napatay bangud sa mpox kundi sa kumplikasyon dala sang advanced human immunodeficiency virus ukon HIV.
english: The agency also clarified that some of the fatalities they recorded were not due to mpox but to complications caused by the advanced human immunodeficiency virus or HIV.

text: Sa pihak sini, todo-panagang ang pungsod suno sa ahensya agud nga indi makasulod ang Clade 1b variant nga amo ang mas madasig maglaton kag mas delikado.
english: Meanwhile, the agency said the country is fully precautionary to prevent the entry of the Clade 1b variant, which is more transmissible and more dangerous.

text: Lakip sa latest cases amo ang sa Davao Region, amo man sa Iloilo City kag Iloilo Province sa Western Visayas.
english: Among the latest cases are in the Davao Region, as well as in Iloilo City and Iloilo Province in Western Visayas.

text: Ang sintomas nga ginabantayan para sa mga malatnan sang mpox amo ang rashes ukon ang mucosal lesions nga mahimo maglawig sang duha tubtub sa apat ka semana.
english: The symptoms to watch for in mpox infections are rashes or mucosal lesions that can last two to four weeks.

text: Ang rashes nga ini ang mahimo man dunganan sang hilanat, sakit sang ulo, pagpalanakit sang lawas, pagluya, kag swollen lymph nodes.
english: These rashes may also be accompanied by fever, headache, body aches, weakness, and swollen lymph nodes.

text: Pagpalayo sa iban nga mga tawo, husto nga pagtatap, kag pagpahuway ang kinahanglan agud nga maka-recover ang pasyente nga may amo sini nga kondisyon.
english: Isolation, proper care, and rest are needed for a patient with this condition to recover.

text: Nagpaandam ang defense minister sang China nga makatuga sang ginamo kun iga-establisar ang alyansa sang militar sa Asia-Pacific nga daw kaangay sang North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO).
english: China's defense minister has warned that establishing a military alliance in the Asia-Pacific similar to the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) could create chaos.

text: Ang NATO amo ang intergovernmental military alliance sa tunga sang 31 ka member states kun sa diin 29 ang European kag duha ang North American.
english: NATO is an intergovernmental military alliance between 31 member states of which 29 are European and two are North American.

text: Suno kay Chinese Defense minister Li Shangfu, kun kaangay sa NATO ang ang alyansa sa Asia-Pacific, daw kaangay lang nga gina-kidnap ang regional countries.
english: According to Chinese Defense Minister Li Shangfu, if the Asia-Pacific alliance is like NATO, it is like kidnapping regional countries.

text: “Attempts to push for NATO-like (alliances) in the Asia-Pacific is a way of kidnapping regional countries and exaggerating conflicts and confrontations,” suno kay Li sa security conference sa Singapore kun sa diin yara man si US Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin.
english: “Attempts to push for NATO-like (alliances) in the Asia-Pacific is a way of kidnapping regional countries and exaggerating conflicts and confrontations,” Li said at a security conference in Singapore where US Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin was also present.

text: Ang komento sang opisyal ang kasunod sang tuman ka lapit nga paglayag sang military vessels sang Amerika kag China sa Taiwan Strait — isa ka insidente nga ginkaakig sang isa ka isa.
english: The official's comments follow American and Chinese military vessels sailing too close together in the Taiwan Strait — an incident that has drawn mutual anger.

text: Wala sang ginpangalanan si Li apang ang iya komento ang gina-angot sa madugay na nga kritisismo sang China batok sa Amerika bangud sa military alliances sini sa Asia-Pacific.
english: Li did not name anyone but his comments were linked to China's long-standing criticism of the United States over its military alliances in the Asia-Pacific.

text: Myembro ang Amerika sang AUKUS alliance kun sa diin yara man ang Australia kag Britain.
english: The United States is a member of the AUKUS alliance, which also includes Australia and Britain.

text: Yara man ang US sa QUAD group kun sa diin yara ang Australia, India kag Japan.
english: The US is also in the QUAD group with Australia, India and Japan.

text: “Today’s Asia-Pacific needs open and inclusive cooperation, not buddying up into small cliques.
english: “Today’s Asia-Pacific needs open and inclusive cooperation, not buddying up into small cliques.

text: We must not forget the severe disasters brought by the two world wars to peoples of all countries, and we must not allow such tragic history to repeat itself,” pahayag pa ni Li sa amo nga summit.
english: We must not forget the severe disasters brought by the two world wars to peoples of all countries, and we must not allow such tragic history to repeat itself,” Li said at the summit.

text: Nagpanindugan si Department of the Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla nga padayunon nila ang pagpasaka sang kaso batok sa Russian vlogger nga si Vitaly Zdorovetskiy.
english: Department of the Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla insisted that they will continue to file a case against Russian vlogger Vitaly Zdorovetskiy.

text: Gintuad ni Remulla nga nagsulat sa iya ang Russian vlogger samtang yara ini sa sulod sang presohan nga nagahangyo nga kun pwedi nga buy-an na ini siya.
english: Remulla admitted that the Russian vlogger wrote to him while he was in prison asking him to release him if possible.

text: Nakabutang sa sulat nga naga-experyensya ini siya sang mental health issues.
english: The letter said he was experiencing mental health issues.

text: Suno kay Remulla, indi dapat pagpabay-an ang ginhimo sang Russian vlogger.
english: According to Remulla, the Russian vlogger’s actions should not be taken lightly.

text: Sa masunod nga semana, igapasaka na ang kaso nga unjust vexation batok kay Zdorovetskiy bangud sa pagpang-harass sa tatlo ka security guards.
english: Next week, a case of unjust vexation will be filed against Zdorovetskiy for harassing three security guards.

text: Nahibaluan na gihangyo sadto sang abogado ni Zdorovetskiy nga makipag-areglo sang mga security guards.
english: Zdorovetskiy's lawyer had previously asked the security guards to make arrangements.

text: Una nga ginbasura sang Prosecutors’ Office sang Taguig ang kaso nga theft bangud sa wala sang maathag nga ebidensya kag ang nakita lamang nga kaso amo ang unjust vexation.
english: The Prosecutors' Office of Taguig initially dismissed the theft case due to lack of clear evidence and found only unjust vexation.

text: Madumduman nga ginreklamo ang Russian vlogger bangud sa ginhimo nga pagpangbastos sa mga gwardya sang mall kag iban pa nga establisyemento.
english: The Russian vlogger was complained of abusing mall guards and other establishments.

text: Mangin si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang wala man nalipay sa ginpang-ubra sang Russina vlogger kag ginahangkat man sang Presidente ang mga otoridad nga kasohan ini.
english: the President also challenged the authorities to prosecute him.

text: Ginpahayag ni National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Jaime Santiago nga nagplastar sang pila ka kondisyon ang gobyerno sang Timor-Leste antes ini nagpasugot sa deportasyon ni anay Negros Oriental Rep.
english: National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Jaime Santiago said the government of Timor-Leste laid down several conditions before it agreed to the deportation of former Negros Oriental Rep.

text: Arnie Teves Jr.
english: Arnie Teves Jr.

text: pabalik sa Pilipinas.
english: back to the Philippines.

text: Isa sa mga ginpatuman nga kondisyon amo ang pag-isyu sang certificate of handover nga nagamando nga dapat tratuhon si Teves sa makatawo nga pamaagi kag indi dapat presuhon sang sobra sa 40 ka tuig.
english: One of the conditions imposed was the issuance of a certificate of handover ordering that Teves should be treated humanely and should not be imprisoned for more than 40 years.

text: Ginsaysay ni Santiago nga suno sa Article 70 sang Revised Penal Code, ginapahamtang sang 3-fold rule nga ang maximum nga sentensiya sang isa ka convicted person, apisar pa man damo ang kaso, limitado lamang sa 40 ka tuig nga pagkapreso.
english: Santiago explained that according to Article 70 of the Revised Penal Code, the 3-fold rule stipulates that the maximum sentence of a convicted person, despite the many cases, is limited to 40 years in prison.

text: Dugang pa nga kondisyon amo ang pagpaniguro nga indi mag-agi sa torture si Teves kag dapat nga madetine lamang siya sa mga pasilidad nga nagasunod sa international standards.
english: Another condition is to ensure that Teves does not undergo torture and that he should be detained only in facilities that meet international standards.

text: Ginpasiguro man sang Timor-Leste nga indi pagpasakaan si Teves sang sentensya sang kamatayon kag dapat siya hatagan sang patas kag public trial base sa layi sang Pilipinas.
english: Timor-Leste also assured that Teves will not be sentenced to death and that he should be given a fair and public trial based on Philippine law.

text: Mahimo nga magpangatubang sang kaso nga libel ang mga indibidwal nga nagapalapta ilabi na ang mga nagahimo sang ‘fake news’.
english: Individuals who spread the news, especially those who create fake news, may face libel charges.

text: Ini kasunod man sang pagduging sang peke nga mga impormasyon sa social media.
english: This also follows the proliferation of fake information on social media.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Richard Habawel, Assistant Chief sang Regional Anti-Cybercrime Unit 6 (RACU-6), iya ginpahayag nga mas nagdata pa gid ang fake news subong kasunod sang pagkaaresto kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Colonel Richard Habawel, Assistant Chief of the Regional Anti-Cybercrime Unit 6 (RACU-6), said fake news has increased following the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Suno kay Habawel, lakip sa mga peke nga impormasyon nga nagalapta amo ang mga spliced videos ukon ginpang-utod nga video kag ginpaslakan sang lain nga audio agud makahimo sang bag-o nga content.
english: According to Habawel, among the fake information that is spreading are spliced ​​videos or cut videos and mixed with different audio to create new content.

text: May yara man sang artificial intelligence ukon AI generated videos nga ginagamit agud nga mapapati ang mga social media users.
english: There are also artificial intelligence or AI generated videos used to convince social media users.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga mahimo magapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act No.
english: He also explained that he may face charges of violating Republic Act No.

text: 10175 ukon Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012 ang sin-o man mapamatud-an nga nagapalapta sang fake news.
english: 10175 or the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012 anyone found guilty of spreading fake news.

text: Naaktuhan sang isa ka sipulturero ang duha ka mga estuyante nga nagahimo sang kamala-malahan sa isa ka patyo sa La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: A gravedigger caught two students committing a crime in a courtyard in La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Giger Poblacion, sipulturero, iya ginpahayag nga Byernes sang udto, Marso 14, 2025, may nagsulod nga babaye sa patyo kon sa diin, wala siya naglaum nga may lalaki na gali nga nagahulat sa iya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Giger Poblacion, a gravedigger, said that on Friday afternoon, March 14, 2025, a woman entered the cemetery where she did not expect that there was a man waiting for her.

text: Suno kay Poblacion, sa amo nga tion, nagahimo sila sang iya anak sang pantyon sang nasaksihan sini ang indi manami nga hitabo.
english: According to Poblacion, at that time, he and his son were building a grave when he witnessed the unpleasant incident.

text: Ginlaragway man sini nga abi niya sa una, nagaistoryahanay lang ang duha, apang ulihi, natukiban sini nga nagadumugay na sila.
english: He also described that at first he thought the two were just talking, but later, he discovered that they were dating.

text: Sa amo nga tion, napuwag ang mga estudyante kag nagpalagyo.
english: At that moment, the students panicked and ran away.

text: Ginhawidan naman sang natungdan ang lalaki kag ginprangka pamangkot kon naga-ano sila sa lugar.
english: The man grabbed the man and asked him what they were doing in the area.

text: Gilayon man nga ginpanginwala sang lalaki nga wala sila may ginhimo apisar sang nasaksihan mismo sa akto sang sipulturero.
english: The man immediately denied that they did anything despite witnessing the act of the gravedigger.

text: Gintuad man sini nga tunga sa oras nga nagpabilin sa sulod sang patyo ang duha antes nga nagguwa.
english: He also admitted that the two stayed inside the courtyard for half an hour before coming out.

text: Opisyal nga nagpanumpa subong nga adlaw, Mayo 30, si Senator-elect Bam Aquino sa iya hometown sa probinsya sang Tarlac.
english: Senator-elect Bam Aquino was officially sworn in today, May 30, in his hometown in Tarlac province.

text: Ginpangunahan ni Conception Mayor Noel Villanueva ang pagpanumpa ni Aquino sa isa ka seremonya nga ginpatigayon sa Conception Municipal Government Center.
english: Conception Mayor Noel Villanueva presided over Aquino's swearing-in ceremony held at the Conception Municipal Government Center.

text: Nag-upod man sa okasyon si Tarlac 1st District Representative Jaime Cojuangco kag 3rd District Representative Bong Rivera.
english: Also present on the occasion were Tarlac 1st District Representative Jaime Cojuangco and 3rd District Representative Bong Rivera.

text: Ginpahayag ni Sen.-elect Aquino nga wala siya sang iban nga lugar nga naisip nga mas angay ukon maayo para sa iya pagpanumpa kundi ang Conception, Tarlac, bilang iya pinalangga nga banwa.
english: Sen.-elect Aquino said he did not think of any other place more suitable or good for his swearing-in than Conception, Tarlac, as his beloved town.

text: Suportado ni US President Joe Biden ang iban nga mga pungsod nga nagtinguha nga mapa-hanas ang Ukrainian pilots sa mas moderno nga fighter aircraft lakip na sa F-16 fighter jets.
english: US President Joe Biden supports other countries that have sought to train Ukrainian pilots in more modern fighter aircraft including F-16 fighter jets.

text: Ginpahibalo ini ni Biden kadungan sang summit sang Group of Seven (G7) Leaders sa Hiroshima nga ginabug-usan sang United States, Japan, Germany, United Kingdom, France, Canada, kag Italy.
english: Biden made the announcement during the Group of Seven (G7) Leaders summit in Hiroshima comprising the United States, Japan, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Canada, and Italy.

text: Matabo ang training sa guwa sang Ukraine ukon sa site sa Europa kag ginalauman nga binulan pa antes ini matapos.
english: Training will take place either outside of Ukraine or on site in Europe and is expected to take months to complete.

text: Ginalauman man nga sa masunod nga semana magaumpisa ang paghanas sa mga piloto.
english: Pilot training is also expected to begin next week.

text: Ini nga tikang ang ginalauman nga magaresulta sa pagpadala sang dugang nga mas abanse kag mas dalagku nga Western fighter jets sa Ukraine.
english: This move is expected to result in the deployment of additional more advanced and larger Western fighter jets to Ukraine.

text: Gin-abi abi naman ni Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskiy ini nga development: “I welcome the historic decision of the United States and @POTUS to support an international fighter jet coalition.
english: Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskiy welcomed the development: “I welcome the historic decision of the United States and @POTUS to support an international fighter jet coalition.

text: This will greatly enhance our army in the sky.
english: This will greatly enhance our army in the sky.

text:
I count on discussing the practical implementation of this decision at the #G7 summit in Hiroshima.”

Nahibaluan nga wala pa sang Western-designed jets sa Ukraine.
english:
I count on discussing the practical implementation of this decision at the #G7 summit in Hiroshima.”

It is known that there are no Western-designed jets in Ukraine yet.

text: Nagapati ang Kyiv nga mas epektibo ang F-16s ipaanggid sa Soviet-era fighters nga ginagamit sini subong.
english: Kyiv believes the F-16s are more effective compared to the Soviet-era fighters it currently uses.

text: Ang Poland kag Slovakia ang nakahatag naman sang 27 ka MiG-29s sa Ukraine.
english: Poland and Slovakia have provided 27 MiG-29s to Ukraine.

text: Samtang, suno kay Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent sa Japan, ginalauman nga buwas nga adlaw man ang in-person attendance ni Zelensky sa amo nga summit kag ginalauman man nga magapanawagan ini sang dugang nga military aid.
english: Meanwhile, Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent in Japan, said Zelensky's in-person attendance at the summit is expected tomorrow and he is also expected to call for more military aid.

text: Kun madayon ang pagtambong ni Zelensky, ini ang iya mangin una nga byahe sa Asya halin sang ginpatigayon ni Russian President Vladimir Putin ang full-scale invasion sa Ukraine sang Pebrero 2022.
english: If Zelensky's attendance goes ahead, it will be his first trip to Asia since Russian President Vladimir Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.

text: Naka-eksperyensya sang kakulangan sang tubig ang pila ka vendors sa Iloilo Terminal Market.
english: Some vendors in the Iloilo Terminal Market experienced water shortage.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Charlie Chan, federation president sang mga merkado sa Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga may mga pwesto sa merkado nga naka-apply sang koneksyon sang tubig apang ang iban, ang ginpili nga indi na lang magpabutang sang water connection.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Charlie Chan, federation president of markets in Iloilo City, said there are stalls in the market that have applied for water connections but others have chosen not to install water connections.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang mga wala nagpabutang sang koneksyon, ginpili nga magbakal na lang sang ‘tingi-tingi’ nga tubig.
english: He also said that those who did not install connections, chose to buy 'tingi-tingi' water.

text: Suno kay Chan, kon magkulang ang supply, nagabakal sila sang tubig sa pribado nga mga indibidwal nga malapit sa merkado agud makasapin-sapin sa ila kinahanglanon sa tubig.
english: According to Chan, when there is a shortage of supply, they buy water from private individuals near the market to meet their water needs.

text: Gintuad man sini nga gina-supplyan sila sang tubig apang nagakulang sa gihapon.
english: He also admitted that they are supplied with water but still lack.

text: Nakaplastar na man sa mga vendors ang pagsulundan kon luyag nila nga mag-apply sang koneksyon sang tubig.
english: Vendors have also laid down the rules if they want to apply for water connections.

text: Lauman nga maga-sentro ang summit sang Group of Seven ukon G7 leaders sa China kag Russia, ang duha ka mga pungsod nga indi man imbitado sa amo nga meeting.
english: The summit of the Group of Seven or G7 leaders is expected to focus on China and Russia, the two countries that were not invited to the meeting.

text: Maga-umpisa subong nga Byernes ang summit sa Hiroshima, Japan kun sa diin magatambong ang mga lider sang G7 countries nga amo ang United States, Japan, Germany, United Kingdom, France, Canada, kag Italy.
english: The summit will begin this Friday in Hiroshima, Japan where the leaders of the G7 countries of the United States, Japan, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Canada, and Italy will attend.

text: Ang Japan amo ang nagaisahanon nga Asian member sang G7.
english: Japan is the only Asian member of the G7.

text: Ini nga mga pungsod ang palareho nga may economic partnership sa China nga amo ang ikaduha sa pinakadaku nga ekonomiya kag isa sa nagapanguna sa global manufacturing base kag market.
english: These countries both have an economic partnership with China which is the second largest economy and one of the leading global manufacturing base and market.

text: Lauman man nga maistoryahan ang dugang nga sanctions nga posible idagdag batok sa Russia agud nga mapwersa ini nga untaton ang pagsulod kag pag-atake sa Ukraine.
english: Further sanctions that could possibly be added against Russia to force it to stop invading and attacking Ukraine are also expected to be discussed.

text: Posible man nga may yara sang virtual message nagikan kay Ukrainian President Volodomyr Zelensky nga ginalauman na nga manawagan liwat sang dugang nga armas kag military aid agud nga makabato sa Russia.
english: There may also be a virtual message from Ukrainian President Volodomyr Zelensky who is expected to call for more weapons and military aid to fight Russia.

text: Nagprangka si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga wala ini nalipay sa nangin performance sang Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW) para sa mga kosumidor sini sa syudad.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas said he is not happy with the performance of Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW) for its consumers in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga medyo naakig ang alkalde nga sa lima ka tuig nga pagserbisyo sang water utility, wala nila natungdan ang ila trabaho apisar sang minilyon nga investments sang syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said the mayor is a little angry that in the five years of service of the water utility, they have not done their job despite the millions of investments of the city.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, ginlaragway sang alkalde nga “indi enough” ang ila services kag luyag sang sini nga dapat long term ang solusyon.
english: According to Fantilaga, the mayor described their services as “not enough” and he wants the solution to be long term.

text: Ginkumpara man sini ang performance sang water distributor sa power distributor nga MORE Electric and Power Corporation kon sa diin, mas nabatyagan sini ang serbisyo sang MORE Power.
english: He also compared the performance of the water distributor with the power distributor MORE Electric and Power Corporation where he felt better about the service of MORE Power.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa sulod sang lima ka tuig, nakaangkon ang MORE Power sang 13% nga compounded growth rate sa patag sang electricity demand.
english: It is known that in the last five years, MORE Power has achieved a 13% compounded growth rate in the field of electricity demand.

text: Ginpresentar na sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) si anay kongresista Arnolfo “Arnie” Teves Jr.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has presented former congressman Arnolfo “Arnie” Teves Jr.

text: sa media subong nga adlaw, matapos siya madala pauli sa Pilipinas halin sa Timor-Leste.
english: in the media today, after he was brought back to the Philippines from Timor-Leste.

text: Nag-abot si Teves diri sa pungsod sang Huwebes sang gab-i, duha ka tuig matapos sa brutal nga pagpatay kay Negros Oriental Governor Roel Degamo kag siyam pa ka mga indibidwal sa insidente nga natabo sang Marso 4, 2023.
english: Teves arrived in the country on Thursday night, two years after the brutal killing of Negros Oriental Governor Roel Degamo and nine other individuals in an incident that occurred on March 4, 2023.

text: Sa pagpanguna sang NBI, ginpa-atubang si Teves sa media samtang kaupod ang iya iloy nga si Zenaida Teves kag abogado nga si Atty. Ferdinand Topacio.
english: Led by the NBI, Teves was brought before the media while accompanied by his mother Zenaida Teves and lawyer Atty. Ferdinand Topacio.

text: Madumduman nga nadakpan si Teves sang nagligad nga tuig sa isa ka driving range sa Dili, kapital sang Timor-Leste, apang ginpunggan sang korte ang iya extradition.
english: Teves was arrested last year at a driving range in Dili, the capital of Timor-Leste, but the court stayed his extradition.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-anunsyo sang gobyerno sang Timor-Leste sang Miyerkules sang gab-i ang plano nga pag-deport kay Teves, bangud ginalantaw nga peligroso ang iya presensya sa ila seguridad.
english: It is known that the government of Timor-Leste on Wednesday night announced plans to deport Teves, as his presence is seen as dangerous to their security.

text: Ginsiling pa nga kabahin ini sang ila preparasyon para sa full membership sa Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) kag responsibilidad nga magbinuligay sa mga legal nga isyu.
english: He said this is part of their preparation for full membership in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and responsibility to cooperate on legal issues.

text: Pagkatapos sang proseso sang booking kag medical examination, yara na subong sa kustodiya sang NBI si Teves, kag ginapangatubang sini ang mga akusasyon nga may kaangtanan sa pagpatay kay Degamo.
english: After the booking process and medical examination, Teves is now in the custody of the NBI, and is facing charges related to Degamo's murder.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, samtang nagapanghatag sang bulig si Degamo sa iya balay sa Pamplona, may anom ka armado nga tawo nga may mga dala sang riffle kag nakasuksok ang mga ini sang uniporme military kag nagsulod sa compound kag nagpalupok sang Marso 4, 2023.
english: According to the investigation, while Degamo was distributing aid at his house in Pamplona, ​​six armed men carrying rifles and wearing military uniforms entered the compound and opened fire on March 4, 2023.

text: Ginaalegar nga kabangdanan sang insidente amo ang tensyon pagkatapos sang 2022 eleksyon, sa diin si Degamo ang gindeklarar nga daog batok kay Henry Teves, utod ni Arnolfo.
english: The alleged cause of the incident was tension after the 2022 elections, in which Degamo was declared the winner against Henry Teves, brother of Arnolfo.

text: Matandaan nga ginpahalin man si Teves sa House of Representatives sang 2023.
english: Teves was also expelled from the House of Representatives in 2023.

text: Sa pareho nga adlaw sang deportation, nag-upload ang anak ni Teves nga si Axl sang video sa social media nga nagapakita sang pagdakup sa iya amay, kag ginpahayag nga daw gin-“kidnap” ini.
english: On the same day of the deportation, Teves’ son Axl uploaded a video to social media showing his father’s arrest, and said it looked like he had been “kidnapped”.

text:
Samtang si Janice Degamo, asawa ni anay Gobernador Degamo, nagpasalamat sa pagdakop kay Teves kag nagsiling nga isa ini ka “maayo nga tikang padulong sa hustisya.”

Sa pihak nga bahin, ginkalipay man ni Teves nga Nakita niya liwat ang iya Iloy nga si Zenaida Teves matapos ang duha ka tuig.
english:
Meanwhile Janice Degamo, wife of former Governor Degamo, thanked Teves’ arrest and said it was a “good step towards justice.”

On the other hand, Teves was also happy to see his mother Zenaida Teves again after two years.

text: Nagapanawagan man ini nga kun pwedi mapadasig ang proseso sang iya kaso bangud nagapati ini nga matinlo ang iya konsensya.
english: He also called for the process of his case to be expedited because he believes he has a clean conscience.

text: Bastante nga pag-inom sang tubig kada adlaw, paglikaw sa softdrinks kag instant nga mga pagkaon, kag paglikaw man sa mataas nga sugar content.
english: Drinking enough water every day, avoiding softdrinks and instant foods, and also avoiding high sugar content.

text: Ini ang panugyan ni Dr. Diosemil L. Guzman, Pediatric Nephrologists, sa mga ginikanan agud nga malikawan nga maapektuhan ang kidney sang mga kabataan.
english: This is the advice of Dr. Diosemil L. Guzman, Pediatric Nephrologists, to parents to avoid affecting the kidneys of children.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Guzman, iya ginpahayag nga katungdanan sang kidney ang mag-sala kag mag-tinlo, gani nagadugang sa iya nga trabaho kun madamo ang ginakaon sang bata nga lunsay indi maayo sa lawas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Guzman, he said that it is the duty of the kidney to filter and clean, so it increases its work if the child eats a lot of food that is not good for the body.

text: Kun matam-an kag kun may yara na sang balatian ang lawas, dako ang posibilidad suno sa doctor nga maapektuhan ang kidney sang bata.
english: If there are too many and if the body is already sick, the doctor said there is a high possibility that the child's kidneys will be affected.

text: May yara sang hereditary, may congenital ukon inborn nga problema sa kidney apang kadam-an subong pahayag ni Dr. Guzman, secondary na lang ini sa lifestyle diseases.
english: There are hereditary, congenital or inborn kidney problems but most as stated by Dr. Guzman, it's secondary to lifestyle diseases.

text: Nagapanghakroy na ang pila ka mga drivers bangud sa sunod-sunod nga pagtimbuok sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: Some drivers are already complaining about the successive increase in the price of petroleum products.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Robin Villaruz, driver sang jeep nga may ruta nga Leganes- Highway, iya ginpahayag nga tuman na kabudlay para sa ila ang pang-adlaw-adlaw nga pagpangabuhi bangud sa kamahal sang presyo sang gatong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Robin Villaruz, driver of the jeep on the Leganes-Highway route, said it is very difficult for them to make a living due to the high price of fuel.

text: Suno kay Villaruz, haluson na sila makabakal sang ila kinahanglanon para sa ila pamilya bangud nagakadto na lang sa pagpatughong ang ila kita.
english: According to Villaruz, they can almost buy their necessities for their families because their income goes to the transplant.

text: Pahayag pa niya, ini magluwas pa sa arkila sa salakyan nga ginabayaran nila adlaw-adlaw.
english: He said this is in addition to the vehicle rent they pay daily.

text: Suno sa iya, para sa isa ka driver nga wala na sang iban nga palangitan-an, tuman ka budlay ang ila sitwasyon subong.
english: He said that for a driver who has no other livelihood, their situation is very difficult.

text: Nagapangabay man ini nga kuntani makapatuman na sang pagsaka sa pletehan agud nga mabuhinan man ang pagpamigado sang mga ordinaryo nga drivers kaangay niya.
english: He also requested that the fare increase be implemented in order to reduce the poverty of ordinary drivers like him.

text: Pareho nga nagdaog sanday former featherweight world champion Mark “Magnifico” Magsayo kag Olympic bronze medalist Eumir Marcial sa ila tagsa ka hampang sa undercard sang Manny Pacquiao vs Mario Barrios match subong nga Domingo, Hulyo 20, sa MGM Grand sa Las Vegas, Nevada, USA.
english: Former featherweight world champion Mark “Magnifico” Magsayo and Olympic bronze medalist Eumir Marcial both won their respective matches on the undercard of the Manny Pacquiao vs Mario Barrios match this Sunday, July 20, at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA.

text: Ginlutos ni Magsayo ang kasumpong sini nga Mexican nga si Jorge Mata via unanimous decision sa WBC Continental American super featherweight title bout.
english: Magsayo defeated his Mexican opponent Jorge Mata via unanimous decision in the WBC Continental American super featherweight title bout.

text: Tatlo ka judges ang nagpabor sa Pinoy, 100-90, 100-90, 98-92 matapos ang 10 rounds.
english: Three judges favored the Filipino, 100-90, 100-90, 98-92 after 10 rounds.

text: Nagsaka na ang record sang former world champion sa 28-2 nga may 18 knockouts kag na-claim pa ang WBC Continental Americas belt.
english: The former world champion's record has risen to 28-2 with 18 knockouts and the WBC Continental Americas belt has been claimed.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, gintumba naman ni Marcial sa third round ang American fighter nga si Bernard Joseph nga amo ang imbukada nga sambuwa sa undercard.
english: Meanwhile, Marcial knocked out American fighter Bernard Joseph in the third round, which was the opening fight on the undercard.

text: Kasunod sang third-round technical knockout win, nagsaka na sa 6-0 ang professional record sang Olympian nga may 4 knockouts.#
english: Following the third-round technical knockout win, the Olympian's professional record with 4 knockouts has risen to 6-0.

text: Nagplastar sang panibag-o nga ceasefire deal si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky para mag-untat ang pag-atake sang Russia.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has offered a new ceasefire deal to stop Russia's attack.

text: Ginsiling sini nga ang 20-points plan ang ginhimo sang US, Europe, kag Russia nga maghatag sang garantiya nga seguridad sa US, Ukraine kag mga pungsod sa Europa nga magform sang kritikal nga kabahin sang peace deal sa Russia.
english: He said the 20-points plan was developed by the US, Europe, and Russia to provide guaranteed security to the US, Ukraine and European countries to form a critical part of the peace deal with Russia.

text: Ginakabig man ini nga pinakali-ot nga ceasefire deal nga ginaduso sang US.
english: It is also considered the shortest ceasefire deal proposed by the US.

text: Hulaton na lamang niya ang sabat subong sang Russia tuhoy sa panibag-o nga ceasefire deal.
english: He will now wait for Russia's response to the new ceasefire deal.
